dpenyu/ /mi che'i byang ba brjod pa/༄ 5 podeb gnyis pa/ gogyidabemado khang / tha'ikazlosno 4shārnyi5kāṣ+ṭhastag lha phun tshogs bkra shis kyis brtsams/bkra shis che ༷༷ waX wawa /ga ༷sa ston gnang /

dkar chagarnga/ bcad bzhi pa/le tshan bcu bdun pa/ bod kyishar phyogs nas rlungs dmar 'tshubapa/ 7le tshan bco brgyad pa/ 'dra mnyam min pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun / 23le tshan bcu dgu pa/ grosamathun don tshan bcu bdun bzhagarjes kyi shugs rkyen dang / srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi mdzad 'khur 'jog dgos byung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ 57le tshan nyi shu pa/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i phyi 'brel las khungs kyi grub tshul dang / rjes su rgya phyogs la be+e bsgril btang skos 117le tshan nyer gcig bod dmagagi lo rgyus rogabasdus dang / gus la 7rgyal ba'i sku srung mda' dpon bsko bzhag stsal ba'i skos 131sa bcad lnga pa/le tshan nyer gnyis pa/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po pe cing du chibs sgyur brtukhoras pa/ ’0 9le tshan nyer sum pa/ ming don mi mtshungs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gsar 'dzugs byas pa/ 173le tshan nyer bzhi pa/ rgya gar gzhung gis gdan zhus ltar 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gnas gzigs su chibs sgyur mdzad pa/ 〉gyi

le tshan nyer lnga pa/ bod sdod rgya mi'i mtho rim nang khul brnag sems lkog gnod kyi 'thab rtsod skos na01le tshan nyer drug pa/ bod kyi mdo stod smad sa khul du btsan rgol gyi me lce de rim bzhin dbus phyogs su mched pa/ na17sa bcad drug pa/le tshan nyer bdun pa/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod rang btsan slar gso'i btsan rgol gyi las 'gul langs pa na51le tshan nyer brgyad pa/ 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor hrag bsdus dang bcas nor gling pho brang nas gsang stabs kyis chibs bsgyur bskyangs pa/ na87le tshan nyer dgu pa/ rgya gar la btsan byol du bskyod pa/ 315le tshan gsum cu pa/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog gis dbu 'khrid bskyangs pa'i bod mi'i btsan byol gzhung gsar gtod kyi lam lugs/ 337le tshan so gcig pa/ phyi lo 1952 lor rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis bod hin sa mtshams la drag dpyang gdong thug gi rgyu rkyen/ 357zur 'dzazag skya dpar khag cig bzhugs/ 385
pe

sa bcad bzhi pa/le tshan bcu bdun/bod kyi shar phyogs nas rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ra༅༅/ /de sngon phran bka' sbug tu sdod ring 'bras ljongs mi rigs yin pa bkris 'ba' pu zhu ba dgung lo 50 lhag tsam phebs pa zhig phrad byung ba khong ni 'bras spyi blon chen yig tshang gi las byed byed myong ba/ bar lam rgas yol thob nas 'bras ljongs khul la kong ri si tshogs pa gsar 'dzugs kyis khong gis tshogs pa de'i spyi khyab kyi 'gan khur bzhin yod zer/ khong gis rgya gar rang btsan sang gnangs tsam thob gtan gtsang ma 'khel yod pas rang cag skad yig dang chos lugs goms gshis bcas gcig gyur yin pa'i bod dang / 'bras ljongs/ 'brug yul bcas kyi hi ma la ya'i mnyam sprel rgyal khab ces pa zhig gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu'i thabs 'tshol gyi las 'gul 'phral nas myur du spel rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang dgos pa'i dus tshod cig la slobs yod/ de sngon bod gzhung gi sku drag ngo shes re zung la bsam tshul de zhu rgyu byung zhes gsungs byung /rjes su phran lha sar 'byor rjes nyin zhig bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyi sku mdun du las don gzhan zhig gi zhor la de'i skor gleng mol zhus par/ khong gi kyang gnas tshul de de sngon nas thos myong zhes gsung pa las de min gang yang gsung ma byung /7

phran tsho lha sar rla shas lhod sdod byas rjes phran bza' tsho gnyis kyis bu mo mkha' 'gro che ring mnyam khrid kyis gtsang khul 'grong rtse gzhis su bskyod de de gar lo gcig tsam ring bsdad nas lo de'i dgun dus bkris lhun po dang / snar thang / sa skya/ lha rtse/ phun tshogs gling / de'i lam 'khel gyi dgon pa dang / ri khrod bcas su gnas mjal du bskyod de rla gnyis min tsam 'gosaskabs der bod gzhung gi bkris lhun po'i chos srid gnyis kyi spyi khyab skyabs dbyings dza sag bla ma gsar pa rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel bsko brdzong gis sa gnas su phebs bzhugs gnang 'dug pas khong gis phran bza' mi gnyis la sne len gzab rgyas gnang byung / skyabs dbyings dza sag bla ma zhes pa'i go gnas de paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag mdzod yin/ de sngon paṇa chen sku gong ma rgya nag tu gsang phebs rjes bod gzhung gis gzhung zhabs ser mo ba gnad yod cig bsko brdzongs gnang ba yin/ phran tshos gong gsal gnas mjal zhus rjes slar yang bkris lhun por phyir 'khor gyis nyin shas bsdad nas 'brong rtse gzhis su phyir log byas/1948 lo'i ston dus lha sar phyir log skabs der gong zhus ltar/ rgya nag gi gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur pa'i 'og lo de'i ston dus rgya gar gzhung gsar pa'i srid blon paṇa〉ta niha rus 'bras ljongs su bca' bzhugs chab srid spyi khyab (rgya gar gzhung gi 'bras ljongs su bca' bzhugs chab srid spyi khyab pa / deyal (mas21557sa bsatwa ji) bodadu ched brdzong gis lha sar phebs nas de sngon bod dbyin gnyis kyi 'brel ba de rgya gar rang btsan thob nas rgya gar gzhung gsar pa nas da mus bzhin 'grel ba mjug skyong gnang phyogs skor bod gzhung dang gros mol gnang rgyu'i ched du phebs pa de ni rgya gar rang btsan thob nas rgya gar gzhung gi 'bras spyi bod du phebs thengs dang po yin 'dug8

khong lha sar phebs nas thog ma'i 'char gzhi zu gcig tsam ring lha sang bzhugs nas 7gong sa chen po mchog dang / srid skyong stag brag rin po che rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad gus btud dang 'brel bod gzhung bka' blon rnams dang / dpon rigs gnad yod che khag bcas mjal 'phrad kyis sngar srol ltar 'tshams rtags 'bul rgyu dang / de nas bka' shag lhan du slad bod hin gnyis kyis 'brel lam sngar bzhin 'dzin phyogs skor dang / lhag par bod hin dbar gyi sa mtshams mekha ma ton sa thig bkod pa'i chings yig de da ༷sa rang sor 'jog dang 'jog min skor gros mol gnang dgos yod med bod gzhung la bsam tshul bton te/ bod gzhung bka' shag gis nang gros gnang skabs bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas/ de sngon bod gzhung dang / dbyin ji'i dbar bzhag pa'i chings yig dang / mekha ma ston thig tshad bkod pa de las btsan pa mi 'dug pas da rgya gar gzhung gsar pa dang / slar yang de'i skor bsgyur bcos lta bu'i bka' mol gnang dgos e yod ces dgongs tshul gnang ba der bka' blon lhan rgyas nas thugs mos byung ste/ 'bras spyi rda yal la mkhas po'i thog nas dgongs tshul bton stabs 'bras spyi rda yal lha sar zu gcig tsam bzhugs 'char der ma gnas par glo bu ra du lha sa nas phyir log phebs dgos byung /de'i yong rkyen ni bka' shod pas dgongs 'char gnang ba des rkyen pas yin zhes bka' blon zur khang dang / bka' tshab sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa rnam gnyis kyi zhal nas thos byung / gal srid skabs der rgya gar gzhung gi dgongs 'char der nyams zhib gting zab gnang nas slad bod hin rgyal khab gnyis kyi mekha ma hon sa mtshams skoradang / bod rgyal khab kyi chab srid sra brtan yong thabs bcas kyi skor zhib phra'i bka' bsdur gnang snye/ rgya gar gzhung nas bod rang btsan khas len byas pa lta bu'i gros chod 9

yig thog tu 'jog thub pa byung yod na/ da cha'i bod kyi gnas stangs 'di las drag pa zhig yong rgyur the tshom med par snyam/phran lha sar 'byor nas dus yun de tsam ma song ba'i nyin zhig nan cing nas sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog gis lha sdod go min tang don gcod las khungs brgyud phran la tar 'phrin zhig gnang ba'i nang / bar lam khong gi grogs mo kru'u tan dang mnyam du 'jig rten mthun grogs gnang rgyu lam tsam thugs gtan 'khel bas gnas tshul de rgyal yum mchog la thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas bka' 'khrol snyan seng zhu rogs zhes dang /ring min 'khrungs sa bskyon ched gron dngul mi nyung ba zhig 'phral du dngul brjes gtong gnang yong ba zhes gsal ba de skor re zhig 7rgyal yum mchog la snyan seng zhu bde ma byung yang / mtha' ma mi zhu mthu med kyis snyan seng bka' 'khrol zhus te lha sdod rgya gar tsho nga don las khungs brgyud rgya nag hrang had dngul khang brgyud dbyin sgor 40000 dngul brjes phul thub pa byung /skabs der rgya nag byang brgyud sa khul mang che ba gung khran gyis dbang sgyur zin nas rgya nag lho rgyud du nyen kha chen po slebs yod stabs go min tang gzhung gis nan cing dang / hrang tad sa khul 'dzin skyong thub min ma nges pa'i gnas su gyar bar brten 7rgyal yum mchog gis dbus nga tsho tshang ma sku gcen rgyal don gyi sku phyu'i skor thugs khral chen po byung ste/ rgya gar tshong don sku tshab las khungs brgyud rgya nag du bca' bzhugs rgya gar gzhung tshab nas sku gcen rgyal don mchog 'phral myur phyir phebs thub rgyur gang ci'i rogs ram yong ba zhes zhus pa dang / de bzhin lha sdod go min tang don gcod khru'u yi khren shi krang la yang sku gcen mchog gi sku phyur nyes skyon med par rgya gar du 'phral phebs thub thabs rogs ram yong ba zhes nan cing go min tang gzhung la 'phral du snyan seng yod 10

pa zhes zhus pa yin/de rjes hrang had grong khyer gyi spyi khyab drung che de sngon lha sdod go min tang don gcod khru'u yi khru'u krang hren tsung lan dang / sku gcen rgyal don mchog gnyis nas tar 'phrin 'byor gsal du/ khong gtan zhal gnyis sku khams bde po'i thog hrang had nas hong kong bar phebs gtan 'khel yod lugs gsal ba des nga tsho tshang ma blo bde bag phebs su gyur/de rjes sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog gis stong kong nas tar zhig gtong gnang mdzad pa'i nang khong gtan zhal gnyis de khul bde phebs zin pa'i thog rgya gar du gang mgyogs phebs rtsis yod kyang phyag gron ma ldang ba'i gnas tshul chags yod pas 'phral du dngul brjes mi nyung ba zhig gtong thabs yod pa zhes 'khod 'dug par brten phran rgya gar du khyug tsam bskyed de ka la ka ta khul ngo shes rgya mi'i tshong pa zhig brgyud hong kong du gyin sgor khri gnyis dngul brjes kyis phul te khong gtan zhal gnyis ring min rgya gar du phebs te re zhig ka la ka tar gtan bzhugs gnang / dus mtshungs bod gzhung gi rgya nag nan cing du bca' sdod don gcod ngo las rnams bod gzhung gi bka' 'brel ltar rgya nag nas rgya gar du phyir 'then gyis bka' sbyag khul du phebs 'byor gnang zhing /phyi lo 1949 che 7 ches 8 nyin bod gzhung gi lha sdod go min tang don gcod khru'i khru'u krang khyen shi krang bka' shag tu 'bod 'gugs gnang ste bka' shag nas/deng skabs rgya nag tu gung khran tang dang / go min tang dbar nang 'khrug ha cang dza drag yod 'dug pas go min tang gi dmag dpung dang / dpon rigs gang du phyin na'ang gung khran tang gis de'i rjes su bsnyegs te rdung rdeg btang stabs bod gzhung nas go min tang gi lha sdod don gcod khru'u yi ngo las tshang ma'i bde 'jags 'gan blos bzod min la brten ga

bod gzhung gis gnas skabs ring go min tang gzhung dang 'brel ba mtshams 'jog bya rgyur bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas thag gcod gnang ba yin pas/ khyed tshos gza' 'khor gnyis nang bod nas rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu thon chog dgos rgyu ma zad/ de bzhin bod kyi mnga' khul du sdod pa'i rgya mi dang / khams pa'i nang gung khran tang mi rdugs yod rnams bod la bsdad chog gi ma red ces tha chig nan tan gyis bsgrags nas zu 7 ches 17nyin lha sdod go min tang gi don gcod khru'u yi ngo las dang / rgya mi gzhan rnams dang / de bzhin rdugs yod khams pa 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs thon khag gnyis su bgos nas phyir 'bud byas/ bod gzhung gis lha sa nas 'bras ljongs sa mtshams sna stod la bar gang ci'i thad lam bar rogs ram bya ched sne shan bsko bzhag dang / rta khal sogs gra sgrig gnang bar dernams 'dod blo khengs pa byung 'dug go min tang gi lha sdod mi sna rnams bod nas phyir 'bud byas te nyin shas rjes bod gzhung gis bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mar nor 'khrul tshabs chen byung lugs kyi nyes ming du rgya mi dga' nye yin pa red ces btags nas bka' blon gnas dbyungs kyis lho kha sne gdong du rgyang 'bud btang /skabs der mi mang khrod kyi gleng gzhir de sngon ka shod pas rwa sgreng dus 'gyur skabs spyod ngan spel yod pa de da cha rdzun rkub brdol ba red zer ba dang / la las de las gal gnad che ba'i gnas tshul zhig spyi tshogs thog khyab rdugs kyi nyen khar brten khong 'dzin bzung gis med pa bzo rtsis byas pa red ces zer/ gnas tshul ngo ma ji yin su zhig gis rtogs ma thub/skabs der go min tang gi dmag rnams gcig mjug gnyis mthud du pham nyes ri bo nyil ba lta bu byung nas nan cing grong khyer shor ba'i nyin cang ce hris rgya nag rgyal 42

khab kyi srid 'dzin dgongs pa zhus nas tha'i wan du gros/ khong gi tshab du srid 'dzin gzhon pa sdus tsung ren zhes pa de srid 'dzin las tshab tu bsko bzhag byas/ de nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar rgya nag lho phyogs nan cing dang / hrang had / zi khron/ ko'ang tung sogs su rim bzhin krung go gung khran gyi dmag chu lud pa ltar khyab nas sa khul de tshor dbang sgyur byas/phyi lo 1949 che 10 ches 1 nyin ma'o tse tung gis pe cing grong khyer la rgya nag mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab gsar 'dzugs byas lugs 'dzam gling yongs su khyab bsgrags byas/ gong ches nyin a mdo'i khul du 'khrungs pa'i paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i 'os sprul der bod ljongs 'dir 'phral du bcings 'grol gtong rogs zhes kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang / dmag spyi kru'u te gnyis la glog 'phrin gtong bcug pa red/ skabs der paṇa chen gyi 'os sprul khong dgung lo bcu tsam las phebs yod pa ma red/ de'i shugs rkyen bod kyi mdo stod smad phyogs su rim pas khyab nas bod dang tha'i wan sa khul gnyis bcings 'grol gtong rgyu lag len bstar gyi yin lugs zhes rlung 'phrin thog yang yang khyab spel byas shing / lo de zu 11 ches 33 nyin ma'o tse tung gis nub byang cus kyis tru'u ci dang po pheng te ho'i la glog 'phrin btang ba'i nang / da lta'i gnas bab la gzhigs na bod du dpung 'jug gi las 'gan gtso bo nub byang cus nas 'khyer dgos pa dang / de 'og lho nub cus kyi las 'gan 'khu ra te rgyab skyor byed dgos rgyu/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni a mdo mtsho sngon nas dbus su sa khod snyom po yod skad dang / de bzhin paṇa chen chogs khag kyang mtsho sngon du gnas yod par brten nga tshos paṇa chen tshogs khag brtson len gyis chab srid thad 'os mtshams kyi sgyur bkod byed dgos pa dang / 'tsho ba'i thad lta skyong byed dgos/ lho nub cus nas si khron dang / shi khams (mdo stod smad 13

phyogs gyi sa khul /btsan bzung byas nas bod du dpung 'jug bya rgyu/ bod du dpung 'jug byed par dmag sgar cun gsum dgos gal (cun re la dmag 'bor khri bzhi yas mas tsam yod/'dug ces gsal ba dang / de'i rjes tsam ma'o tse tung gi bsam par bod ljongs dbus phyogs su dpung 'jug lag len 'phral du bstar na rgyal spyi'i thog la gnas tshul ji chags thad som nyi byung ste lo mjug tsam la mo si khor bskyod zhor ru su'i gzhung gi bsam tshul dang rgyab skyor yong bar byas par ru su'i gzhung gi mos mthun thos ma thag phyi lo 1950 zu 1 tshes na nyin snga dro chu tshod bzhi pa'i thog mo si kho nas rgya nag nub byang cus kyis h+phu'u ci pheng te ho'i brgyud des teng zha'o phing dang / li'u po khrin/ ho lung bcas la bod du dpung 'jug byed rgyu'i don tshan gsum 'khod pa'i mdzub ston gyi glog 'phrin zhig btang ba'i don tshan gnyis par bod la mi 'bor de tsam med kyang de'i rgyal spyi'i thog go gnas ni ha cang gal chen po yin stabs / nga tshos nges par btsan bzung byed dgos pa dang / don tshan gsum pa'i nang gses gnyis par lho nub cus kyi dpung dmag 'phral du dar rtse mdo btsan bzung byas te bod du dpung 'jug gi gra sgrig dang /'char gzhi 'god rgyu'i thog zu ba gsum dang phyed ku'i ring dar rtse mdo nas dpung dmag khag bgos te shis khams (mdosmad phyogs /dang bod kyi sa mtshams bar 'byor thub pa byed dgos bcas dang /1950 lo zu 1 ches 10 nyen ma'o tse tung gis le'u po khren dang / teng zha'o pheng / ho lung bcas la glog 'phrin zhig btang ba'i nang le'u teng li'u po khren dang /teng zha'o bang /sogs nas zu ba dang po'i ches bdun nyin bod du dpung 'jug gi 'char gzhi phul 'byor byung ba de la yongs su rgyab skyor yod/ da ltar dbyin ji dang / hin du/pa gi si than bcas kyi nga tshor ngos len byas 'dis nga chos bod du dpung dmag lag ga

len bstar rgyur phan thogs chen po yod ces bcas krung go'i rgyal khab dbu brnyes rjes kyi ma'o tse tung gi zin bris zhes pa'i nang las gsal/de nas bod kyi smad phyogs sa khul du rim bzhin dpung 'jug gis phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi nus shugs bod nas mtha' sgrod gtong rgyu'i don tshan bcu 'khod gyi yig cha 'grems spel byas par brten bod gzhung gis bod rgya gnyis lo rgyusathog mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yod pa las bod de rgya 'og min pa'i lo rgyus bgrangs shing /gal te rgya nag rgyal khab chen po des bod rgyal khab chung chung zhig 'bu ches chung bzos byas na pho zad mo la thug kyang rgol 'dzings mthar phyin bya rgu yin zhes bod rgya dbyin gsum gyi skad thog nas lha sa'i rlung 'phrin brgyud lan 'debs yongs khyab gsal bsgrags nyin shas ring byas/ skabs der bod skad shod mkhan rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / dbyin skad shod mkhan pho ḍa sa heb ces dbyin ji ba zhig yod pa de yin pa dang / rgya skad shod mkhan phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris kyis shod dgos lugs bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs nas bka' phebs pa ltar nyin ltar snga dgong gnyis su bshad pa yin/skabs der bod kyi shar byang sa khul mdo stod smad gnyis su krung go gung khran tang gi dpung dmag rnams bcings 'grol dmag ces pa'i ming tshog snyan po zhig btags nas dar mdo/ 'jang / rgyal rong / mgo log shar khog co ne/ bla brang /dpa' ris/ mtsho sngon bcas la btsan 'dzul drag shugs kho nas rim bzhin mnga' 'og tu 'jug rtsis kyis bod dbus phyogs su dpung 'jug bya rgyu lag len bstar te ldan ma chos 'khor dgon du glo bur 'jab rgol byas nas bod gzhung gi sa gnas der yod pa'i zhi ba'i las byed dang / rlung 'phrin yo chas bcas btsan 'phrog byas pa sogs kyi 15

chabamado mdo spyi (chab mdor bca' bzhugs mdo smad spyi khyab bam/ mdo spyi bka' blon )lha klu che dbang rdo rje nas lha sa bka' shag tu gnas tshul 'byor/chab mdo mnga' khul de nyen 'gan je cher gyar nas bod gzhung gis rtsis dpon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med la mdo spyi bka' blon las 'phar bsko bzhag gis lha sa nas chab mdor 'phral phebs gnang dgos pa dang / mdo spyi rnying pa bka' blon lha klu che dbang rdo rje gnas skabs ring bka' blon nga phod chab mdor ma phebs bar chab mdor bzhugs rgyu dang / de nas bka' blon las 'phar nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med lha klu che dbang rdo rje'i phyag rogs su bzhugs rgyu gnang yang / bka' blon lha klus lo dus tshang ba'i skor rgyal khab tu snyan zhu rim 'byor la bod gzhung gis gnas skabs ring lho rdzong du bzhugs dgos bka' khyab gnang ba dang / de mtshungs byang rgyud nag chu khul du dmag spyi che ba bka' blon mdo mkhar ba dang / dmag spyi dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims ngo las ched brdzong gnang /skabs der lha sa'i mi dmangs khrod du glu gzhas kyi chig tu/ lha klus glod nas phebs byung / nga phod ngar zhen mi shes/ jo lags ra ga shag gis/ tan tan gnang rogs gnang dang / zhes dang / sngon chad sde pa gzhung la/ stag seng kha sprod yog red/ da ni 'phar ba spyang khyis/ bstan srid rlung la bskur ba/ zhes btang yod/de nas bod kyi byang shar sa khul ldan khog phyogs dang / ri bo che/ smar khams/skam thog gru kha bcas su rgya dmar gyi bcings bkrol dmag gis dus gcig tu btsan 'dzul byas par brten zhi bde bag phebs kyi bde skyed ldan pa'i sa khul de rnams la ltas ngan gyi rlung dmar khyab pa dang / nam mkha' sprin nag 'khrigs nas drag char rlung 'tshub kyi khrod du gnas pa ltar byung ba'i snga rjes su bod gzhung bka' shag nas bod ljongs tshogs 6

'du rgyas bsdus snga rteng rim bzhin bskong tshogs kyis dza drag tshabs che'i gnad don de dag sel thabs su gang dga' ci legs skor tshogs 'dus gros bsdur zab nan gnang ba'i don snying mdzad phyogs ni/ gtso bor rang sa rang srung ched byang shar so so'i sa mtshams su bod kyi rgyal srung dmag sgar khag gtan sdod yod mus kyi dpung bsnon du skabs 'phral dbus gtsang khul nas dmigs bkar grong drag dmag bskul 'phar ma bsdu bskongs mdzad pa'i dmag sgar khag 'go dmag rnams sa gnas so sor gtong gnang thog de dag gi spyi 'doms su bod gzhung gi dmag spyi gzhon pa mkhan chung dga' brang blo bzang rin chen las bya dang bcas bsko gzhag mdzad/de bzhin bod rgyal khab dang phyi 'brel yod pa'i stobs chen rgyal khab a ri dang /dbyin ji/ khyim mches rgya gar dang / bal yul rgyal khab bcas so so nas bod rgyal khab kyi bden rgyab dpung rogs yong thabs zhu bskul ched sku tshab mi sna gsham gsal ltar bsko gtong gnang rgyu/lhag par rgya dmar gung khran gyi spyi khyab ma'o tse tung la bod kyi sa mtshams khag nas rgya dmag gis brgal bskyod gsar spros mi 'byung ba yong thabs bod gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs nas phyi lo 1949 che 13 ches 3 bod sa glang rla 9 ches 13 la yi ge zhig btang ba dang / de mtshungs rgya bod zhi mthun yong ched rgya nag pe cing du bod rgya zhi mol kyi sku tshab ser skya ngo las ched brdzong gnang gtan 'khel te mi 'gro su bzang zan brtag 'bul gnang mdzad pa/ rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan rnam gnyis bsko gzhag gnang / rtsis dpon zhwa skab pas bka' shag tu rgya skad skad bsgyur stag lha phun tshogs bkris bsko bzhag yong ba'i snyan seng zhus don bzhin bka' shag nas srid skyong stag brag rin po che mchog la 'char gzhi phul 17

te nyin zhig shod 'gag nas phran la yig chung 'byor gsal du/ gnangs nyin khyed rang shod 'dag tu ngo bcar dgos lugs phebs pa ltar/ de nyin snga dro shod 'gag tu bcar te sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis phran la/ skyabs mgon srid skyong rin po ches bka' spyi phebs su/ 'char gzhi phyag rtags dgongs don bzhin rang gzhung gi rgya nag tu zhi mthun sne mthud sku tshab gnyis kyi rgya skad skad bsgyur las byar khyod rang stag lha sras phun tshogs bkris la rim bzhi sras rnam pa'i gdan thob thog bsko gzhag bstsal don bzhin/ gsar mjal 'phral du zhus 'brel sku tshab rnam gnyis lhan du 'phral thon gyis zhu bya 'thus shor med pa dgos rgyu zhes bka' bsgyur bstsal/skabs der sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis bka' bsgyur gnang ba'i ring gzhung srol ltar/ phran gyi zhwa mo phud de khong gi mdun du sgur sgur byas nas bka' de rnams nyan rjes nang du phyir log gis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams 7rgyal yum mchog la snyan seng zhus/ gsar mjal zhu rgyu'i ches cha dge ba zhig sman rtsis khang du rtsis 'bras bskor nas nyin gcig gi sngon du skra lcang lo'i steng du gser gyi skra ga'u dang / ser ril smyug khrog sogs rtsis phrug pa'i las zhu las gos cha tshang gyon nas rtsis khang du bcar/spyi srol ltar byas na de nyin rtsis khang du rdel rgyugs dang / yig tshad 'bul dgos kyang / phran la de 'dra'i sbyong brdar byed pa'i go skabs ma byung ba'i thog de'i sang nyin zhabs zhu byed dgos pa'i ches cha gtan 'khel la brten rten 'brel mtshon byed lta bur rdol chas dang / yig chas la lag pa 'chang tsam byas rjes/ rtsin dpon bde mkhar bas/ phyin chad zhabs zhus rjes gzhung sa'i zhabs 'degs lhag bsam dang ldan pa zhu dgos lugs kyi bka' bsgyur gnang /48

de nas rtsis dpon rer rten 'brel gyi mjal dar re phulda nas nang du log rjes lam seng sras rnam pa'i thob thang ltar spa lcog brgyab nas de'i steng du gser gyi skra ga'u brgyab/ de'i sang nyin rgya lu chas cha tshang spras shing / tshos man ser po gyon pa'i g.yog bzhi bcas rta rags bsgrigs nas gzhung pa'i zhabs sdod gsar mjal gyi mdzad sgo'i snga dro gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che jo bo rnam gnyis la mchod mjal zhus shing /de nas rtse pho brang nub brgyud gzim chung nyi 'od du mdzad sgo'i sar 7gong sa mechog dang srid skyong stag brag rin po che'i sku mdun du maṇaḍal rten gsum dang 'brel zhabs sdod gsar mjal zhus/yab gzhis stag 'tshor du phyir log rjes yab gzhis tshoms chen nang 7rgyal yum chen mo bzhugs khri zhig tu bzhugs thog de'i sku 'khris su khri de las dma' tsam zhig gi steng du gos kha gsar pa bsgron thog g.yung drung bris pa de'i steng du bsdad nas gro so phye mar dang / gro ma 'bras sil sogs rten 'brel gyi rdzas rnams rim pas bstar 'bul dang 'brel phran gyis khri de las mar babs nas 7rgyal yum chen mor rten 'brel gyi mjal dar zhig phul te/ slar yang gdan steng bsdad rjes stag 'tshor phyag mdzod dang /zhabs gras rnams gral bstar bsgrigs nas phran la bkris bde legs kyi mjal dar re gnang / de nas ngo shes sku drag khag dang / tshong rigs khag bcas nas rten 'brel gyi mjal dar dang / 'bul tshan bcas gnang ste mdzad sbo legs par grol/nyin de nas phran bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi gzhung zhabs gras su tshud pa der bsam brjod las 'das pa'i dga' spro 'phel zhing / de ni 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bkrin nyag cig la brten nas byung ba zhig yin pas sor bcu'i 'dab ma snying gar bkod de 'di phyi che rabs kun tu mgon po gang de'i thugs rje'i grib bsil ge()

las mi 'bral ba'i smon lam shugs drag btab/de rjes bod gzhung sku tshab rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhu skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan rnam gnyis dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi gcig bcas sngon nas bsko bzhag zin pa'i thog las bya phreng ring sras 'jigs med sum rtsen/ phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris/ rtse drung las tshan blo bzang snyan grags/ shod drung 'bri yul che ring dbang 'dus bcas bsko bzhag gnang nas ngo las rnams la bod gzhung gi phyi rgyal las khungs nas bod shog thog gzhung dam 'khod pa'i phyi rgyal khag tu bskyod 'thus kyi lag 'khyer re gnang zhing / ngo las rnams rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu thon rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/gong smos ltar gyi a mi re ka dang / dbyin ji/ nye 'brel khyim mtshos rgya gar dang / bal yul bcas pas bod gzhung la bden rgyab rogs ram yong ba'i thabs skul ched du a mi re kur tha'i ji sding cha ba dang / mkhan chung thub bstan sangs rgyas gnyis dang / eng lan du g.yu thog bkris don grub dang / mkhan chung thub bstan mkhyen rab/rgya gar du tshong don sku tshab rim bzhi blo bzang che dbang dang / rim bzhi zur khang lha dbang stobs rgyal/ bal yul du chang khyim mkhan chung thub bstan che dpal dang / rim bzhi ches gsum phun khang bcas bsko brdzong gnang ba rnams lha sa nas rgyal rtser phebs 'byor skabs a dbyin rgyal khab gnyis kyis bod gzhung gi sku tshab phebs na 'grigs dang 'grigs min gyi lan gsal sprod rgyur ka kor byas stabs/ sa gnas so sor phebs ma thub pa'i blo pham rang bzhin gyi gnas tshul byung /nga tsho ka la ka tar 'byor skabs sku gcen rgyal don mchog de khul bzhugs 'dug pa sku tshab ngo las rnams kyis khong dang mjal 'phrad gnang / phran yang khong gnyis 20

kyi bzhugs sar yang yang bcar te bar lam rgya nag dang bod kyi gnas bab ji byung skor gleng mol ji snyed byung / rgya dmar gzhung gis stong kong du bzhugs pa'i sku gcen rgyal don mchog gi lcam gyi yab kru'u hre kus la/ bod gzhung sku tshab rnams hong kong du gang mgyogs phebs 'byor yong gi yod 'dug par phebs lhag zhu dgos lugs mngags yod pas khong gis gnas tshul de rnams sku gcen rgyal don mchog brgyud sku tshab mkhan rtsis gnyis la zhus pa ltar de lan du mkhan rtsis gnyis kyis pe cing nas hong kong du sku tshab tshad ldan zhig 'phral du gtong dgos lugs khong gis pe cing la zhu rogs zhes pa'i gnas tshul btang lan du/ khyed rnams hong kong tu gang mgyogs phebs gnang yod pa zhes gsal 'dug dbyin gzhung gi ka tar bca' bzhugs don gcod las khungs su bod gzhung sku tshab ngo las rnams gang mgyogs tong kong du bskyod 'thus kyi thongs mchan yong ba zhus par ka kor kho na'i ngang nas skabs 'phral thon ma thub par ka ta khul du zu ba gcig lhag tsam 'gor te mtha' ma 'bar ma brgyud hong kong du bskyod 'thus kyi thongs mchan thob cing / thon ches gtan 'khel byas kyang rang phyogs nas ka kor kho na'i ngang dus thog tu thon ma thub stabs dbyin gzhung gi sngon du sprad pa'i thongs mchan de yang phyir len byas pa red ces pa'i lan 'byor te nga tsho tshang ma ha las hon 'thor gyi gnas su gyar/ 'on kyang gnas tshul de dag bden rdzun ji yin gsal rtogs ma byung bar ngo las rnams nang gros kyis gal srid dbyin gzhung gis nga tsho hong kong du bskyod ma bcug par ka kor bya rgyu'i bka' btang zin yod na/ nga tshos nges par du dus thog thon rtsis bya rgyu'i rnam 'gyur ston gal 'dug gal srid thon thub pa byung na rgyal khab kyi bka' dgongs bzhin zhu bya'i dmigs yul bsgrub thub pa yong rgyu/ 'on kyang ngo las tshang ma lhan du ma thon par khag bgos kyis snga rting gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel te thon thengs dang por/21

phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / las tshan 'bri yul ba che ring dbang 'dus gnyis thon rgyu dang / thon thengs gnyis par sku tshab mkhan rtsis ngo las rnams phebs thon gnang rgyu byas/ ci ste phran gnyis thon ma thub na phyi'i ltar snang la bod gzhung gis rgya nag la zhi gros byed pa'i sku tshab rnams dbyin jis hong kong du 'gro rgyu'i thongs mchan ma sprad par ka la ka tar bkag 'gog byas pa red ces gnas tshul de rgya phyogs nas nges par shes rtogs yong rgyu dang / de ni dbyin ji gzhung gis bka' 'gog byas pa las bod gzhung sku tshab rnams la kha 'phangs yong gi ma red ces ngo las tshang ma dgongs tshul gcig mthun byung ba ltar/ 1950 zu 4 ches 15 nyin phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang /'bri yul che ring dbang 'dus gnyis ka la ka ta'i gnam gru'i thang du bskyod de tong kong la thon ched gnam thang nas lag sgam gnam gru'i nang du bcug nas phran gnyis gnam gru'i nang 'dzul khar gnam thang du yod pa'i nyen srung pas phran gnyis kyi lag khyer blangs nas gnam grur 'dzul mi chog pa'i bkag 'gog byas rkyen bya thabs gang yang ma byung /skabs der phran gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon du gsar 'god pa mang po 'dzoms yod pa de tshos phran gnyis la par mang po brgyabs pa dang / dre ba mang po byas kyang skad cha ma shes pa'i stabs legs kyis lan rgyag mi dgos pa byung ste gnam thang nas mgron khang du rang sar phyir log byas/de'i sang nyin ka ta khul gyi gsar shog gi mdun shog gi nang du phran gnyis kyi par dang / de'i gsham du bod gzhung gi skya tshab rgya nag tu bskyod pa'i lam bar du glog zhu dmar po zhig spar yod pa red ces pa'i gnas tshul mang dag cig bkod pa rnams 'dzam gling yongs su khyab ste rgya nag gzhung gis btsan rgyal dbyin jis bod kyi sku tshab mes rgyal du zhi gros byed par yong rgyur bkag 'gog byas pa red ces pe cing khul gye 22

gsar shog dang / rlung 'phrin thog nas kha brdung btang /skabs der nga tsho ka ta nas hong kong du thon ma thub pa de mur lus pa'i nyin zhig sku gcen rgyal don gtan zhal rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs yul du bskyod skabs khong gis da cha nga rang sang nyin snga dro 'di nas gnam thog phe li pin du bskyod gtan 'khel song ba khyed kyis 'di skor ma shes pa yin tshul gyis su zhig la'ang ma gsung rogs nga tsho mgyogs po 'phrad kyi red/ ngas bsam pa dang byas pa'i las ka rnams slad 7gong sa mchog dang / a ma lags/ khyed tsho tshang mas 'grigs bzhag ces gsung rgyu yong gi red gsungs byung / phran gyis mi yul thag ring du ma phebs rogagazhes pa'i tshig 'di tsam zhus pa las bka' 'dre gang yang zhu ma thub par sems sdug chen po'i thog nas mgron khang du phyir log byas/de'i sang nyin snga thog khong gnyis kyis zhabs gras shig phran sar yi ge zhig skyel bar gtong gnang mdzad pa'i nang / da res phran bza' tsho gnyis rgya gar nas rgyal khab gzhan du 'gro rgyu yin pa ring min sa gnas de nas khyed la yi ge gtong gi yin pas khyed blo bde po gyis/ da res 'di nas glo bur thon khar rang gzhung sku tshab mkhan rtsis rnam gnyis dang / khyed rang bcas la thon gyi yin lugs tsam ma bshad par phyir thon byas par dgongs 'gal med pa zhu rgyu/ khyed kyis nga tsho'i skor sems khral gnang ma dgos zhes 'khod 'dug pa lta ra/ de skor mkhan rtsis rnam gnyis la zhu skabs ngo las tshang ma ha las pa'i gnas tshul byung zhing / sku tshab mkhan rtsis rnam gnyis kyis rang cigazhung bka' shag tu tar 'phrin thog snyan zhu phul thog khong rnam gnyis dang / las bya bla phyag phreng ring bcas rnam gsum ka ta nas ldi lir phebs te rgya gar gzhung dang / dbyin ji'i ldi lir bca' bzhugs gzhung tshab bcas la rim gyis mjal 'phrad kyis da lam bod gzhung 23

sku chogatshogs pa hong kong du bskyod khar ka ta gnam gru thang du bkag 'gog byas pa'i skor dang / bod kyi byang shar mnga' khul sa mtshams su rgya dmar gyi dpung dmag mang po btsan 'dzul gyi dza drag 'phrad yod par brten bod gzhung sku tshab tshogs pa 'phral nas myur du hong kong du thon thub pa'i thongs mchan gnang skyong yong ba zhes zhus kyang / don son ma byung stabs nga tsho ngo las rnams ka ta nas/ 1950 lo'i zu 9 ches 4nyin ldi ler phebs te rgya gar phyi srid dru che me non (5 5 9lo baXb) dang / srid blon 'jo wa har lal niha ru/ rgya gar dpon rigs gnad yod che khag mjal 'phrad gnang lte bar lam nga tsho bod la dza drag rga dka' ngal ji 'phrad skor rgya gar gzhung gis dka' ngal sel thabs kyi rogs ram gnang rogs zhus par rgya gar phyi srid drung ches/ da cha rgya nag gzhung gsar pas ldi ler gzhung tshab khang gsar 'dzugs gtan 'khel yod pa ring min gzhung tshab gnad yod mi sna yong nye yod pas/ khyed tshos gzhung tshab dang mjal 'phrad kyis bod rgya zhi mthun bka' mol gnang rgyu byung na dge mtshan yod lugs kyi bsam tshul byung ba ltar/ sku tshab ngo las rnams kyis gnas skabs ring rgya nag gzhung gsar pa'i sku tshab mi sna ldi lir 'byor rgyur sgug sdod byas/de rjes rgya gzhung gsar pa'i gzhung tshab las rogs hren can dang / ngo ma de'i rjes tsam gzhung tshab mjal 'phrad kyis phan tshun sku tshab rnams bka' mol ji byung skor mkhas dbang zhwa skab pa mchog gis bka' rtsom mdzad pa'i bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs glegs bam gnyis pa'i sa bcad 30 pa'i nang zhib phra gsal don bzhin 'phros mol gyis mtha' don bod gzhung sku tshab rnams pe cing du thon gtan 'khel te ldi li nas ka ta brgyud hong kong du thon khar/ lha sa nas bka' shag gis/ khyed tsho ngo las rnams gnas skabs ring pe cing du thon thal ma byed ces tar 'phrin phebs pa ltar ngo las rnams ldi li 24

nas bka' sbug khul du phyir log gis rgyal khab kyi bka' ji phebs ltar sgug nas bsdad/dus skabs der rgya dmar gyis zhi drag dpon dmag rnams kyis khams khul gyi sa gnas khag lnga nas chab mdor btsan 'dzul gyis dgra lag tu shor ba'i gnas tshul de'i 'og bod gzhung tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms sar bka' gros rim mdzad skabs tshang mas ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun tu bstan srid nyag phra'i skabs su gyar ba'i dus der 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po sku na shin tu phra bas rang bzhin zhu nus bral yang /gangs can zhing 'di'i 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po'i skyong skal thun mong ma yin par brten chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan bdag gir bzhes pa tsam gyis gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos dge mtshan che nges yong rgyu gdon mi za bas/ bod ljongs lugs gnyis chos srid kyi 'khor lo skyabs mgon don gyi bdag po rang nas thugs 'gan skyong bzhes yong ba zhes lha mi rnams mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa ltar/ thugs 'gan skyong bzhes mdzad rgyu'i bka' bzang spyi bo'i mdzes rgyan du smin pa bzhin srid skyong yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che nas srid skyong mdzad khur khri lo 10 tsam gnang ste lcags stag phyi lo 1950 zu 10 ches 7 nyin mdzad khur dgongs zhu gnang /de'i sang nyin bod zla 10 ches ra phyi lo 195༷ zu 11 ches 17nyin 7gong sa skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen pos bod rgyal khab kyi chos srid lugs gnyis kyi mdzad 'khur bskyed bzhes gnang 'phral skye bo phal cher blo las 'das pa'i mdzad bzang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba zhig ni/ skabs der bod rgyal yongs su khrims 'gal can gyi btson pa yod rigs tshang ma zu ches gong gsal gyi mdzad sgo'i nyin de rang la dus gcig tu glod bkrol gtong dgos pa'i 7gong sa skyabs mgon 25

chen po mchog nas bka' shag tu bka' phab don ltar/ glod bkrol gnang ste btson khang khag gi nang gna' bo'i srol bzang ltar dkar rtsi btang zhing / btson grol gnang khongs su nor gling sku srung dmag sgar du btson du yod pa'i rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku/ lho kha sne gdong rdzong gi btson du yod pa'i ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/ gzhan yang lha zhol gnyis kyi khrims khang dang / rgya khab rdzong gzhis khag mtha' dag gi btson du yod pa'i nyes can yongs rdzogs dus thog tu glod bkrol gnang ba'i rlabs chen mdzad bzang 'dis skabs der bod nang khul du rwa stag gnyis so so'i phyogs zhen gyi 'gal ba sel ba'i sman mchog tu gyur pa ma zad/ phyi phyogs nas rgya dmar btsan 'dzul pa'i nyen tshabs la'ang rang shugs kyi phan nus ldan pa bcas spyi sger gang sar bka' drin gzhal nus bral ba'i mdzad 'phrin bskyangs/gong smos ltar sku tshab mkhan rtsis ngo las rnams bka' sbug tu rgyal khab kyi bka' ji phebs sgug bzhugs pa'i skabs der khong rnam gnyis kyi phran dang 'bri yul che ring dbang 'dus gnyis sgang thog tu gtong gnang gis lha sa bka' shag nas 'bras spyi yig tshang gi skud med rlung 'phrin thog mnyam sgrel rgyal tshogs kyi drung cher 'bul rgyu'i snyan zhu 'byor rim bzhin rtsis len gyi bka' sgug tu skabs 'phral gtong dgos lugs bka' mngags gnang don ltar/ phran gnyis sgang thog tu bskyod nas tar 'phrin 'byor rim bzhin rtsis len gyis mkhan rtsis rnam gnyis kyi phyag tu 'bul brdzong zhus zin rjes bka' sbug tu phyir log byas/skabs der chab mdo mnga' khul rgya lag tu shor zhing / bod mi rnams dngangs skrag dang nyen kha tshabs chen byung bar brten bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po re zhig bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams la nyen g.yol lta bur 26

chibs bsgyur gnang na legs tshul bsam tshul gcig mthun gyis bka' shag brgyud snyan seng zhus pa ltar/ phebs thon gnang rgyu gtan 'khel byung /de'i sngon tsam nas bka' shag tu las don lcogs min la bsnyad de mkhan chung thub bstan rab dbyangs dang / tha'i ji shan kha 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal rnam gnyis la bka' tshab bsko gzhag gnang ba dang / zu 1 ches 13 nyin 7gong sa mchog lha sa nas gro mor phebs thon gnang khar rgyal khab tu chab srid kyi thugs 'gan skyong bzhes gnang mkhan mkhan che blo bzang bkris dang / rtsis dpon bde mkhar ba che dbang rab brtan gnyis la srid tshab bsko bzhag gis chab srid las don byed sgo bka' mngags gnang thog 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams pho brang nas gsang thabs kyis phebs rdog thon te phebs lam rgyal rtse brgyud gro mor zhabs sor 'khod nas re zhig gro mo dung dkar dgon tu bzhugs sgar mdzad/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mdzad rnam las/ skabs der gnas tshul nyen kha can der mi dmangs kyi bsam tshul ji yod shes rtogs ched bka' shag nas tshogs chen zhig bsdu 'gugs byas shing / tshogs 'du'i brjod don la/ rgya nag bcings bkrol dmag nas nam zhig lha sar btsan 'dzul bya rgyur nga'i srog la nyen 'gal mi 'byung ched gro mor 'gro bskyod dgos pa'i re 'dun bton byung / skabs der/ rang ngos nas mi dmangs la rogs ram gang thub byas te sdod 'dod las 'gro rgyur 'dod pa med stabs/ re 'dun de la 'dod babs ma byung na yang bka' shag nas nan brjod che bar brten mthar thug kho tsho'i re 'dun la nyan 'jog byas pa yin zhes gsal/skabs der 7gong sa mchog dgung lo 15 las phebs med na yang / bod la dza drag gi gnas tshul de'i 'og mi dmangs rnams blos gtong mi gnang bar skyed na 27

mnyam skyed dang / sdug na mnyam sdug gi dgongs pa bla na med pa bzhes 'dugarjes su skabs de'i gnas tshul go thos shig la/ bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/bod ljongs tshogs 'du bcas kyis rgya dmar gung khran tang gi byed spyod la yid rton 'pher ba gtan nas med pas lha sar 'jab rgol byas na sku phyu'i nyen srung dang bcas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po re zhig gro mo tsam la chibs sgyur gnang na legs tshul bsam gros gcig mthun gyis 7gong sa chen po mchog la spyi zhus tshig tho 'bul lam zhus pa ltar/ chibs bsgyur bskyang rgyu'i thugs gtan 'khel mtshams gnad yod dpon rigs tshang ma lha sar lus rdugs blo 'tshab kyi ngang nas byes su chibs zhabs khongs phebs 'dod las/ gzhis su rgyal khab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes te bzhugs 'dod gnang mkhan su zhig kyang ma byung / cibaka' shag dang / sku bcar spyi mkhan/ drung rtsis/ dza tha'i sogs gnad yod chibs zhabs su 'os zan brtags zhu gnang gis thon pa rnams phebs pa smos med thog ma thon pa 'ga' shas kyang las ming gzhan btags nas chibs zhabs kyi zur du phebs rgyur thugs gtan 'khel mtshams rgyal khab tu mkhan che blo bzang bkres dang / rtsis dpon bde mkhar ba che dbang rab brtan gnyis la srid blon las tshab bsko bzhag gnang ste gro mor chibs thon gnang ba red zer/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po lha sa nas gro mor chibs bsgyur ma gnang ba'i sngon tsam la chab mdo nas mdo spyi nga phod kyis las bya mi sna gnyis rgyal khab tu chedabardzong mdun rgya phyogs kyis bod gzhung nas zhi mthun sku tshab lha sa sam/ chab mdo/ pe cing bcas gang 'os su bsko bzhag 'phral gtong dgos skor dang / gros don thag ma chod bar rgya dmag lha sar dpung bskyod mi byed pa'i khas len byas yod pa dang / 7gong sa 28

chen po mchog gi sku phyu mdzad 'phrin dang / dpon rigs rnams la gnod skyon rtsa ba nas mi byed pa mdo spyi nga phod ngo las ser skya rnams nas 'gan len zhu gi yin zhes dang /rang gzhung gi sku tshab 'phral du bsko brdzongs gtong gnang mdzad na dge mtshan yod lugs kyi snyan zhu 'byor ba ltar/ rgya phyogs kyis me mda'i 'jigs skul 'og zhi ba'i rnam 'gyur rdzus ma bstan pa der bod gzhung 'u thug thabs bral gyi gnas su gyar nas mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / bsam pho rim bzhi bstan 'dzin don grub rnam gnyis la mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod kyi phyag rogs su bsko bzhag gnang ste lha sa nas chab mdor mngags brdzong mdzad/7gong sa mchog gro mor zhabs sor 'khod rjes sku tshab mkhan rtsis mkhan chung dang / rtsis dpon gyi mtshan gnas yod pa'i ser skya dpon rigs nyis sgrel gyi bsdus ming / rnam gnyis bka' sbug nas gro mo bzhugs sgar du 'phral bcar dgos pa'i bka' rgya phebs 'byor ltar/ gro mor phebs pa'i lhan du phran dang sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma gnyis kyang bcar te gro mor 7gong sa mchog dang / rgyal yum chen mo'i mjal khar bcar/mkhan rtsis rnam gnyis nas byes phebs rgyal blon rnams la/ bar lam rgya nag tu bskyod ma thub pa'i skor dang / rgya gar srid blon dang / gnas yod dpon rigs khag a ri dang / dbyin ji/ bal yul bcas phyi rgyal gzhung tshab khag gi gnad yod mi sna rnams dang mjal 'phrad kyi phan tshun bka' mol ji byung skor/ de bzhin snga rjes su spre lir bca' sdod rgya gzhung gi gzhung tshab thug 'phrad thog bka' mol ji byung skor bcas snyan seng zhus/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i lhan du7rgyal yum chen mo mchog dang /sku'i gcen po spyi mkhan blo bzang bsam gtan/ sku'i gcung mo rje btsun pad+ma/ phran gyi bu 29

bstan 'dzin ngag dbang dang / bu mo mkha' 'gro che ring bcas gro mor bde phebs gnang 'dug de bzhin sku gcen stag 'cher mchog sprul rin po che mdo smad sku 'bum byams pa gling gi khri pa las thog yin bzhin pa'i thog rgya phyogs nas bod du 'thabs phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus lag len bstar ba'i 'og lha sar sku tshab tu ched brdzongs phebs 'byor gyis mdo smad sa khul la rgya dmar gung khran tang gis gsar brjer ngo rgol pa zhes par drag gnon byas pa'i las 'dul dang / 'byor ldan sa bdag rigs don med dmar gsod kyi ngan spyod ci rigs lag len bstar ba'i gnas tshul mngon sum du gzigs shing / skabs der khong stabs legs kyi mdo smad nas lha sar phebs 'byor thog 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du gro mo bzhugs sgar du lhan bzhugs gnang 'dug pa de dus sa gnas der mjal yong bsam pa ma byung bas rmi lam lta bur dngos su mjal bar dga' spro dpag med byung /gro mo bzhugs sgar nas kyang mes tshog mer gtugs kyis zhi gros yong thabs skor rgya dmar gung khran tang gi spyi khyab ma'o tse tung la stsal rgyu'i 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i phyag bris dang sbrags ldi li rgya gzhung bca' sdod gzhung tshab sar bod gzhung phyi srid 'gan 'khur ba zur zur dza sag dbang chen che brtan dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan rnam gnyis/ las bya phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris dang / las tshan sa 'du rin chen bcas la bsko bzhag gis gro mo nas bka' sbyag dang ka la ka ta brgyud ldi li rnying pa'i ri li'i babs tshugs su phebs te dza drung rnam gnyis kyi 'gro gron gang chung gi mgron khang khe po zhig tu khang mig gnyis gla rgyu'i bka' 'phebs par las tshan sa 'du rin chen dang phran gnyis nas mgron khang phran bu drag gras shig ma byung na phyi mis mthong chung byed pa ma zad/ rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya mi'i gzhung tshab mi sna nga tsho'i sar thug 'phrad du yong 30

skabs ngo tsha po yong lugs zhus par/ dza drung gnyis kyis rang gzhung sku ngal yod pa'i dus 'dir nga tshos 'gro gron gang chung btang na ma gtogs mi gzhan gyis zer skad la cha 'jog byed dgos don med ces nan tan gsungs nas/ ldi li rnying pa'i ri li babs tshugs kyi nye 'gram mgron khang ha cang zhan po zhig tu khang rmeg gnyis glas nas khang mig gcig nang dza drung rnam gnyis bzhugs pa dang / de min khang mig gzhan pa de'i nang phran las bya gnyis dang / khong rnam gnyis kyi zhabs gas bcas bsdad/ mi re la nyin re khang gla sgor gnyis dang phyed ka sprod dgos pa dang / gsol tshigs phyi rol gyi srang lam du mchod rgyu byas/de'i dgong mo mi tshang mar 'dre shig gis bsun po bzos nas ngo las tshang ma gnyid ma khug pa'i dka' ngal phrad rkyen de'i sang nyin zur zur dza sag gis/ mgron khang de las cung drag pa zhig btsal nas spos na legs gnas kyi dgongs tshul bton pa ltar/ldi li rnying pa'i khul phyi rgyal 'grul pa sdod yul mgron khang cung drag pa zhig tu khang mig mdo sbug gnyis glas te khang mig sbug ma der dza drung rnam gnyis bzhugs pa dang / mdo ma der las bya gnyis dang / g.yog gnyis sdod skabs nyal khri med par phran gnyis so pā steng du nyal ba dang / g.yog gnyis po sa steng du nyal/ zur zur dza sag dang / mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan rnam gnyis kyis las don la gros bsdur gnang skabs phan tshun gcig gi gcig la bskun mkhas chen po gnang gi 'dug pa de ni bod gzhung mtho rim mi sna rnams kyis goms gshes srol bzang gi spyod tshul du mthong zhing / rgya gar phyi 'brel las khungs kyi mi sna dang / rgya mi'i gzhung tshab la zur zur nas bka' mol gnang skabs tshog 'jam don zab kyi bka' mol zhe cig gsung gi 'dug nga'i bsam par khong ni nub phyogs kyi shes yon sbyong ba'i go skabs byung med kyang 'dzam gling gi gnas stangs gsal 31

por mkhyen pa mtshon gyi 'dug gshis/ khong gi sa nas slob sbyong zhu 'os mang po byung song /'on kyang spyir btang spyod tshul ni dang dod med cing / gtsang sgrar thugs snang chung chung zhig red 'dugachos 'phel thub bstan zur zur dza sag ltar gyi dgongs pa zab mo de 'dra med rung las don thog ha cang thag chod po zhig 'dug gong smos ltar dza sag zur zur dang /mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan rnam gnyis kyis ldi lir rgya mi'i gzhung tshab snga rjes gnyis mjal mol gnang ste mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod ngo las gsum chab mdo nas pe cing du thad phebs gnang rgyu dang / gro mo nas sku tshab 'phar bsnon gnyis dang las bya bcas rgya gar nas hong kong brgyud pe cing du phebs rgyu'i bka' mol lam tsam gtan 'khel ltar dmag spyi dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud dang / mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar rnam gnyis thog las bya bcas bsko bzhag dang sbrags ngo las rnams rgya gar nas hong kong brgyud pe cing du phebs thon gnang /32

khuye tshan bco brgyad pa/'dra mnyam min pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun/da༅༅/ /phyi lo 1951 zu 4 ches shar tsam la gro mo bzhugs sgar nas bod rgya zhi mthun sku tshab dmag spyi dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud dang / mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/ las bya phran phun tshogs bkris dang / las tshan sa 'du rin chen bcas bsko bzhag gnang /bod gzhung nas sku tshab dza drung rnam gnyis gdong bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med sogs la sgug dam sbyar ma'i bka' yig dang / phyag 'khyer/ rgya gar srid blon niha ru mchog la sku tshab gnyis la gang ci'i slob ston gnang rogs zhes 'khod pa'i 7gong sa mchog gi mtshan thog nas gnang ba'i phyag bris bcas stsal te ngo las rnams gro mo nas ka la ka ta brgyud ldi ler phebs/dang thog rgya gar srid blon mjal 'phrad zhus pa'i thog 7gong sa mchog gi phyag bris phul te bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi gtsos pa'i bod gzhung sku tshab rnams lam phyogs khag gnyis nas rgya nag pe cing du thon rgyu yin lugs dang / slad bod rgyal khab kyi bstan pa chab srid ji srid bar gnas thabs skor bka' slob zhus pa'i lan du/ bod gzhung gi zhi mthun gyis lam nas 'bad thabs byed pa de sdig po red/ dmag don lag bstar byed mi rung / bod de rgya khongs ming tsam yin pa khas len byed dgos byung na skyon gang yang med/ bod de rgya khongs yin par khas len ma byas na rgya mis nyan gyi 33

ma red/ de bzhin bod kyi phyi 'grel gyi las don mtha' dag bod gzhung gi byed 'jug gi ma red/ de dag kyang khas len gnang dgos pa chags kyi red/ de min bod kyi sa khul khag la bcings bkrol dmag mi sdod rgyu'i skor nges par du shod kyi red/ bod kyi sa thog rgya mi'i dmag dpung gtong bskyod mi byed pa'i thog thabs mkhas gang che'i 'bad 'thab byed gal/ gal srid rgya dmag bod la 'jog rgyu'i khas len byas che bod la dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i thog rgya gar la'ang gnod skyon yong gi red/ bod nang gi dbang cha thob gang thub kyi 'bad brtson byed dgos zhes pa bcas bka' slob gnang byung ba las/ rgya gar gzhung gis bod rgya zhi mthun gros mol thog bar bzhugs yong ba zhes snga rjes zhus pa de/ skabs der yang bskyar mjug skyong byas kyang zhal bzhes gnang ma song /de ni lo de'i snga lo bod gzhung sku tshab phyag rtsis (rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po dang / rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa gnyis kyi mtshan gnas bsdus ming / ngo las bzhi pos srid blon niha ru mjal 'phrad skabs rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pas bod rgya bka' mol dngos gzhi'i skabs sngar lam ltar rgya gar gzhung gis bar bzhugs gnang rogs zhes dgongs tshul zhus par srid blon niha rus/ de snga sem la'i chings yig gros mol skabs dbyin ji gzhung 'dzam gling thog shugs chen po yod pa'i skabs yin pa dang / rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab gsar pa btsugs ma thag yin pas/ nus shugs gang yang med pa bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og dbyin ji'i rgya gar gzhung nas bar bzhugs byed thub yod/dmag chen gnyis pa'i rjes 'dzam gling gi gnas stangs la 'gyur ba chen po thebs pa dang / lhag par rgya gar gzhung 'di dbyin ji'i 'og nas rang btsan thob nas dus yun thung ngu las ma song bar rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs zhan po yin pa dang / rgya nag gung khran gzhung gsar pa de sngar gyi go min tang gi gzhung dang mi 'dra bar dmag don thog 34

shugs drag chen po yod pas nga tsho de'i dbar bar bzhugs bya rgyu ha cang khag po red/ rgya dmag bod du yong mi dgos pa byung na/ nga chos gang thub kyis phyi 'brel gyi lam nas shugs rkyen gang thub byas dang byed bzhin yin zhes gsungs byung /skabs der rgya gar gzhung gis bod don thog rang nyid kyi mdun du yod pa'i khe phan thob thabs kyi srid byus bzung nas rgya mir ngo dga' byas te nyam thag pa'i bod kyi rgyal khab 'di bzhin rgya dmar gung khran tang gzhung la 'bul ba phul ba lta bu zhi bde mnyam gnas kyi rtsa don lnga zhes bzhag mig rgyang ring po ma bltas pa'i rkyen gyis 1953lor hin rgya gnyis kyis bod hin sa mtshams kyi rtsod rnyog thog phan tshun dmag 'khrug 'thab nas rgya dmar gung khran tang gi bod hin gnyis kyi lo rgyus thog bzhag pa'i mekha ma hun sa thig las brgal nas rgya gar gyi mnga' khul a sam gyi sa mtshams sru btsan 'dzul byas pa de rgya gar ba ngo gnong dgos pa'i rjes 'bras zhig byung ba red/sku tshab dza drung rnam gnyis nas ldi lir bca' bzhugs rgya dmar gyi gzhung tshab ngos mjal gyis rgya gar nas pe cing du thon rgyu'i lag khyer dang / hong kong gzhung gis thong mchan dang gnam gru'i kri si bcas 'phral du thon thub pa'i byed sgo dang 'gro lugs bcas bka' mol zhus/de sngon sku tshab phyag rtsis ngo las rnams kyi phyir thon lag khyer ṇ+ḍab lo me ṭika lag khyer (21 9/'tsho'ajikhu2333dzin7)dbyin ji'i tshig 'di bod skad du phyi 'brel las don rnams kyi tshig don / zhes thob yod pa phran gyis rgyus yod thog lag khyer de rigs zhus par sngar ltar thob/ ldi lir bzhugs ring rgya gar gzhung gis da res bod gzhung gis sku tshab dza sag khe smad pa bod gzhung gi dmag spyi'i mtshan gnas thugs 'gan bzhes yod par brten rgya 35

gar gyi dmag spyi 'jar nal pori ya nas skya tshab ngo las tshang ma gsol ston gdan zhus skabs sbag sbag bzhon mkhan sku srung dmag mi gnyis dang / dmag dpon zhig phebs bsu'i mo ṭa dang sbrags phebs bsur bcar te ldi li'i nub 'gram gyi dmag spyi khang gi las khungs su gdan zhus kyis bod gzhung dmag spyi dza sag khe smad mchog sding cha'i thog gdan zhus kyis dmag mi ru sgrig gi che bstod dga' bsu zhus pa dang / de rjes rgya gar gzhung gis dmag spyi 'ja' nar ka ri ya nas de gar yod pa'i dmag dpon rnams dmag spyi khe smad la ngo sprod kyi gus btud zhus rjes gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams te ngo las tshang ma gsol ston la dgyes par rol/ gnang sgo legs grub zin rjes ldi li nas gnam thog hong kong du phebs thon skabs hong kong khul la gnam gshis shin tu ngan pa'i rkyen 'phrad de chu chod gcig lhag tsam ring hong kong du lding skor brgyab nas 'grul pa rnams gdong gshis 'gyur te gcig gis gcig la bltas nas dngangs skrag chen po byung yang / mtha' ma bab ma thub par de nas phe li phen gyi rgyal sa ma ni la'i gnam thang du bab/de'i sang nyin nas hong kong du chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam bskyod de hong kong gnam thang du bde bab thub pa byung zhing / skabs der pe cing nas bod gzhung sku tshab ngo las rnams a ri'i gnam gru'i thog hong kong la ma babs par phe li pin la btsan khrid byas pa red ces don med rdugs pa skyed nas sems khral chen po byung song zhes rjes su pe cing du 'byor skabs rgya mi'i gnad yod las byed kyis phran la gleng ba'ang byung /skabs der nga tsho mnyam du ldi li rgya mi'i gzhung tshab las rogs hren can nga tsho'i lam rogs lta bur gnam gru de'i nang yod pa skabs der khong rang yang 'jigs snang chen po byung yod pa red/ khong de sngon lde lir snga rjes 'ga' shas thug 'phrad skabs rgya 36

skad ma gtogs dbyin ji'i skad mi shes pa'i rnam pa bstan nas skad bsgyur brgyud nas phan tshun bka' mol gnang ba byung yang / da res hong kong du 'byor nas bzung khong gis nga tsho'i dbyin ji'i skad sgyur yang byas/ hong kong la 'byor ba'i dgong dro tha'i wan nas skya gcen rgya lo don grub mchog gis phran la zhal par zhig phebs byung ba khong gi gsung thos skabs dga' skyo gnyis kyi tshor ba zhig byung / snga lo khong ka ta nas thon te phe li pin rgyal sa ma ni lar phebs rjes de nas rgya nag tu phebs rgyu byas kyang / go min tang gi phe li dzin rgyal khab tu bca' sdod sku tshab khren ṭi phen gyis shes te kho pas u tshugs kyi tha'i wan du gdan 'dren zhus 'dug da cha de nas sa gnas gzhan du gtong gi mi 'dug ces thugs skyo snang chen pos bka' mol gnang byung bar re zhig bya thabs bral/phran gyis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi dbus rgyal yum mchog dang / sku mched rnams sku khams bde thang yin pa'i skor dang / re zhig ma mjal ring gtan zhal lhan gnyis sku gzugs la 'phrod bzhes gang legs gnang gal dang / gang ci'i thugs stabs zab mkhas gnang dgos lugs skor zhus/ de nas nyin shas ring khong gi dpa' nyams rgyas pa'i zhal ras de kho bo'i yid lam du lhang lhang 'khor byung / hong kong du nyin zhag gnyis bzhugs rjes de nas rgya nag ko'ang kra'u la ri li'i nang du thon/ ko'ang kra'u zhing chen spyi khyab dmag dpon ye can ying gis bod gzhung gi sku tshab ngo las rnams la dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams/de'i phyi nyin slar yang ri lir zhugs skyod kyis/ 1951 zu 4 ches/ 35nyin pe cing ri li'i babs tshugs su bde phebs skabs rgya nag dbus mi dmangs srid gzhung gi drung che len pe chus dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur dang / mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gcig lcogs li hu we han sogs dpon rigs du ma bcas 3 7

dang / slob grwa khag gi slob phrug brgya lhag tsam/ bkris lhun po'i las byed 'ga' shas/khams phyog nas pe cing du phebs mkhan bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang las rogs gnyis bcas phyi ches nan nyin sngon phebs grub 'dug pas/ khong rnams kyis ri li babs tshugs su dga' bsur phebs/ de nas nga tsho sku tshab snga rjes ngo las tshang ma bzhugs yul pe cing mgron khang du gra sgrig byas pa ltar/ sku tshab ngo las rnams kyis mtshan sbyar bzhugs khang khungs so sor gnas skabs ngal gso mdzad/ de nas dza drung rnam gnyis kyis bka' blon nga phod la sbug dam bka' yig dang / phyag khyer bcas phul nas slad bka' mol gnang phyogs ji 'dab gros bsdur gnang bar skabs der phran yang bcar dgos lugs gsungs pa ltar nang gros tshogs 'dur bcar/nga phod ngo las rnams chab mdo nas pe cing du ma thon gong nga phod kyis skabs de'i dza drag gi gnas babs de'i 'og 'phral sel bod ljongs su bde 'jags yong ched rgya phyogs la don tshan lnga gnang ba /dang po/ bod du btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan shugs rtsa ba nas med/ bod dang dbyin ji'i dbar phyi 'brel gyi 'brel ba phran bu yod pa de ni tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa rgya gar du phebs pa'i rjes su byung ba zhig red/ bod dang a ri'i dbar tshong las kyi 'brel ba tsam yin/gnyis pa/ de snga rgya gzhung rnying pas bzung pa dang / da lta'i bcings 'grol dmag gis bzung ba'i bod sa rnams phyir sprod yong ba/gsum pa/ gal te phyi rgyal gyis bod du btsan 'dzul byas na rgya gzhung nas rogs ram yong ba zhu rgyu/bzhi pa/ khams khul dang mtsho sngon khul du slebs pa'i bcings 'grol dmag 38

mi rnams phyir 'then gnang rogs/lnga pa/ slad phyin paṇa chen dang / rwa sgreng shog kha'i dbyen sbyor la gsan 'jog med pa zhu rgyu/ zhes pa'i chig tho bkod de chab mdor slebs pa'i bcings bkrol dmag gi 'go pa wang chi mes la sprad/ rgya phyogs kyi lan 'debs su/dang po/ dbyin ji dang a ri gnyis nas rang rgyal gyi nang srid la the byus byas pa ni gsal rjen zhig yin/ bod kyi zhi mol 'thus mi pe cing du dbye 'byed gros mol byed par bskyod rgyu bkag 'gog byas pa/ (phyag rtsis ngo las rnams la zer / de'i thog nas dngos ra 'phrod thub kyi red/gnyis pa/ rgyal srung sra brtan gtong rgyu de shin tu gal 'gangs che ba zhig yin pas nges par du dpung 'jug byed dgos/gsum pa/ rang dmag bod du dpung bskyed byas pa'i rjes su mi rigs 'dra mnya ma dang / sa khul rang skyong gi srid byus lag len bstar rgyu yin/ bod kyi dmag srid lam lugs dang / tā la'i bla ma'i go gnas la sgyur bcos mi byed/ tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal du phebs mi rung / sngar yod go gnas srung 'dzin gnang dgos/bzhi pa/ bod du mi rigs sa khul rang skyong lag len bltar skabs tā la'i bla ma'i sngar yod go gnas rang 'jags las der sgyur bcos mi byed/lnga pa/ bod sa gnas nang khul phyogs khag so so'i dbar gyi 'brel ba'i thad/mthun sgril gyi rtsa don gzhir bzung gros mol gyi sgo nas thag gcod byed dgos pa las nga tshos 'khon lan slog rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi med/ ces brjod/bka' blon nga phod kyis bton pa'i don tshan lnga yi nang nas don tshan dang po dang / don tshan gnyis pa/ don tshan lnga pa bcas par rgya phyogs nas bden med ham 39

bshad kyis phyin ci slog nas lan 'debs byas pa las/ don dngos la lan ma sprad pa'i thog bod du phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul mthar skrod du rgya dmag dpung 'jug bya rgyu yin zhes nyag rkyang bshad pa dang / de bzhin du bod du mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi mi rigs sa khul rang skyong lag len bstar rgyu/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi mtshan gnas bsgyur bcos mi byed pa bcas mgo bskor bslu brid kyi mngar chas btums pa'i mde'u lta bu'i lan zhig sprad pa bcas don snying 'jam rtsub gnyis kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pa'i srid byus 'og bod rgyal khab de bzhin khyur mid gtong ba'i lag len bstar ba red/thog mar nga phod kyi dgongs 'char la srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi mos mthun gnang ste/ bod rgya zhi gros bka' mol gnang yul chab mdo'am/ lha sar gnang rgyu byung na dge mtshan yod pa'i dgongs tshul byung yod kyang / byes kyi rgyal sa gro mo bka'ashag nas ldi ler yod pa'i rgya mi'i gzhung tshab brgyud bka' mol gnang don ltar/ zhi gros byed po skya tshab rnams pe cing du gtong gnang mdzad/nga tsho pe cing du 'byor ba'i de'i sang nyin 1951 zu 4 ches 37 nyin a mdor 'khrungs pa'i paṇa chen 'os sprul sku 'khor rnams mtsho sngon nas pe cing du ri li'i thog phebs 'byor gnang gi yod pas bod kyi sku tshab rnams phebs bsur phebs dgos lugs rgya gzhung nas zhus yod kyang / mtha' ma sku tshab bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub dang / las bya sa 'du rin chen/ phran bcas pe cing ri li'i babs tshugs sar phebs bsur btang ba las/ bka' blon nga phod kyi gtsos pa'i sku tshab gzhan rnams ma phebs pa red/ de ni skabs der bod gzhung nas paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid ngo mar khas len gnang med pa'i rkyen gyis red/de nas paṇa chen 'os sprul pe cing du phebs rjes rgya phyogs nas paṇa chen sku phreng 40

dgu pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin zhu phyogs skor bsam tshul bton gsal du/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa skye rdu mdor dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes skya 'bum du yod pa'i paṇa chen nang ma sgang gis a mdo sbos mdo khul nas 'khrungs pa'i yang srid 'os sprul zhig rnyed pa de sngon chad go min tang gis paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gyis paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i khri gsol gtso skyong byas yod pa ma zad/ nga tsho krung go gung khran tang nas kyang khas len byas yod stabs bod gzhung gi nges par khas len zhu dgos kyi red/ ces mtha' nan btsan bshad byung bar brten skabs der bod gzhung sku tshab rnams kyis gong gsal skor rang gzhung la snyan tar phul ba'i bka' lan du spos mdo nas 'khrungs pa'i mgon po che brtan gyi bu paṇa chen sku gong ma'i yang srid du 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma mchog gi thugs dam bzang phebs byung zhes tar lan phebs don ltar/ de'i sang nyin bod gzhung skya tshab ngo las rnams paṇa chen mchog sprul rin po che'i bzhugs yul du bcar te bod kyi sngar srol ltar maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul ba dang sgrags mjal dar bcas phul/de nyin nas bzung bod gzhung gis sbos mdor 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul de paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po cher ngos len gnang ba red/de bzhin bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub gyis rtsom gnang mdzad pa'i mi che'i rba rlabs 'khrugs po zhes pa'i lo rgyus nang / rgya mis khu tshugs mtha' bskor ri bskor gyis 'jam rtsub mkhas snyan re rdugs g.yo sgyu'i thabs 'phrul sogs gang sar u tshugs mtha' gcig tu byas te/ de khul yod pa'i paṇa chen 'os sprul la gtan 'khel dgos lugs nyag rkyang brjod pas ji ltar zhu 'gab bka' gsal 'phral du gnang skyong zhes pa'i snyan tar phul lan du/ 'di gar thugs dam gnang bar/ paṇa chen 'os sprul mgon po 4

che brtan gyi bu la bzang phebs byung zhes phebs pas khas len bya bde byung yang / gros mthun nang bkod don med bzhin du rgya mis gtan nas ma nyan par 'god dgos byung ba red ces gsal/ de bzhin 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam las/ phyi lo 1950 lor khams phyogs nas paṇa chen 'os sprul khag gnyis byung ba'i thog a mdo khul nas kyang 'os sprul gcig byung zhes dang / phyi lo 1951 lo pe cing du gros mthun 'jog skabs/ nga tsho'i sku tshab gtso bo nga phod nas glog 'phrin zhig btang 'byor du rgya mi'i 'os sprul der khas len ma byas na gros mol la gnod skyon yong gi yod tshul 'khod 'dug gzhung dang dgon khag gi 'go khrid chos sngar lam brtag dpyad dgos tshul brjod kyi yod kyang skabs der de ltar yong thabs med stabs rim bzhin da lta'i mchog sprul rin po che 'di ngo mar gyur/de dus khong dgung lo bcu gcig bcu gnyis tsam son yod 'dug ces gsal por 'khod 'dugade bzhin zhwa sgab pa'i bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs su/ de'i dbar bkris lhun po'i bla brang gi las byed dang / zur bzhi bla khag spyi mgrin nas khams khul 'khrungs pa'i kun gzigs rin po che'i 'os sprul gnyis dang / a mdo khul 'khrungs pa gcig gi mtshan shog bcas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por thugs dam brtag dpyad zhu son phul 'byor byung ba'i khar/ pe cing nas bka' blon nga phod kyis glog 'phrin phul gsal la/a mdo'i phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul der zhal bzhes ma gnang na/ rgya bod gros mol la gnod skyon yong tshul zhus rkyen a mdo'i phyogs su 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul la phyag rtags bstsal ba red/ de ni rgya nag gung khran gzhung gis ngos len byas par brten skabs bsnun de 'dra zhig mi gnang mthu med byung ba yin tshul zhes gsal ba de dngos 42

'brel gyi gnas tshul zhig red/paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa'am dgu pa rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma dge legs rnam rgyal mchog rgya nag nas a mdo khul brgyud dbus su phyir phebs gnang ba'i lam bar du/ phyi lo 1937 zla men ches 1 nyen skye rgyu dgon du sku gshegs pa red/de rjes bod gzhung dang / bkris lhun po thun mong thog nas bod kyi chol kha gsum yongs su yang srid brtsad gcod zhus pa ltar a mdo khul sbos mdo sa khul la 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul gcig dang / bar khams tsha ba dpa' shod dang / li thang khul so so nas 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul khag gsum byung yod pa red/ a mdo spos mdo nas 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul der paṇa chen gyi mtshan gnas mnga' gsol zhus rjes de min khams dpa' shod du 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul de 'bras spungs dgon gyi tshogs chen sprul sku dang / li thang sa khul du 'khrungs pa'i 'os sprul de bkris lhun po'i tshogs chen sprul sku bcas bskos te khungs so sor chos zhugs gnang rjes su 1955 lor bkris lhun por chos zhugs gnang ba'i 'os sprul de rgya gar gnas gzigs su phebs skabs rgya mis gro mo nas 'dzin bzung gis da bar gar song med par gyur/'bras spungs su chos zhugs gnang ba'i 'os sprul de 1951 lor 'bras spyangs nas rgya gar du bros byol gyis deng sang phyi rgyal a yar laṇa ḍa rgyal khab tu bzhugs yod pa zhor 'phros dang /de nas zu 4 ches 28 nyen gyi snga dro mi rigs las don u yon lhan khang gi kru'u rin li lnga'i han gyis/ bod gzhung sku tshab rnams mi rigs las khungs su gros mol gyi tshogs 'du gra sgrig byed stangs dang / dus tshod/ gros gzhi go rim bcas kyi skor phan tshun go bsdur bya rgyu yin zhes nga tsho bod gzhung sku tshab rnams bos byung ba ltar/ tshang 43

ma dus thog tu mi rigs las khungs la 'dzoms te rgya phyogs gyi de sngon mdo stod smad sa khul du 'grems spel byas pa'i don tshan bcu yi deb chung de bod gzhung sku tshab rnams la sprad nas sang gnangs de'i thog gros steng gi gzhi rtsa bzung dgos zhes bshad/bod gzhung gi 'thus mi dza sag khe smad gyis bod gzhung nas dza drung nim gnyis gdong bstsal ba'i sbug dam 'byar ma'i phyag khyer don tshan lnga 'khod pa phyir bton pa gnang ste/ bka' blon nga phod la 'bul rtsis byed skabs rgya phyogs nas ma 'os pa'i rnam 'gyur shugs chen bstan stabs de dag phyir bsdu gnang rogs zhes gsungs te de'i nang du 'khod don tshig zur tsam yang 'don gleng byed ma bcug par rdog rol du btang /bod gzhung gi rgya bod zhi gros don tshan lnga 'di lta ste/ bod chos ldan rgyal khab 'di bzhin rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab cig yin zhing / sngar rabs nas da bar bod rgya'i dbar lo rgyus thog yod pa'i mchod yon 'brel ba zab mo rgyun khyong thog 'di gong 'phel du gtong rgyu/ bod gzhung dang rgya nag gzhung gsar pa'i dbar gyi 'brel lam de bod gzhung dang go min tang gzhung dbar gyi 'brel lam ltar rgyun khyong bya rgyu/ rgya phyogs nas bod du bca' sdod sku tshab dang / las byed bcas mi grangs brgya las mi brgal ba dang de rnams kyis srung skyob bod dmag gis 'gan 'khur bya rgyu/ dar rtse mdo yan gyi bod sa rnams bod gzhung la phyir sprod thog rgya phyogs kyi zhi drag dpung dmag rnams phyir 'then dgos rgyu/ bod kyi sa mtshams khag brtan srung gi 'gan khur bod dmag rang gi bya rgyu bcas 'khod yod/mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar gyis bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha 'dems sgrig 'don thengs dang po'i nang bris pa'i bod rgya zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags 44

bkod pa'i snga rjes su zhes pa'i rtsom yig nang / thog mar krung dbyang nas bton gnang ba'i don tshan bcu la nga tshos dang len zhus pa dang / nga tshos kyang don tshan dgu bton par krung dbyang nas yang dag pa'i phyogs khas len gnang ba dang 'brel lugs mthun min rigs la 'grel bshad dang slob gso gnang byung zhes gsal ba de ni khong rgya mi'i lag 'og tu gnas yod par brten rgya mir ngo dga' sgrel lad dang / bod mi rnams la rdzun gtam khyab spel btang ba zhig rang red/de'i dgong dro krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid blon kru'u en len yis bod gzhung skya tshab ngo las rnams la yus ho'o cha'o zhes pa pe cing grong khyer dmag don u yon lhan khang nang dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams pa dang sbrags bod rgya gnyis gyi zhi gros 'thus mi rnams phan tshun ngo sprod lta bu byas/ rgya phyogs kyi zhi gros 'thus mi gtso bo 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi spyi khyab dang / mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gi kru'u ren gcig lcogs sdus we han dang / rgya nag srid 'dzin las khungs kyi don gcod khang gi kru'u ren krang cing u/ rgya nag lho nub dmag khul khongs gtogs dmag sgar ang bco brgyad kyi dmag spyi krang sko hā/ lho nub dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi drung che sung kri yon bcas yin/ de min rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi'i ming khur ma yin pa tshogs 'dur rgyun bcar gras su/ dmag sgar ang bco brgyad pa'i 'brel gtugs sde tshan gyi spyi khyab 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / khong gi las rogs lo'o yus hun/ (a lo pu'u krang )skad sgyur a mdo gro tshang phun tshogs bkris bcas yin/bod phyogs nas sku tshab nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gtsos pa'i dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus dang / mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar/ mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon/ rim bzhi bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub/45

skad sgyur phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris bcas yin/1951 lo zla 4 ches 39 nyin gong gsal nas dmag don u yon lhan khang gi 'brel gtugs las khungs kyi tshoms chen nang du bod rgya zhi gros tshogs 'du thengs dang po tshogs te rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo sdus we han gyis kha sa bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la sprad pa'i don tshan bcu 'khod pa'i yig cha de gros gzhi gtso bor bzung nas gros mol gnang rgyu yin zhes bsam 'char shugs che bton te gros mol gyi go rim skor gros bsdur byas pa dang / nga phod kyis mtsho sngon dang / shin cang sa khul khag gnyis kyi bcings 'grol dmag mi rnams lha sa dang stod mnga' ris phyogs su dpung bskyod byed bzhin yod 'dug pas/ de ltar byas na tu la'i bla ma bod du bzhugs thabs byed rgyu khag po chags kyi red na/ bcings 'grol dmag mu mthud nas mdun skyod ma gnang rogs/ de dag la khas len byung che nga tshos tu la'i bla mar tar 'phrin 'bul gyi yin zhes dgongs tshul bton pa'i lan du/ sdus we han gyis krung dbyang la dgongs skor zhu gi yin zer/ de'i gnangs nyin zu 5 ches 1 lnga gcig dus chen yin stabs de'i rjes ches 3 nyin sa gnas de rang du mu mthud nas tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu byas/zu 5 ches 1 nyin 'dzam gling ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi lnga gcig dus chen nyin 'khel yod stabs rgya nag gzhung gsar pa btsugs nas lnga gcig dus chen thengs dang po'i nyin der pe cing gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen du dga' ston rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo yin zhes gsal bsgrags byas shing / bod gzhung skya tshab 'thus mi rnams kyang phebs dgos pa dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dbu bzhugs sdings cha'i thog phebs rgyu gtan 'khel ltar kho bos skad sgyur du lhan bcar zhus/ de bzhin paṇa chen rin po che yang dbu bzhugs sdings cha'i thog gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs bzhugs gnang /46

bka' blon nga phod dang kho bo gnyis gnam bde sgo mo'i thog phebs 'byor rjes de'i byang gi nye 'gram phebs lam du kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung sgug sdod byas/ skar ma gnyis gsum tsam gyi rjes su ma'o tse tung dang / khong gi rogs pa sdus rlu han bcas nga phod nga gnyis yod sa der dal po'i sgo nas 'byor ba dang bsnun te nga phod kyi bod lugs mjal dar zhig ma'o tse tung la phul ba'i skabs der sdus wi han gyis bod gzhung gi 'thus mi'i tshogs gtso nga phod ngag dbang jigs med dang / skad sgyur tu la'i bla ma'i gcen mo'i sku zu stag lha phun tshogs bkris red ces ma'o tse tung la ngo sprod byas/ ma'o tse tung gis nga phod la/ khyed tsho pe cing du phebs par nga chos dga' bsu zhu gi yin/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor bka' mol yag po gnang rgyu dang / rgya bod gnyis kyi mthun sgril yag po yong gi red zer nas sdings cha'i steng du phyin te rgya nag gzhung gi gnad yod 'go khrid rnams kyi dbus su bsdad/de nyin pe cing grong khyer yongs su khang srung re gnyis tsam las de min dal sdod mi chog pa'i bka' nan btang 'dug rkyen gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen du mi tshogs kyis khengs te sa gzhi g.yo ba bzhin brjid nyams chen po zhig tu gyur/ ma'o tse tung sdings cha'i steng du 'khod ma thag thang chen du yod pa'i mang tshogs kyis ma'o kru'u zhi khri lo brtan par shog ces dang / krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab khri lor brtan par shog ces skad 'bod dbyar rnga ltar bsgrags/mdzad rim ni/ gnam mtsho skam gsum gyi dmag mi dang / me sgyegs/ 'phrul chas 'khor lo sna tshogs/ bzo pa/ slob phrug bcas shog khag mang po ru sgrig gis ma'o tse tung la gus btud byed pa dang / skad 'bod byed pa/ de bzhin gnam bde sgo mo che'i mkha' dbyings su gnam grus lding bskor rgyag pa bcas gus btud kyi mdzad sgo tshugs/47

gnam bde sgo mo che'i gsham gyi sdings cha'i g.yas g.yon du shing sgrom bang rim mtho dman rim brtsegs can nang g.yon phyogs su phyi rgyal sku mgron byings dang mnyam du bod kyi 'thus mi byings rnams bzhugs/skabs der phyi rgyal sku mgron gyi gras su ru su'i gzhung tshab ngo las dang / yo rob shar phyogs dmar po'i rgyal khab khag phyi sog to ri ya byang ma/ rgya gar bcas kyi gzhung tshab ngo las khag ru su gzhung nas rgya nag gi las rigs khag tu rogs ram gyi zhabs 'degs su btang ba'i mkhas pa rnams dang / skabs der rang dbang rgyal khab nas dbyin ji dang / rgya gar gzhung tshab phud de min rang dbang rgyal khab kyi sku tshab mdzad sgo der zhugs med par snang zhing / de'i g.yas phyogs su rgya nag dbus gzhung gi zhi drag dpon rigs khag dang / zhing chen khag nas yong ba'i gnad yod 'go khrid/ mdzad sgo tshugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas ma thag thang chen la yod pa'i slob phrug dang / mang tshogs rnams kyi lag tu yod pa'i lgang bu rnams glod pa ma zad/ 'ang gu mang po yang gnam la btang / skabs der sgang bu mang po'i khrod du snang pu gnyis la ras dkar po re btags pa gcig gi thog tha'i wan mgyogs myur bcings 'grol gtong rgyu zhes pa dang / cig shos der bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu yin zhes pa'i yig chen bris 'dug pa de'i ras dkar rlung gis khyer nas mkha' dbyings su lding bzhin gnam bde sgo mo che'i steng phyogs su slebs/ tha'i wan bcings 'grol gtong rgyu zhes 'khod pa'i ras dkar de rgyal sgo'i steng gi shing la 'khon nas bkog ma thub par rang bzhin gyis 'jog dgos byung /bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gtong rgyu zhes 'khod pa'i ras dkar de nye 'gram du slebs nas yang skyar rlung gis khyer/ skabs der nga phod kyis phran la ras dkar de gnyis thog yi ge ga re bris 'dug ces dris byung bas/ rgyal sgo'i steng du shing la 'khon pa de tha'i wan 48

bcings 'grol gtong rgyu zhes pa de red/ rlung gi 'khyer ba der bod zhi bas bcings 'grol zhes 'khod 'dug ces zhus par/ nga phod kyis a'o/ tha'i wan bcings 'grol gtong rgyu khag po yong gi yod pa 'dra zhes gsungs byung / skabs der phran gyi bsam par de sngon go thos su nga phod la rnam rtog dang mongs dad kyi 'du shes de tsam med lugs zer mkhan byung yang / de ring gi gsung stangs la bltas na/ khong yang rnam rtog la brtsi mkhan zhig red 'dug snyam pa byung / da cha lo bzhi bcu tsam gyi ring la tha'i lhan bcings 'grol gtong ma thub pas nga phod kyi rnam rtog de mngon sum du gyur ba'i gnas tshul zhig byung song / zu 5 ches na nyin snga dro sngar bzhin tshogs 'du tshogs yul der mu mthud nas tshogs te bod gzhung gi 'thus mi gtso bo nga phod kyis bod de sngar nas da bar rang dbang rang btsan du gnas lugs skor dag skyel 'grel bshad gnang ba'i thog da mus bzhin bcings 'grol dmag bod du bskyed rgyu byas pa de ni 'gag rtsa zhig la ngos 'dzin zhu gi yod/ de dag gsal po thag gcod ma byas na zhi gros rtsa don thog la 'gal ba 'phrad kyi yod par brten bod gzhung la dgongs skor gyi tar 'phrin 'bul rgyu'i dgongs tshul bton pa red/rlos blu han gyis rdzig nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyed bya rgyu de ni krung dbyang gis gtan la phab pa'i byed phyogs shig red/ bod ni krung go'i mnga' khongs kha bral du mi rung ba'i cha shas shig red/krung go'i sa khul yongs su nges par du bcings 'grol gtong gi yin/ bcings 'grol dmag bod du dpung bskyed byas pa des bod rigs rnams la phan thogs yong gi red/rgyal yongs la yang phan thogs yong gi red/ krung go mi dmangs srid gzhung gis bod kyi 49

mi dmangs rnams la rogs ram byas nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan shugs bod nas mtha' skrod gtong rgyu dang / lhag par bod kyi sa mtshams srung rgyur krung go rgyal srung dmag nges par du 'dzugs dgos gal zhig red/ de ni snga phyi bar gsum du 'gyur ba med pa'i srid byus shig red/ bod ni krung go'i mnga' khongs kyi cha shas shig yin pa de ni dbyin ji dang / hin rdu rgyal khab gnyis kus khas len byed kyi yod pa red/ bcings 'grol dmag bod du bskyod rgyu de rang rgyal nang khul gyi bya ba zhig yin pas dbyin ji dang /hin rdu rgyal khab bcas la the byus spu tsam med/ tu la'i bla ma'i sngar yod go gnas de nga tshos khas len byed kyi yod/ tā la'i bla mas bod kyi chab srid thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i skabs der ma'o kru'u zhis khong la/ rten 'brel zhu ba'i tar 'phrin zhig phul yod pa red/khong gal srid hin rdur phebs che khong gi da yod mtshan gnas de shor gyi red ces rdzig rdzig rngam rngam gyis bden med ham bshad thog 'jigs skul kho na'i 'og bod de khyur mid gtong rgyu'i rnam 'gyur dngos su bstan/sdus wi han gyis tshig rtsub mang po zhig bshad rjes 'thus mi krang cing u yang ngo gdong dmar por gyur te yar langs nas/ bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi don tshan bcu de ni krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes skabs thun mong rtsa 'dzin gzhir bzung ba de yin zhes rngam rdzig gi chig rtsub mang dag bshad de bod gzhung 'thus mi rnams nas dag skyel gang thub kyis bsam tshul gang mkhas gsungs kyang / rgya phyogs 'thus mi tshos nyan 'jog ma byas par blo pham pa'i ngang nas de nyin tshogs 'edu 'grol/1951 che 5 tshes 7 nyin phyi dro sngar bzhin bod rgya gnyis kyi 'thus mi lhan 'dzoms thengs gsum pa tshogs te rgya phyogs kyi bsam tshul ji bton la ma nyan rang nyan gyi gnas tshul byung / bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub kyi rtsom bris mdzad pa'i mi 50

che'i rba rlabs 'khrug po zhes pa'i shog grangs 111 nang sku tshab phan tshun 'dra mnyam gyi gros sdur bya rgyu ltar bzhag bka' dpyad gnang mkhan dang / dka' dpyad zhu mkhan gyi 'du shes lta bu zhes gsal ba ltar ya nga ba'i gnas stangs zhig byung /1951 lo rla 5 ches 10 nyin gyi phyi dro bod rgya'i 'thus mi tsho gros mol thengs bzhi pa byas te rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo cas we han gyis tshogs 'du sngon ma'i thog phan tshun bsam tshul shod res byas pa rnams la sngar bzhin rdzig nyams kyi thog nas 'grel bshad byas pa'i thog bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol byung thabs kyi gros mthun bzhag rjes bod la dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu yin zhes bsam tshul bton nas bod gzhung 'thus mi rnams kyis dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs kyi yin zer bar dogs gnad chen po skyes te gcig gis gcig la mig hrig ger bltas pa'i ngang mkhan drung lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar gyis dmag srid u yon lhan khang zer ba de ga re'i don du 'dzugs rgyu red/ ga re byed yag red dam zhes dris par/ sdus we han gyis dmag srid u yon lhan khang de bod sa khul yongs kyi dmag srid gnyis kyi 'go 'doms byed mkhan gyi las khungs gco bo zhig red ces brjod par/ de 'dra yin na/sngon du bka' mol ji gsungs ltar/ 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma'i sku dbang la gnod skyon dang / 'gal ba yong gi ma red dam zhes dres par/ sdus smi han rab tu khros te/ krung dbyang gis tā la'i bla mar sngar yod dbang cha de rang 'jags yin par bsgyur bkod gtong gi ma red sus zer gyi 'dug gam/ khyod tshos krung dbyang gi bod la dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyur bkag 'gog byed kyi yod pas/ bod de krung go'i cha shas kyi sa khul zhig red/ langs phyogs de 'dra zhig yin na rtsa ba nas 'grigs thabs yod pa ma red/ khyod tsho ga dus log na'ang 'gregs kyi red/ sang gnangs log na'ang 51

'grigs kyi red/ yang na bod sa khul la drag po'i bcings 'grol btang rjes khyod tsho log na'ang 'grigs kyi red/ de'i ring khyod tsho pe cing la bsdad na'ang 'grigs kyi red/nga tsho'i mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod sa khul du slobs yod pas sa gnas su tar zhig gtong rgyu las gzhan gyi rnyog dra dang dka' ngal gang yang med/ lar nas khyod tshor bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol dgos sam/ yang na drag po'i bcings 'grol dgos sam/ de gnyis bdams ka byas na 'grigs kyi red/ ces gdug rtsub btsan po dbang yod tshod med de lta gu'i 'og bod kyi 'thus mi tshang ma hang sangs nas yud tsam tshang ma gdong nag por gyur te kha zhu sem por gnas pa'i thog tshogs 'du ma grol rang grol byung /lu'u yi hung gis gong gsal nyin tho'i nang / blo mthun sdus khri tan gyis bod kyi zi 'thus mis bton pa'i gnad don la lan 'debs 'grel bshad gnang / dmag srid u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyu'i gnad don 'don skabs rtsod rnyog byung song zhes gsal ba de ltar red/ de nyin gyi tshogs 'du grol skabs rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi tshos/ ngar shugs spobs nyams kyi rnam 'gyur ston pa dang / bod kyi 'thus mi tsho gnya' chag nyams shor gyi ngang nas tshogs ra nas kha bral te rang rang so so'i gams su loganyin shas ring tshogs 'du ma tshogs par gnas te bod gzhung 'thus mi ngo las rnams nga phod kyi bzhugs khang du thengs mang 'dzoms te rgya phyogs nas btsan po dbang yod kyis bya spyod ngan pa spel ba'i gnas stangs de lta bu'i 'og gros mthun gyi 'bras bu ji 'dra zhig chags yong snyam pa'i thugs tshabs chen po skyed pa'i ngang tshang mas ji 'gab kyi bsam tshul mang po bton/ skabs der bka' blon nga phod kyis/ da nga tsho rgya mi'i lag tu slebs yod pas/ gsod gtubs ji byed kho tsho'i 'dod pa red/ de 'dra'i dbang yod bshad na gros mthun yong thabs dka' ba red/ nga tsho zhed dgos don yog 52
