ma red ces gsungs/skabs der khong gis btsan shugs kyi gnas stangs de 'dra zhig gi 'og dpa' mi zhum pa'i brjid nyams can gyi bka' mol gnang ba de phran gyis khong la sngar las lhag pa'i brtsi bkur gyi bsam pa je cher gyur/gros mol tshogs 'du'i thog rtsod gleng byung rkyen phan tshun slar yang zhi gros bya rgyu'i 'brel ba chad pa lta bu byung yang / rgya phyogs nas 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs kyi nga tshor 'brel ba byed du btang nas chad mthud yo bsrang gi gses 'grol mgo g.yogs lta bu'i 'og slar yang tshogs 'du thengs lnga pa de zu 5ches 14 nyin tshogs/ skabs der bod phyogs nas rang gzhung la dgongs bskor tsam yang zhu khom med par bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun don tshan 17 zhes pa de 'dra mnyam med pa'i thog 'jog dgos pa'i gtan lam tsam 'khel/skabs der bod kyi 'thus mi tshos rgya phyogs kyi 'dod par ma bskun par rnam 'gyur mkhregs po rgyun skyong byas pa yin na/ rgya mis bod du dpung 'jug bya rgyu gdon mi za ba'i gnas tshul dza drag cig chags yod pa red/ gal srid bod du dpung 'jug byas na snod bcud gnyis kur gtor bcom nyam chags brjod kyi mi lang pa yong rgyur blos kyi ma bzod par brten gnas skabs ring de rigs mi yong ba'i g.yol thabs su rgya phyogs nas bton pa'i don tshan rnams khas len bya dgos byung zhing / dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus kyis mdzad pa'i rgas po'i lo rgyus 'bel gtam gyi sde tshan 5 pa'i nang / gros mthun ma bzhag na lam rkyang bod du dpung 'jug bya rtsis mngon dod nyen tshabs shin tu che ba ma zad/ skabs der 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog kyang gro mo nas phyi rgyal sa thog chibs skyod yod che ji ltar byed 'gab sogs khe nyin re rdugs 53

mang po zhig yod par brten ngo las rnams nyin mtshan dgongs bzhes bka' bsdur rim pa gnang ba'i da lta'i gros gzhi 'di la rang phyogs nas 'dod blo khengs pa rtsa ba nas mi 'dug kyang / 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog phyi rgyal sa thog chibs sgyur bskyangs yod che slad kyi 'jog bzo thon pa zhig ma byung mthu med thog gros mthun ma bzhag par ya 'gal du gyur na rgya mis lam seng dpung 'jug byed nges nyen 'gan shin tu che bar brten snga 'phros nga tshos rgya dmar la 7gong sa chen po phyi rgyal sa thog chibs bsgyur grub yod na ji byed rdugs 'dre byas te phyir phebs skabs mtshan gnas sku dbang gang ci rang 'jags gnas rgyu'i 'gan len gros mthun la 'khod pa zhig yong gi yod phyin gnas skabs gros mthun la nga tshos ming rtags bkod na dge mtshan gzhan med rung / 'phral sgang bod la dpung 'jug bya rtsis de dag 'gyangs 'then thub rgyu zhes bka' mol gnang bar slad bod du nam phebs mtshams mtshan dbang gang ci rang 'jags yong rgyu zer ba de don gros mthun la brjod gtsang zhib gsal 'khod thabs rgya gzhung sku tshab rgya dpon sdus khri han nas gros mthun la ming rtags 'god thub pa'i ched du zur yig khag gnyis bzhag rgyu'i khas len byas/ tā la'i bla ma phyi rgyal sa thog phebs yod na phyir phebs gnang dgos lugs khyod tshos snyan tar 'bul dgos zhes brjod song bar nga tshos de rigs rtsa ba nas 'bul nus pa mi 'dug gang yin zer na/ nga tshos snyan tar phul bar dgongs bzhes kyis bod nang phyir phebs grub gnang ba yin na/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma'i sku phya nyen 'gan che stabs bod gzhung dang / ser skya mi dmangs rnams nas nga tshor snyan tar 'bul thal gyur lugs sogs kyi bsam 'char thabs rdugs gang min yong gi red gsungs/ rtsa ba'i gros mthun ma mo dang khyad chen po med gshis zur yig nang tu la'i bla ma rgya gar sa thog lo shas bzhugs rgyun ji gnang ring skya'i nyer chas dang /54

thugs mkho sogs bod gzhung nas nar 'bul zhu rgyu/ lo shas ring bcings 'grol dmag bod bskyod las don ji byed thugs zhib dang 'brel gung khran tang gi srid byus la thugs yid ches te slar bod du phyir phebs nam gnang mtshams mtshan gnas sku dbang tshang ma sngar rgyun rang 'jags gnas rgyu bcas gsal ba ltar yin/dus de nas bzungs dngos don thog bod kyi rgyal rabs thog byung ma myong ba'i yul brlag dbang shor ya nga ba'i dus tshod 'go tshugs kyang / da dung dga' gces 'os pa'i mes rgyal gyi khyim tshang nang du log pa red ces rgya dmar gyis btsan dbang kho nas brjod bcug gi yod pa red/gros mthun la ming rtags 'god rgyu lam tsam gtan 'khel mtshams rgya phyogs nas g.yo sgyu dran 'khrul gyis krung dbyang dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gnyis dbar gyi don gnad rnams gros mthun nang du 'jog rgyu thag gcod byung yod na'ang / bod nang khul gyi gnad don thag gcod bya rgyur bsdad yod/ de ni bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / paṇa chen nang sgang dbar gyi 'gal zla thag gcod yong thabs gros mol byas te gros mthun nang 'god dgos rgyu gal che zhes bsam tshul nan po bton par brten bod kyi sku tshab rnamasaha las hon 'thor ba red/skabs der nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis krung dbyang gis bton pa'i bod nang khul gyi gnad don thag gcod byed rgyu'i skor la nga tshos gros mol byed kyi min/ gang yin zhe na/ nga tsho sku tshab rnams la bod sa gnas gzhung dang / krung dbyang dbar gyi gnad don skor gros mol bya rgyu'i bka' mngags gnang ba las/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bla brang bkris lhun po dbar gyi gnad don skor gros mol bya rgyu'i bka' mngags dang / dbang cha gang yang gnang med/ de ni bod nang khul gyi gnang don zhig 55

yin stabs/ slar bod sa gnas gzhung dang / bla brang bkris lhun po dbar gyi gnad don zur du skad cha byed rgyu zhes gsungs pa red/ 'on kyang rgya phyogs kyi sku tshab tshos u tshugs mthar skyel gyis paṇa chen gyi gnad don de gros mol ma byas par 'jog thabs med lugs dang / gal te khyed tsho dbar gyi gnad don de thag gcod ma byung tshe gros mthun la ming rtags 'god thabs bral ba red ces ngar ngar phad phad kyis 'jigs bskul gyi rnam pa'i thog nas tha tshig bsgrags pa red/ nga phod nas 'u thug bzod bral gyis de 'dra yin na gros mthun bzhag ma thub kyang bya thabs bral zhes lan 'debs gnang ba red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og gros mthun la ming rtags 'god rgyu ha lam re ba med pa'i gnas su gyur te nyin shas ring yang skur gros mol mtshams 'jog mi byed thabs med byung ba red/ de nas nyin gcig rgya phyogs kyi sku tshab sun kre yon gyis nga phod dang khong gcig pu kher rkyang gleng mol byed kyi yin zhes bsam tshul bton te skad bsgyur 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi byas/ de nyin nyin gang tsam phan tshun rno ngar ldan pa'i gleng mol byas 'dugade dag ni 1989 lo zla 7 tshes 31 nyin nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis bod rang skyong ljongs kyi skabs lnga pa'i mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i thog gnang ba'i gtam bshad du/ gros mol gyi nang don gtso bo ni sngar bzhin bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang bkris lhun po bla brang nang snang dbar gyi 'gal zla thag gcod bya rgyu'i gnad don la thug yong gi 'dug gnad don de krung dbyang gi bton pa zhig yin cing / bla brang bkris lhun po nang sgang gi phyogs nas bton pa zhig kyang yin srid/gang yin zhe na de dus paṇa chen rin po che ni dgung lo bcu lhag tsam las phebs med/56

khong gi bton pa'i gnad don de tsho'i nang bod dbus gtsang gi sa khongs dbye rgyu sogs gnad don mang po 'dug ngas de snga'i gnas tshul gang yin pa de rang la 'jog dgos pa las da lta bskur du dbus gtsang gi sa khongs gtan 'khel byed mi rung zhes bshad pa yin/ sun kre yon gyis de thad gros mol byed dgos zhes u tshugs brgyab pa dang / ngas gros mol byed kyi min zhes mthar skyel btang nas nga gnyis tshu tshod bcu gnyis bar du gleng mol byas kyang / 'bras bu gang yang thon ma song / nyin dgung rjes skyar du gros mol byas nas phyi gro'i tshu tshod drug pa bar du gros mol byas kyang sngar bzhin gros 'chams byung med/ mthar sun kre yon gyis ngas bsam 'char zhig 'don gyi yin/ de ga re red zer na gros mthun nang tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen er te ni'i sku phreng dgu pa rnam gnyis thugs mthun po'i skabs kyi go gnas dbang cha gang yod ltar bya rgyu/ zhes don tshan gcig bris na 'grig min zer bar ngas bsam 'char der mos mthun byas pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhe na tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa nas bcu gsum bar dang / paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bzhi pa nas dgu pa'i bar 'gal zla dang rtsod gzhi che rigs lhag myong med par brten tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang paṇa chen er ti ni sku phreng dgu pa rnam gnyis thugs snang mthun po'i skabs kyi sngar yod go gnas dang dbang cha cha 'jog bya rgyu zhes bris par mi 'os mi 'tshams pa med pa'i rkyen gyi yin/ ngas da dung de min gyi cha rkyen mang po zhig dang re ba mtho po bton pa yin na 'grig gi ma red ces bshad pa yin/ mthar phyogs gnyis gros mol byas pa brgyud bsam 'char gcig gyur byung rjes nga tshos dngos gzhi'i gros mthun la ming rtags bkod pa yin/ paṇa chen rin po che'i gnad don skor gros gtan 'khel ba'i nang don ltar gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang gi don tshan drug pa'i nang 'khod yod ces gong gsal 57

tshogs 'du der gtam bshad gnang ba'i snying don rags tsam ngo sprod lta bur bkod pa yin/yang de skor/ lu'u yus hun gyi nyin tho'i nang bod kyi 'thus mi nas gros mthun gyi nang du paṇa chen gyi gnad don 'god rgyur mos mthun med cing / zur du chod yig 'jog rgyu'i re ba 'don gyi 'dug de ltar ma byas na khong tshos dgongs skor zhus rjes gzhi nas ming rtags 'god rgyu yin zhes brjod kyi 'dug sdus sbu krang (sdusa3han nas bshad don/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dbu brnyes rjes paṇa chen gyis sngon la brtsi bkur zhu rgyu'i rlung 'phrin phul yod/ khong tshos lo ngo sum cu'i nang du btsan rgyal ring lugs dang ngan 'brel byas med pa dang / phyi rgyal la phyin yod pa ma red/ de ni dbye mtshams shig red ces gsungs byung zhes 'khod 'dug klog pa po rnams kyi gzigs dang / sdus we han gyis khyad gsod dgos dbang gis brnyas bcos dang / dbang yod/thub tshod bcas kyi btsan shed tshig don der khungs lung gang 'dug gam/ kho pas rang snang gang dran bshad pa de bzhad mo shor ba'i rgyu zhig ma red dam/gros mol tshogs 'du mtha' ma de rla 5 ཿsa 21 nyen mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang du tshogs te gros mthun don tshan 17 dang / zur yig khag gnyis la zhus dag byed du bcug cing / 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma phyi rgyal la phebs yod che lo ngo re gnyis bzhugs nas bod du phyir phebs skabs sngar yod mtshan gnas dang / sku dbang rang 'jags bzhes chog rgyu dang / de'i ring sku'i nyer chas sogs bod gzhung nas rgyun 'bul zhu rgyu bcas 'khod pa'i zur yig cig dang / de min don tshan lnga yod pa'i zur yig zhig gi nang du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod sa khul mtha' mtshams khag gi sa srung du grangs 'bor cun gcig/ yas mas zhig 'jog rgyu dang / krung go bod sdod 58

bcings bkrol dmag gi dmag spyi gzhon pa'i go gnas yod pa bod gzhung bka' shag nang nas bka' blon gcig gnyis la dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi gzhon pa'i go gnas bsko bzhag bya rgyu/ don tshan gcig la/ gros mthun ma mo'i don tshan 2 bod dmag rnams rim gyis bcings 'grol dmag la sgyur rgyu zhes 'khod pa las bod dmag gi grangs 'bor gsal po 'khod yod med zur yig de'i nang du tu la'i bla ma'i sku srung dmag lnga brgya tham pa dang / de min sa gnas khag gi bde 'jags srung skyob tu bod dmag chig stong tham pa nyar te de 'phros bod dmag rnams phyir slog bya rgyu zhes 'khod 'dug de min gros mthun ma mo'i don tshan bcu bzhi bar/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas krung dbyang gis btsugs pa'i phyi 'brel las khungs zu sgril gyi sgo nas bod kyi phyi 'brel las don mtha' dag bya rgyu zhes 'khod pa las/ bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs zu sgril byed stangs skor 'khod med stabs zur yig nang du da phan bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs de dag krung dbyang gis bod du btsugs pa'i phyi 'brel yan lag las khungs su zu sgril bya rgyu dang / sa gnas srid gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs kyi las byed ngo las rnams krung dbyang gis btsugs pa'i phyi 'grel yan lag las khungs su 'os babs kyi 'gan khur len rgyu/ de min gyi zur yig don tshan gzhan rnams dus yun lo mang song bar brten don gnad zhib gsal nges min gyis zhu thabs dka' bar gyur/bod gzhung sku tshab dza sag khe smad kyis brtsams pa'i rgyal khams nyul ba'i lo rgyus 'bel gtam du/ don gnad sogs zhib gsal rang gzhan tshang mas nges min gang ltar don snying gros mthun de'i skor phyin chad 7gong sa mchog dang bod ser skya mi dmangs bcas nas khas len ma byung che zur du bka' mol zhu rgyu zhig zhes gros mthun ma mo dang /zur yig rgya bod shan sbyar gnyis so sor rtags 'jog sa yig 'god gnang mdzad pa 59

red ces gsal/ rgya phyogs nas zhi mthun gros mol 'go 'dzugs nyin don tshan bcu sprad pa de gzhir bzung nas bka' mol gnang yod pa las/ bod phyogs kyis bton pa'i don tshan lnga yod pa zhig dang / don tshan bcu 'khod pa zhig bcas yod rung / rgya phyogs nas bdag med rdog rol du gtong rkyang byas pa las/ rgya bod 'dra mnyam dang / gnyis mos byung ba'i gros mthun min gshis skabs der bka' blon nga phod kyis mdo spyi'i bka' dam mnyam 'khyer yod kyang gzhung dam 'khyer med lugs gsung stabs/ rgya mis ched mngags bod kyi 'thus mi so so'i ming 'khod pa shing gi dam phrug re gsar bzos kyis phab rgyag byas pa red/zu 5 ches 33 nyin gyi snga dro pe cing krung nan has ching krornyi tan zhes srid skyong tshoms chen nang du bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags 'god pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs/ bod rgya zhi mthun ming rtags 'god pa'i rten 'brel mdzad sgo tshugs skabs rgya nag gzhung gi srid 'dzin gzhon pa kru'u te dang / srid blon gzhon pa khren yun gyis gtsos pa'i gnad yod dpon rigs nye shu lhag tsam mdzad sgor zhugs pa dang / ming rtags bkod zin mtshams rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi gtso bo sdus snyi han dang / bod kyi 'thus mi gtso bo nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med/ rgya nag srid 'dzin gzhon pa kru'u te bcas nas rten 'brel gyi gsung bshad re gnang ste mdzad sgo grol/nga phod kyi gsung bshad de yang rgya phyogs la go sdur 'dod bsnun thengs mang gnang dgos byung bas/ bod phyogs rang ngos nas dngos don gsungs pa'i go skabs byung yod pa ma red/ de'i dgong dro rgya phyogs kyi srid blon kra'o en len yis bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun don tshan la ming rtags bkod pa'i rten 'brel gyi ched du gros mol bya yul yus ho cha'o la gsol ston bshams skabs glo bur nam mkha' mun 60

nag tu gyur te glog dmar khyug cing / drag char rlung 'tshub chen po byung / gsol ston sar rgya dmar gung khyan tang gi gnad yod dpon rigs dang / gung khran tang ma yin pa'i pe cing du sdud pa'i go min tang dang / dmangs gtso tang shog khag sogs kyi 'go khrid mi sna mang po phebs 'dug gsol ston ma bzhes gong tshang ma dal sdod kyis chang rag dang / chu mngar mo/ ja thang sogs rang rang gi 'dod pa ltar bzhes nas phan tshun spyir btang gi gleng mol byed du bcug pa'i skabs der phran gyi g.yas g.yon gyi rkub bkyag steng / de sngon yun nan zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi lung yun dang / de min shi'i khang khams khul smad phyogs )zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi le'u lhun hus gnyis kyis phran la da res bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun bzhag pa der bkris bde legs yod ces zer/ lung yun gyis gros mthun gyi zur yig gcig bzhag pa de yag po byung bzhag ces skad shugs chung ngus bshad byung / skabs der phran gyis dmag sgar cun gcig yas mas zhes pa'i grangs 'bor ji yod dres par khong gis/ spyir btang byas nas khri gnyis nas gsum bar yin yang /yas mas zhes 'khod yod pas de las mang du gtong rgyu yod la/ nyung du yang gtong chog pa zhig yin/ yas mas zhes pa de ga par 'then 'then nges gtan med pa'i tshig don red/ grangs 'bo ra gsal po 'god thub pa byung na yag po yog red ces zer byung ba dang / khong gis nga tshor gang drag bsams pa'i sems khur gyi rnam pa zhig ston gyi 'dugaskabs der le'u lhun hus kyis mgo lcog lcog byas pa las skad cha gang yang bshad gabyung /bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol skor gyi gros mthun la ming rtags ma bkod tsam la bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi mtshan thog nas srid blon kra'o en len la slad mdo stod smad yongs su gnas pa'i bod rigs yod do cog rnams bod sa gnas gzhung gi khongs gtogs su rla sgril yong thabs kyi re 'dun tshig tho zhig phul yod par 61

gros mthun la ming rtags bkod zin rjes kra'u en len yis da lta'i dus skabs 'dir bod zhi bas bcings 'grol gtong rgyu red/ bod rigs sa khul gzhan rnams bcings 'grol de'i sngon nas thob zin yod par brten de rnams kyis gsar brje'i go rtogs yar thon byung yod pa ma zad/ de sngon bod rigs sa khul so so'i dbar lo rgyus thog nas phan tshun ma mthun pa'i rtsod rnyog 'phro lus yod stabs da lta'i dus skabs 'dir lam seng bod rigs yongs rdzogs gcig gyur gyis srid 'dzin gcig gi 'og la zu sgril bya rgyu 'os 'tsham gyi dus su slebs med/ lo shas rjes bod rigs sa khul rnams phan tshun gros mol thog nas gcig gyur bya rgyu lag len bstar chog gi red ces ngag thog nas lan sprad yod kyang / da bar lo ngo bzhi bcur nye ba song zhing / sngon gyi kha dan tshig la ma gnas par bod kyi sngar yod kyi chab srid go gnas de dma' ru btang ba dang / der 'gog gnon byas nas rgya nag khongs su yod pa'i spyir btang gi rang skyong ljongs gzhan rnams dang spyi mtshungs su bzhag pa red/phyi lo 1951 zu 5 ches 35 nyen phyi dro'i tshud bzhi pa'i thog bod gzhung zhi mol 'thus mi ngo las rnams nas rgya nag gzhung gi srid 'dzin ma'o tse tung gis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs gnad yod rnams mjal 'phrad thog bod kyi thon zog dngos rigs 'bul gnang mdzad/ma'o kru'u zhi mjal 'phrad skabs khong gis nga phod kyi gtsos pa'i bod kyi 'thus mi rnams la nga tsho gung khran tang ni khyed tsho bod kyi rig gnas dang / dpal 'byor bya bzhag gong 'phel gtong rgyur rogs ram byed mkhan zhig yin pa las dpon po byed mkhan dang / bya ba ngan pa bya mkhan min/ gal te rgya rigs las byed pas khyed tshor brnyas bcos byas na khyed tshos nga tsho 'tshol bar shog ces dang / yang khong gis lo brgya 62

phrag 'ga' shas ring krung go'i mi rigs khag dbar mthun sgril med pa dang / lhag par bod nang khul gyi mthun sgril dang / rgya bod mi rigs dbar mthun sgril ma byung ba de log spyod man ju srid gzhung dang / cang ce hri srid gzhung gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i ngan 'bras la brten nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i 'bras bu red/da cha tā la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen er ti ni rnam gnyis kyis 'go khrid pa'i phyogs khag dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dbar tshang ma 'dra mnyam thog nas mthun sgril legs sgrig byas pa de spun zla lta bu'i mthun sgril byed pa las phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan der gnya' gnon byed pa zhig ma yin/ mthun sgril de'i mang gzhi'i thog nas nga tshos bod mi rigs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung bcas gang ci'i gong 'phel gtong thub kyi red/ da cha zhi ba'i gros mthun bzhag pa des rgya bod mi rigs gnyis ku'i gzi brjid yin lugs dang pe cing yang bod mis bdag gnyer byed chog gi red/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi srid 'dzin yang bod pas byed chog gi red/ 'on kyang snga 'phros bod phyogs nas lo gcig gnyis tsam ring bcings 'grol dmag la bza' chas rogs ram byed dgos pa dang / de'i mtshams nas rgya rigs kyis bod mir gang ci'i rogs ram byed thub rgyu yin lugs bcas bshad nas brjid nyams che mdog dang / bod par brtsi mthong chen po yod khul gyi gtam snyan gang 'dra chags chags bshad par brten skabs der phran gyi blo yul du/ da nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams kyi mdun lam 'od zer lham mer 'phro ba cig yin par snyam nas dga' snang byung /de'i nub mo ha'o'i rin thang du bod rgya'i gros mol 'thus mi ngo las yongs rdzogs dang / paṇa chen sku 'khor/ rgya dpon gnad yod dpon rigs nyis brgya lhag tsam la ma'o yis gsol ston chen po bshams/ de'i rjes tsam la rgya phyogs kyi bkod byus 63

'og da phan gzhung bla gnyis dbar gyi 'khon 'dzin de —da nas bzung nam mkha' g.ya' dag dang / sa gzhi rdul dag gi dpe bzhin gtsang sel byung ba'i mtshon rtags su phan tshun gsol ston 'bul res byed du bcugade nas paṇa chen sku 'khor rnams pe cing nas mtsho sngon du phyir phebs gnang /bod gzhung gi 'thus mi bka' blon nga phod kyis gtsos pa'i ngo las rnams pe cing nas rgya gar brgyud 7gong sa chen po mchog la gros mthun bzhag pa'i skor 7snyan seng zhu khyad dang bcas phebs rtsis yod lugs kyi dgongs tshul rgya phyogs su 'don skabs nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med ni bod gzhung gi zhi mthun gros mol 'thus mi gtso bo yin stabs rgya gar brgyud phebs rgyu bde po med lugs dang / gal srid phebs na phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khag gi myul mas khong gi sku srog la nyes skyon gtong rdugs kyis nyen 'gan bzod kyi mi 'dug pas sngar bzhin khams brgyud rang 'jags phyir phebs gnang na legs gnas dang / de min sku tshab byings rnams rgya gar brgyud nas phebs na 'thus rgyu bcas lan rnyed pa ltar nga phod khams phyogs brgyud nas phebs/ khong gi phyag rogs mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / las bya rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs bcas dang /rgya phyogs kyi lho nub dmag khul khongs gtogs kyi dmag sgar ang 18 pa'i dmag spyi krang go ha/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas khong mnyam du pe cing nas khams phyogs brgyud lha sar thon gnang mdzad/de bzhin dza drung ngo las rnams dang lhan du rgya phyogs kyi zhi mthun gros mol 'thus mi krang cing us rgya nag dbus gzhung gi sku tshab ming khur byas te nga tsho mnyam du rgya gar rgyud phebs/ khong gi las rogs su dmag sgar ang 18 pa'i 'brel gtugs sde tshan gyi spyi khyab lo yus hun/ kha lo pu'u krang dang / de min sku tshab krang cing u'i sku srung 64

gnyis dang / skad sgyur gcig bcas pe cing nas tong kong dang / rgya gar brgyud gro mor mnyam thon gnang /pe cing nas ma thon gong tsam la phran la mig nad phog ste lam bar ha cang dka' ngal chen po phrad/ ko'ang kro'u du 'byor skabs sngar las ji sdug tu gyur te bdun phrag gnyis ring ko'ang kra'u krung hran sman khang chen mo'i nang sman bcos dang bshags bcos byas/ dus yun thung ngu'i ring las ngal gso bya rgyu ma byung bar khong rnams lhan du hong kong brgyud rgya gar du thon dgos byung zhing / ka tar 'byor skabs mig la zug dwo sngar las che ba byung / ko'ang kro'u nas ma thon gong tsam la krang cing u sman khang du phebs te khyed rang gnas skabs ring sman khang nang ngal gso sman bcos gnang na legs gnas dang /de nas mig drag skyes byung mtshams ga ler phebs na legs tshul zhes byams brtse'i ngang nas gsungs kyang / phran gyis khong rnams phyir phebs te rang nyid gcig pu rgya nag tu lus rdugs kyi dngangs skrag byung nas khong gi kha la ma nyan par khong rnams mnyam du thon/ pe cing nas mig nad phog pa nas bzung bka' sbug tu ma slebs bar grogs po bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub dang / sa 'du rin chen rnam gnyis kyis phran la nad g.yog las lhag pa'i rogs ram chen po gnang ba de'i bka' dren dus nam yang brjed thabs med pa zhig yin pa de snying thag pa nas bkren yang yang dran gyi 'dugadza drung ngo las rnams dang / rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u bcas bka' sbug tu phebs 'byor skabs byes kyi rgyal sa gro mo bka' shag nas krang cing u ngo las kyi bzhugs khang dang / gro mo bar 'grul bzhud kyi phebs sgrig la sne shan phag ri rdzong sdod zhol khang sras bsod nams dar rgyas bsko bzhag ched brdzong gnang ba bzhin 'byor te bka' sbug tu nyin shas bzhugs rjes dza drung rnam gnyis dang / sku tshab krang cing u bcas bka' lhag 65
nas sgang tog brgyud gro mor ched thon gnang / skabs der phran gyi mig nad drag skyed ma byung bas khong rnams dang lhan du gro mo bzhugs sgar du bcar ma thub//66

le tshan bcu dgu pa/ gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag rjes kyi shugs rkyen dang /srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi mdzad 'khur 'jog dgos byung ba'i rgyu mtshan/༄༅༅/ /gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod pa'i mdzad sko 'i skabs bka' blon nga phod kyi gsung bshad gnang ba de rgya mis rlung 'phrin thog bod ljongs yongs su khyab spel byas pa'i gnas tshul des rkyen pas bod mi rnams dogs 'grogs chen po byung ste/ mi tshang ma tang sangs nas 'jigs snang byung ba red/ lhag par du gro mo khul 7gong sa mchog nas dbu khrid mdzad pa'i byes gzhung dpon rigs rnams kyi thugs yul las 'das pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag pa'i skor rang gzhung la dgongs bskor tsam ma zhus par ming rtags bkod pa'i 'bru don rnams la ha las dgos pa'i gnas tshul byung /7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang / ngos kyi mi dmangs zhes pa'i mdzad rnam du/ nga dang nga'i gzhung la gros mthun la ming rtags bkod tshul ma brjod kyang pe cing rlung 'phrin nang nga phod kyi drel bsgrags byas pa de nga chos thog mar go thos shes rtogs byung ste ha las byung zhes gsal ba ltar/ gong 'khod bzhin gros mol gnang ba'i skabs der bod gzhung gi 'thus mi tshos rang gzhung la dgongs bskor zhu dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul bton yod kyang / rgya phyogs kyi 'dzam gling spyi srol las 'gal ba'i ka kor dus 67

'gyangs kyi dgongs skor bka' slob zhu ma bcug par btsan shugs kyi gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun zhes pa shog dkar yig nag gi thog la ming rtags bkod dgos byung /rgya phyogs nas sang nyin de gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags 'god rgyur gtan 'khel yod lugs kyi gros mthun zin bris kyang 'dod dbang rang snang gang shar gyis bris pa de dag gtsang bshus bya dgos rgyur sprad yod pa las gros mthun zin bris kyi brjod chig rnams bod gzhung 'thus mi rnams la go bsdur gnang long ma byung bar mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub gnyis kyigros mthun gyis zin bris de dag ma yig tu phab rgyur khong gnyis dang / phran las tshan sa 'du rin chen bcas rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi las khungs shig tu 'khrid de/ de'i dgong mo phyi po bar las ka byed dgos byung /gros mthun de dag btsan shugs 'og bzhag pa'i shugs rkyen des bod mi phal mo che blo ma bde bar gyur te ma 'ongs bod rgyal bstan chab srid kyi gnas babs ji 'gyur sus kyang tshod dpag dka' ba byung 'dug par brten rgya phyogs nas khyab bsgrags byas pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang du 'khod pa'i 'gru don la gzhigs na/ ma 'ongs par rang cag gi rgyal bstan chab srid thog la gnod skyon chen po zhig yong rgyu ma zad/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi sku phya blos 'gan bzod min gyi gnas tshul 'phradastabs gro mo byes gzhung nas 7gong sa mchog gro mo nas rgya gar du re zhig ring nyen g.yol lta bur gdan zhu gnang na legs gnas kyi dgongs 'char gnang mkhan byung ba dang / khag gcig nas 7gong sa mchog phyi rgyal la gdan zhu gnang rgyu mi 'dug de las lha sar phyir phebs gnang na legs gnas kyi bsam tshul bton par phyogs gnyis kyi mtha' ma'i 68

bsam tshul du dza drung ngo las rnams mnyam du rgya dpon krang cing u rgya gar brgyud ring min gro mor yong gi yod 'dug pa de rnams 'byor rjes de dag gi rnam 'gyur la gzhigs nas lha sar phyir phebs gnang dang / yang na re zhig rgya gar du chibs sgyur gnang rgyu ji 'gab thugs gtan 'khel rgyu gnang /gong gsal 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam shog grangs 93 du gros mthun der ming rtags bkod rjes nga'i zhabs 'bring 'ga' shas kyi bsam tshul la/ brtan po'i ched du phyis skyon med par rgya gar du phyin na legs par mthong zhing / de'i skor phan tshun go bsdur gleng rtsod mang po byas mthar rgya dpon krang cing u de ma 'byor bar sgug sdod rgyu/khong gi rnam 'gyur la brtag dpyad byed rgyu zhes gsal ba ltar/ skabs der gro mor phebs 'byor bod gzhung drung rtsis lhan rgyas gtso khrid kyi gnad yod dpon rigs rnams tshogs 'du tshogs te/ gong gsal dgongs tshul khag gnyis skor rtsod gleng rno ngar dngaldan pa zhig byung yod lugs skor rjes su phran tsho gro mor 'byor skabs gong gsal gnas tshul gsal po thos byung /1951 zu 7 ches 15 nyen 7gong sa chen po mchog nas krang cing u dang khong gi phyag rogs bcas gro mo dung dkar dgon pa'i gzim chung nang du mjal 'phrad gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba'i nyin gcig gi sngon du gro mo byes gzhung bka' blon rnams krang cing u bzhugs sar mjal 'phrad du phebs te krang cing us bar lam bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor kyi gros mthun bzhag pa'i skor khong rnams la 'grel bshad byas pa ma zad/ gros mthun bzhag pa'i skor bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis kyang krung dbyang la dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur zhig tar thog nas ston dgos yod lugs bcas brjod par/ bka' blon rnams kyis de skor lam seng thad kur lan gsal ma / 69

gnang bar krang cing u tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad zhu stangs skor bka' mol gnang bar khong gis kyang krung dbyang gi sku tshab tu la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad kyi mdzad sgo'i thog nas sa gnas srid gzhung dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dbar gyi yang dag pa'i 'brel ba de nges par mtshon thub pa byed dgos kyi red ces gleng rnyog gi sngon 'gro gtong 'go tshugs/ skabs der bod gzhung gis krang cing us tu la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad zhu rgyu'i mdzad sgo de 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri la 'khod rjes bod gzhung dpon rigs rnams g.yas g.yon du bzhengs rgyu dang / de nas krang cing u mjal 'phrad du bcar skabs 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri las bzhengs gnang mdzad de sne len gnang rgyu dang / krang cing u yis rgya nag srid 'dzin ma'o tse tung gi gnas bres dang 'dra par bcas 7gong sa mchog gi phyag tu 'bul bzhes gnang rjes bzhugs khrir 'khod rgyu/ g.yas su skya tshab krang cing khu dang / khong gi las rogs la gdan khri cung zad dma' ba byed kyi yin lugs zhes gsungs pa de krang cing us ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur bstan 'dug kyang / de'i sang nyin 1951 zla 7 ches 15 nyin 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog gi bzhugs sgar dung dkar dgon gyi gzim chung du rgya nag gzhung gi sku tshab krang cing u dang mjal 'phrad gnang / skabs der 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri cung dma' ba'i thog bzhugs pa dang /de'i ga( ne+e/sa ngos su krang cing u dang / khong gi las rogs so so de las dma' tsam gyi gdan brgyab yod pa/ krang cing u gzim chung du bcar 'phral 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khri las bzhengs gnang mdzad de krang cing u can la phyag btang nas 'tshams 'dre gnang /krang cing u yis srid 'dzin ma'o tse tung gi gnas bris dang 'dra par bcas 7gong sa mchog gi phyag tu phul/ krang cing u yis gros mthun don tshan bzhag pa'i skor sogs snyan seng dang 'brel gros mthun ming rtags bkod par brtsi bkur bkris bde legs 70

kyis tar 'phrin zhig ma'o kru'u zhi la 'phral du gtong gnang yong ba zhus yod kyang / lha sar ma phebs bar zhal bzhes gnang med/ dza sag khe smad gsod nams dbang 'dud dang mkhan drung thub bstan bstan dar rnam gnyis krang cing u bzhugs sar ched brdzong gis khong gro mo nas lha sar phebs rgyu'i skor dang / gros mthun skor dga' bsu yod lugs kyi rnam 'gyur tar 'phrin 'bul dgos thad bka' blon nga phod lha sar phebs 'byor nas bod gzhung bka' blon rnams thugs 'phrad byung ba'i rjes su bod gzhung gi gzhi nas dga' bsu'i rnam 'gyur ston rgyu'i 'grel bshad gnang yang / krang cing us bod gzhung nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag pa'i skor gyi rnam 'gyur sngon tsam la bstan na yag po red/ de ltar gnang thub na rgyal yongs mi dmangs rnams kyi khrod du tu la'i bla ma'i snyan grags la phan thogs yong gi red/ de bzhin paṇa chen nas tā la'i bla mar brtsi bkur gnang gi yod stabs mthun sgril yong ched tu la'i bla ma nas kyang rnam 'gyur nges par du ston dgos pa'i tar 'phrin zhig gnang na yag po yong gi red ces byis par mgo skor bslu brid byed pa lta bu'i skad cha de bshad/ 'on kyang de'i sang nyin zu 7 ches naX nyin bka' shag gi mtshan thog nas rgya nag gzhung la nga phod phyir phebs rjes gros mthun gyi ma yig 'byor mtshams bod ljongs tshogs chen tshogs te gros mthun skor gros bsdur byas thog gzhi nas lag len bstar rgyu yin zhes tar 'phrin zhig btang ba red/phyi lo 1951 zu 7 ches 31 nyin 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po ston 'khor rnams gro mo dung dkar dgon bzhugs skar nas lha ldan rgyal khab tu chibs sgyur mdzad/ nyin gnyis kyi rjes su ches 33 nyin rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u ngo las gro mo nas rta thog lha sar thon te lam bar nyin bco lnga tsam 'gor nas phyi lo 1951 7 87ga

ches 8 nyin lha sa'i nye 'gram skyid tshal klu sdings su 'byor skabs bod gzhung gi bka' blon phyogs phebs kyi lam srol ltar/ bod gzhung gi gnad yod mi sna dang rtse shod las tshan yan chad nas dga' bsu zhus/ lha sa grong khyer nang du yod pa'i khri smon gyi gzim shag de g.yar po zhus nas der krang cing u ngo las bzhugs gnas gra sgrig gnang / nyin shas rjes srid bka' lhan rgyas kyis bla steng gzim chung du krang cing u la mthun lam gyi dga' bsu'i gsol tshigs shig bshams par lha sa'i mi dmangs rnams kyis ma 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa'i gtam gleng ji snyed lhags/ de nas bzung krang cing u yis bod gzhung gi srid tshab rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pas bka' tshab/ mtho rim dpon rigs bcas la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi las 'gul lag len bstar 'go tshugs te/ de rnams kyi bzhugs shag tu ngo bskyed kyis mjal 'phrad zhus pa dang / chabs cig gros mthun don tshan 17 bzhag pa'i skor dang / bod sa gnas de mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du phyir log byas tshul/ bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kyis mthun sgril dam zab bya dgos rgyu dang / mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag mes rgyal gyi lho nub rgyal mtshams srung rgyu bcas kyi skor 'grel brjod byas/krang cing us srid tshab klu khang pa dang / srid tshab bla ma blo bzang bkris gnyis sngon rjes su mjal 'phrad zhus te krang cing u yis don tshan 17 bzhag pa'i skor dang /bod de mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du log pa de yag po yin lugs dang / krung go mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis rgyal khab kyi lho nub sa mtshams sra brtan srung rgyu/bod nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs mtha' skrod gtong rgyu'i skor mkhas snyan dang / rdzig rngam zung sprel gyi rnam pa bstan nas 'grel bshad byas pa'i thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang krung dbyang srid gzhung (dbusagazhung ) dbar bzhag pa'i gros 72

mthun la dga' bsu dang / brtsi bkur zhu rgyu zhes pa'i rlung 'phrin zhig gtong dgos lugs kyi re 'dun zhus par srid tshab klung khang pas/ the tshom med pa'i thog nas lan 'debs shugs che gnang ste/ dang thog gros mthun dang / rlung 'phrin nang nas thon pa'i nang don gnyis mtshungs kyi mi 'dug ces dang / nga phod pe cing du bskyed skabs khong la sprad pa'i las 'gan ni zhi ba'i dbye 'byed gros mol bya rgyu de yin pa las dmag don skor gros bsdur bya rgyu'i dbang cha sprad yod pa ma red/ don tshan 17 ni bsam yul las 'das pa zhig byung 'dug cing / gros mthun de dag yang snying gang 'dra byung yod med skor nga phod phyir 'khor mtshams snyan seng dang / gros bsdur byas rjes skad cha byas chogachab mdor btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gnas tshul de thos byung / bod ni chos ldan rgyal khab zhi bder dga' mkhan zhig yin/ skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon tshang mas zhi bde yong rgyu kho na'i dgongs bzhes gnang gi yod cing / skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pas kyang 'che med zhi ba yong gang thub gnang gi yod red/ skabs der bod mi rnams ngar sems skyes yod kyang tu la'i bla mas pe cing du 'thus mi btang ste zhi mol gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes mtha' gcig tu gnang pa red/ bod ni chos lugs dar khyab che ba'i rgyal khab cig yin par brten de gar dmag dpung btang ba las/ spung grung 'dzoms la 'jon thang che ba'i sku tshab drag gras zhig btang yong na de yag gi red/ krung go ni mi 'bor che ba'i rgyal khab gcig red/ 'on kyang bya ba gang zhig byas kyang tshod yod pa zhig byed dgos/ gal te de ltar ma byas na gnyid khug pa'i mi yang yar langs te ngo rgol byed kyi red/ gal te bod 'bangs la gnya' gnon btang che nga rang ni rma ra dkar po chags shing / 'chi la khad kyi mi zhig yin/ bod 'bangs rnams la stobs shugs med na yang / kho tshos dkon mchog gsum la smon lam brgyab ste rjes su las 'bras 'khor 73

srid kyi red ces gsungs 'dugade nyin krang cing u ngo gdong dmar por gyur yod kyang / gang mkhas mkhas kyis 'grel bshad 'bad brtson bya rgyu'i rnam pa'i thog nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dbang cha tshang ma yod pa'i 'thus mi nga phod kyis gnas don gal 'gangs che rigs rnams gros mol thog gros mthun bzhag pa red/ ces lan 'debs byas /skabs der lha sa khul du rgya dmag khams phyogs dang / byang shar mtsho sngon/nub byang tur ki si than shar ma/ (shingacang) bcas khag gsum nas yong gi yod lugs zhir grags che/lo de'i rla 9 ches 9 nyin de sngon bod gzhung gi shar phyogs mnga' khul lte gnas chab mdor bcings 'grol zer ba'i rgya dmag gi btsan 'dzul byed mkhan dmag sgar ang 18 gyi dmag spyi gzhon pa wang chi me yis sne khrid pa'i rgya dmag drug brgya lhag tsam lha sar 'byor/ de rnams ma 'byor gong rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u yis bod gzhung bka' shag la gros mthun don tshan 17 nang du 'khod pa bzhin mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag lha sar yong ba rnams kyis za chas dang / sdod gnas bcas bod gzhung gis gra sgrig rogs ram bya dgos pa'i bka' btang ba ltar/ nan po bshad de bod gzhung bka' shag gis phyi 'brel las khungs kyi dbu 'dzin dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / dmag spyi dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus rnam gnyis la/ rgya mi'i dpon dmag rnams kyi za chas dang / sdod gnas sogs gra sgrig sne len bya mkhan bsko bzhag gnang ste khong rnam gnyis kyis gra sgrig gang thub gnang /mdo smad khul nas byang lam nag chu brgyud rgya mi'i dmag dpon phan min gyis sne khrid byas pa'i rgya dmag chig stong nyis brgya skor lha sar 'byor/74

skabs der bod mi ser skya bsam yod rnams kyis da bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'di yag po yong gi ma red snyam pa'i snang ba shar te sems khral je cher song /bod gzhung gis rgya mi'i dpon dmag rnams kyi dgos mkho dang / sdod yul sogs la kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gra sgrig mi gnang mthu med byung / rgya mi'i dpung dmag rnams kyi sdod gnas de gnas skabs bod gzhung ga dang dmag sgar klu sbug rdo'i seng ge dang /dmag sgar gsar pa/ zhes pa der gra sgrig gnang ba dang / me shing / za 'bru bcas bod gzhung rang gis gang thub ci thub rogs ram byed dgos byung /de nas bzung rim bzhin lha sa dang / bod ljongs yongs su bza' chas kyi rin gong nyin re bzhin 'phar nas mtha' ma ldeb bcu lhag tsam 'phar stabs bod mi rnams kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i mu ge mi yong ngam snyam nas mi phal cher sdug bsngal gcig thog gnyis brtsegs byung na yang su zhig gis kyang ngo rgol skad 'bod byed ma nus pa'i ngang rgya mi'i zhi drag gnyis kyi mi 'bor nyin re bzhin je mang du song / rgya mes lha sa grong khyer nang gi sa khang spyas nyo dang / lha sa'i lho rgyud gtsang po'i 'gram du dbyar dus spro skyid gtong yul gling kha rnams la rgya mi'i sdod sgar chen po bskrun/ de bzhin rgya mis za 'bru 'bor chen zhig dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul brjod pa ltar bod gzhung nas za 'bru gang thub ci thub rogs ram gnang yang da dung de bas mang tsam g.yar po zhus stabs/g.yar gtong mi thub stabs dgon pa khag dang / bla brang khag sger khag bcas nas 'bru rigs g.yar len gnang dgos kyis bod gzhung la sku ngal chen po byung / za 'bru shin tu dkon po byung ste rin gong nge cher 'phar/ de nas bzung bod mi chos rgya mi la mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur je sdug tu song mthar mi dmangs chos bka' shag tu bde sdug zhu 'bod ma nga po byung yang / bka' shag gi gnang thabs gang yang ma byung bar rang bzhin du lus/75

'on kyang gnas tshul de'i 'og bod gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs mang che bas rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u la bod sdod rgya dmag nyung du gtong dgos zhes pa'i re 'dun bton kyang rgya phyogs nas dngos yod gnas tshul gyi dka' ngal la ma bltas par phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi lkog byus yin tshul gyi rdugs pa chen po skyes/skabs der rgya mi'i gnad yod 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi mi sna zhud than lu'u zhes pas srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi sar ngo shes mthun 'brel bzo thabs su bcar skabs srid tshab klu khang pas/ rgya mis bod la gung khran gyi lugs srol gsar pa ma spel rogs/sangs rgyas kyi chos dang mi mthun pa'i lugs srol spel na/ mtha' ma pham nyes yong gi red/ khyed chos dmag mi gang nyung nyung las yong rgyu med/ dmag mi mang po yong na dmag thog tu dmag pham pa las/ grod khog ltog pa de sdug gi red ces bka' gnang skor zhud than lu'u gyis phran la thengs 'ga' shas gleng mol byung ba ma zad/ kho pas srid tshab klung khang pa de mi ha cang mkhregs po zhig red ces bstod bsngags lta bus bshad byung /yang nyin zhig srid tshab bla ma blo bzang bkris kyi sku mdun du rgya mi'i dmag dpon krang go hā gtsos pa'i dpon rigs 'ga' shas bcar skabs srid tshab bla mas rgya dmag nyung nyung las yong rgyu med pa dang / de rnams mtha' mtshams sa srung byed dgos pa las/ lha sa grong khyer nang du yong dgos don med ces gsungs/ de bzhin srid tshab klu khang pas khyed tsho de sngon man ju dang / khyad par spu tsam mi 'dug da dung man ju las sdug gi red/ chab mdor btsan 'dzul byas pa de ni drag shugs kyis ham bzung byas pazhig red/ rgya nag de rgyal khab chen po gcig red/ bod ni rgyal khab chung chung zhig red/rgyal khab chen po des rgyal khab chung chung la thub tshod gtong rgyu yog ma red/ khyed tshos bod du dmag nyung tsam gtong dgos/ gros mthun don tshan 17 nang gnad don 'ga' 76

shas yang skyar gros bsdur byed dgos kyi 'dug bod chos ldan gyi rgyal khab bar gnas su bsdad pa zhig yin pas sngar nas da bar rgyal khab su 'dra zhig gis kyang ham bzung byas med/ bod 'di sus za bsam na yang don dngos thog za mi thub pa zhig red/ gang ltar khyed tsho rgyal khab chen po de bod rgyal khab chung chung la brnyas bcos byed mkhan red 'dug bod rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus dngos 'brel de khyed tshos shes kyi ma red/ bod la zing 'khrug byung na rgya nag la yang zing 'khrug yong gi red/ khyed tshos chab mdo sogs la drag shugs la brten nas 'phrog pa zhig red/ 'jigs skul byas pa'i rkyen gyis 7gong sa skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma gro mor phebs dgos byung ba de ni bod mi ser sku yongs rdzogs kyis re 'dun byas pa zhig red ces nan po zhig gsungs 'dug7gong sa mchog gro mo nas lha sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes rgya mi'i skya tshab krang cing us kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gi tshab byas te ṭī la'i bla mar phyag rtags 'bul rgyu'i mdzad sgo gnang stangs skor bka' shag la rnyog gleng snga phyi thengs kha shas byung yod gshis nyin zhig sku tshab krang cing u bka' shag tu bcar te krung dbyang gi tu la'i bla mar phyag rtags 'bul rgyu'i mdzad sgo'i rtsa don ni chab srid thog krung dbyang (dbus gzhung /mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi 'jog byed dgos rgyu dang / chos lugs kyi thad sa gnas chos lugs kyi dbu khrid brtsi 'jog bya rgyu'i phyogs gnyis la dgongs bzhes gnang dgos lugs skor gyi don gnad gcig dang / de min rgyal ston dus chen zla 10 tshos ’ nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs pa'i dran gso'i dus ches lu rten 'brel zhu phyogs kyi tshogs chen tshogs rgyu'i skor dang / de dang 'brel ba'i gros mthun lag len bstar rgyu'i mos mthun gyis rgyal ston dus chen gyi gong du brtsi bkur zhu rgyu'i skor dbus gzhung la tar 'phrin 'bul thub na dge mtshan yod lugs bcas kyi bsam 77

tshul bton pa ltar/ sku tshab krang cing us kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gi tshab byas nas 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma la phyag rtags 'bul rgyu'i mdzad sgo'i thad bka' shag nas mos mthun gnang ba dang sbrags mdzad sgo byed stangs kyi skor sku tshab krang cing u nor gling pho brang gi tshom chen du 'byor 'phral 7gong sa tā la'i bla mas bzhugs khri'i thog nas yar sku bzhengs kyis phyag rtags bzhes te bzhugs khri'i thog bzhugs rgyu dang / bzhugs khri'i g.yon du bzhugs stegs mtho po zhig brgyab nas der krang cing spru bzhugs rgyu/ de'i gral mtshams rgya phyogs kyi dpon rigs rnams la gdan 'os 'tshams rgyag rgyu/ sku tshab krang cing u yis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog la phyag rtags phul rjes khong sger gyi ming thog nas 7gong sa ṭī la'i bla ma mchog la mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'bul rgyu/mdzad sgo grub rjes sku tshab krang cing u 7gong sa mchog gi gzim chung du bcar te bka' mol gnang rgyu bcas kyi dgongs 'char bton gnang ba der krang cing us mos mthun byas yod kyang / krang cing us kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung gi par chen po zhig tshom chen nang du khyer yong skabs tu la'i bla mas ma'o kru'u zhi yi par la thal mo sbyar nas gus btud zhu dgos pa dang / ma'o yi par de 'jog yul tu la'i bla ma'i bzhugs khri las mtho ba zhig gra sgrig dgos rgyu bcas kyi bsam tshul bton/zu 9 ches 38 nyin tshud 11 thog rgya gzhung sku tshab krang cing us 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog la phyag rtags 'bul rgyu'i nyin mo der krang cing u ngo las rnams lha sa nas nor gling pho brang du bskyod skabs ma'o tse tung gi par chen po zhig rgya dmag bzhi yi 'khyer ba dang / de'i rjes su rgya dmag pho mo lnga bcu lhag gis rnga brdungs rol cha btang nas bskyod/ de'i rjes su krang cing u ngo las rnams nor gling du bskyod/ sku tshab krang cing u sogs nor gling skal bzang pho brang gi tshoms chen 'gag tu 'byor rjes byings rnams 78

phyi ru bsdad pa dang / khong gi las rogs rnams tshoms chen nang du bcar/ skabs der 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen pos bzhugs khri'i gsham du sku tshab krang cing u la dga' bsu gnang / ma'o yi par bzhugs khri'i g.yon du sgrig gshom byas te 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog nas ma'o yi par la gzigs nas phyag 'phur 'phur gnang ba las gus btud gang yang ma mdzad/ de nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog bzhugs zhabs 'khod 'phral sku tshab krang cing u sger gyi ming thog nas 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog la mjal dar dang / maṇ+ḍal rten gsum sogs phul rjes las byed gzhan rnams nas rim bzhin mjal dar phul zin bstun/ sku tshab krang cing u'i gtsos pa'i ngo las rnams dang/ bod gzhung srid tshab rnam gnyis sogs rang rang so so'i bzhugs khrir 'khod / sku tshab krang cing u'i bzhugs gdan mtho ba dang de'i 'gram du de las dma' ba'i gdan rim pa ltar de'i thog las rogs rnams bsdad/ mdzad sgo grub rjes sku tshab krang cing u gong sa mchog gi gzim chung du khyug tsam bcar/mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod pe cing nas khams brgyud lha sar phebs 'byor rjes bar lam pe cing du gros mthun bzhag pa'i skor 7gong sa chen po mchog dang / srid tshab rnam gnyis/ bka' shag bcas la snyan seng rim zhus rjes nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du bod ljongs ser skya yongs rdzogs kyis tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog bka' blon nga phod kyis dang thog rgya dmag gis khams phyogs su dpung 'ju ga byas pa'i skor/ rim bzhin chab mdo dbang sgyur byas te bod gzhung gis pe cing du zhi mthun sku tshab bsko rdzong gis gros mthun snga phyi bar gsum gyi yong rkyen bcas phra zhing zhib pa'i snyan seng ring po zhig mdzad/dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus kyis mdzad pa'i rgad po'i lo rgyus 'bel gtam las/ lha ldan rgyal khab chen po'i gzhis byes bla dpon lhan 'dzoms 79

mtshams nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms thog bka' blon nga phod nas thog ma'i yong rkyen spyi dang / bye brag gros 'char don tshan ji 'khod/ de rjes paṇa chen skor sogs don tshan gsar snon gang byung zur yig 'jog pa gnang ba'i dgos pa rgyu mtshan sogs re re bzhin phra zhing zhib pa'i sgo nas yul dus gnas bab gang sa ci thad nas da lam 'di 'dra zhig las gnang thabs med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / rgyu rngan rjes 'brangs sogs kyis bstan pa dang / sgo phyogs brjes pa'i thugs dogs yong gzhi med kyang rang ngos nas dam tshig gtsang thabs zhus par 'gal med la song / bstan srung dmar nag dpang btsugs yin zhes tha tshig dbu mnas rgyas dpyad dang bcas de nyin chu tshod drug tsam ring zhib zhu mdzad par tshogs 'du lhan rgyas nas kyang yul babs dus bsnyun de las gnang thabs mi 'dug thugs rje che zhes gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung yang mdzad song zhes gsal/ de'i rjes tsam la bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyis bka' shag tu bsam tshul phul don gsham gsal/skabs der tshogs 'du nas gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun nang don tshan bzhi pa dang / dgu pa/ bcu gnyis ba bcas yag po byung 'dug kyang / bcings 'grol dmag mang po mi yong ba brtson len gang thub gnang dgos/ de rnams kyi bskyod lam thad lha sar gcig bsdud bya rgyu med pa dang / lho lam nas gro mo sogs kyi sa mtshams sushar bskyod bya rgyu/ gros mthun lag len bstar skabs dang len zhu thabs med rigs bsam tshul bton 'thus chog rgyu/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi 'gan dbang ni bcings 'grol dmag dpung rnams sgrig khrims las 'gal du mi 'jug pa zhig byed dgos/ bod kyi 'dzugs skrun dang / sa mtshams kyi srung skyob thad bod kyi gnas tshul dang bsnun dgos rgyu/ gros mthun lag len bstar ba'i nang gros mthun dang 'gal rigs rnams bod 80

gzhung gis the gtogs byed chog rgyu/ bod ljongs mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba'i rigs dngos su sgyur bcos thub pa bya dgos/ slob gso 'dzugs nyer gyi thad shugs rkyen thebs rgyur do snang bya dgos/ rgyal ston dus chen gong gros mthun la brtsi bkur gyi tar 'phrin 'bul rgyu'i rnam 'gyur ston rgyu/ gros mthun 'jog pa'i nang zhugs mkhan 'thus mi tshos thabs byus gang thub gnang bar tshogs 'du nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas kyi chig tho bka' shag tu phul/sku tshab krang cing us be+e 10 ches 3 nyin krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs nas lo gcig 'khor ba'i rgyal ston rten 'brel ched lha sa gtsang chu'i nye 'gram du bod gzhung rtse skor rnams kyi spro gling rtse drung gling kha'i nang du rgyal ston rten 'brel gyi gsol ston bshams te bod gzhung srid tshab rnam gnyis dang / bka' shag gi bka' blon rnam pa/ dza tha'i drung rtsis rnam pa/ de bzhin gros mthun 'jog skabs su bskyod pa'i skya tshab ngo las/ lha sar bca' sdod rgya gar gyi tshong don sku tshab dang / bal po dang / 'brug pa sogs kyang gsol ston du gdan zhu byas/de nyin srid tshab rnam gnyis gsol ston du ngo phebs ma thub par ngo tshab tu sne mgron dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog gsol ston du gtong gnang mdzad par krang cing u yis srid tshab rnam gnyis ma phebs par ngo tshab btang ba der 'dod blor ma babs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis sku mgron mang po'i sar khrel dgod cig bgad de 'jig rten gyi las don thog sku tshab gtong srol yod kyang / gsol ston du sku tshab gtong srol e yod ces 'phya smod lta bus bshad pas tshang mas gad mo gcig bgad pa las tshig lan rgyag mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / srid tshab gnyis gsol ston du ma phebs pa'i don ni/mi dmangs kyi 'dod blo dang mi 'gal ba'i dgongs pa bzhes pa zhig yin zhing / gsol 81

ston du sku tshab gtong gnang mdzad pa ni mthun lam gyi ched du yin par snyam/sku tshab krang cing u yis bod gzhung nas gros mthun la brtsi bkur zhu ched pe cing du tar 'phrin zhig gang myur gtong dgos lugs skul 'ded byas stabs bod gzhung gis bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshig tho don tshan gsum bka' shag brgyud 7gong sa mchog la snyan zhu phul nas chog mchan stsal te bod gzhung bka' shag gi sku tshab krang cing u la don tshan gsum 'khod pa'i tshig tho zhig sprad pa'i don tshan dang po/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi 'gan dbang skor/ gnyis pa/ bod du rgya mi'i bcings 'grol dmag dpung gang nyung bya rgyu'i skor/ gsum pa/ chab mdo mnga' khul bod gzhung gi khongs su phyir slog bya rgyu'i skor bcas yin/ bka' shag nas nga phod brgyud sku tshab krang cing u la bod gzhung gis rgya nag dbus gzhung la gros mthun la brtsi 'jog bya rgyu'i rlung 'phrin ma gtong gong rgya phyogs nas bka' shag gis bton pa'i don tshan gsum la yig thog nas lan 'debs byung mtshams bod gzhung gis gzhi nas rlung 'phrin btong rgyu yin zhes brda sprod gnang /nyin zhig bka' blon lha klu che dbang rdo rjes sku tshab krang cing u dang 'phros mol skabs lha klus krang cing u la/ bod du bcings 'grol dmag mi grangs 'bor ga tshod 'jog rgyu yin nam/ zhes dri ba gnang ba'i lan du/ phal cher mi grangs chig khri nyis stong nas brgyad stong bar yin zhes lan 'debs byas yod pa red ces zer/ de ni snga lo pe cing du gros mthun don tshan 17 'jog skabs gros mthun gyi zur yig gi don tshan gcig gi nang du/ bod du bcings 'grol dmag cun gcig yas mas zhes 'khod pa dang mtshungs pa zhig dngos 'brel bshad 'dugaskabs der rgya phyogs kyi bod du dmag grangs chig khri lhag tsam bzhag rtsis yod par mngon/ bar lam rgya dmar bod dmag khul khang gi dmag dpon 'bring rim ci 82

yi'u tshon gyis bris pa'i bod ljongs kyi ngo log zing 'khrugs zhod 'jags btang ba'i dngos don zin tho'i zhes pa'i deb chung nang du/ 1951 zla 'a tshes 19 nyin rgya dmar gyi dmag sgar cun 18 zhes pa khongs kyi thon 154 pa'i khongs kyi ru khag gsum pa dang / thon de'i me sgyegs 'phrul chas brgya shog gcig bcas kra go hā yi bka' bkod ltar lha sar 'byor te sngon bskyed dpung sde'i nus stobs che ru phyin par brten bka' shag gi 'dzims pa med pa'i rdzig nyams de chag nas don tshan bcu bdun la rnam 'gyur zhig bstan te krang cing u la don tshan gsum bton pa red/dang po/ bod la dmag srid u yon lhan khang btsugs nas de'i las don dang / dbang tshad/ t+yā la'i bla ma'i dbu gnas dang / dbang cha/gnyis pa/ bod du bcing bkrol dmag mi gang nyung nyung las gtong rgyu med/sa mtshams gnad yod khag la brtan srung kyi las 'gan bod dmag la 'khur du 'jug rgyu/gsum pa/ bod rigs gnas ba'i sa khul yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgril dgos pa/ chab mdo sa khul de sngar bzhin bod gzhung la phyir sprod dgos rgyu bcas kyi bsam 'char bton pa red/de'i rjes tsam la krang cing u yis dmag srid u yon ldan khang / krung dbyang mi dmangs gzhung (dbusagazhung ) gi bod la sku tshab kyi las khungs yin pas nges par 'dzugs dgos pa dang / bod dmag khul khang ni dmag don bdag gnyer byed pa'i las khungs shig yin/ gong gsal las khungs de gnyis kyi dus kun tu bod sa gnas gzhung dang 'brel gtug byed dgos par brten dmag srid u yon lhan khang gis bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bod dmag khul khang gi las don mtha' 83

dag bcas bdag gnyer bya rgyu/ bod du mi mang bcing bkrol dmag gi cun zhes pa'i dmag sgar gcig yong rgyur dmag 'bor khri gnyis yas mas shig yod/ de rnams kyis rgyal rtse dang / gzhis rtse/ mnga' ris/ kong po nying khri bcas kyi sa srung bya rgyu dang / lha sar bcing bkrol dmag 'bor stong bzhi yas shig gtan sdod bya rgyu dang /dmag gi bza' chas rnams rgya nag nas 'or 'dren byed rgyu las bod mi rnams kyi 'gan 'khur byed dgos ma red/ bod dmag rnams rim bzhin go rim ltar bcings bkrol dmag tu bsgyur te bcings bkrol dmag gi thob thang sprod rgyu/ bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs gcig tu bsgril rgyu'i skor/ si khron dang / kun su'u/yul nan/ khams (skabs der shi khang zhing chen zer ba'i ming bsdad yod )mtsho sngon zhing chen bcas kyi bod rigs mi mang rnams kyis 'dems shog 'phen nas thag gcod bya rgyu dang / de rnams kyi mos mthun byung na 'grigs kyi red/ 'on kyang da lta'i dusaskabs 'dir bcings bkrol btang zin ma thag yin stabs gang ci'i thog mthud mtshams byas yod pa ma red/ lhag par bod rigs sa khul gzhan dag rnams bcing bkrol sngon du thob par brten las don yar rgyas myur du 'gro bzhin yod pas/da lta'i dus skabs 'di gcig gyur gyi gros mos yong mi rung / chab mdo sa khul de krung dbyang (dbusagazhung ) gi chog mchan thon ma thag bod la phyir sprod byed kyi red/tshod dpag byas na dka' ngal yong gi ma red/ tā la'i bla ma'i mtshan gnas dang dbang cha'i skor 'gyur ba 'gro gi ma red/ krung dbyang gis khong la dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi (srid 'dzin nam spyi khyab ) byed 'jug gi red bcas bka' shag lhan rgyas la lan gsal sprad yod pa red ces gsal/gong gsal gyi gnas tshul de dag ni/ rgya dmar gyi dmag khul gi chab srid 84

dril bsgrags sde tshan khru'u yi khru'u krang gzhon pa ci yi'u chon gyis rtsom 'bri byas pa'i gong gsal deb chung nas ngo bshus byas so/sku tshab krang cing u yis bod gzhung gis sprad pa'i don tshan gsum la lan 'debs bya rgyu ka kor kho na'i thog tar 'phrin gtong dgos lugs sngar bzhin skul ma yang yang byas stabs bka' shag nas tar 'phrin gyi zin bris shig bstan pa der rgya phyogs nas bzo bcos kyis bka' shag la mos mthun byed du bcug1951 lo'i rla 'a chis 30 nyin krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal ston dus chen la bod gzhung gis tar 'phrin btang pa de lo rgyus thog byung thengs dang po yin/ lu'o yus hun gyis rgyu cha 'dems sgrig 'don thengs drug pa'i nang / rla 10ches 11 nyin khe smad nas bka' shag gi yi ge zhig nga tshor sprad pa de'i nang du yang gros mthun la rnam 'gyur ston rgyu'i skor rlung 'phrin khyab gtong ma byas gong krang tas pe'o/ (sku tshab krang cing u ) yis me dmag srid u yo na lhan khang dang / dmag khul khang gi bka' bkod pu'u yi 'gan dbang skor/ 3 chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs gang ci'i thad gong mthor phyin rjes bod yongs gcig gyur bya rgyu'i gnad don/ nya mdo smad sa khul de bod khongs su gtong rgyu bcas la lan 'debs dgos tshul 'khod 'dug ces gsal/ lo de'i rla 10 ches 14 nyin krang tas pe'o/ phun dbang dang la'o yus hun bcas mnyam du bka' shag tu tshogs 'du tshogs par phyin pa yin/ de'i gros don ni/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi 'gan dbang gi gnad don dang / bod rigs sa khul gcig gyur gyi gnad don mdo smad sa khul (chabamado sa khul ) de bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khongs su gtogs rgyu'i gnad don/ dmag dpung mang po yong rgyu med pa'i gnad don bcas red ces gsal/85

rgya phyogs nas/ dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi kru'u zhi tu la'i bla mas thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu dang / tshogs 'du dang / mdzad sgo'i skabs tu la'i bla ma nges par du phebs bzhugs gnang rgyu/ de bzhin dmag srid u yon lhan khang gi gros gzhi thag gcod byed skabs bod gzhung gi lugs rnying sgrig srol ltar bka' shag nas srid blon dang / de nas tu la'i bla mar rim pa bzhin snyan zhu phul nas thob rgyu de ltar byed dgos min/ de bzhin tu la'i bla mas sku tshab btang nas tshogs 'dur zhugs na yang mi 'grigs pa bcas kyi bsam tshul bton te gros bsdur byas kyang gcig mthun byung mi 'dugaskabs der bka' shag nas 7gong sa mchog slob gnyer mtshan rtags ma zin gong chab srid kyi thugs 'gan mang po bzhes che slob gnyer thog 'thus shor 'gro rgyu yin pa'i dgongs tshul shugs che bton pa ma zad/ bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/rig gzhung sogs gang ci'i thad gong mthor phyin rjes bod rigs sa khul yongs rdzogs gcig gyur yong rgyu'i re 'dun slar yang bton pa de ni sngon zhus ltar/ 1951 lo pe cing du gros mthun bzhag pa'i rjes tsam la bod gzhung gi sku tshab bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyi mtshan thog srid blon kra'u en le la chig tho zhig sprad yod pa de dag la slar yang skul lcag gnang ba zhig red/bod gzhung gis rgya phyogs la bcings 'grol dmag gang nyung gtong thabs kyi re 'dun thengs mang bton kyang / re 'dun de dag rgya mtsho rdo dbyugs lta bur gyur thog bar lam bod mi dmangs tshogs pas sprad pa'i yi ge de dag mi dmangs kha la 'khyer ba tsam las nang don mi dmangs kyi rgyab tu gab yibs kyis bka' bkod byed mkhan zhig yod nges zhes srid tshab rnam gnyis la dogs pa byas/skabs der lha sar mi dmangs 'thus tshogs zhes pa zhig tshugs nas kho tsho 86

bka' shag la snyan zhu phul ba'i skor rgya mis thos te re 'dun zhu yig gi nang don gtso bo ni gros mthun la ngo rgol bya rgyu de yin lugs rtsod rnyog mang po byas pa ma zad/ nyin shas sngon nas dge 'dun pa rnams ri la phyin nas dam bca' bzhag pa dang / de ring rdzun chas spras te ri nas babs thog bod mi khram pa khag gcig bsdu rub kyis lkog tu zing cha slong rtsis byas tshul/ lha sa grong khyer nang mang tshogs kyi ru tshogs zhes pa byung zhing / kha dang mda' dpon gyi dmag dpung tshang ma phyir don yod lugs/ rgya mi'i dpon rigs kyi sdod khang la bod mi rnams nas lkog rgol bya rtsis kyi 'char gzhi yod lugs sogs ji mang bshad 'dug par brten dngos su gnas tshul de rigs gang yang byung med kyang / de ni rgya mi'i so pas ma yin yin tshul gyi dkrug rkyen gnas tshul rdzun bzo byas par yid ches byas te ri bong cal 'grogs lta bu'i gnas tshul byung /bka' blon shan kha'i rang rnam rang byung zangs las/ nyin gcig sa 'du rnying par krang cing u'i sar bka' shag lhan rgyas phebs dgos zer ba ltar phebs skabs/krang cing us brjod gsal/ rang re'i phyogs khag gang sa nas dpung rgol bya rtsis kyis se ra nas grwa pa skya chas gyon pa mdung ring 'khyer ba mang po zhig sa 'du'i 'khris kyi khang pa'i nang du 'dzul bsdad yod lugs dang / do nub tshe mchog gling phyogs nas grwa dmag mang po lha sar yong gi yod tshod sogs rdugs pa chen po skyes te srog 'gan len dgos sogs rnyog dra sha stag bshad par bya thabs bral te sa 'du'i nye 'gram gyi khang khungs nang ched mngags blta mkhan btang bar smon lam grol te pha yul du lo ltar 'char can log 'gro mkhan gyi grwa pa yin pa las/ rgya mir ngo rgol byed mkhan gyi gra dmag ma yin pa'i khungs skyel byas rung nyan sems med par da dung tsho mchog gling brgyud dang / phyag mdzod gling kha'i nang skya ser mang po yod tshod sogs rnyog dra chen po shod mus su sa 'du'i lcang 87

gseb dkyil nas me mda'i sgra zhig thon song stabs tshang ma 'ur 'grogs chen po byung song ba de dag brtsad gcod skabs/ rgya mi kho rang tsho'i srung dmag khongs nas dogs 'dregs 'dar sig gis me skam mnan thal byung 'dug de nub bod mi mang pos mtshan 'gebs byed kyi yod skad kho na bshad par brten bka' blon rnams kyang bya thabs bad zad kyis mi dmangs nas tshur rgol yong na shi na mnyam shi dang / gson na mnyam gson bya rgyur krang cing ur rogs pa bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / lha klu/nga phod gsum bcas sa 'du rnying par mi gte ltar bur bzhugs rgyur thag bcad de/ de nub chu tshod 11 ma zin bar rgya mis dgra zon chen pos sgug nas bsdad/ dgra sogs kyi gnod 'che byed mkhan gang yang med stabs gang 'tshams nas sku rtsed mā cang dang /tag se sogs kyang gnang ste bzhugs/ sang nyin nyi ma ma shar tsam la gzhi nas tshang ma gnyid kyis ra ros lta byas bzhugs 'dug ces gsal/ skabs der gang ltar rgya mis rnyog dra mang po bshad de bka' shag nas 'gan khur gnang dgos lugs bshad 'duganyin zhig krang cing u nor gleng lhun grub dga' tshal gzim chung du 7gong sa mchog mjal bcar skabs srid tshab rnam gnyis kyang lhan bcar gnang yod pa dang krang cing us srid tshab rnam gnyis 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du bzhugs pa der mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ de nyin gyi gsung sgyur ni krang cing u'i skad sgyur a mdo gro tshang phun tshogs bkris dang / phran gnyis yin/ 7gong sa mchog zhal lho gzigs kyis bzhugs sgrom du bzhugs shing / sku tshab krang cing u dang / khong gi rogs mi gcig g.yon phyogs dang / srid tshab rnam gnyis g.yas phyogs/ skad sgyur gnyis bzhugs gdan gzhan las dma' tsam thog bsdad nas phun tshun gyi gsung gleng sgyur zhu byas/krang cing u yis 7gong sa mchog la/ bar lam rgya bod gnyis gros mthun lag 88

len bstar phyogs skor bgro gleng thengs 'ga' shas byung yang phan tshun bsam tshul ma mthun pa je sdug je zhan du 'gyur ba'i skor zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas rgya phyogs kyi bsam tshul gleng bar lan 'debs ji 'gab skor srid tshab rnam gnyis la gzigs tsam gnang bar/ srid tshab rnam gnyi sa kyis da lta krang cing zhus 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus bden la cung zad dan min gyi dgag lan lta bu gnang rjes krang cing u ngo gdong dmar por gyur te/ khong khro rab du 'bar nas/ khyed gnyis tu la'i bla ma'i sku mdun la gus zhabs dang / brtsi bkur med par ham zhu'i thog kha lan slog pa 'os su ma mchis pa red/ ces tshig nan mang dag gis kha rdung drag po btang bar brten phran skad sgyur gnyis 'jigs snang chen po skyes pa'i 'og yud tsam ring phan tshun gyi gsung gleng ji bzhin sgyur ma thub par hang sangs pa zhig byung ba'i mur/ srid tshab klu khang pas/ skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma 'dir gtso bor bzhugs yod pa red/ de'i 'og nga tsho las ku'i 'gan khyer nas las ka byed kyi yod/ de 'dra yin tsang las ka byed stangs skor snyan seng zhu ba'i las 'gan yod/ de zhu dbang med pa ga re zer gyi yod/ krang cing u yis/ khyed gnyis tā la'i bla ma'i sku mdun la skad cha shugs chen po bshad pa de tu la'i bla mar gus zhabs dang / brtsi 'jog mi byed pa ha cang thabs sdug yin lugs bshad de srid tshab bla mas rgya skad kyi tshog tu (gre ka me yo kon she/de ga'i byed kyi 4red ces gsungs pa'i ngang mjal 'phrad de mi dga' ba'i ngang nas grol dgos byung /de nas bzung rgya phyogs nas bka' shag la/ slad tu la'i bla ma'i sku mdun mjal 'phrad zhu skabs srid tshab lhan bcar gnang na 'grig gi mi 'dug ces dgag cha zhus te srid tshab rnam gnyis phebs rgyu med pa chags/ srid tshab bla ma blo bzang bkris ni de snga rgya nag nan cing du bod gzhung gi don gcod kyi thugs 'gan lo shas bzhes yod 89

stabs rgya skad gang tsam mkhyen gyi yod/rgya phyogs nas mi dmangs kyis snyan zhu phul bar blo 'don gros rogs lta bu srid tshab rnam gnyis yin par dogs pa chen po yod lugs yang nas yang du bshad par bka' shag nas dag sel ji ltar gnang yang nyan shes go shes med pa'i thog btsan po dbang yod kyi nag nyes bkal thog gal srid bka' shag gis mi dmangs tshogs pa de rtsa gtor ma btang tsho rgya phyogs kyis drag po'i thog nas lag len bstar gyi yin zhes 'jigs snang ji snyed skul zhing / gal srid bod gzhung gis lha sa grong khyer yongs kyi bde 'jags las don byed ma thub che mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis srung skyob bya rgyu yin lugs kyi rdog kha blangs/ de nyin krang cing u gdong gshis dmar por gyur nas bod gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs rnams kyi dkyil du rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyis yar mar 'gro bzhin du srid tshab gnyis kyis mi dmangs tshogs pa'i rgyab tu gab nas dmag 'thab kyi bka' bkod byed lugs kyi 'khrab stangs ji snyed byas 'dug 'on kyang de'i rjes tsam gyi nyin gcig krang cing u yis mi dmangs tshogs 'thus gsum kho pa'i sdod gnas su ched 'bod thug 'phrad skabs bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ dza tha'i sogs kyang lhan 'dzomasasu 'bod 'gugs byas te rgya mis tshogs 'thus gsum la ja dang / kha tog gzab rgyas kyi sne len dang mdza' brtse ldan pa'i rnam pa bstan nas 'jam mkhas thog nas dri ba mang po byas song yang / de gsum gyis snyan zhur gsal ba'i zhu tshig kho na las gzhan gang yang ma bshad par rgya mi'i khog rtsis ngan byus de ha log pa lta bu byung /de rjes rgya phyogs nas sngar bzhin bka' shag la mi dmangs 'thus mi'i rgyab tu skul slong bya mi zhig yod pa der rgya bod thun mong nas bka' zhib tshogs chung zhig 'dzugs dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul bshad pa ltar bka' shag gis tha'i ji bsam pho 90

bsko bzhag gnang ste/ rgya phyogs nas bskos pa'i mi sna dang mnyam du zhib gcod byas/ rgya mi'i re bar mi dmangs skul slong byed po zhig thon pa bya rgyu de yin na yang / de lta'i skul slong byed po med nges la brten bod gzhung gis zhib gcod pas do snang chen po ma byas pa'i rkyen red ces da dung rnyog rtsod bshad rkyen bka' shag 'u thug thabs zad kyis mi 'thus byed gte rnams la sgo g.yogs/ lcags brgyab/ rta lcag gtong rgyu'i thog lha sa'i khrom lam du bdun phrag kha shas 'jog rgyu sogs kyi 'char gzhi zhig sku tshab krang cing u la mig ston gnang skabs/ rgya phyogs kyis mi 'thus tshor khrims gcod de 'dra bya rgyu rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la gnod gzhi yong rgyur brten de rigs ma dgos pa'i bsam tshul bshad de gnas tshul de rang bzhin gyis nar 'gyangs su lus/rla 4 ches 3 nyin gyi dgong dro bod gzhung srid tshab rnam gnyis dang /bka' blon rnam pa bcas dang / rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u dang lhan du gros mthun lag len bstar stangs skor lha sa gtsug lag khang steng snang srid gzim chung du gros mol gyis rgya phyogs nas mthun sgril dam gzab yong ba dang / gros mthun lag len bde blag tu bstar phyogs skor dang / lhag par du mig sngar byung ba'i mi dmangs tshogs pas rgya phyogs dang / bod gzhung bka' shag la phul ba'i tshig tho'i skor phan tshun gzigs phyogs dgongs tshul rno ngar can du gyur pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul byung /bka' blon shan kha'i rang rnam rang byung zangs las/ rgya phyogs nas mi dmangs kyi snyan zhu phul bar blo 'don gros rogs lta bu byed mkhan srid tshab rnam gnyis la dogs pa chen po yod mus su rgya phyogs nas bod don skor bka' mol zhu rgyu ji rnyed yod ces srid bka' lhan tshogs thog rbo phyogs nas krang cing u can bla steng snang srid gzim chung du lhan rgyas bka' mol gnang dgos zer ba bzhin bka' mol ji byung chig tho bkod pa red/94

srid tshab bde khar bas/ bod sar rgya mi'i 'go dmag rogs ram yin tshul gyi mi mang po yong mi dgos pa dang / bod 'byor rnams la dgos mkho me shing bod gzhung gi gzhung gling khag nas dgos nges sprod bzhin yang rgya phyogs kyis lha khul gyi khyi rus dang /gos trul/ btsog lud sogs gang byung mer bsregs kyi dre ngan gang sar khyab pas mi dmangs kyi gtsang sbra 'phrod bsten la brtsi med gnod skyon kun gyi shes gsal la de rigs mi 'byung ba'i khyab 'doms zhu rgyu sogs dang / lhag par bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol gyi gros mthun don tshan 17 bod kyi yul lung yar rgyas rogs ram kha zhe gnyis mtshungs sheg gnang gi yod na/ bod sa rgya'i btsan 'og tu bsdad pa'i 'ba' li rgyal gsum dang /hor ser khag lnga/ sde chab sogs mdor na sngar gyi bod sa bsnyen med rgya bod sa mtshams gung gu rme ru'i rdo ring yan bod gzhung rang la phyir log yong ba dang / de min nad pa zhig sar 'gyel ba'i skabs sgab gsham nas mar bsnan te yar longs zhes ji tsam bshad kyang langs thabs med pa'i dpe ltar rgya phyogs nas bod sa bston med rnying khungs chos ldan bod mi nyam chung thog mi'i spyod bzang 'dzam gling spyi khrims las yongs su 'das pa'i gdug rtsub kla klo'i spyod ngan 'bu ches chung bzos kyi bya spyod shin tu ngan pa'i thog da dung bod kyi sa sde mi gsum rtsis sprod ma gnang bar rgya phyogs nas bod de yar rgyas gong 'phel bzo rgyu yin lugs ji ltar gsungs kyang da lta rgya bod gnyis dmag 'thab kyi mi bsad khrag sbyor byung ba'i mgo bo'i khrag kyang ma skam pa yod mus su da dung bod yar rgyas gtong rgyu'i bka' mol de dag tshang ma be'u ljang khrid kyi bslu tshig kho nar ngos 'dzin byed pa las bod mi bsam yod sus kyang yid ches byed mkhan yong gi ma red/ 'jig rten kha dper/ mgo gser skus bcag na byirne rlabs med/ dma' gnyen gyis phab na phab bden yin/ zhes zer ba ltar bod mir rgya phyogs nas rogs ram yin 92

tshul gyis snga phyi bar gsum la btsan gnon sdang zug che bas bod mi rnams blo pham nga rgyal ma bsangs pa'i mur da dung rgya phyogs nas gnang gnang mang po rang gnang na zhi ba'i gros mthun la mi gnas pa'i 'gal rkyen dzi 'gyur nges pa med pas bka' mol babs brling brtan gsum dgos zhes gsungs pa gsal ba ltar/ de nyin srid tshab bde kharabs/ brjid nyams spobs pa dang ldan pa'i bka' mol gong gsal don gnad rnams thad kur gsungs pa'i skor de sngon bka' blon shan kha ba dang / sne mgron mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchog gnyis nas kyang go thos byung / rgya'i gtam dpe las/ 'jig zil bstan kyang mgo mi sgyar/ dbang shugs la yang gnya' mi chag ces pa ltar bsngags brjod kyi me tog lan brgyar 'thor 'os pa zhig yin/yang nyin zhig tshogs 'du dngos gzhi'i bka' mol ma gnang gong phan tshun spyir btang gi bka' mol ci sgros mol sgros lta bu gsung skabs skya tshab krang cing u yis/ srid tshab bde mkhar bar/ sku nyid kyi bzhes can 'di'i nang nyin re gsol ja ga tshod bzhes kyi yod dam zhes bka' 'dre zhus par/ de'i lan du/ ja zhim po byung na rgyags tshada'athung gi yod/ zhim po ma byung na rtsa ba nas 'thung gi med ces go rgyu'i gtam lan 'debs gnang mdzad pa'i chig don de yongs grags su khyab yod/sku tshab krang cing u yis kyang tshogs 'du'i gros gzhir gsal bshad bskyar zlos yang zlos byas pa der srid tshab bde mkhar bas krang cing u'i brjod chig rnams la skyon brjod nan po gnang stabs phyogs so so'i bsam tshul dag sel rno ngar dang ldan pa'i rtsod gleng byung bar brten rgya phyogs kyi bod dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi gzhon pa phu'u si ling yon phan ming nas srid tshab rnam gnyis la mi'i cha mthong tsam yang ma bzhag par gdug rtsub ham bshad kyis da lam bod mi dmangs kyi snyan zhu phul ba'i zhu tshigs 93

sogs gang la gzhigs kyang srid tshab bde mkhar ba phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab kyi dbang shugs dang 'brel ba yod pas/ srid tshab gnyis gnas dbyungs gtong rgyu yin zhes zer skabs der srid tshab bde mkhar bas/ nga ni skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma rin po ches srid tshab bsko gzhag gnang ba zhig yin/ khyod lta bu zhig gis gnas dbyung gtong rgyur nyan thub kyi ma red/ 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma rin po ches nga la chu la mchong dgos zhes bka' phebs kyang mchong gi red ces gsungs te 'jig zhum spu tsam med pa'i lan 'debs nan po gnang 'dugaskabs der krang cing u yis nga ni bod rgya tshang ma'i las don la zhib 'jug byed mkhan sku tshab cig yin/ da lta phan si ling yon gyis bshad pa'i skad char cha bzhag yog ma red zer bar/ srid tshab bde mkhar bas khyed rang rgya gzhung gis bod du btang ba'i sku tshab kyi go chod kyi mi 'dug ces gsungs nas de nyin tshogs 'du grol skabs phan tshun spyir btang gi phyag gtong res kyang ma gnang bar phan tshun gcig gis gcig la rnam 'gyur sdug po bstan res byung 'dug pa ma zad/ skabs der gtsug lag khang gi shing ra'i snang srid gzim chung 'gag bar rgya mi bcings 'grol dmag brgya lhag tsam zhig bstar sgrigs kyi drag chas spras te dmag sar slebs pa nang bzhin rgol lan sprad chog chog gi gra bsgrigs byas par brten skad cig tsam la yang rgya dmag gis ngan spyod ji byed nges med kyi gnas su gyar bas g.yas g.yon du gnas pa'i bod mi rnams la dngangs skrag dang sems khral chen po byung /rgya mis gong gsal tshogs 'du de 'dra snga rjes thengs 'ga' shas skong tshogs thog bod dmag rnams bcings 'grol dmag la bsgyur ba'i dus babs lugs dang /bod kyi dmag sgar du btsugs pa'i bod kyi rgyal dar de'i tshab tu rgya mi'i rgyal dar 94

'dzugs dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul bton par srid tshab klu khang pas/ bsam tshul de dgos don med la khas len thub pa yang ma red/ gros mthun don tshan 17 la ming rtags bkod tshul rgya mi tshos brjod pa 'di dag nga tsho'i mi dmangs nas khas len byas pa med/ gros mthun nang gi don tshan rnams la rgya mi khyed rang tshos rgyab 'gal yang yang byas yod/ bod dmag rgya dmag la bsgyur rgyu'i thad bod mir btsan shed mi byed pa'i skor gros mthun nang gsal yod/ bcos sgyur de la bod mis dga' mos byed kyi ma red/gal srid rgya mi'i rgyal dar btsugs pa yin na/ bod mi rnams kyis 'bebs kyi red/ de ltar byung na khyed tsho ngo tsha po yong gi red ces gsungs 'dug sku tshab krang cing us khong khro chen po'i sgo nas gros mthun du 'khod pa'i bod dmag bcings 'grol dmag la bsgyur du mi 'jug pa dang / krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal dar 'dzugs mi chog pa dang / gal srid btsugs na 'bebs dgos lugs gsung babs la bltas na/ sridatshab gnyis nas mi dmangs snyan zhu 'bul du bcug pa dang / der skul slong dang rgyab bskyor byas pa de mngon gsal byung song zhes bshad ma thag tshogs 'du de grol dgos byung / skabs der lha sa'i khul sngar srol bzhin lha ldan smon lam chen mo tshugs rgyu'i brel 'tshabs yod pa dang dus mtshungs mi dmangs tshogs pas ngo rgol gyi las 'gul bslang mi yong ngam snyam te rgya phyogs la dogs 'drogs dngangs skrag gi gnas tshul 'og lha 'byo ra rgya mi'i zhi drag 'go byed rnams kyis tshogs 'du 'tshogs nas rgya mi zho drag yongs rdzogs drag chas spras te da lta rang g.yul sa chen po zhig tu bskyed rgyu yin pa lta bu'i gra sgrig bya rgyu'i bka' btang ba dang / lha sa'i nye 'khor sa khul du yod pa'i rgya dmag bcings 'grol dpung dmag rnams lha sa khul du bskong 'dzoms byas/95

lo yus hung gis nyin deb las/ 1952 zu 4 ches 1 nyin dgong mo kung u'i/ krang go gung khran tang bod sdod don gcod lha khang kyis dza drag gi dmag grabs skul slong byas shing / gzhis rtser bca' sdod rang re'i me sgrogs dmag sgar lha sar bskong pa dang / las khungs khag so sos kyang dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig byas zhes gsal/dus skabs de'i sngon tsam la mdo smad shar byang khul sogs nas rgya mi'i zhidrag 'go dmag rim 'byor la brten srid tshab rnam gnyis nas bka' shag la bka' mngags gnang don ltar/ rgya mi'i zhi drag 'go dmag phon che rim 'byor yong bzhin pa yin pas/ deng skabs bka' shag tu bka' blon ngo las dang / bka' tshab bcas brgyad tsam yod gshis slad bstan srid kyi mdzad byus dus bsnun chogs su tshud ched rgya phyogs la yang mthun lam legs 'grigs ched bka' blon nga phod dang / bka' tshab bkras gling pa/ bka' tshab shan kha ba bcas gsum bka' sha ga zur tshogs kyis rgya mi 'go dmag rnams kyi dgos mkho dang sdod sgrig sogs dang / lhag par las don che phra mtha' dag gi rigs 'brel mol gtso bo zhu dgos rgyu dang / bstan srid skor gal che'i skabs su bka' shag lhan 'dzoms thog bka' gros gnang dgos lugs bcas bka' mngags gnang don bzhin 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog la dgongs skor snyan seng dang 'brel ba'i zur skyong bka' shag ces gsar 'dzugs gnang snye nyin re bzhin rgya mi dang 'grel gtugs kyi phyag las gnang /skabs der bod mi dmangs nas rgya dmar la ngo rgol gyi yig skyur yang yang sbyar 'grems byung ba'i gnas tshul de'i skor rgya mis bod gzhung bka' shag la rnyog dra mang po zhig zhus don bka' shag nas mi ngan nyung shas la rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la dkrug rkyen bzo ru bcug tshul dang / lhag par gros mthun la ngo rgol byed 96

pa'i yig bsgyur sbyar du bcug pa/ lha sa'i dam/ngas khrod du rgya rgol gyi glu gzhas dang /'chal gtam gang byung bsgrags pa de rigs la 'gog 'doms ma gnang ba bcas rgya phyogs nas bka' shag la rgol gtam nan po btang thog lam seng de rigs mi chog pa'i bkag 'doms kyi rtsa tshig nan po zhig 'grems dgos lugs zhus pa ltar/ bka' shag nas zhal bzhes ma gnang mthu med byung /gong gsal bod rgya dpon rigs gnad yod rnams kyis tshogs 'du snga rjes thengs 'ga' shas tshogs par grub 'bras gang yang ma byung khar/ phan tshun gyi 'gal rla je sdug tu gyur te rgya phyogs nas kha skyengs khro langs kyis sngar bzhin srid tshab rnam gnyis btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan shugs dang 'brel ba yod lugs dang / gros mthun la gtor bshig gtong mkhan/ mi rigs kha bral gtong mkhan/ mngon sum 'dzems med kyis mi dmangs tshorges pa zer ba de'i gtso skyong byed mkhan sogs yin lugs kyi ma nyes kha g.yog sna tshogs bkal snye srid tshab klu khang pa dang / blo bzang bkris gnyis nas bod kyi srid tshab 'gan 'khur 'phral du phyir 'then dgos lugs bka' shag brgyud yig thog nas snyan zhu phul zhing / de bzhin bka' shag nas kyang / 7gong sa mchog la srid tshab rnam gnyis dgongs pa zhu bcug na legs tshul gyi bsam 'char phul yod par brten 7gong sa mchog nas sku ngal mdzad dka' ci che'i ngang srid tshab gnyis dgongs pa stsal dgos byung 'dugagal srid skabs der srid tshab gnyis dgongs pa ma gnang bar da mus bzhag pa yin na/ rgya phyogs nas khong gnyis rgya nag tu btsan khrid bya rgyu nang don lam tsam gtan 'khel 'dug 7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang / ngos kyi mi dmangs zhes pa'i mdzad rnam shog grangs 103 nang / bka' shag nas srid tshab gnyis ka dgongs pa zhu 97

ru bcug na legs tshul bsam 'char sprad byung zhing / gnas tshul de mthar thug skabs dka' tshogs can gyi las ka zhig byed dgos byung / klung khang pas snying stobs chen pos rgya mir lan 'debs byas pa der phran nas brtsi mthong chen po yod kyang / yang na klu khang pa mu mthud las ka byed du 'jug rgyu dang / yang na rgya mi'i ngag bzhin phyir 'then bya rgyu de gnyis red/ de la gnad don gnyis yod/ dang po klu khang pa'i lus srog gi nyen kha dang /gnyis pa ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi gnad don de red/ klu khang pa'i lus srog ni kho rang gis nyen kha'i nang bcug zin pa dang / ngas las khur mu mthud bzhag kyang / rgya mis thabs sna tshogs shig bya rgyu yin pa gsal mthong red/ ces gsal ba ltar/ 7gong sa chen po dgung na shin tu phra ba'i dus 'dir bstan pa chab srid rnyog 'dzing gnyan 'phrang dka' tshogs can gyi gnas bab 'og skad cig tsam gyi ring la yang yo lang gi 'gal rkyen ji 'gyur su zhig gis kyang tshod dpag mi thub pa'i dbang gis 7gong sa che na po mchog nas rgya mi'i zhu don dang / bka' shag gi dgongs 'char la gzhigs te thugs mi 'dod bzhin du srid blon rnam gnyis kyi las khur dgongs pa gnang dgos byung /phyi lo 1951 lo tsam sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog tha'i wan nas a rir phebs te de gar dus yun thung tsam zhig bzhugs nas rgya gar du phyir phebs kyis re zhig rgyal yum chen mo dang lhan du ka rdor khul la bzhugs/phyi lo 1953 lo 'go tsam rgyal yum dang lhan du lha sar phebs/ de dus lha sar bod gzhung gi chab srid thugs 'gan bzhes mkhan srid tshab bla ma blo bzang bkris dang / bde mkhar ba rnam gnyis kyis dbus pa'i bod mi mang tshogs bcas nas bod du lhags pa'i rgya'i zhi drag dpon dmag gi dbang shed 'dod rnga ma je cher song ba dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho gos gnas stangs la dka' ngal chen po 'phrad bzhin pa bcas la bzod 98

sgom byed thabs bral te bden pa'i spobs nyams kyis 'dzams zon med par rgya dpon dang rtsod gleng lan snga phyi gnang bar brten khong gnyis la ma dga' zhe 'dzin gyis a mi ri ta'i so myul red zer ba sogs nyes ming rnams grangs bcu tsam bkal nas phyogs gnyis dbar 'gal ba dza drag tu 'gro ba'i dus dang 'khel ba rgyal don mchog ni sku na gzhon la lhag bsam dpa' ngar gnyis 'dzoms thog rgya'i skad yig kyang mkhyen pa'i cha rkyen la brten/ sku tshab krang cing u dang / dmag dpon krang go hā sogs la srid tshab rnam gnyis gzhung zhabs rgan gas myong can lhag bsam zol med kyi thog nas gang ci'i gnas lugs drang por gsung pa las/ phyi lag nang sgrel gyi g.yo sgyu'i rigs nam yang med nges kyi rgyu mtshan gsal bshad kyi ngo chen lta bur phebs par rgya dpon chos nyan shes kyi bdag sprod byed rgyu phar bzhag sngar bas g.yo sgyu dang kheng dregs kyi rnam 'gyur bzung nas khong rnam gnyis a ri'i so myul yin lugs nan brjod dang 'brel sdigs mo'i tshig gis tshar gcod pa'i byed stangs des khong gi rgya dmar gung khran tang la re mos gnang ba'i 'khrul snang gi dgongs pa de shul med du btang ba ma zad/ byed bab de dbang la gzhigs na gang nyid la'ang snga phyi ma gtogs nyen kha 'phrad rgyu yin pa gzigs te re zhig lha sar ma bzhugs par yab gzhis kyi 'dzin khong gzhis ka khag la gzigs zhib tu phebs te mthar lho kha bya yul gzhis nas gsang stabs kyis bros phebs te mon rta dbang nas chibs pa phyir bslog mi sna'i gdong da res gsang phebs/gnang dgos pa'i skor kho bor phyag bris stsal 'dug pa blo yul las 'das pa'i gnas 'dir phran rang re zhig hon thor nas ci bya gtod med kyi gnas su gya ra zhing / lhag par rgya dpon tshor 'di skor gnas lugs 'grel bshad ji ltar byed 'gab mi shes par brten bka' blon nga phod la bka' slob zhus par khong yang hang sang nas 'di skor da lta rang sku tshab krang cing u la 99
