zhib phra zhu thub na legs gnas dang / ngas kyang rgya'i dpon rigs tshor thabs mkhas kyi brjod nas rogs ram gang thub zhus chog gsung gi 'dug de ltar nga phod kyi bka' slob ltar ngos rang krang cing u'i sar bskyod nas gnas lugs rnams brjod skabs kho pa gdong gshis 'gyur nas yud tsam skad cha tshog gcig kyang ma brjod par gang mtshams nas kho bor khro mig cig bltas nas khrel dgod kyis rgya lo don grub phyir thon skabs khyed tsho nang mi su la'ang gnas lugs brjod ma byung ngam zhes dres pa las/ de min tshig gzhan gang yang 'dre ma byung zhing / rjes su nga phod nas rgya mi chos rgya lo don grub phyi gros gnang bar de tsam gyi gnad 'gag brtsi gi mi 'dug ces gsung byung ba ltar blo bde byung /rgya phyogs nas srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi mdzad khur phyir 'then byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po drangs nas nag nyes don tshan bcu rdzun bzo bsnyad 'dogs kyis nyin gcig bod gzhung mtho rim mi sna dang / gzhon nu/ gdan sa khag gi mkhan po/ bla sprul bcas bskong tshogs kyis dril bsgrags nan po byas kyang dngos don thog srid tshab rnam gnyis kyi mdzad spyod thams cad spyi don lhag bsam rnam dag las/ sger don g.yo lhad phra mo tsam med pa de mang tshogs tshang mas shes gsal la brten/ srid tshab rnam gnyis phyir 'then gnang ba des mi dmangs rnams phangs sems blo pham tshad med kyis mya ngan zhu dgos byung /srid tshab rnam gnyis dgongs pa ma gnang gong / rgya phyogs nas khong gnyis kyitshab tu srid blon gsar pa rgyal gces lhag bsam yod pa dang / mi dmangs kyi spyi mos yod pa zhig tu la'i bla mas bsko bzhag gnang na legs tshul bka' shag lhan rgyas sar bsam tshul bton kyang / srid blon rnam gnyis dgongs pa gnang rjes srid blon gsar bsko gnang rgyu'i skor/ rgya phyogs nas kha dan chig la ma gnas par tu la'i bla mas srid 400

kyi thugs 'gan bzhes mus ltar bka' shag gis zhabs 'degs sngar rgyun mdzad 'thus las/ srid tshab gsar bsko gnang mi dgos pa'i bsam tshul zhus rkyen/ srid tshab gsar bsko'i 'char gzhi der 'gal rkyen byung / lo yul hung gis nyin deb las/ rla 4 ches 3 nyin tshogs 'du grol rjes nga phod kyis krang tas pe'o la gsung gsal/ tā la'i bla mas drung rigs ser skya'i nang 'jon thang yod mkhan skyi rgyal gces ring lugs pa 'dems pa gnang ste srid tshab bsko rgyu'i gros 'go bton e yod/ ngas bltas na de ltar gnang che bka' shag nang rtsod gleng yong srid pas btsan rgyal ring lugs dga' nye bsten mkhan la ngo rgol byed pa'i mi rigs mthun sgril gyi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur la shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs nges red ces gsung gi 'dug khong gi dgongs 'char der ngas mos mthun zhus shing / khong gis gnad don la dgongs pa bzhes skabs ha cang gting zab cig gnang gi 'dug ces gsal ba de rgya phyogs kyis srid blon gsar pa nga phod bsko thabs kyi re ba byung min nam snyam yang nga phod kyi gtam la brten nas kha dan la 'gyur ba 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu rkyen yin pa gsal por mngon/srid tshab bde mkhar ba sku gzhon nu'i skabs/ slob grwa'i nang phyag bris de tsam hur brtson med pa'i thog yig phreng gi grangs ka lon dka' bas yang yang 'khyam bskyed mkhan zhig yin stabs dge slob rnams kyis khong la rdzab chen a ra dkar po zhes mtshan btags yod pa red/ de rjes rtsis phrug pa'i skabs yig rtsis 'jon thang che ba min yang /phyag las hur brtson thog khur 'gan ci rigs bzhes thub mkhan zhig byung ste/ gong rim tshos khong la gzigs mthong chen pos bstod bsngags gnang bar grags/7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs klu khang bas lha sa gnyer tshang ba'i 'gan khur gnang ba'i skabs der las don phran bu zhig 'thus shor byung gzhag

ste/ nor gling spyan gsal pho brang yas mas su lcang ma grangs tshad nges can zhig 'dzugs rgyu'i nyes pa phog par khong gis las zhwa las gos gyon thog nyin shas ri nga gus zhabs ldan pa'i thog nas kho rang sku ngo mas lcang ma btsugs pa'i lo rgyus shig thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi phran la gsungs byung /de rjes bka' drung gi thugs 'gan gnang skabs paṇa chen sku gong ma sku 'khor rnams glo bur bkris lhun po dgon pa nas rgya sog yul du gsang bros phebs pa'i gnas tshul bod gzhung gis mkhyen tshor byung 'phral/ dmag spyi rtsis dpon lung shar ba dang /gtsang mda' sa lung pa/ ru dpon mtsho sgo ba sogs rjes 'ded du bsko brdzong gnang rgyu'i bka' dam lag khyer zhu rgyu'i 'char gzhi phyag rtags stsal don ltar/ lung shar gyis bka' drung sring khang bar lag khyer zin bris gtsang bshus byed bcug par klu khang pas/zin bri sa de yang bskyar skyar bskor gyi bklogs te dbu g.yug g.yug gis zin bris de bka' blon khri smon gyi gsol lcog gi steng du phyal te/ gus zhabs ldan pa'i sgo nas dbu zhwa phud de ngag thog snyan zhu gnang dgos don du/ lag khyer zin bris 'di'i nang phyags skyon chags gzhi'i brjod bya dgos min mang po 'khod 'dug bka' shag gi phyag dam de bzhin rgyal bstan chab srid kyi lung sgyur phyag dam rtsa che yin gshis 7rgyal mchog yab sras dbar de lta'i phyag khyer zhus stsal la bka' shag nas go bskon gsal 'debs ma gnang bar lam seng bka' dam gnang thal gyur che/ nam yang thugs 'gan bzod bral la bka' blon rnam pas 7rgyal ba don gyi bdag por gsal 'debs snyan zhu zhig nges par zhu ba gnang dgos zhes zhus te/ lag khyer zin bris gtsang bshus ma brgyab pa dang / bka' dam ma gnang bar brten rtsis dpon lung shar rab tu khros te phyir log bya dgos byung 'dug402

skabs de ra rtsis dpon lung shar dbang shugs che bas bka' blon rnams kyang khong la bag zon gnang gi yod stabs bka' blon rnam pas bka' drung klu khang par bka' bkyon mang po gnang yang / rdo la lab pa nang bzhin gsan 'jog dang lan 'debs ma zhus par rang sar phyir log gnang ba'i gnas tshul de rjes su bka' shag nas 7gong sa sku phreng 13 chen por snyan seng zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas bka' drung klu khang pa de mi drang po red/ da dung yang bka' shag la de 'dra mang po dgos rgyur 'dzems zon med pa'i gsal 'debs la gsan dgongs gnang na legs gnas zhes bsngags brjod gnang yod 'dug khong gis bka' drung thugs 'gan bzhes ring bka' shag gis rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya dang / rta khal lam yig sogs stsal rgyu'i nang bka' tham phab rjes thal lus byung yod med kyi nyams zhib thengs 'ga' shas gnang srol yod zer/khong gis rtsis dpon thugs 'gan bzhes ring tha'i ji khyung ram gyi don rkyen thog 7rgyal po rwa sgreng la phog thug yong rgyur 'jigs snang spu tsam yang ma gnang bar tshig gnad mang po gsungs yod/ khong gi spyi sems rnam par dag pa'i thugs rgyud ni kun gyis tshad mar 'jog pa zhig yin pas/ rtsis dpon phyag sprel tshang mas khong la rang bzhin gyis gus brtsi gnang dgos pa zhig yong gi yod/khong ni drag shul dang / dka' nyen ji 'dra zhig la'ang dpa' mi zhum par blo brtan 'gyur med cig yin kyang nyam chung srog chags ci tsir 'jigs snang chen po gnang mkhan zhig yin pa de/ skabs der bka' drung phyag rogs khe smad che dbang don grub kyis mkhyen nas/ nyin zhig khong gis gtsug lag khang dpal lha drag mo'i sku mdun nas tse tse'i ro zhig bsgrugs te bka' drung klu khang pa phyag las gnang bzhin pa'i skabs der tse ro de skupang du dbyugs ma thag a tse zhes gsung skad chen po shor zhing / 'phag tshag 'ga' shas 403

bskyon nas sku spro/zugs 'dar sig sig gnang song zhes rtsis dpon khe smad kyis phran la gsungs myong ba de dpa' bo snyan grags can gyis dgra dmag khri khrag la yang mi 'jigs par nyam chung tse tse la shin tu skrag pa'i ya mtshan gyi lo rgyus shig red 'dugakhong gis phyag sbrel sri da tshab bla ma blo bzang bkris ni thugs rgyud drang zhing thugs thag chod po zhig yin par brten/ rtse skor rnams kyis brtsi bkur chen po zhu yul zhig yin/ srid tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes ring phyag sbrel klu khang pa dang thugs snang gshin po byung zhing dza drag gi rnyog zing dang / nyen kha phrad skabs kyang rang zon rgyab skyur gyi snying stobs bzung nas phyag sbrel dang lhan du rgyag gcig ma chongs gcig gi 'thab grogs ngo gnong mi dgos pa yin pa ma zad/ 19 43 lo nas bzung rgya dmar gyi btson 'jug byed skabs kyang dgra bo'i btsan shugs dang bslu brid la mgo ma sgur bar sku che'i 'phen pa ma rdzogs par blo brtan 'gyur mestan phyi / mimig dper 'os pa'i rlabs chen gyi mi sna zhig red 'dugasrid tshab rnam gnyis dgongs pa zhus 'khrol rjes 7gong sa mchog nas bod rgyal bstan chab srid kyi thugs 'gan cha tshang skyed bzhes kyis bod ljongs rgyal khab yongs kyi mi dmangs rnams kyi bde sdug gnas stangs gzhi rtsar bzung nas legs bcos lhan tshogs gsar 'dzugs bskyang / de'i tshogs gtso nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang /de'i phyag rogs su mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan dang / rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med rnam gnyis bsko bzhag gnang / tshogs mi'i gras su gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus dang / tshogs 'thus/ gzhung zhabs drung rigs ser skya gnas rim so so'i tshogs 'thus gnyis re bcas bka' shag nas 7gong sa mchog la mi 'gro'i 'char gzhi phul ba ltar/ sras rnam pa'i tshogs 'thus gras su hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar dang / phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris gnyis la phyag rtags stsal 104

phebs byung zhing / legs bcos lhan tshogs kyi tshogs gtso rgan gzhon gsum phud/ tshogs mi sum cu tsam yod/ legs bcos tshogs 'du de rgya khyab rdzong gzhis mtha' dag la legs bcos kyi phyag las mdzad phyogs skor bka' bsdur gnang skabs gdan sa gsum gyi tshogs 'thus rnams kyis chos gzhis khag la legs bcos gtong 'dod med pa'i dgongs 'char yang nas yang du shugs chen gnang stabs/ legs bcos kyi phyag las la 'gog rkyen chen po byung / phyogs gzhan zhig nas legs bcos kyi tshogs 'du de rgya phyogs kyi blo la ma babs pa byung yang / dngos su ngo rgol gyi bsam tshul ma bton par lkog tu mi 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur ji snyed bstan par brten tshogs gtso bka' blon nga phod kyis legs bcos gros 'char de lam lhongs mi yong ba'i 'gal rkyen mang po 'phrad pa de gzigs pas de'i thog thugs snang je chung dang / legs bcos tshogs 'dur phebs rgyu je nyung du song nas mthar legs bcos lhan tshogs kyi 'gan khur de drung rtsis rnam gnyis kyi phrag par babs nas legs bcos kyi thog ma'i dmigs yul gyi snying don rim pas nyams brlag du song nas mtha' ma legs bcos lhan tshogs de rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi lo re'i thon 'bab kyi rtsis rgyag dang / rdzong gzhis mi 'gro khag la phogs thob sprod phyogs kyi las don la do dam bya mkhan zhig tu gyur/de gong 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin legs bcos lhan tshogs gsar 'dzugs gnang ste rgya khyab rdzong gzhis tshang mar bkod rgya don tshan lnga ldan zhig gnang yod pa de mkhas dbang zhwa sgab pa'i bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs glegs bam gnyis pa'i shog grangs 455 par gsal yod pa ma zad/ legs bcos lhan tshogs nas rgya khyab yongs kyi zhing pa rnams la khral 'bab chag yang btang ba dang / rdzong gzhis sne sdod kyi dpon rigs tshos mi ser thog tshul min brdab gsigs su 'gro rigs ma chogapa dang /405

gal srid de rigs byung che mi ser so sos legs bcos lhan chogs la zhu gtug thad kur byas chog pa/ mi ser 'khos dman nyam thag bu lon sprod 'jal mi thub pa rnams kyi ngo skyed gnyis ka rtsa yang stsal ba/ yang 'ga' shas 'khos 'byor phran bu yod kyang bun 'bab che gras kyi skyed cha chag yang dang / ngo bo rnams bsdebs sprod ma dgos pa lo dus kyi rim sprod chog rgyu/ de mtshungs rdzong sdod kyis mtshon pas rta khal gang byung bskul 'ded mi chog khar/ rta khal gyi gla cha yang yul thangagi gnas bab gzhi bzung sprod len dgos rgyu bcas bod rgyal yongs su bka' rgya stsal ba red/ legs bcos spyi tshogs las khungs 'dzugs rgyu'i sngon tsam du bod gzhung nas gtsug lag khang gi e waṃ tshoms chen du bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms skong tshogs gnang ba de'i rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi chab 'bangs mi ser rnams kyi dka' ngal sel thabs su 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos bla na med pa'i thugs 'khur zab mo bzhes lugs gzhung nas tshogs 'du'i thog gsal bshad gnang nas nyin bskud bka' bsdur gnang zhing / tshogs 'du'i bar gse nga la rnam kun kho bo cag dang 'grigs 'dres yod pa khag gcig nas deng rabs 'dzam gling khyon gyi rgyal khab khag nang mi ser dang / sa zhing rnams rgyal khab gzhung la dbang ba las/ rang cag bod nang bzhin gzhung sger chos gsum gyis bdag 'dzin byed pa'i lam lugs med cing / der brten rang re'i lam lugs 'di da mus bzhin gnas thabs dka' ba dang / lhag par rgya phyogs nas kyang 'di mur bzhag gi ma red/ de las kho bo cag rnams rang 'gul lta bus pha gzhis rnams gzhung la 'bul na legs gnas skor gleng mo' byung zhing / rjes su gnas tshul de rgya phyogs nas thos te kho pa tsho'i dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur zer ba de lam lhong yong bzo mi 'dug snyam nas ched mngags mi re zung bed spyad de gnas tshul la sgro btags nas sger 106

pa 'ga' zhig bu lon gyis rkub rul nas bsdad yod stabs spang dang me tog chab cig gzhung nas bzhes rogs zhes bsam tshul red ces dkrog gtam khyab spel byas pa red/dus skabs der rgya mis dbus gtsang grong gseb khag la 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong thabs ched yin tshul gyi dril bsgrags 'og skyed med kyi bu lon khyon che btang ba ma zad bu lon mi len pa zhing pa 'ga' zhig la u tshugs brgyabs nas sprad pa yang byung 'dug zer/ de ni bod gzhung gi legs bcos lag len bstar bzhin pa der 'gog rkyen bzos pa zhig yin pa gor ma chag gogazhan yang 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin lha sa grong khyer khul du bdag med kyi rgan khog dang/ zha long ltugs gsum rnams la rgan gso zhig bod gzhung nas gsar bsgrun gnang ba sogs phyag len don 'khyol gyis mi dmangs nyam thag rnam sa la phan rlabs chen po byung zhing / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog gis dus bsnun mi ser dmangs rnams kyi blo mos dang mthun pa'i sa zhing bcos bsgyur sogs gang la ji dge'i dgongs bzhes kyi thog nas rim bzhin phyag len mdzad rgyu yin lags pa bcas so/phyi lo 1953 rla 7 ches tsam la rgya mi'i sku tshab krang cing u yis bka' shag tu/ gros mthun bzhag nas lo gcig lhag tsam song ba'i rten 'brel du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dbus gzhung dang / ma'o kru'u zhi la thugs rje che zhu ba'i gus btud rten 'bul tshogs pa zhig dang / de dang dus mtshungs mes rgyal nang khul du lta skor tshogs pa zhig bkod sgrig gi gtong dgos rgyu zhes bsam 'char bshad pa de ni snga rabs rgya nag gi lo rgyus thog krung go'i mtha' skor du gnas pa'i khyem mches rgyal phran nyams thag khag la drag po'i btsan gnon gyi 'og rgya nag than khra'o/ /gnam gyi rgyal khab chen po zhes par lo re rten 'bul 'bul ba'i srol rgyun lag len bstar ched sku tshab 107

krang cing us bsam 'char bton pa ltar/ bod gzhung gis rten 'bul tshogs pa zhig gtong rgyu bkod sgrig ma gnang rang gnang byung ste bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs kyi do dam dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa tshogs pa de'i tshogs gtso dang / tha'i ji sding bya rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / bkras lhun spo ra mkhan che gnyis tshogs gtso gzhon pa/ phran stag lha phun tshogs bkris la drung che'i ming khur bcas bsko bzhag stsal/ tshogs mi'i gras su mi drag sras rnam pa zhol khang sras bsod nams dar rgyas dang / phun khang sras che ring don grub/ bshad sgra'i sras dga' ldan dpal 'byor sogs gtan zhal dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma yang phran tsho lhan du phebs/nga tsho lha sa nas rgya gar dang / hong kong brgyud pe cing du gnam thog tu phebs/de bzhin lta bskor tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang / bla phyag sman stod sras blo bzang dbang 'dus/ tshogs mi gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / bkras bla'i zhabs gras/ sa skya'i 'thus mi/ gdan sa gsum gyi grwa tshang so so'i 'thus mi/ tshong rigs khag gi 'thus mi/ chab mdo mnga' khul gyi 'thus mi bcas mi grangs 50 lhag tsam khams phyogs brgyud nas rla 9 pa'i zu mjug tsam la tshang ma pe cing du mnyam du 'dzoms te rla 10 ches 1 nyin rgyal ston dus chen zhes pa'i rten 'brel du zhugs dgos byung /de nas nyin zhig kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung dang / dpon rigs che khag mjal 'phrad rim bzhin zhus/ skabs der ma'o kru'u zhis dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar par tu la'i bla mas khyed rnams de ring mes rgyal pe cing du btang 'byor byung bar dga' bsu zhu gi yin/ snga lo bod zhi bas gros mthun bzhag pa des las don yag po zhig byung ba red/de sngon phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul rgyal khab dang / man ju/ go min tang log spyod pa bcas kyi 108

dkrug shing dang / gdug rtsub can gyi btsan gnon la brten rgya bod mi rigs gnyis kyi 'brel ba kha bral nas dus yun ring po song yang / da cha bod de mes rgyal gyi pang du log thub pa byung ba de ha cang don snying chen po zhig red/ pe cing dang / hrang had grong khyer bcas khyed rang tshos bdag dbang bya rgyu'i thob thang yod ces brtse gdung chen po yod mdog dang / 'dzum dmul gyi rnam 'gyur thog nas dngos 'gal gyi rdzun gtam mang po bshad/ rgyal ston dus chen zhes pa de zin rjes pe cing du zu gcig lhag tsam lhod bzhugs kyis de khul gna' shul khag dang / bzo grwa bcas su lta skor rjes mtsho sngon khul dang / nang sog gi shar rgyud/ rgya nag lho rgyud bcas su lta skor gdan zhu byas pa ltar phebs/ dus skabs der a mi ri kus ko ri ya byang ma'i mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab la dmag 'thab kyis dza drag gi skabs su 'khel yod par brten rgya nag nas ko ri ya byang mar rogs ram rgyab skyor gyi a 'gog khra'o rogs zhes pa'i las 'gul spel mus dang /de mtshungs yo rob tu snyan grags yod pa'i grong khyer khri ye nar a ris ko ri ya byang mar dmag 'khrug brgyab par ngo rgol gyi zhi bde'i tshogs 'du zhig tshogs kyi yod par rgya nag nas chab srid tshogs khag gi mi sna dang / tshan rig lag rtsal/ chos lugs khag gi mi sna/mi rigs ma rtsa can/ dmag 'thab byas rjes can gyi dpa' bo/ mi rigs khag gis mi sna'i 'thus mi bcas nyis brgya lhag tsam sgrig 'dzugs byas te tshogs 'du der bsko brdzong byas/ de'i khongs su phran bza' 'tsho gnyis bod rigs sa khul khag yongs kyi 'thus mi yin khul gyis tshogs pa de dang mnyam du bskyod dgos lugs zhes 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi pu'u krang rlos khri han gyi bka' yin zhes zer ba ltar/ rla 11 zu mjug tsam la 409

pe cing nas gnam thog phyi sog rgyal sa u lan sba thur dang / mo si kho/ bu ta pe se bcas brgyud we ye na grong khyer du bskyod/ rgya nag gi 'thus mi rnams kyi tshogs gtso rgan pa sung ching ling dang / (sun krung hran gyi lha lcam /dang tshogs gtso gzhon pa le'u nying yi (bzo tshogs spyi khyab /gnyis yin/ tshogs pa de'i 'go khrid byed mkhan dang gnad yod las byed rnams gung khran tang mi sha stag red 'dug de min rgya nag gzhung gsar pa'i khongs su zhugs pa'i tshogs pa gzhan khag gi 'go khrid lo'o lung ci dang / krang pe cun/ ko'o mu'u ru/ khren phu thung / me la'i phang sogs mi grangs sum cu lhag tsam pe cing nas mo so kho bar gnam gru gcig gi nang du phran bza' 'tsho gnyis dang mnyam du yod/ de min tshogs byings rnams pe cing nas me 'khor thog sngon du thon 'dug phran tsho pe cing nas ma thon gong gi nyin mor srid blon kra'u en le yis 'thus mi rnams la mjal 'phrad kyis da lam lī ye na grong khyer du 'dzam gling zhi bde'i tshogs 'du zhig tshogs rgyu yin pa de gal gnad chen po yod skor gtam bshad dus yun chu chod gcig lhag tsam byas pa dang /de'i sang nyin 'thus mi rnams la nub phyogs kyi goms gshis dang / mdor na kha zas za stangs bcas kyi skor slob sbyong byed du bcug/ de gang yin zhe na/ 'thus mi mang che ba phyi rgyal du 'gro ma myong ba ma zad/ rgya nag nang khul gyi grong khyer che khag la'ang slebs ma myong ba yang mang po 'dug lhag par nub phyogs kyi kha zas ma myong ba ji snyed yod pa de'i nang 'ga' shas ko ri ya'i dmag sa nas dbang po skyon can byas rjes chen po yod lugs gras kyis za stangs dang 'gro stangs sogs slob sbyong gtso bor byas song /nga tsho pe cing nas gnam thog thon te phyi sog rgyal sa u lan sba thur brgyud mo so kho bar nyin mtshan gnyis tsam 'gor/ mo so kho'i nas lī ya na bar ru su gzhung gis ri li gra sgrig byas 'dug pa lam bar nyin mtshan gnyis tsam 'gor /4 10

skabs der 'dzam gling zhi bde'i tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan mi mang che ba gung khran rgyal khab khag dang / rang dbang rgyal khab khag nang gi gung khran shog khag dang / spyi tshogs shog khag bcas kyi mi sna sha stag red 'dug tshogs 'du 'go tshugs nas nyin shas ring gtam bshad gtso bo de a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis ko ri ya spyi mthun rgyal khab la btsan 'dzul gyi dmag 'khrug 'phral du mtshams 'jog dgos lugs dang /'dzam gling yongs su zhi bde srung skyob nges par dgos gal/ 'dzam gling zhi bder dga' ba'i mi dmangs yongs kyis mthun sgril dam zab thog btsan rgyal a ris nyam thag rgyal khab khag la btsan 'dzul gyi nus pa mthar phyin rtsa gtor gtong dgos zhes 'tshang ga shig shig gis skad cor mang po brgyab mthar tshogs 'du grol/khri ya nar tshogs 'du'i ring nga tsho nyin gcig tshogs 'du grol nas rgya mi'i 'thus mi mnyam du mgron khang du lto chas za skabs nga tsho'i khongs su rgya mi na gzhon ngo gdong 'bar mdel gyi 'tshigs pa byas rjes can zhig yod pa des kha zas slebs ma thag hab thob rgyag pa lta bu'i spyod tshul bstan stabs de mnyam yod pa'i rgya mi shes yon can rgan gras shig gis mkhas po'i sgo nas blo mthun/ 'di gar kun spyod yag po bya rgyu de gal chen po yin/ de 'dra ma byed/ nub phyogs pa tshos nga tshor phya smod byed kyi red ces bshad ma thag na gzhon de khong khro chen po langs nas yar langs te lcog rtse'i steng du khu tshur shugs chen brdabs te lcog tse'i steng gi zas sna 'ga' shas kyang 'thor song / na gzhon des mi rgan de'i mdun du mdzub mo btsugs te khyed lta bu da bar mi dmangs kyi khrag 'jibs mkhan/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyugs khyi/ mgo bde dran 'khrul byed mkhan sogs kha nas ngan tshig gang thon gyi skad cor brgyab par za khang de'i nang lto chas za mkhan mang pos lta rub brgyab/ rgya mi'i las byed 'ga' shas kyis lo gzhon de phar ga ga

'khrid song / skabs der rgya mi'i 'thus mi gzhan rnams ngo tsha nas khyug tsam ring gang byed 'di byed ma shes par gcig gis gcig la bltas te dbugs ring btang nas bsdad/rjes su go thos la na gzhon der bslab bya byed mkhan de hrang had du bzo gra'i bdag po snyan grags yod pa'i ma rtsa can zhig yin lugs zer/o si kri ri ya'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa we ya na ni de sngon dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs a ri dang / pha ran si/ dbyin ji/ ru su bcas rgyal khab bzhis 'jar man la phar rgol dmag 'thab byed skabs rgyal khab bzhi'i dmag mi o si kri ri ya'i rgyal sa we ya na grong khyer der bsdad nas khag bgos kyis dbang sgyur byas 'dug dper na/ nga tsho tshogs 'du tshogs yul gyi sa khul de dbyin ji'i dmag mis srung skyob bya yul de red 'dug nga tsho sdod sa'i mgron khang de ru su'i dmag gis srung skyong byas 'dug de'i dbar phan tshun gom bgrod byas na chu chod skar ma bcu tsam las 'go3 gyi mi 'dugakhrom gzhung phar tshur bskyod skabs khrom lam gyi ang rtags la bltas nas 'gro dgos kyi 'dug nga tsho we ya nar dang thog 'byor ma thag rgya mis we ya na grong khyer nang phan tshunagang byung bskyod na nyen kha yod lugs dang / ang rtags thog nas bskyed dgos lugs kyi ngo spyod lta bu chu tshod 'a ga' shas ring byas byung / gal srid ang rtags thog ma bskyod na btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi dmag mis srung skyob bya yul du slebs che nyes skyon byung na khag po byed kyi red/ gal srid 'gro dgos gal byung na tshogs pa'i drung che rgan gzhon la dgongs skor snyan seng dang sbrags srung skyob kyi mi sna mnyam du gtong gi red ces rgya mis nan tan gyis bshad pa ma zad/ lhag par du phran bza' 'tsho gnyis la dmigs bkar gzab nan gnang dgos red ma gtogs btsan rgyal a ri'i so nyulagyi mgo skor bslu brid kyi btsan khrid byed kyi red ces nan po mngags byung yang / ngos gnyis kyis de sngon rgya mi 112

bod du ma yong gong bod la lo 7 tsam sdod myong ba'i 'jar man ha rar zhes pa de'i skye yul yin tsang kho rang 'phrad mi yong ngam snyam pa'i re ba byung yang 'phrad rgyu'i go skabs ma byung zhing / tshogs 'du'i bar seng du khrom gzhung gang sa gang du bskyed de skabs re a ri'i dmag mi mang po yod sar yang slobs skabs su zhig gis dre ba tsam byas ma byung ba ma zad/ do snang yang byed kyi mi 'dug sku'i gcen mos bod chas bzhes yod pas mi re zung gis zur mig bltas pa tsam las gzhan gyi gnas tshul gang yang byung ma song bas/ngos gnyis nas rgya mis don med kyi rdugs pa chen po byas pa red ces gleng mol byung /tshogs 'du grol rjes nga tshos we ya na grong khyer yas mas kyi gna' shul grags can khag dang / o si kri ri ya'i rgyal po'i pho brang khag dang / gung khran ring lugs gsar gtod byed mkhan gas en khe se'i bzhugs khang bcas su lta skor du 'khrid byung /we ya na'i tshogs 'du'i ring phyi sog gi 'thus mi zhig phran gnyis sar phebs te phan tshun skad brda ma 'phrod par bsam tshul legs po brje res gsal po zhig ma byung yang / sog po'i 'thus mi des bod yig dbu chen phran bu shes pa'i thog nas khyed gnyis pe cing du phyir phebs kyi lam bar du u lan sba thur khyug tsam phebs rogs gnang zhes bris 'dug ngos gnyis kyang 'gro 'dod chen po byung ste rgya mir phyir log lam zhor du u lan sba thur nyin shas lta skor du 'gro chog pa'i skor gyi bsam tshul bshad par lam seng lan gsal ma byung gshis mo so khor 'byor skabs/ da res khyed gnyis gcig pu u lan sba thur ma phebs rogs gnang / rin min nga tsho krung go'i sku tshab tshogs pa snyeg mong gol mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab tu 'tshams 'dre lta skor du phebs gtan 'khel 'dug na/ skyed bza' 'tsho gnyis de mnyam du nges par du gdan 'dren zhu rgyu yin lugs dang / da res lam zhor du phebs na sku ngal 'phrad kyi red zer ba ltar/ phyi sog ga 3

la 'gro rgyu'i go skabs ma byung zhing / we ya na grong khyer nas sngar bzhin ri li thog lam bar hang ka ri ya'i rgya la sa bu ta pe ser zhag gcig bsdad nas grong khyer der lta skor du khrid/ de nas slar yang ri li thog mo si khor 'byor/ nga tsho mo si kho grong khyer gyi gna' shul grags can khag dang / mo si kho mtho rim slob grwa chen mo dang / las byed kyi bu phrug 'jog sa'i bu bcol khang bcas su lta skor rim bskyod skabs lam bar 'ga' shas su gangs kyis khengs pa'i rkyen gyis mo ṭa 'gro ma thub pa'i gnas tshul 'phrad skabs tshang mas gangs steng du gom bgrod byed dgos byung /nga tsho mnyam du yod pa'i rgya mi'i 'thus mi mi sna grags can lo na 70 tsam la slebs pa 'ga' shas kyis gangs kyi steng du gom bgrod ma thub par dka' ngal chen po 'phrad par skabs shig ring phran bza' 'tsho gnyis mnyam du khyen phu thung zhes pa'i mi rgan de gangs steng du gom bgrod bya rgyur dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i ngang phran gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas bskyor te khrid dgos byung bar khong la khyed rang mgron khang du ngal gso ma gnang bar ga re gnang gi yin nam zhes sku'i gcen mos bka' 'dri gnang song bar sdod thabs yog ma red ces bshad nas dbugs ring chen po zhig btang ba las gang yang ma bshad/ khyen phu thung zhes pa'i rgan po de de sngon hrang had dang / than cin grong khyer gnyis su 'thag las kyi bzo grwa mang po yod pa'i ma rtsa can zhig red 'dug rgya nag bcings 'grol zin skabs khong gi bzo gra dang / rgyu dngos gang yod rnams rang 'gul gyis gzhung gsar par phul ba dang / mi rigs ma rtsa can zhes pa'i ming skam po zhig thogs pa'i gras shig red 'dug nga tsho mo si kho sogs la lta bskor rjes pe cing du sngar bzhin gnam thog nas phyir log gis sku tshab rnam pa dang / mnyam 'dzoms byung bar dga' spro chen po byung /ga 4

skabs der bod gzhung gis pe cing du tā la'i don gcod las khungs zhes pa gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ de sngon go min tang gis rgyal sa nan cing dang / khrung ching bcas su bod gzhung gis bod kyi rgya nag rgyal sar bca' sdod las khungs shig btsugs yod pa der da cha bod kyi don gcod kyi ming du tu la'i don gcod zhes par bsgyur ba de go gnas phab pa lta bu chags te sku tshab don gcod spyi khyab tha'i ji ram pa rnam rgyal dbang phyug dang /mkhan chung blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ las bya lcang can sras dbang phyug rgyal po/ rtse mgron rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin/ shod mgron blo bzang don grub/ shod drung dge rgyas pa bstan 'dzin rdo rje bcas bsko brdzong mdzad pas nga tsho ngo las tshang ma dga' 'dzoms byung / phyi lo 1953 che 3 par nga tsho pe cing nas hong kong brgyud lha ldan rgyal sar phyir log byas pa bcas so/ga bya

le tshan nyi shu pa/bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i phyi 'brel las khungs kyi grub tshul dang rjes su rgya phyogs la rla sgril btang skor/༄༅༅/ /de sngon bod gzhung dang phyi 'brel yod pa dbyin ji dang / rgya gar dang / ñtsa nagaphyi sog bal yul tsam las de min phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba rgya che ma byung ba'i stabs kyis bod gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs zur du 'dzugs rgyu byung mi 'dug cing / skabs re gong gsal rgyal khab khag la dmigs bsal can gyi 'brel gtugs gnang dgos byung skabs bka' shag rang na sa thad kur 'brel gtugs gnang gi yod 'dugaphyi lo 1855 lo bod gzhung dang / bal yul rgyal khab gnyis pos zhi mthun chings yig bzhag pa'i 'bru don bzhin bal yul gzhung gis bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa dang /gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse/ bal bod sa mtshams 'khel ba'i bod kyi gnad yod sa gnas gnya' nang dang / skyid grong sogs su bal gzhung gi bca' sdod sku tshab ched 'dzugs byas yod pa ma zad/ lo rer bod gzhung nas bal gzhung la rgya gar sgor mo chig khri tham pa sprod rgyu byas pa dang / slad rgyal khab gzhan gyis bod rgyal khab la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i gnas tshul byung lngu bal gzhung gis bod gzhung la dmag rogs gtong rgyu byas/ skabs der bod gzhung gis bal yul gyi rgyal sar sku tshab btsugs med cing / bod gzhung gis lha sar gor zhib las khungs zhes gsar 'dzugs kyis gzhung zhabs ser skya gnyis tsam 117

bsko gzhag gnang thog bal bod mi rigs dbar gyi gyod gzhi dang / bal po'i mi rigs nas khrims 'gal bya spyod byas rigs bcas la bal bod gzhung gnyis kyis bsko gzhag gnang ba'i dpon rigs lhan tshogs thog nas zhib cha'i thag gcod gnang yod gi 'dugade bzhin gong gsal sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag la bal bod mi rigs dbar skyod gzhi rtsod rnyog gi khrims 'gal lab gleng byung che bod gzhung gi sa gnas rdzong dpon dang / bal gzhung skya tshab mnyam sbrel gyis gyod gzhi thag gcod byed kyi yod 'dugaphyi lo 1850 lo nas bzung dbyin jis rgya bskyed srid jus spel te bod kyi lho nub tu gnas pa'i rgyal phran 'bras ljongs dang / 'brug gnyis la rim bzhin shugs rkyen thebs nas rgyal phran de tsho dang bod dbar sngar yod thun mong ma yin pa'i chos srid kyi 'brel ba de nyams brlag tu gyur/phyi lo 1888 lo dbyin bod sa mtshams su lo rgyus thog grags pa'i sa byi dmag 'khrug byung zhing / phyi lo 1904 lor dbyin dmag gis phag ri brgyud lha sa bar btsan 'dzul byas / bod dbyin gnyis kyis lha sar zhi mthun chings yig bzhagaphyi lo 1909 lo 7gong sa sku phreng 13 chen po rgya sog yul gru khag nas rang yul chos ldan rgyal khab tu zhabs sor 'khod 'phral bod dang khyim mches rgyal khab khag dbar gyi 'brel ba sngar bas ji cher gyur par brten rang gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs shig dgos gal gzigs te rtse mgron rgyal mtshan phun tshogs dang / rtsis dpon khe smad rin chen dbang 'dus gnyis la bod gzhung phye 'brel las khungs kyi do dam bsko bzhag gnang nas phye 'brel gnang dgos skabs so so'i las don gnang ba las/ las khungs gtan 'dzugs thub pa byung med skad/phyi lo 1931 lo'i blo 5 ches 5 nyin phyi sog dmar po'i rgyal khab ga bya

gsar btsugs rjes 1927 lo phyi sog dmar po'i gzhung gis sku tshab che dpag rdo rje zhes pa'i gtso khrid kyis mi sna 'ga' shas lha sar btang 'byor gyis bod sog rgyal khab gnyis dbar sngar bzhin mthun lam dam zab slar gso yong thabs su bod gzhung dang 'brel gtugs bka' mol zhus par/ bod gzhung gi phyi 'brel 'brel mthud sku tshab tu phun khang gung bkres rdo rje dang / mkhan drung dge 'dun chos dar gnyis la bsko bzhag gnang /phyi sog sku tshab kyis zhu don don tshan dang po/ bod sog gnyis mthun sgril sngar srol ltar yar rgyas gtong rgyu/ gnyis pa/ rgyal khab phan tshun so sor sku tshab 'dzugs 'jog bya rgyu/ gsum pa/ phyi sog rgyal sa u lan sba thur nas lha sa bar thag ring kha par 'dzugs rgyu bcas don tshan gsum gyi bsam tshul bton par/ bod gzhung gis bod sog gnyis kyi 'brel lam sngar nas da bar nyams med yod mus thog sog yul nas bod du chos kyi slob gnyer du yong ba'i gra rgyun rnams la bod gzhung nas gra pa so sor lta skyong rogs ram byed mus yin zhing / slad kyang sngar bzhin rogs bya rgyu/ gnyis pa/ rgyal khab phan tshun so sor sku tshab 'dzugs 'jog bya rgyu mthun 'grigs gang zab yong rgyu'i dge mtshan chen po yod nges kyang / bod kyi khyim mches dbyin ji de bzhin deng sang dpung stobs btsan pas bod dang sa mtshams khad nye'i stabs kyi thabs mkhas mi gnang mthu med la brten snga 'phros sku tshab 'dzugs rgyu ngang 'then gnang rgyu/ gsum pa/ rgyal khab gnyis kyi rgyal sa phan tshun dbar thag ring kha par 'dzugs rgyu bod sog yul gru'i dbar sa khad ha cang ring ba ma zad/ byang thang mi med lung stong la brten lag len 'khel rgyu shin tu dka' ba bcas kyi bka' lan gnang lugs de sngon bka' zur sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa'i zhal nas thos byung /ga bya

mkhas dbang rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pas mdzad pa'i bod kyi srid don rgyal rabs las/ phyi sog dang / u ru su gzhung gi 'brel ba zhu mi yin zhes u ru su'i dmag dpon gcig gis 'go khrid byas te sog rigs 'ga' shas nag chu kha brgyud lha sar 'byor par 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i mjal kha sogs spyir btang las ma mdzad cing / yar zhus mar gsung tshang ma phyi rgyal las khungs brgyud nas gnang ba dang / de rnams rla gsum tsam bsdad kyang 'dod pa khengs pa rang ma byung ba'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas phyir log byas/ don gcod pa des gang zhus yod med gzhung 'brel yig cha sogs ma mthong yang / u lan sba thur dang / bod gzhung dbar sngar gyi 'brel ba tshugs thabs zhus pa red ces ngag sgros tsam gleng rgyun 'dug ces gsal/gong gsal gnas tshul khag gnyis la gzhigs na bod gzhung phyi srid las khung des phyi rgyal khag la skabs sbyar 'brel ba gnang gi yod pa 'di'i thog nas mngon/ 'on kyang skabs der bod gzhung gyi rgyal spyi'i lam lugs ltar phyi rgyal khab khag dang / lhag par du bod rang nyid kyi khyim mches rgyal khab khag la phyi srid kyi lam lugs thog nas 'brel ba byed mkhan bod kyi gzhung tshab las khungs 'dzugs ma thub pa de ni bod mi tshor deng rabs kyi rgyal spyi'i shes yon ma ldan pa'i dbang gis byung ba zhig yin 'dugaphyi lo 1904 lo bod dbyin dbar lha sar chings yig bzhag pa'i nang rgyal rtse dang / gro mo/ stod sgar thog bcas sa gnas khag gsum la tshong ra 'dzugs rgyu dang tshong 'brel sku tshab sa gnas khag gsum la 'dzugs rgyu byas/phyi lo 1914 lo sem lar bod dbyin rgya gsum gyis bod rgyal khab kyi mnga' khongs bdag dbang skor gros mol gnang ste mthar rgya phyogs nas chings yig ngo mar mos mthun ma byas stabs slad dbyin gzhung gis bod rang btsan la rgyab skyor ched/ bod 420

dbyin gnyis chings yig zur 'jog nang bod kyi lho rgyud mon yul rnams dbyin gzhung la thugs rje legs 'bul phul rgyur mekha ma ton sa thig ces pa dbye 'byed byas/phyi lo 1933 lo 7gong sa skyabs mgon skya phreng 13 pa dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rjes lo de'i lo mjug tu rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab gzhung gis dgongs rdzogs mchod sprin 'bul bar sku tshab bod du bcar 'thus zhus par bka' 'khrol bzhin skya tshab hong mu sung gis gtsos pa'i las byed mi sna 'ga' shas bcas khams brgyud lha ldan rgyal sar 'byor te dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul zhu sgo zin mtshams bod rgya'i sa mtshams dbye 'byed skor bod gzhung dang bka' mol rim zhus yang lam seng phan tshun dgongs mthun thag gcod ma byung stabs bka' mol mjug skyong zhu mkhan yin tshul rgya dpon cang kri yu'i ngo las lha sar bzhag ste tong mu sung rgya nag tu phyir log byas/ tong mu sung gis bzhag pa'i mi sna des gros mol mjug skyong gi go skabs la bsnyad de lha sar bod du bca' sdod don gcod las khungs btsugs/ de'i rkyen gyis dbyin ji gzhung gis kyang lo der lha sar bca' sdod tshong don don gcod las khungs su gyur/ de nas bzung rgya dbyin don gcod bcas kyis las don che phra rnams bka' shag la yang yang zhu ba ra bcar mus bka' shag mdzad brel gyis rkyen pas skabs re thugs lcogs gyur min dang / lhag par rgya dbyin gnyis kyis gtsos phyi rgyal gyi don gcod khag la bka' shag nas thad kur bka' mol gnang rgyur thal lus mi 'byung ched phyi lo 1941 lo phyi rgyal gyi lugs dang mthun zhing ming don mtshungs pa'i bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs gong gsal sngar yod de rgyun 'dzin gtan 'jags 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ skabs de'i 'go 'dzin dza sag zur zur dbang chen che brtan dang / tā bla ma dkon mchog 'byung gnas gnyis la bsko bzhag gnang ba ltar/ bod gzhung bka' shag nas lha sdod rgya dbyin don gcod gnyis dang / gor 121

ṣa'i skya tshab bcas la da nas bzungs phyi 'brel las khungs la 'brel gtugs bya dgos lugs brda khyab gnang 'dug par dbyin ji'i don gcod nas dga' bsu dang bcas de don zhus 'thus bka' lan phul 'dug kyang / rgya gzhung go min tang gi don gcod kyi bod gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs zhes pa de khas len zhu thabs med lugs dang / phan tshun gyi gnad don zhu sgo rnams sngar bzhin bka' shag rang du zhu gi yin zhes lan gsal phul ba dang / gor ṣa'i sku tshab kyi kyang sngar nas da bar gor bod chings yig gzhir bzung gor zhib las khungs zhes gor bod gnyis ku'i sku tshab lhan tshogs kyis las don thag gcod byed srol yod mus ltar zhus chog pa zhes lan gsal phul ba red/lo der nyi tong gis ma la ya dang 'bar mar btsan 'dzul gyi nyen dogs chen po byung ste a dbyin rgya gsum mthun phyogs rgyal khab rnams kyis rgya gar a sam phyogs nas bod kyi mnga' khongs rdza yul brgyud rgya nag lho nub sa khul du dmag mkho'i yo byadasogs 'or 'dren gyis lam kha zhig gsar bzo byas chog pa zhes a ri dang / dbyin ji gzhung gnyis kyis lha sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don sku tshab dang / rgya mi'i don gcod gnyis phyogs nas bod gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs dang / bka' shag la snyan seng bka' 'khrol yong ba zhus kyang bod gzhung gis bod ni a dbyin rgya gsum dang / nyi hong sogs mthun phyogs rgyal khab su la'ang the gtogs med par bar gnas kyi rgyal khab yin par brten bod kyi sa thog brgyud dmag mkho'i yo byad 'or 'dren bya rgyu'i lam kha bzo thabs med lugs kyi lan gsal mtha' bkag gnang 'dug gnad don de'i thog nas gsal por mtshon pa ni bod rgya khongs ma yin pa smros ci dgos/'di ni 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs bod rgyal khab bar gnas su sdod mkhan gyi rgyal khab rang btsan gtsang ma yin pa'i dpang rtags gal che zhig yin/122

de rjes phyi 'brel do dam tu bla ma dkon mchog 'byung gnas 'das tshab dza sag blo bzang dpal ldan bsko bzhag gnang yang dus yun de tsam ma song bar 'das/phyi lo 1948 lo 'go tsam la bla phyag mkhan chung sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dza sag tu gnas spar gyis phyi 'brel do dam dza sag zur zur gyi phyag sgrel la bsko gzhag bstsal/phyi lo 1949 lo rgya nag gi gnas tshul 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ba'i skabs der bod gzhung bka' shag dang / drung rtsis lhan tshogs bka' bsdur thog nas sa mtshams su dmag mi 'jog rgyu dang / dmag skul gnang phyogs/ de 'brel dmag phogs 'du 'god/ phyi rgyal khag la bden rgyab 'bod skul gnang rgyu sogs bka' shag lhan 'dzoms gnang ma dgos par bka' blon re res phyag las re thugs 'gan bzhes rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba bzhin phyi 'brel las khungs kyi da yod do dam ser skya dza sag gnyis thog dbu 'dzin bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen gyis thugs 'gan bzhes/phyi lo 1950 lo 'go nas rgya dmar gyis mdo stod smad sa mtshams nas rim bzhin btsan 'dzul byas te lo de'i rla 10 tshes 30 nyin chab mdo rgya dmag gis btsan bzungs thog bod gzhung mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med ngo las dang / 'go dmag bcas gru gu dgon nas 'dzin bzung girung tshang ma chab mdor btsan khrid byas te re zhig bzang btson lta bur bzhag pa bcas dza drag gi gnas tshul 'phrad bzhin pa'i skabs der mon rta dbang gis gtsos pa'i mon yul sa khul rnams la rgya gar gzhung gi dpon dmag gang tsam 'byor te sa gnas de dag rgya gar gzhung gi sa cha yin lugs kyis bdag bzung thog rta dbang bla gnyer rtse drung thub bstan chos 'phel yang 123

mtsho snar phyir 'bud byas tshul mtsho sna rdzong sdod nas bka' shag la snyan seng 'bul 'byor ltar/ bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs kyi do dam dza sag rnam gnyis kyis lha sdod rgya gar gzhung gi tshong don sku tshab si na la nye dus chab mdor rgya dmag slebs te bod gzhung dka' ngal 'phrad skabs 'dir rgya gar gzhung gis kyang bod la rogs ram gnang rgyu'i tshab tu 'gyel thog rdog brdzis kyis mon rta dbang yul lung khag glo bur btsan bzung byas pa de dag shin tu blo pham gyi gnas la brten rgya gar dpon dmag rnams 'phral du phyir 'then gnang dgos zhes 'phros mol nan po gnang bar rgya gar tshong don skya tshab si na yis de 'dra dngos 'brel yin na nga'i gzhung gi gnang babs thabs sdug byas 'dugabod gzhung nas thugs pham ma gnang rogs gnang / ngas gzhung la lam seng snyan seng zhus te bka' lan gang mgyogs 'khor ba zhu gi yin zhes brjod 'dugade rjes rgya gar gzhung gi lha sdod tshon don las khungs sku tshab si na brgyud rgya gar gzhung gi bka' lan phyir 'khor du rgya dmar dmag dpung gis chab mdo btsan bzung byas zin pa dang / da dung dbus gtsang phyogs su slebs pa yin na/ rang re'i sem la'i chings yig gzhir bzung sa mtshams da lta nas rgya gar gyis brtan bzung ma byas na slad rgya mi dang rtsod rnyog yong rgyur brten de don rgya gar gzhung gis dpung dmag gtong dgos byung ba las/ bod gzhung la gnas dus chod rtsis zhus pa gtan nas min pas thugs pham gnang mi dgos/ slad bod gzhung sngon ma ltar gnas pa yin na/ rta dbang sa khul nas rgya gar gyi dmag mi rnams lam seng phyir 'then zhus chog ces rgya gar gzhung gi bka' lan byung lugs sku tshab nas brjod/phyi lo 1951 lo zu 5 tshos 33 nyen pe cing du rgya bod zhi mthun gyi gros mthun don tshan 17 bzhag pa nas bzung mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag ces pa 124

rim bzhin bod ljongs yongs kyi gnad yod sa gnas khag dang / bod dang rgya gar/ bal yul/ 'brug bcas khyim mches rgyal khab khag gsum gyi sa mtshams su srung dmag bzhag bod rgya'i gros mthun don tshan 17 gyi nang gses bcu bzhi par krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung nas bod sa gnas su byung ba'i phyi 'brel las don mtha' dag gcig sgril gyi sgo nas bya rgyu dang / 'dra mnyam gnyis phan/ phan tshun gyi mnga' khul dang / rang btsan gyi dbang char brtsi bkur thog nye 'dabs rgyal khab dang zhi mthun du gnas rgyu ma zad/ drang 'brel gyi tshong las 'dzugs rgyu dang gong 'phel du gtong rgyu zhes gsal ba ltar/phyi lo 1953 rla 5 nang bod gzhung gi sngon yod phyi 'brel las khungs de rgya nag dbus gzhung gi phyi 'brel las khungs khongs su rla sgril bya rgyu thugs gtan 'khel te gong ches nyin zla sgril gyi mdzad sgo'i tshogs 'dur rgya phyogs kyi sku tshab krang cing us gtsos pa'i zhi drag gnad yod dpon rigs khag dang / bod gzhung gi bka' blon rnam pa dang /sngon yod phyi 'brel las khungs kyi ngo las bcas mdzad sgo'i tshogs 'dur zhugs/ slad las khungs der krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi phyi srid las khungs khongs bod sa gnas yan lag phyi srid don gcod las khungs zhes pa'i ming btags/ rgya phyogs kyi las khungs de'i 'gan khur byed po yang kung su dang / de'i las rogs su rang gzhung gi sngon yod phyi 'brel do dam dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / drung che phran rim bzhi stag lha phun tshogs bkris/ gor yig drung yig rtse drung las tshan grags pa yar rgyas/dbyin drung las tshan sa 'du rin chen don grub/ las bya rtse drung rgyal mtshan bstan 'phel/ shod drung las tshan rta ra mdo pa che brtan dbang phyug shod drung las tshan byams pa ngag dbang sogs yod/go thos ltar las khungs de'i do dam pa rgan pa yang kung su dang / gzhon pa dza 425

sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa rnam gnyis la rgya'i gnas ming la spang pan rgan gzhon zhes zer/ de'i rjes tsam la phyi 'brel don gcod khru'u zhes par bsgyur te spang pan rgan gzhon gnyis la khru'u krang rgan gzhon zhes zer/ de gnyis kyi 'og tu gzhung don khang zhes pa sde tshan spyi yongs kyi 'go 'doms shig yod/ de'i 'gan 'dzin rgan pa rgya mi phu'u hren zhes pa dang / gzhon pa phran stag lha phun tshogs bkres yin/ sde tshan des las khungs kyi dgos mkho dang / sde tshan gzhan rnams kyis las don sgrub phyogs/ las byed rnams kyi kun spyod la lta rtogs dang / phogs thob sogs kyi 'gan khur byed/ de 'og kho'o zhes pa'i sde tshan khag lngar bgos pa ste/ rgya gar gyi don gnad skor gyi sde tshan dang / bal po'i don gnad skor gyi sde tshan/ 'brug pa'i don gnad skor gyi sde tshan/ skabs der 'brug pa'i don gnad de tsam med stabs bal po'i sde tshan gyis gcig lcogs byas/ de min rgya bod dang / bod dbyin / bod gor bcas kyi yig rigs rnams phar tshur phab sgyur gyi sde tshan gcig dang / sa mtshams skor la nyams zhib sde tshan bcas yin/ nyin re'i sde tshan so so'i las don zhu phyogs skor gzhung don khang brgyud gong rim do dam rgan gzhon gnyis la dgongs bskor snyan zhu dang / bka' slob zhu ba/ lha sdod rgya gar dang / bal yul/'brug pa bcas so so'i sku tshab kyis phyi las do dam rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad zhu rgyu dang /gsol ston gdan zhu'i mgron brda 'byor mtshams 'brel yod sde tshan nas mjala'aphrad kyi dus tshod ji tsam la 'gab min dang / mgron 'bod du phebs mkhan gyi mtshan tho bcas gong rim la dgongs bskor dang 'brel brda lan sprod rgyu/ sde tshan de'i sku tshab so sos bka' mol ji zhu'i don gnad skor sngon tshud nas shes thabs byas pa la gzhigs nas lan 'debs byed phyogs go sgrig byas nas gong rim la snyan seng go sdur byed pa/gal srid don gnad ji zhu nges gsal med na/ dogs 'char yod rigs kyi thad la 126

bsam gzhigs byas te gang la de 'tshams kyi lan 'debs byed phyogs sngon tshud nas sde tshan khungs so sos go sgrig khur len gtsang ma byed dgos kyi yod/ skabs der phyi 'brel las khungs nang rgya mi las byed pho mo naX lhag tsam yod khongs nas dbyin ji dang / hin dhi/ bal po'i skad yig bcas legs par shes mkhan 'ga' shas yod pa tshos las khur gtso bo byed par brten bod gzhung gi phyi rgyal skad yig shes mkhan ha lam phyag las med pa lta bur gnas 'dug de'i don gnad gtso bo gcig ni/ las don rnams gsang ba phyi gyar mi yong ba'i ched dang / bod mi las byed pa tshos gnas tshul ji bzhin ma rtogs par cha 'jog gis bod mi las byed par las ka ma sprad pa ma min nam/ 'on kyang gzhung don khang gi 'gan 'dzin kru'u rin dang / phran gnyis las don mtha' dag go bsdur thag gcod byed kyi yod/ gza' 'khor rer rgya bod las byed rnams lhan 'dzoms thengs re byed pa dang / las khungs rang gi las don byed phyogs skor dang bsam tshul go bsdur/ las byed nang khul las ka nor 'khrul byung rigs la skyon sel byed res skabs ngo gdong so sor 'dzams med bsam 'char shod rkyang byed dgos kyi 'dug tshogs 'du grol rjes tshang ma sngar rgyun ltar gtseg gis gcig la mi dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur ston mi chog pa de ni spyod lam ha cang yag po zhig yin pa snyam byung / gza' 'khor re'i nang sa mtshams nyams zhib sde tshan gyi 'gan khur ba rgya mi las byed krang tsu'u ci zhes pas rgya bod las byed rnams la phyi srid las don sgrub phyogs skor gyi shes bya slob khrid thengs gnyis byed kyi yod par brten/ phran gyi dus rtag tu slob sbyong gi go skabs chud zos su ma song bar zhugs thub pa des rang nyid la phan thogs chenapo byung / phran la gzhung don sde tshan gyi las 'gan yod thog sa mtshams nyams zhib sde tshan gyi 'gan 'dzin krang tsu'u ci'i la rogs byas te gong rim gyi bka' mngags ltar 127

bod dang rgya gar/ bod dang bal yul gyi sa mtshams 'khel yul khag la de sngon rim pas the gu sne shor du song ba rnams kyi yig rigs dang / sa rtags bcas kyi thog nas khungs skyel phyir len thub pa'i gros bsdur gyis phyag len bltar rgyu/ rgya bal sa mtshams 'khel ba'i sa gnas rdzong khag sogs kyi gzhung sger chos gsum sa mtshams skor gyi yig rigs kha gsal dang / sngar gyi rgan rabs rnams la sngar gyi sa mtshams ji yin rgyus babs 'dre brtsad dang nyams zhib byed par/ sa mtshams khag so sor rgya bod las byed sprel po re ched brdzongs byas te gnas tshul bsdu len byas rigs kyi tshig tho 'phral 'bul dgos rgyu'i mngags cha byas/ de mtshungs rang gzhung bka' shag dang / mdzod sgugartse shod las khungs khag la gong gsal sa khul khag gi sa mtshams skor gyi lo rgyus yig rnying dang / gyod gzhi/ khral 'bab bsdu len gyi skor yig rigs bcas phyi las su rtsis sprod yong thabs bka' shag tu snyan seng bka' 'khrol dang 'brel bka' shag nas las khungs so sor bka' khyab gang ste yig cha gang 'tshams bsdu gsog byed thub/lhag par du bka' shag tu yod pa'i dbyin bod gnyis kyis sem lar bzhag pa'i chings yig dang / sa bkra de yang phyi las su gsol stsal byung / sa bkra de'i nang mon yul gyi ri klung phal mo che bod gzhung gis dbyin gzhung la sprad pa'i sa thig dmar rtags mekha ma hon sa thig ces pa de sa bkra'i nang du bkod yod pa gsham gsal/ bod kyi srid blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang / dbyin gzhung sku tshab rgya gar gyi phyi srid blon chen/ mekha ma hon gnyis kyis mtshal dmar gyis bris pa'i mtshan rtags re bkod 'dugade mtshungs sngon chad bod gzhung gi chab srid kyi gar stegs thog 'khrab ston byed myong mkhan mi sna sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang / srid zur glang mdun kun 28
dga' dbang phyug gnyis kyis sar ba car te de sngon sa mtshams khag gi rgyus babs gnas tshul bka' 'dri zhus len gyis yig thog tu bkod/ 429

le tshan nyer gcig pa/bod dmag gi lo rgyus rob bsdus dang / gas la 7rgyal ba'i sku srung mda' dpon bsko bzhag stsal ba'i skor/༄༅༅/ /bod rgyal khab chen po'i dpung sde'i dus rim gsum tsam 'pho 'gyur byung yod/dus rabs bdun pa'i sngon bod kyi chab srid kyi sgrig 'dzugs chags pa nas bzung srid dbang sra brtan gtong ched gdod ma'i lam gyi drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs chags shing / dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs bod kyi snyan grags can gyi mes po srong btsan sgam po'i dus rabs nas bzung dus rabs dgu pa'i dkyil tsam bar dus rim gnyis ring dmag don gyi sgrig khrims rim bzhin legs bcos dang yar rgyas chen po byung nas bod rgyal khab kyi mtha' bzhi dang / mtshams brgyad kyi khyim mches rgyal khab dang / bod rigs rgyal phran rnams dbang du bsdus pa ma zad/ shar phyogs snyan grags can gyi rgya nag rgyal khab dang /nub phyogs kyi stag gzig dang / byang gi gru gu bcas la dpung 'jug gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i mnga' khul la ru dang / ru lag stong sde/ stong bu chung / sku srung gi stong sde bcas su phye yod pa red/dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs bod dmag gis bod kyi shar phyogs mdo stod smad dang / li yul/ rma chu brgyud nas rgya nag nub byang gi sa khul khag la dbang sgyur rjes sa gnas khag so sor spyi khyab blon chen gyi bkod 'doms 'og tu ru chen dmag dpung zhig yod pa de'i las 'gan ni rang gis bdag gnyer byed pa'i sa khul srung skyob dang / gzhan 131

gyi btsan 'dzul la dpung rgol bya rgyu de yin/ dus bde zhod 'jags skabs su dmag rnams kyis zhing las thon skyed kyi las ka byed kyi yod 'dug drag po'i dpung sde'i gnas rim lnga la phye yod pa ste/ dang po sa khul spyi khyab blon chen gyi 'og tu ru chen zhes pa'i dmag dpon gyi go gnas shig yod pa de ni ru sde de'i dmag rnams la 'go 'doms byed mkhan yin/ gnyis pa ru sde gcig la ru dpon rgan gzhon gnyis re yod/ ru sde gcig la stong sde bcu yod/ stong sde re la dmag grangs khri gcig yod/ sum pa stong dpon gyi 'og tu stong bu chung zhig yod pa de'i 'og tu dmag grangs stong phrag 'ga' shas yod/ stong bu chung ba zer don ni dmag mi khri gcig ma lon pa'i don yin/ bzhi pa/ lnga brgya chen po zhes pa de dmag mi 500 yas mas kyi 'go 'doms dmag dpon la zer/ lnga pa/dmag grangs brgya tham pa yod pa'i sde khag la brgya dpon re yod/dus skabs de'i dmag rnams la spyi tshogs nang nas mthong che shos su brtsi gi yod/ dmag sar rang srog blos btang ba'i byas rjes can gyi khyim tshang dang / dmag dpon byas rjes can la sa khang dang nor phyugs/ bran g.yog 'os 'tshams zhig bya dgar sprod srol yod/ dpa' bo rnams la gong ras dmar po dang / stag gi pags pa'i stod gos kyi gzengs bstod dpa' rtags stsal gyi yod cing / de'i khyim tshang gi sgo'i steng du drag chas lcags khrab re 'dogs pa dang / g.yul sa nas bros pa'i dmag mi rnams la lha'i rnga ma'i zhwa mo bskon nas khrom bskor du khrid pa dang / dpung sde dang mang tshogs kyi dkyil du rkang lag bzhi ka sa la btsugs nas khyi skad rgyag tu 'jug gi yod 'dugadamag dpon rnams ni dpung nang nas dpa' stobs che ba dang / dmag rtsal mkhas pa sha stag 'dems bsko byed srol dang / dmag dkyus nang nas dmag sar byas rjes bzhag rjes dmag dpon gyi go gnas sprod kyi yod pa ma zad/ btsan po sku ngo mas 432

dmag dpung de'i byas rjes can la bya dga' sprod pa dang / dmag sar nor 'khrul byung rigs la dma' 'bebs dang / byas nyes la gzhigs pa'i khrims gcod bya srol yod pa sogs kyi thabs byus bzang po bton par brten dmag dpung gi nang nas dmag sar dang blangs kyis byas rjes 'jog mkhan dmag dpon mang po thon gyi yod/deng dus phyi nang gi mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis nyams zhib byas par gzhigs na srong btsan gyi dus su mi tshang gsum rer dmag mi re 'khri gi yod ces gsal/ dus rabs dgu pa'i smad du btsan po glang dar ma 'das rjes bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum sil bur gyur te bod spyi la dbang pa'i srid dbang ma byung stabs sngon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chab srid kyi sgrig srol nyams chag tu gyur pa dang chabs cig dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs kyang nyams rgyad du gyur to/ dus rim gnyis pa/ dus rabs bcu gsum pa tsam nas bzungs bod kyi chos rje sa skya dang / phag gru/ rin spungs/ sde srid gtsang pa bcas kyi dus rim la sa gnas sde pa che chung gi 'go khrid 'og drag po'i dpung sde )zhig chags/ de rnams dus rgyun du khyim du gnas pa dang / lo re bzhin dmag spyong gi sbyong brdar yang byed srol yod/ dmag 'khrug langs skabs srid dbang 'dzin mkhan des mnga' khul sde khag la dmag skul gyi grangs 'bor gyi bka' btang ste dus thog tu bskong bsdu byas nas sde khag so sos rang khungs kyi dmag rnams kyi 'go 'doms dmag dpon byed/ de rnams rgyun du khral 'ul rgyugs mkhan gyi dmag mi yin pa dang / rgyags rang khur yin stabs dmag shugs de tsam med pa dang / rgyal kha thob pa na dpa' tshod ma bzung bar glen rtags kyi rjes 'ded gtong ba dang / dmag pham dus rang rang so so mgo gang thon gyis bros byol du 'gro gi yod pa de dag ni dmag gi sgrig khrims dang dmag sbyong sogs ji bzhin med pa'i nyer 133

len red 'dug/dus rim gsum pa/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang 7rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa chen po'i skabs bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang dbu brnyes nas bzung sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gzim pa zhes pa'i gna' bo'i chos rgyal skabs kyi drag po'i dmag gi rnam pa mtshon pa'i drag dpung gi rtsa 'dzugs shig 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ de rnams nas 7gong sa mchog gi gzim chung yas mas la bskor srung gi las 'gan khur gyi yod stabs gzim pa'am gzim chung dmag zhes pa'i ming btags shing /de la yang gzim pa lding dpon dang / gzim pa dmag dkyus bcas 'go dmag gi rim pa cha tshang yod/ gzim pa rnams kyi dmag rkang re la dmag rten sa zhing son khal brgya dang brgyad cu 'gro ba'i sa cha yod/ bar skabs shig nas gzim pa rnams lo ltar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i mdzad chen dang 'char 'phar gtor rgyag gzab gsol sogs su bcar te ru sde g.yas g.yon bar gsum gyis gna' rabs kyi dmag chas khrab rmeg 'khor gsum cha tshang gyon nas mda' gri mdung gsum phub bcas khyer te snga rabs kyi dmag rtsal 'gran par byed/7rgyal ba sku phreng 13 pa'i skabs gzim pa ru phyi nang bar gsum du phye ste nang mas lo ltar smon lam mdzad chen sogs la gong bzhin zhabs bcar zhu ba dang / ru bar phyi gnyis kyi dmag rnams cha dang dmag skar du dmag sgar (ang drug par )bsgyur te me sgyegs dmag sgar ram gzim chung dmag ces zer/ dmag sgar der mda' khag gcig gi dmag grangs 500 tsam yod/dus rim bzhi pa/ 7rgyal ba sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i sku dus su gor bod dmag 'khrug gi rjes tsam la / rab byung pa 13 pa'i chu glang zu 4 ches 134

13 phyi lo 1793 lo bod dmag 3000 gsar 'dzugs gnang 'dug bod dmag sum stong tham pa rtsa 'dzugs gnang ste dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis khag la cha gses kyis gzhis rtse khul nas dmag mi 1༷༷༷ dang / rgyal rtse khul nas dmag mi 5༷༷ ding ri khul nas dmag mi 500 dbus khul nas dmag mi 1000 bcas bskong bsdu byas nas gzhis rtse dang dbus gnyis kyi dmag sgar la mda' dpon gnyis re dang /rgyal rtse dang deng ri gnyis la mda' dpon re bsko bzhag stsal/ de rnams la rgya sbyong dmag sgar ram bod dmag sum stong yang zer/gtsang khul gyi dmag rten la sa zhing rab 'bring cha snyom son khal bco brgyad 'gro ba'i sa yod/ dbus khul la dmag rten sa zhing son khal lnga bcu yin pa dang /dbus dmag 1000 de'i gnas sa lha sa'i byang ngos gra bzhir yod pa der gra bzhi dmag sgar zhes pa'i ming thogs/ rjes su dmag sgar der kha dang dmag sgar yang zer/(dmag sgar ang gnyis pa ) spyir sgrig gzhi gzhir bzung dmag grangs 500 rer mda' dpon re dang / ru dpon gnyis/ brgya dpon bzhi/ lding dpon 30 yod/ gra bzhi dmag sgar la mda' dpon gnyis dang / ru dpon bzhi/ brgya dpon brgyad/ lding dpon 40 dmag dkyus 1008 re bcas yod/gtsang dmag 1000 gzhis rtse grong khyer du gnas yod par brten der gzhis rtse dmag sgar yang zer ba dang / ga dang gzhis rtse dmag sgar yang zer/ (dmag sgar ang gsum pa / de bzhin rgyal rtse'i dmag sgar gnas sa de rgyal rtser yin pas der rgyal rtse dmag dang / nga dang dmag sgar yang zer/dmag sgar ang bzhi pa ding ri'i dmag sgar de lo rgyus thog ding ri khul gor dmag bod du btsan 'dzul yong rdugs kyis gor srung du bca' sdod la brten ding ri rang 135

du gnas sdod byas stabs der ding ri dmag sgar dang ca dang dmag sgar yang zer/(dmag sgar ang lnga pa 'i) dus rim lnga pa/ chu byi phyi lo 1913 lo mdo stod khul du rgya dmag mthar skrod dang / sa srung la shugs snon rgyag ched bod dmag mda' khag gam dmag sgar khag bcu'i bar rgya skyed du btang ste dmag dpung gi sgrig gzhi bod yig gsal byed ka li'i do rim la gzhigs nas bsgrigs pa ka nas da bar ste/ sku srung dmag sgar ka dang / gra bzhi dmag sgar kha dang / gzhis rtse dmag sgar ga dang / rgyal rtse dmag sgar nga dang / ding ri dmag sgar ca dang / de min cha dang / ja dang / nya dang / ta dang / tha dang / da dang bcas rim bzhin gsar 'dzugs kyis gong gsal dmag sgar rnams la khyon bsdomaso dmag grangs 10000 lhag tsam byung 'dugade rjes na dang/ pa dang / pha dang / ba dang / ma dang so so'i dmag sgar yang rim bzhin gsar 'dzugs gnang / dmag sgar khag gi dmag mi rnams kyi dmag rtsed dbyin ji dang / ru su/ nyi hong bcas kyi dmag rtsal dge rgan bod 'gugs dang 'brel khungs so sos dmag rtsed slob sbyong byas te dmag rtsed ji legs kyi dmag sbyong la 7rgyal mchog sku phreng 13 pa chen pos gzigs zhib gnang ste dbyin lugs dmag rtsed la thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar/ gzhung zhabs shod skor dang / dmag sgar khag gi na gzhon shes rig bkra ba 'ga' shas rgya gar du'ang dmag rtsed slob sbyong du btang ste/ de rjes sku srung dmag sgar dang / gzim chung dmag sgar sogs nas kyang 'dems bsgrugs gnang ste rgya gar du dmag rtsed dang rol cha slob sbyong byas nas 'dzam gleng dmag mi spyi mtshungs kyi rjes su bsnyegs thub pa'i dmag rtsed slob sbyong gang legs thon te bod du phyir log gis dmag sgar khag gi 'go pa dang / dmag rtsed dge rgan bcas gang latsho ji 'os kyi bsko 136

bzhag ༷/khukhri/sa lug phyi lo 1919 rgyal rtse khul dmag dpon slob sbyong gsar 'dzugs kyis sger pa'i bu phrug khag gcig la dbyin ji'i dmag gi sgrig srol dang / me mda' rgyag stangs/ ru sgrig stangs/ dmag rgyag stangs bcas slob sbyong sprad 'dugaphyi lo 1933 lo bka' mgron g.yu thog sras bkris don grub dang / phreng ring sras 'jigs med sum rtson dbang po/ sku srung dmag sogs mi grangs 35 rgyal rtse'i dmag don slob sbyong du btang ste drag po'i slob sbyong thon mtshams lo der g.yu thog sras la grong drag dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon dang / phreng ring sras la mda' tshab/ de min sger pa'i bu phrug 'ga' shas la ru dpon dang / brgya dpon bcas bsko bzhag stsal ba byung 'dugagong gsal dmag sgar khag phud grong drag dmag sgar gyi dmag mi'i yongs khungs de dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis khag nang 'byor ldan mi tshang khag gi bu phrug sha stag bskong bsdu byas/ thog ma'i 'char gzhir dmag grangs 15༷༷ bskong bsdu bya rtsis byas kyang mtha' ma dmag grangs 700 tsam las ma byung / 7rgyal mchog sku phreng 13 dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rjes grong drag dmag sgar gyi dmag mi rnams phyir slog gnang dgos byung 'dugagong gsal dngos gzhi'i dmag sgar khag de rnams kyi thog yul gru lung tshan khag tu yul dmas gi sgrig gzhi btsugs pa dper na/ sho star lho gsum dang / re dkar sog gsum/ spo /dmag dpa' shod dmag bcas yul dmag gi sgrig lam thad dngos gzhi'i dmag dang gcig mtshungs yod pa'i thog dmag sbyong yang gang 'tsham yod/ de rnams dus rgyun rang khyim du bsdad de dza drag gi gnas tshul byung skabs rang gzhung gi ga37

bka' 'gugs nam gnang mtshams zha bas bcar zhus te dmag gi 'go 'doms spyi khyab rang gzhung gis ser skya dpon rigs la skabs bsnyun bsko bzhag gnang gi yod cing / de 'og ru dpon dang / brgya dpon/ lding dpon/ bcu dpon bcas rang khungs yul dmag nang shes 'jon gnyis 'dzoms gas nas bsko bzhag byed/gong gsal yul dmag de rnams kyi thog byang rigs sde bzhi'i rta dmag 800dang / hor tsho so dgu'i yul dmag smar khams se ril yul dmag 'do 'jo se ril yul dmag brag g.yab se ril yul dmag tsha ba rong gi yul dmag bcas yod/gong gsal drag po'i dpung sde rnams kyi spyi 'doms bod gzhung dmag spyi khang de/phyi lo 1913 lo gsar 'dzugs gnang nas dmag spyi che ba bka' blon gcig gis mtshan khur gnang gi yod pa dang / de 'og rgyun las dmag spyi chung ba ser skya dza sag gi mtshan gnas yod pa gnyis/ skabs re dmag spyi mkhan chung ngam rim bzhi'i go gnas yod pa yang bsko bzhag gnang srol yod/ de 'og dmag drung gnyis dang / las bya rtse drung gnyis/ yig 'bri lding dpon gyi go gnas yod pa 'ga' shas bcas nas gong rim dmag spyi rnam gnyis kyi bka' bkod ltar/ dmag spyi khang gi 'char 'phar las don rnams sgrub kyi yod/ bod dmag gi nang nas 'das grongs song ba dang dgongs zhu'i rigs sogs kyi tshab gsar 'byor rigs la lag thel dmag spyi khang du zhus te thag gcod gnang ba las/dmag sgar so sos thag gcod byed pa'i dbang cha med/ dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon bsko bzhag dang phyir 'then/ gnas spo bcas bka' shag nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen por 'char gzhi 'os dang gnyis rim can bkod de phyag rtags phab rgyu dang / ru dpon/ brgya dpon bsko 'then thad dmag spyi las khungs nas bka' shag tu 'char gzhi phul te bka' shag nas phyag rtags gnang gi yod pa ma zad/ drung gnas kyi gras su 'tshud stabs gzhung 138

sa'i mdzad chen dang / gsar mjal bcar srol yod/ lding dpon bsko bzhag dmag sgar khungs so sos dmag spyi khang la 'char gzhir 'os 'dra gnyis gsum bkod nas phul te dmag spyi khang gis phyag rtags bsko bzhag stsal lam yod/dmag sgar so so'i nang dmag dkyus dmag sbyong legs pa dang / kun spyod legs pa/ 'jon thang ldan pa'i rigs la dmag rtsed dge rgan dang / bcu dpon/ me jar bcas dmag spyi khang du snyan seng bka' 'khrol dang 'brel dmag sgar so so'i mda' dpon rang gis bsko bzhag gnang srol yod/dus rim drug pa/ sa glang 1949 lo bod gzhung dmag spyi khang nas bod dmag gi sgrig gzhi 'char gzhi phyag rtags dgongs don dmag khrims don tshan 35'khod pa zhig gtan 'bebs gsar gtod gnang ba de'i rtsa don ni/ dgra la phar rgol mi byed pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed srol dang / tshur rgol yan por mi gtong ba srid kyi rgyal po'i bzhed srol yin zhes 'khod yod/ dpung sde'i kun spyod kyi dmag khrims dam zab kyi rnam pa mtshon byed dpung dmag gis dgon sde ji 'dra zhig mjal ba tsam gyis de la phyag 'tshal ba dang / skyabs su brten dgos pa sogs lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi bzhed srol dri ma med pa lag len bstar rgyu/ dpung dmag rnams phyi bskyod skabs lam bar gral bstar 'a)ga pos 'gro dgos pa dang / lam 'khel mi ser rnams la za brnyes brdabs gsig 'phrog bcom sogs byed mi chog pa sogs dang /de sngon bod dmag rnams kyi dmag rtsed dbyin skad de mkhas dbang a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel dang / ka shod sras don grub chos rgyal/ shod drung mkhar sna mkha' khyab bde chen/ ka dang sku srung ru dpon mi 'gyur/ lding dpon bka' khyim rgod skyes bcas nas bod skad du bsgyur/ dmag rtsed skad brda bsgyur ba dang dus mtshungs dmag sgar byings 39

kyi dmag chas kyang bod chas su gtan la phab/ 'on kyang ka dang sku srung dmag rnams kyi dmag chas dbyin lugs rang 'jags gnas yod/ de byings dmag sgar gzhan rnams snam bu sa mdog gi la shag dang / zhwa lham tshang ma gzhi mtshungs bod bzo dang / mda' dpon gyis gos chen mdzod gos ser po'i la shag gi gong rgyan si shan rgya log can dang /zhwa mo'i thog gser gyi mo sgor rdo rje rgya gram ris g.yu phra mu tig sogs kyi brgyan pa bcas bod lugs dmag chas skor 'char phul phyag rtags gtan 'khel byung yang / mda' dpon khag gi dmag chas sngar srol dbyin lugs kyi dmag chas rang 'jags su gnas/ru dpon gyi dmag gos tshos man rdza mdog si shan gong rgyan can gyi la shag dang / zhu mo'i thog gser gyi mo sgor g.yu khra can / brgya dpon dang lding dpon tshos snam bu sa mdog gi la shag la rgya log gi gong rgyan can/ de bzhin go gnas mtho dman gyi mtshon rtags su dmag spyi'i dpung rtags gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram rtse bzhi pa dang / zhwa mo'i sked bcings dmar pos brgyan pa/ mda' dpon gyi zhu mo dang / dpung rtags la gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram rtse bzhi pa/ ru dpon la rtse gsum pa/ brgya dpon la rtse gnyis pa/ lding dpon la rtse gcig pa bcas yin/ 0bod dmag gi go gnas rim pa ni/ dmag spyi bka' blon nam dza sag gi go gnas rim pa gsum pa / dmag spyi gzhon pa rtse skor mkhan chung ngam shod skor gnas rim bzhi pa/ mda' dpon gnas rim bzhi pa bcas dmag dpon de rnams mang che ba gzhung zhabs ser sku'i khongs nas bsko bzhag gnang srol yod kyang skabs re dmag dkyus khongs nas dmag thog tu byas rjes gzengs su thon pa byung ba rigs la mda' dpon gyi go gnas gnang ba yang byung 'dug dper na/ de sngon 7rgyal mchog sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i skabs gor dmag gis bod du btsan 'dzul 'gog pa'i 440 ri

dmag 'thab nang ru dpon shel dkar gling pas gor dmag la phar rgol gyis dpa' bo'i byas rjes su gzhung zhabs sger pa'i gras su zhugs pa'i thob thang zhabs rten pha gzhis kyang bstsal 'dugade bzhin sku phreng 13 pas kha dang gra bzhi ru dpon gnyis pa/ 'phyongs rgyas na ra ba 'gyur med tsho brtan gyis zhi drag gnyis kyi zhabs 'degs gzengs su thon pa byung rjes dmigs bsal ka dang sku srung mda' dpon nam/ kha dang dbus mda' gang rung 'dod bstun bgyis te snyan seng dang 'brel gsar mjal 'phral du zhu dgos pa'i bka' bzang phebs nas dbus mda' bsko bzhag bstsal 'dug de ni rigs rus mchog dman gyi dbye ba med par dmangs gtso'i lam lugs gsal po bstan pa'i khyad chos su mngon/ ru dpon rnams phyi'i rim pa lnga pa dang / byas rjes can re zung la las tshan rim pa lnga pa yang bstsal srol yod/ brgya dpon rnams phyi'i gnas rim drug pa dang /lding dpon rnams la phyi'i gnas rim bdun pa bcas yin/gong zhus ltar/ de sngon 1912 bod chu byi lor bod dmag rnams la dmag rten sa zhing yod mus thog bod gzhung gi dmag mi rer 'gru phogs stsal lam bzos te lo rer /mag mi rer 'bru khal nang sprod kyi yod pa dang / dmag sar bskyod skabs dmag mi rer nyin re rtsam bre gang re sprod pa dang / ru dpon la rla re dngul srang 35brgya dpon la dngul srang zheX lding dpon la dngul srang 18 bcas sprod srol yod 'dugachu byi phyi lo 1913 lo yul thang la bskun nas dmag phogs stsal srol la bcos bsgyur btang ste dmag spyi la ṭam rdo 50 dang / mda' dpon la ṭam rdo 35ru dpon la dmag dkyus kyi phogs skal 5 dang / brgya dpon la dmag dkyus phogs 444

skal gsum/ lding dpon la dmag dkyus phogs skal gnyis bcas dang dmag dkyus re zla rer 'bru ru'i khal gnyis dang / mar rgya ma gsum re dang / tsha rgya ma gcig bul tog bre gang bcas brtsis pa'i thob skal gnang srol yod/sa glang phyi lo 1949 lo dmag phogs bskyar sgrig bsgyur bcos kyis mda' dpon gyi thob skal mda' gzhis phyir bsdus kyis dmag skye dang mtshungs pa lo rer dngul phogs dngul srang 35000 dang / ru dpon la rla rer phogs 'bru ru'i khal bcu dang / ja ril gsum/ dngul srang 350 brgya dpon la phogs 'bru ru'i khal cudang / ja ril gnyis / dngul srang 135 dang / lding dpon la phogs 'bru khal 4dang / ja ril gcig dngul srang 84 bcas sprod kyi yod/ de min dmag chas mthun rkyen sngar srol gtan 'bebs ltar dmag bdag so so'i sa nas lo re dbyar dgun gyon chas bsdu sprod byed mus dang / skabs re dmag chas kyi rgyu 'gro rnams dngul rkyang bsdu len byed kyi yod/bod dmag dmag sgar khag gi dmag dar ni da yod rgyal dar gzhir bzung thog dmag sgar so so'i ka rtags dang / gangs ri/ seng ge nyi rla bcas yod/ dmag mi'i zhu mo dang dpung pa g.yon la dmag sgar gang yin dang / dmag mi'i ang grangs bcas 'khod yod/ ka dang sku srung dmag gi zhu mo geb zhu dang / dbyin lugs gyon chas snam bu ser po yin pa dang / 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur chen mo'i skabs sogs mdzad sgo'i dus chen khag la go snam ser po'i stod gos dang / gu thung sngon po'i dmag chas gyon gyi yod/ dmag sgar gzhan rnams kyi dmag chas gong du 'khod pa ltar yin/dus rim bdun pa/ phyi lo 1951 lo pe cing du bod rgya gnyis dbar gros mthun don tshan 17 bzhag rjes rgya dmag rim bzhin bod du lhags nos gros mthun 442

gyi don tshan brgyad par gzhir bzung bod kyi dmag sgar rnams rim bzhin bcings 'grol dmag la bsgyur nas krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab srung ba'i drag shugs khag gcig tu bsgrub rgyu zhes 'khod pa ltar/ bod dmag rnams rgya dmag tu bsgyur dgos zhes rgya phyogs nas yang yang brjod pa dang / phyogs gcig nas rgya dmag gis sa mtshams brtan srung bya rgyur bod dmag rnams rgyas bsdus bzo dgos pa'i thugs gtan lam tsam 'khel ba ltar/ bod dmag 4000 gi nang nas dmag grangs 500yis 7rgyal ba'i sku srung zhabs zhu dang / de 'phros 500 yis lha sa grong khyer gyi gtsos pa'i sa gnas gnad yod khag gi bde 'jags bskor srung gi 'gan khur zhu rgyu/ de 'phros bod dmag rnams phyir bsdu gnang phyogs thad dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag rang khyim du phyir log byed 'dod yod rigs tshang ma phyir log gtong rgyu dang / log yul med pa'i rigs la shes 'jon la dpag pa'i zhi las su bsgyur rgyu bcas yin zhes khyab bsgrags gnang /skabs der kha/ nga / cha gsum gyi 'go dmag spyi mgrin nas gzhung sa dang / rgyal srung dmag mi ya bral 'gro ma dgos pa dang / lhag par gangs ljongs rgyal bstan chab srid yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po gse ra zhal 'tsho bzhugs yod bzhin du dbu dpung ya bral du 'gro ma dgos pa'i bde sdug snyan zhu zhib nan zhig 'bul lam zhus song /bod gzhung 'bru khang spyi 'doms las khungs nas bka' 'gugs kyis da yod dmag rnams phyir bsdu'i skor gong rim nas thag gcod gnang zin 'dug na/ khyed tshos lkugs pa u tshugs kyis snyan 'bul zhus kyang don smin son thabs med nges sogs bka' nan gnang bar brten khong rnams 'u thug thabs zad kyis 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog stod lung mtshur phu kum pa'i bla brang nas gdan zhus chibs bsgyur skabs 443

kha nga cha gsum dmag sgar gsum gyi lding dpon re ched gnyer gyis mtshur phurabacar nas bar lam byung ba'i gnas tshul zhib 'khod kyi snyan zhu phul/de nas dus yun ring por ma song bar 7gong sa mchog nas da lta bod dmag nyung shas las med stabs khu bsdu phyir log ma dgos pa'i bka' bzang stsal thon gyis sngar bzhin gnas thub pa byung song / de bzhin ga dang mda' dpon mu bya bar gzhis rtse spyi rdzong bsko bzhag gnang rjes de sngon chab mdo khul 'thor gyar phyin pa'i ga dang dmag rim bzhin gzhis rtser bsdu len byas nas dmag grangs 300 lhag tsam gyi dmag sgar slar gso byas/mkhan chung blo skal lags la dmag spyi gzhon pa bsko bzhag gnang rjes gong gsal dmag sgar khag nas nad 'das yul byol song rigs kyi tshab 'jug zhu bsdad tshang ma gsar 'dzugs zhus 'thus byung ba ma zad/ khong gis dmag rtsed dang go lag bcas par thugs 'khur gzigs zhib nan po gnang ste dmag sgar khag sngar las lhag pa'i sra tshugs byung ba dang / de bzhin 'go byed 'os rigs drang bden gyis bskos 'dugaphyi lo 1955 lo'i zu 4 pa'i nang bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi rten 'brel zhu ched de sngon don tshan 17 nang 'khod pa ltar/ bod dmag da yod sku srung 'go dmag rnams dang / dmag sgar khag gzhan rnams kyi lding dpon yan gyi dmag dpon rnams la rgya mi'i bcings 'grol dmag gi sgrig srol ltar go gnas dang /dmag chas bcas sprod rgyur nor gling sku srung dmag sgar gyi pho brang mdun du bod rgya zhi drag gnad yod dpon rigs rnams mdzad sgor phebs te go min dang / dpung rtags dmag chas bcas sprad pa dper na/ bod gzhung dmag spyi dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud mchog la hra'o cang dang / dmag spyi mkhan chung blo skal mchog la tu sha'o/144

phran sku srung mda' dpon la hra'o sha'o/ de min mda' dpon rnams la krung sha'o/ ru dpon rnams tā 'us/ brgya dpon rnams la krung 'us/ de min hra'o lngas bcas kyi go gnas sprad/de'i sngon tsam la bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / dmag spyi bka' blon mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas gnyis la gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun gyi zur yig nang 'khod don ltar/ bcings 'grol dmag bod dmag khul khang si ling yon gzhon pa'i mtshan krung cang zhes pa phul yod/ de rjes dmag spyi bka' blon mdo mkhar ba 'das rjes 7gong sa mchog nas tha'i ji bsam pho che dbang rig 'dzin dmag spyi bka' blon bsko bzhag gnang bas/ rgya phyogs kyis khong la mdo mkhar ba'i tshab tu si ling yon gzhon pa'i hra'o cang gi mtshan gnas phul/phyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 3 par bod rang btsan sger langs las 'gul byung ba nas bzung rgya mis sprad pa'i dmag chas dang / go gnas bcas mtshams 'jog gis sngar gyi rang lugs dmag chas slar gso byas so/phyi lo 1954 lo 'go tsam la nyin gcig rtse 'gag nas phran la khyod rang gnangs nyin snga dro rtse 'gag tu bcar dgos zhes pa'i yig chung phebs gsal ltar bcar skabs mgron chen pha lha bas/ 7gong sa mchog nas bka' spyi phebs su 'char gzhi phyag rtags dgongs don bzhin khyod rang phyi las drung che rim bzhi stag lha sras la 7rgyal ba'i sku srung mda' dpon pha lha ba phogs dpon du 'phos tshab bsko bzhag bstsal song bas gang myur bka' bsgyur mjal dar dang / gsar mjal chabs cig zhu dgos zhes bka' bsgyur phebs don ltar gsar mjal zhus rjes sku srung mda' dpon zur pa phogs dpon pha lha'i sras kyi sa nas sku srung dmag sgar gyi phyi nang zhu bya dang / go mtshon yig rigs 145

sogs rtsis len byas/ skabs der sku srung dmag grangs 500 tsam las med/7rgyal ba sku phreng 13 pa chen po gser zhal 'tsho bzhugs skabs sku srung dmag sgar gyi dmag grangs meX lhag tsam yod thog dmag da mangs rnams kyi kun spyod dang / dmag sbyong bcas skabs de'i 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan gyi dmag gi sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rjes zin yod pa dang / 7rgyal ba sku phreng 13 chen po dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rjes sku srung dmag grangs phyed tsam byang rgyud nag tshang sa srung du btang ba dang / de 'phros rnams 7rgyal ba'i pho brang nor gling yas mas su srung char bzhagaphran nas sku srung mda' dpon gyi las 'gan rtsis blangs rjes gtso bo'i zhu bya ming don mtshungs pa'i sku srung zhabs 'degs 'thur shor ma song ba dang / pho brang yas mas srung 'doms zhu rgyu 'gan len gyi dam bca' bzhag ste 7rgyal ba'i bzhugs yul pho brang phyi nang gnyis dang / pho brang yas mas su chibs sgyur skabs phebs lam g.yas g.yon bcas nyen rtogs srung skyob zhu mkhan dmag dkyus khongs nas na gzhon drag gras 'dems sgrug gis srung cha bkod sgrig byas pa dang / res gza' nyi ma phud nyin ltar snga dro dmag dmangs rnams rgyugs shar dang / dmag sbyong byed du bcug thog dmag mi na gzhon rnams la nyin re chu chod gnyis tsam ring bod yig 'bri klog gi 'dzin grwa yang gsar 'dzugs byas / de min na gzhon spyang grung 'dzoms pa 'ga' shas bdams nas bcings 'grol dmag sgar gyi sman khang nang du sman g.yog gi slob sbyong byed bcug ste dmag mi rnams kyi 'phrod bsten ched du dmag sgar nang du sman khang chung ngu zhig gsar 'dzugs byas/ de bzhin gzugs stobs legs pa'i dar ma 30 lhag tsam mo ṭa che chung gtong ba'i slob sbyong sprad nas rjes su 7rgyal ba'i zhabs zhur thugs phan chen po sos song /dpyid ku'i dus su dmag mi rnams las seng skabs nor gling pho brang yas 146

mas dang / dmag sgar nye 'gram bcas su lcang ma 'debs 'dzugs kyi ngal rtsol byed du bcug pa dang / dmag mi'i 'tsho ba gong 'phel yong thabs su sku srung dmag sgar gyi nub ngos nye 'dabs dang / nor stod gling khar sa stong gsar sbol gyis 'bru rigs 'debs las byed du bcug de bzhin dmag sgar nang du yod pa'i sa stong gsar sbol bya rgyu de lding khag la bgos te der tshal zhing 'debs las kyis thon 'bor 'gran bsdur byed du bcug ste thon 'bor legs pa byung rigs la gzengs bstod bya dga' sprod pa ma zad/ thon 'bab tshal rigs ston 'bras rnams lding khag so sor cha bgos kyis sprad par brten 'go dmag rnams kyi tshal zhing dang / ston thog 'debs rgyur do snang dang / hur skyed chen po byas song / de bzhin dmag sgar nang nyin re'i dgos mkho'i tshong khang zhig gsar 'dzugs byas pa des 'go dmag rnams la phan thogs chen po byung / de sngon dmag sgar du dmag mi'i nang mi sdod srol yod pa de rnams kyi sdod khang nor stod gling khar ar po gsar rgyag gis gzhis chags lta bu'i 'dzugs skrun thon skyed byed du bcug par brten de rnams kyi 'tsho ba rim bzhin gong 'phel du gyur nas 'go dmag rnams snying stobs che ba'i dmag dpung zhig tu bsgyur te 7rgyal ba'i sku srung zhabs 'degs la 'thus shor ma byung ba'i legs tshogs rlabs po che zhig gsog thub pa byung /phran gyi sku srung dmag sgar gyi las khur rtsis len zhus rjes lugs dang mi mthun pa'i dmag khrims yongs su zhib brtag gis nyes spyod che chung la gzhigs pa'i nyes pa gtong ba dper na/ nyes pa lci ba'i rigs la dmag sgar yas mas sogs kyi mi lud bsgrug te tshal zhing la spyod du bcug pa dang / de 'og la ngal rtsol sna tshogs skul ba/ de min tshal zhing dang / shing sna 'debs su 'jug gi yod/ de bzhin dmag rtsed rtse skabs g.yol 'gro mkhan gyi rigs la rgyugs bshar glod du 'jug pa bcas kyi nyes chad 447

lag len bstar nas lo gcig tsam song ba'i ring dmag rnams kyi kun spyod tshul ldan zhig tu bsgyur yod/ de sngon mda' dpon dang / ru brgya gsum gyis dmag mi mang po bran du bkol ba de grangs tshad gtan 'bebs bzos nas mda' dpon la g.yog bzhi dang / ru dpon la gsum/ brgya dpon la gnyis/ lding dpon la gcig bcas gtan 'bebs bzos/ de mtshungs ngo shes dga' nye tshor dmag mi gang byung btang nas bed spyod mi chog pa bcas sgrig srol gtan 'bebs byas/gong smros ltar dmag spyi mkhan chung blo skal mchog la dmag spyi bsko bzhag gnang pa nas bzung khong gis bod dmag gi dmag sgar rnams dang / lhag par du sku srung dmag sgar la thugs snang chen pos gzigs skyong gnang ste sngon phyir slog byas pa'i dmag rnams mngon chung thog bsdu bskong bya rgyu'i bka' bzang thob ste phyi lo 1958 lo mjug tsam la sku srung dmag grangs 1000 min tsam slar gso byed thub pa byung / gal srid 1959lo'i sger langs 'khrug 'dzings ma byung ba yin na de sngon sku srung dmag gi gtan 'bebs grangs tshad 1000 lon thub rgyur the tsham med pa zhig yin/ de bzhin rgya phyogs dang 'brel ba thabs mkhas byas te rgya phyogs nas sku srung dmag sgar la thon gcig gi dmag mkho'i sgrig chas rogs ram bya rgyu lam tsam gtan 'khel ba'i skor dmag spyi khang dang /bka' shag tu snyan seng bka' 'khrol zhus par bka' shag gis rgya phyogs kyi go mtshon blangs na slad nyen kha chen po yong lugs kyi bka' phebs par phran gyis rgya mi'i go mtshon des rang re'i dmag rnams la drag chas sprad te go skabs dang bskun nas bed spyod byed chog pa zhig yin pa'i bsam tshul zhus kyang gsan 'jog ma gnang stabs rang bzhin du 'jog dgos byung /148

sa bcad lnga pa/le tshan nyer gnyis pa/7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po pe cing du chibs sgyur bskyangs pa/da4shākya/ /rgya dmar gyis phyi lo 1949 lor gzhung gsar pa btsugs nas 1954lo rgyal khab kyi rtsa khrims gtan 'bebs bya rgyur rgya nag sa khul so so nas 'thus mi 'dems bskos kyis pe cing du skabs dang po'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen zhes pa bskong tshogs byas pa'i skabs der bod nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyis dbus 'thus mi bcu tshogs 'dur phebs rgyur rgya mis gtan 'bebs byas te/ de'i nang bod mi ma yin pa'i rgya mi'i gnad yod las byed kyang bod mi'i 'thus mi'i gras su bskos 'dug7gong sa mchog rgya nag la chibs thon ma gnang gong rla gcig gi sngon du de snga rgyal mchog sku phreng rim byon gyis rgyal srid chos srid bdag gir bzhes rjes yab gzhis nas 7rgyal dbang mchog gdan zhu byed pa'i mdzad lam bzhin rgyal yum chen mo mchog nas yab gzhis stag 'cher 'tsho 'dzin rnam gnyis la bka' bsdur dang 'brel 7gong sa mchog yab gzhis stag 'cher du gdan zhu gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar rtse 49

mkhan mgron che ba pha lha brgyud snyan seng zhus gnang la chibs sgyur gnang rgyu'i bka' bzang phebs te rla 3 ches dge ba'i nyin 7gong sa mchog dang / sku 'khor hrag bsdus nor gling skal bzang pho brang nas lcang gseb shar yab gzhis stag 'tshor du phebs byo'i thog chibs bsgyur zhabs sor 'khod nas bzhugs zhag gsum mdzad de sngar lam gyi mdzad sgo mtha' dag thugs gra legs 'grigs thog rgyal yum chen mo mchog gis dbus yab gzhis sku 'khor dang / zhabs gras bcas la legs skyes gnang cha stsal te skal bzang bla na med pa thob/de nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar 7gong sa mchog dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis / rgyal yum chen mos dbus yab gzhis sku 'khor/ bka' blon zur khang dang / nga phod rnam gnyis kyis mtshon gzhung zhabs ser skya brgya lhag tsam gyi chibs zhabs dang bcas phyi rla 5 ches 11 nyen lha sa nas rgya nag tu chibs zhal sgyur te kong po rgya mdar ma slebs tsam bar me le 57 lhag tsam gyi sar phebs tshur thog phebs pa dang /de nas chibs thog tu phebs dus char zhod che skabs 'khel zhing / lhag par spo yul khul gyi gdod ma'i nags tshal nang phebs lam ji bzhin med par zhabs bgrod kyis phebs dgos pa'i sku ngal chen po byung zhing / bzhugs gnas ji bzhin med par nub gcig rgya mi lam bzo'i gur nang bzhugs dgos byung /7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams spo bo spra mog tu zhabs sor 'khod skabs sa gnas der bsdad pa'i rgya mi'i bcings 'grol dpon dmag rnams kyis dga' bsu zhus te rgya dmag gis gsar bskrun byas pa'i shing khang du bzhugs zhag mdzad/spo bo spra mog sa gshongs kyi g.yas g.yon ri rtser dbyar dus mi zhu ba'i dngul mdog can gyi gangs rir rta bdun dbang po'i 'od zer 'phros pas kha mdog bdun ldan 150
