gyi 'ja' tshon rnam par bkra ba/ ri gsham du g.yu ltar sngo ba'i yid 'ong gtsang po de lho nub tu rgyugs pa/ sa gshongs kyi g.yas g.yon spang gshongs thog yid dbang 'phrog pa'i me tog sna tshogs kyi dri zhim phyogs bcur khyab pa bcas mdzes sdug can gyi yul ljongs phun sum tshogs pa zhig snang /de sngon rang gzhung nas sa chu'i mthun rkyen shin tu legs pa'i dben pa'i skyed tshal de lta bu zhig gi thon skyed kyi sgo mo ma phye ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin nam snyam pa byung / sa khul de rgya mtsho'i ngos las mtho tshad mi ṭar 155 nas 300 lhag tsam las med stabs gnam gshes tsha grang snyoms pas shing sna ha cang mdzes po yod pa dang / de'i lho brgyud gangs ri'i phar nang du bod dang rgya gar gyi lo rgyus thog dbye mtsha34sa phye ba'i mekha ma ton sa thig gi nang du tshud/ shar lho'i gangs ri'i phar phyogs 'bar ma rgyal khab dang 'brel 'dug spo yul de stod smad gnyis su phye ba'i yar lung chu'i gtsang po'i chu rgyud stod la spo stod dang / gtsang po'i smad rgyud la spo smad ces grags/ de sngon bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i skabs spo yul sa khul de mdo spyi'i mnga' khongs kyi rdzong khag gas shig yin 'dugade'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams spra mog nas phebs ṭo 'jib 'khor nang phebs thon gyis phebs lam tsha ba dpa' shod sa khul gyi me tog sgang dang / tsha ba spom mda' bcas la zhag sa 'khel nas rim bzhin chab mdo grong khyer du zhabs sor 'khod skabs de khul gyi ser skya mi dmangs stong phrag mang pos dad gus kyi ngang nas 7rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bru mchog la chos srid zung sdel gyi dga' bsu bla na med pa zhus te bzhugs sgar chab mdo dgon chen gyi tshoms chen steng 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung du phebs sgrigs zhus/ 151

chab mdo ni bod shar phyogs kyi mdo smad spyi khyab bzhugs yul gyi bsnyi gnas yin pa'i dbang gis khams phyogs mnga' khul yongs su chab srid dmag don sogs zhi drag las don mtha' dag gi bka' bkod bya yul zhig yin/phyi lo 1950 zla 10 ches nyin rgya dmar gyis dpung 'jug btsan 'dzul gyi chab mdo mnga' khul du sngon yod bod gzhung gi srid 'dzin rtsa 'dzugs de rtsa gtor btang ste chab mdo bcings bkrol u yon lhan khang zhes pa rgya mi'i go mtshon 'og tu gsar 'dzugs byas 'dug chab mdor nyin gcig tsam sku ngal sos te de nas phebs lam 'khel yul sde dge dang / dkar mjes/ rta'u bcas brgyud dar rtse mdor chibs bsgyur bskyangs/dar rtse mdo yan gyi sa khul yongs la bod mi 'dus sdod kyi sa khul sha stag yin stabs bod mi rnams kyis 7gong sa mchog zhabs sor gang du 'khod sar ser skya mi dmangs stong phrag mang po 'du 'dzoms la 7gong sa mchog nas mjal kha stsal ba dang /de rnams kyis dad gus bcos min ngang 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs sgar la bskor ba rgyag pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba bcas byas nas 7gong sa mchog rgya nag nas bod kha ba can gyi yul du gang myur zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / yar lam khams khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams la chos kyi bdud rtsis byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam drag po btab par 7gong sa mchog nas thugs dgyes mnyes chen pos zhal gyis bzhes/dar rtse mdo sa khul de bod shar phyogs mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i rgyal sgo lta bu'i snyan grags can gyi grong khyer zhig yin pa ma zad/ bod rgya mi dmangs gnyis kyi nyo tshong byed sa'i tshong ra zhig kyang yin par brten bod kyi sa khul nas thon pa'i bal dang /152

gla rtsi/ be smug dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu/ de min gyi sma rtsa/ pags rigs 'dren yul zhig dang / de bzhin rgya nag nas thon pa'i ja dang gos dar sogs de nas bod du 'dren pa red/ grong khyer der rgya bod mi dmangs gnyis 'brel mthud du gnas stabs mi sde gnyis kyi goms gshis kyang 'dres pa lta bu yod/ grong khyer de'i shar byang mdo smad rgyal mo rong sa khul nas snyan grags can gyi rgya mo rngul chu byang shar du rgyugs nas 'bri chu dang 'dres yod/ de'i byang shar gyi ri rgyud bod skad du g.yag la ri zhes pa de rgya skad du ar lang hran zhes zer/ri klung sa khul der gnas pa'i mi dmangs rnams bod kyi rgyud pa sha stag yin zhing / dus rabs 15 tsam la sa khul der bod rigs tsho khag drug ces grags/ dus skabs der rgya nag nas sa khul de'i 'go pa rnams la rgya mi'i go gnas sprad yod pas rgya skad du than chon bod rigs tsho drug zer/ dus rabs de nas rim bzhin bod rigs de rnams rgya'i rig gzhung gi rba rlabs nang thim nas rgya rigs kyi rnam par bsgyur te rim bzhin rang nyid gyi skad yig dang / rigs rgyud nyams brlag tu 'gyur bcug 'dugagayag la brgal te rgya'i grong khyer g.ya' rngan du bzhugs zhag mdzad/ de'i sang nyin zi khron zhing chen gyi bste gnas grong khyer khren tur zhabs sor 'khod de/ de nas gnam gru'i thog rgya nag dzub byang gi lo rgyus thog snyan grags can gyi shi'i an grong khyer du phebs/ kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che lha sa nas bod kyi byang lam dang mtsho sngon brgyud shi'i an du phebs 'byor thog 7rgyal ba yab sras gnyis lhan du 'dzoms/ shi'i an grong khyer de dus rabs brgyad pa'i dkyil du bod dmag gis der dpung 'jug byas nas rgya nag thang rgyal po ta'i tsung byang phyogs su bros te bod dmag gis khri sde gtsug brtan gyi btsun mo rgya bza' cin khreng kong jo'i tsha bor thang rgyal po gsar pa bskos thog nyin bco 453

lnga bsdad nas bod dmag rnams phyir 'then byas pa'i lo rgyus bod rgya gnyis ku'i rgyal rabs deb ther du gsal/de nas 7rgyal ba yab sras rnam nyis dang sku 'khor nyis brgya lhag tsam bcas shi'i an nas ri li thog pe cing du phebs / pe cing ri li babs tshugs sar rgya nag dbus gzhung gi kru'u zhi gzhon pa dmag spyi kru'u te dang/ srid blon kra'u en le yis sne khrid kyis gnad yod dpon rigs brgya lhag tsam dang / bod mi dang / rgya mi/ mi rigs gzhan dag bcas kyi slob phrug stong phrag lhag tsam dga' bsur bcar 'dugape cing du 7gong sa mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyi bzhugs sgar khag so so gra sgrig zhus 'dug pa 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs sgar de de sngon 1951 lo bod rgya zhi mthun gros mol bya yul yu ho cha'o sa khul gyi khang chen nang 7gong sa mchog dang / yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ 7rgyal yum chen mo yab gzhis sku 'khor/ sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum bcas kyi bzhugs sgrig zhus 'dug de min bka' blon zur khang dang / nga phod / kun gling dza sag mkhan drung ngag dbang don grub/ rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha/ rtsis dpon khe smad sogs pe cing mgron khang du gra sgrig zhus pa dang / de byings chibs zhabs khag gnyis su bgos te tu la'i don gcod khang dang / mgron khang gzhan bcas su phebs sgrig zhus 'dug paṇa chen sku 'khor rnams pe cing grong khyer byang ngos spyi gling 'gram gyi mgron khang legs pa zhig tu bzhugs sgrig zhus 'dug/ 7gong sa mchog dang / paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis bod nas pe cing du chibs sgyur phebs gtan 'khel skabs rgya nag dbus gzhung gi mi rigs don gcod u yon lhan khang dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur bod sdod rgya mi gnad yod dpon rigs bcas 7gong sa mchog dang / paṇa chen rin po che rnam 454

gnyis pe cing du phebs skabs dga' bsu sne len zhu babs mtho dman ji 'os skor gros gleng mang dag byung ba'i bsam tshul mthun dang mi mthun ji snyed byung ste khag gcig gis sngon yod lo rgyus dang / don dngos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas tā la'i bla ma bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid yin stabs sne len zhu sgo paṇa chen las phran bu mtho ba zhu dgos nges zhes brjod pa dang / khag gcig gis tu la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen bla ma gnyis la sne len zhu sgo gcig mtshungs dgos pa ste paṇa chen bla ma mes rgyal la sha zhen yod lugs kyi phan tshun rtsod gleng byung ste mtha' ma kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la skad cha dris par ma'o yis bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu la'i bla ma chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid yin zhing / paṇa chen ni bod kyi chos phyogs kyi dbu khrid yin pa ma zad/ khong ni mes rgyal la sha zhen yod pa'i mi sna zhig kyang yin/ 'on kyang mi gcig la mgo gnyis yod na rang bzhin gyi bde po yod pa ma red/ ṭī la'i bla ma bod kyi dbu khrid gtso bo yin par brten sne len zhu sgo paṇa chen las cung gzab pa dgos gal 'dug ces bka' gnang ba ltar/ 'brel yod las khungs nas de don phebs sgrig zhus/ skabs der tā 'a'i bla mar rgyab bskyor zhu mkhan mi rigs don byed kyi spyi khyab gzhon pa le'u ke ping dang / 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi chos dang mi rigs sde tshan gyi si krang ṭa'o phan/ bod sdod sku tshab krang cing u dang / phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcas kyi gtsos pas rgyab skyor bsam tshul bton pa'i skor go thos byung /paṇa chen gyi phyogs su rgyab skyor zhu mkhan mi rigs don gcod las khungs kyi spyi khyab gzhon pa dbang phung dang / bod dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi gzhon pa phan ming bcas yin/gong gsal gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ de sngon phyi lo 1951 lor pe cing du gros mthun don tshan 17 'jog skabs dbus gtsang gnyis kha phral te rang skyong tha dad 455

'dzugs rgyu'i ngan sems bcangs pa ltar skabs 'dir yang gong gsal rgya mi gnad yod dpon rigs khag gcig gis paṇa chen rin po che'i phyogs zhen gyis/ chab srid kyi go gnas tu la'i bla ma dang gcig mtshungs bzo thabs kyis dbus gtsang gnyis kha phral rgyu'i lkog g.yo lag len bstar rtsis byas pa mngon gsal red/7gong sa mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis sku 'khor bcas pe cing du phebs pa'i dgong dro der dga' bsu'i gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams pa'i sar rgya mi'i gnad yod dpon rigs mang po dang / gzhung bla gnyis phyogs kyi chibs zhabs mtho ri ma dpon rigs bcas gsol ston du bzhugs/ gsol ston 'go tshugs ma thag kru'u te nas tu la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen er te ni rnam gnyis bod nas mes rgyal gyi rgyal sa pe cing du bde phebs byung bar dga' bsu zhu ba dang / de sngon gros mthun bzhag pa nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams mes rgyal gyi pang du phyir log byung ste dbus gzhung gis bod ljongs yar rgyas gang mgyogs yong ba'i rogs ram byed kyi yin lugs sogs bshad/de nas nyin gnyis gsum ring sku ngal gso gnang mdzad de nyin zhig 7gong sa mchog dang yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ bka' blon rnam gnyis/ spyi khyab mkhan tshab sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan bcas chibs zhabs su lhan bcar gyis ma'o tse tung mjal 'phrad du phebs pa'i skor 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam las/ ma'o tse tung gi gsung mol nang ngas rgya nag gi tshogs chen du yong mos byas pa la dga' po byung tshul dang / rgya nag nas bod la rang bzhin gyi mthun rkyen rnams bed spyod kyis bod yar rgyas gtong rgyu yin zhing / krang cing u dang phan ming gnyis nga dang bod mi mang la rogs ram byed ched rgya nag gi sku tshab bod la btang ba red/ khong tshos bod gzhung dang mi dmangs thog dbang sgyur byed par phyin pa min zhes sogs brjod cing / da dung khong nas krang phan 456

gnyis la mdzub mo btsugs te kho bor thad kur dri ba byas don/ rgya nag gi sku tshab chos nga'i 'dod par ma babs pa byas ma byung ngam zhes zer byung zhes gsal/skabs der 7gong sa mchog nas mkhas mdzangs ldan pa dang mdza' grogs kyi rnam pa'i thog nas khyed kyi 'go khrid 'og bod la gang ci'i thog rogs ram yong ba'i re 'dun zhu rgyu dang / rgya nag gi sku tshab tshos 'grigs min byung skabs phan tshun drang po thad kur shod kyi yod ces lan 'debs mdzad/ ma'o tse tung nas 7gong sa mchog la byams brtse dang ldan pa rnam 'gyur gyi gleng mol zhus pa de rnams dbu bskor bslu bred kyi rdzun gtam zhe gcig yin na'ang / skabs der nga tsho tshang mas ma'o yi gleng mol la yid ches dang / brtsi bkur yod khul byed dgos kyi yod/de rjes 7gong sa mchog sku rkyang dang / phyag rogs su phun tshogs dbang rgyal bcar nas ma'o tse tung la mjal 'phrad thengs gnyis pa zhus nas yun ring po bzhugs pa'i skabs 7gong sa mchog nas bar lam bod la gnas tshul byung skor dang / slad bod ljongs yar rgyas yongs thabs skor bka' mol zhib phra lhug po byung 'dugama'o tse tung gis gros mol don tshan nang gsal ba ltar/ bod du dmag srid u yon lhan khang zhes pa gsar 'dzugs byed rgyu de dag ma dgos par de'i tshab tu sa gnas mi rigs rang skyong zhes pa'i gra sgrig lhan khang 'dzugs rgyur tā la'i bla mar thugs babs yod med bka' 'dre zhus pa tsam las rtsa ba'i thog nas gra sgrig u yon lhan khang 'dzugs rgyur thag gcod zin 'dugade ni rgya dmar gyis phyi lo 1933 lo zu lnga pa'i nang krung gung tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa'i thog gsal bsgrags nang du bod dang / sog po/ hu' cang / (shing cang /)sa khul gsum la dmangs gtso rang thag rang gcod gyi rgyal phran nam/ krung ha mi mang 157

mnyam sbrel spyi mthun rgyal phran 'dzugs 'thus chog rgyur ngos len dang / de rjes phyi lo 1931 lo rla ba bcu gcig pa'i ches bdun nyin cang shi zhing chen sa khul du krung gung krung ha su'u lī es spyi mthun rgyal khab bzo zhing dmag 'thus mi'i tshogs chen thengs gnyis pa'i rtsa khrims don tshan gsum pa'i nang du mi rigs grangs nyung rang thag rang gcod byed chog pa'i dbang char ngos len thog su'u we es mnyam sprel spyi mthun rgyal khab btsugs te nyam thag grangs nyung mi rigs rnams la mi rigs rang thag rang gcod thog byed rgyu dang / yang na rang mos kyis mnyam sbrel bya rgyu'i thob thang yod/ mdor na rgya nag dang kha bral 'dod yod pa'i mi rigs rnams logs su rgyal khab 'dzugs chog pa'i ngos len byas yod/lhag par bod dang / sog po/ shing cang bcas khag gsum gyi gnas stangs de skor dmigs su gsal yod kyang 1949 lo rgya dmar gyis rgya nag yongs su dbang sgyur byas rjes snga tshig phyi 'gal gyis sa gnas mi rigs rang skyong zhes pa'i srid byus lag len bstar rgyu byas pa red/man ju mi rigs yin pa g.ya' tan krang gis sdus khri tan 'das pa'i mya nganached rtsom nang gsal/ de sngon krung gung gis mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul khag la krung ha mnyam sbrel rgyal khab 'dzugs rgyu de lag len bstar rgyu yin na'ang / blo mthun sdus khri han gyis ma le ring lugs dang ma'o tse tung gi dgongs pa gzhir bzung nas krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab khongs kyi grangs nyung mi rigs sa khul rnams sa gnas mi rigs rang skyong gi srid 'dzin lag len bstar na/ krung go rgyal khab kyi gnas babs don dngos dang mthun gyi red ces 'char gzhi bkod de rgyal srid spyi khyab khang brgyud ma'o kru'u zhi la phul te chog mchan gnang yod pa'i byas rjes bla na med pa zhig bzhag yod pa de ni 158

bsub thabs med pa red ces gsal/ de ni sdus we han gyis rgya nag chen po'i ring lugs kyi dbang bsgyur g.yo ngan khog bcangs kyis rgya nag khul gyi grangs nyung mi rigs rnams dang / lhag par du bod kyi 'os shing 'tshams pa'i thob thang btsan 'phrog gis kho pa tshos lo rgyus thog bzhag pa'i yig cha de nag bsub btang ba'i byas rjes yin par bsngags pa brjod pa zhig red/de nas dus yun gang tsam song rjes nyin zhig ma'o tse tung glo bur 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul du 'tshams 'dre lta bur bcar te dus yun chu tshod gcig lhag tsam phan tshun gleng mol mdzad/skabs der ma'o yis 7gong sa mchog la khyed rang tshor rgyal dar zhig yod pa ma red pas/ de bkal na 'grigs kyi red ces zhus 'dug 7gong sa mchog pe cing du bzhugs rgyun ring ma'o dang mjal 'phrad snga phyi bzhi tsam gnang zhing / thengs shig ma'o yis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi dmangs la phan pa'i mdzad pa bskyangs lugs sogs zhus 'dug pa de ni g.yo thabs kyi rnam pa mtshon pa zhig yin/rgya nag mi dmangs tshogs chen tshogs ring 7gong sa mchog tshogs dus mang che bar chibs sgyur bskyangs shing / gzhan yang bod gzhung gi sku tshab yongs 'dzin sku gzhon khri byang rdo rje 'chang dang / bka' blon nga phod/ sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma/ phunatshogs dbang rgyal/ rgya mi krang go ha/ phan ming / bkras bla'i khongs nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin dngul chu/ dza sag ce 'jigs med/ chab mdo mnga' khul nas spom mda' stobs rgyal/ de min gzhan zhig bcas bsdoms sku tshab bcu gnyis tsam rgya phyogs kyi btsan bskul 'og krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi rgyal yongs mi dmangs tshogs chen thengs dang po'i tshogs chen thog zhugs dgos byung /459

rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus mi'i tshogs chen grol rjes 7gong sa chen pos dbus chibs zhabs dang bcas rgya nag sa khul byang shar dang / nub byang / shar lho/ lho nub bcas kyi gnad yod grong khyer khag dang / nang chos dgon sde khag gna' shul grags can/ bzo grwa dang / gter kha sogs la gzigs bskor du gdan zhus ltar chibs sgyur gnang / rgya gzhung nas 7gong sa mchog gzigs bskor chibs sgyur gnang skabs mi rigs don byed las khungs kyi gtso 'dzin gzhon pa le'u ke'i pheng phebs rogs su bcar/khong ni hu'i rigs shig yin/ mi gshis 'jam po dang / shes yon yod pa zhig yin stabs 7gong sa mchog la phyag rogs zhabs zhu gang legs zhus 'dug de sngon gsar brje'i las 'gul du bzhugs ring byas rjes chen po bzhag yod lugs dang / go min tang gi btson khang nang du rgyun ring sdod myong mkhan zhig red/ khong gi lag pa g.yon ma'i mdzub mo go min tang gis nyes chad gtong skabs bcad pa red zer/7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams pe cing du bzhugs skabs mdo smad khul gyi ser skya mi mang nas gdan zhu'i snyan seng zhus don ltar/ pe cing nas nub byang sa khul lan kra'u grong khyer du zhabs sor 'khod skabs mdo smad bla brang bkris 'khyil ser skya mi dmangs kyi 'thus mi dang / de khul gyi dpon chen a pha a blo bcas mi sna du ma phebs bsur 'byor te de nas ka chu sa gnas su nyin dgung gsol tshig gnang skabs sne shan le'u ke'i pheng gis deng sang sa khul 'dir bsdad pa'i mi dmangs rnams hu'i rigs sha stag yin zhing / hu'i rigs 'di khul ma slebs gong bod rigs sdod pa'i sa gnas red 'dug snga rabs sa khul de bod dang rgya'i sa mtshams lta bu yin/ hu'i mi slebs rjes bod rigs rim bzhin sa khul de nas lho nub khul du gnas spo byas yod lugs zer srol 'dug ces 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus song /160

ka chu sa gnas de yangs shing rgya che ba'i zhing las kyi sa khul zhig red / rgya skad du ling shā zhes 'bod kyi 'dug rgya'i lo rgyus thog dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs hor jing ger si han gyis dbus e sha ya'i yul gru dbang sgyur byed skabs sa khul de nas khrid yong ba'i dmag mi dang / btson pa yin zhes zer/ de nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su gyur te rgya nag nub byang kun su'u dang / nying shā/ mtsho sngon bcas su 'phel rgyas byung yod pa red ces kyang zer/bla brang bkris 'khyil dgon chen de ni kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po ngag dbang brtson 'grus kyi rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa glang phyi lo 1709lo phyag btabs/ dgon chen de'i mdun nub nas shar du rgyugs pa'i bsang chu de mdo smad khul gyi chu chen zhig tu brtsi gi yod/'jam dbyangs bzhad pa sku phreng dang po de ni bod ljongs yongs su mtshan snyan grags chen po yod pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma zhig yin pa ma zad/ 'bras spyangs sgo mang gi mkhan po rgyun ring gnang 'dugabakris 'khyil sa khul de phal cher rgya mtsho'i ngos las mi ṭar 557 yas mas kyi mtho ba'i 'brog khul zhig yin/ dgon pa der dge 'dun zhal grangs 5000lhag tsam yod/ skabs re bdun stong tsam zin gyi yod zer/ de ni mdo smad khul gyi dge lugs pa'i dgon pa che shos gcig yin pa dang / de nas mtshan nyid slob gnyer gnang ba'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan mang po zhig thon yod/7gong sa chen po mchog bkris 'khyil du nyin zhag bdun tsam bzhugs ring de khul du 'dzoms pa'i bod mi ser skya mi dmangs 'bum gcig lhag tsam la chos 'brel rgya che gnang thog nyin gnyis ring snga dro chu tshod 10 nas dgong dro chu tshod 4 bar gcig

mjal kha mtshams ma chad par bkrin bskyangs te tshang ma'i 'dod blo khengs pa byung /skabs der rgya mi las byed chos mi 'bor mang po de lta bu 'dzoms pa da phan mthong ma myong zhes bshad yod/ rob rtsis ltar na mi 'bor 'bum gcig lhag tsam yod ces zer/chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo grub rjes de nas slar yang lan kra'u grong khyer du chibs sgyur mdzad/ de nas sku 'bum byams pa gling dgon chen gyi las sne dang / grwa dmangs thun mong nas sngon du gdan zhu'i snyan zhu phul don ltar/ der zhabs sor 'khod rjes de khul 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi dmangs khri khrag lhag tsam rnams la spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang chen dang / ma ṇi'i ljags lung sogs dang / mjal dmangs bcas kun gyi 'dod blo khengs pa'i bkrin bskyangs/ de nas sku 'bum shar lho'i nye 'gram 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i 'khrungs khang stag 'cher dang / de'i nye 'khor gyi rgyal ba tsong kha pas chos rje kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung nas dge bsnyen sdom pa bzhes gnang yul shar tsong ri khrod du gnas gzigs su phebs/ stag 'cher 'khrungs khang du zhag gcig bzhugs nas slar yang sku 'bum brgyud pe cing du phyir phebs mdzad/bod kyi lo gsar skabs der 'khel bas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar bod pa'i yul goms gshis lugs dang mthun pa'i gra sgrig gis ma'o tse tung gis gtsos pa'i rgya nag dpon rigs gnad yod rnams la bod kyi dkar spro dang gsol ston bshams/ mgron shog nang du mthun pa spyan bzhi'i ri mo par bskos te rgya dpon so sor mgron brda phul/lo gsar rten 'brel gyi kha zas kyi rigs sgrig bkod ngo so thon pa byung / de nyin 7gong sa mchog gi phyag g.yas pas gro 'bras kyi phud gtor gnang nas dkon mchog gsum la 'bul lugs skor ma'o tse tung la 'grel bshad gnang bar ma'o tse tung gis 162

yar thengs gsum gtor rjes mar sa la thengs gsum gtor te khong gis gnam dang sa gnyis bsdur na mi 'tsho gnas bya yul sa yin pas gal chen po red ces dran rgyu rgod po'i rnam 'gyur bstan song /7gong sa mchog pe cing du bzhugs skabs rgya nag gzhung gis rgya gar gyi srid blon paṇa〉ta niha ru gdan zhus ltar/ pe cing du phebs nyin gyi dgong dro dga' bsu'i sne len gyi sar 7gong sa mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyang gdan zhus ltar chibs sgyur skabs chibs zhabs su phran gcig pu bcar du bcug byung / rgya mi'i dpon rigs rnams kyi khrod du niha ru phebs 'byor skabs rgya me'i las byed gcig gis 7gong sa mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis la srid blon niha ru ngo sprod zhu skabs niha rus/7gong sa mchog gi phyag nas 'jus te 7gong sa mchog gi zhal ras la dus yun skar ma gcig tsam gzigs te bka' mol chig gcig kyang ma zhus/ yud tsam song rjes rgya mi las byed pa tshos srid blon niha ru rgya dpon gzhan tsho'i sar ngo sprod du gdan zhu byas/ de rjes 7gong sa mchog dang srid blon niha ru khyug tsam ring lhan bzhugs kyis rgya mi'i skad sgyur brgyud bka' mol tshig 'ga' shas byung /7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi dmangs/ zhes pa'i mdzad rnam shog grangs 133 las kra'u en le nas khong naha ru dang ngo spyod byas byung / yud tsam smra ba gang yang med par mig hur rer dgongs pa bzhes te bzhugs par kho bos khong la 'di ltar zhus pa ste/ 'dzam gling nang sku nyid srid don thog snyan grags can zhig yin pa lung khug bod kyi nang du'ang go thos byung zhing / sku nyid mjal 'dod chen po yod tshul brjod par khong gis 'dzum tsam gnang rjes khyed rang mjal ba de dga' po byung zhes pa las gzhan gang yang gsungs kyi mi 'dug ces gsal ba ltar/ de nyin rgya gar srid blon 463

niha ru dang 7gong sa mchog rnam gnyis mjal thengs dang po yin gshis/ niha rus 7gong sa mchog mjal 'phrad skabs khong gis de sngon bod la dka' ngal 'phrad skabs rogs ram bya ma nus pa'i thog bod de rgya mir rtsis sprod byas pa lta bu'i 'gyod bsam 'khor yod par mngon/ de rjes gsol ston dang sne len tshogs 'du bcas su thengs 'ga' shas ngo 'dzoms byung yang srid blon niha rus rgya mir 'jigs zon byas te 7gong sa mchog la bka' mol gang yang zhu nus mi 'dug pa las/ khong gis bka' mol zhu 'dod med pa ma yin kyang / bka' mol mang po zhus na bod don la phan las gnod che dang / rgya mi rdugs pa skye mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dgongs pa bzhes pa min nam snyam/7gong sa mchog pe cing du bzhugs rgyun ring nang chos la dad pa byed mkhan rnams dang / nang sog sa khul khag nas sog rigs don gnyer gyis 7gong sa tā la'i bla mar mjal 'phrad zhu bcar mang po rnams la chos 'brel dang / mjal kha 'dod blo ltar bkrin bskyangs/ rgya nag khul du mdzad sgo lam tsam grub rjes ma'o tse tung la thon mjal lta bur mjal 'phrad gnang skabs ma'o yis 7gong sa mchog la yid ches rnyed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan nas sba gsang med pa'i thog zhus don la/ de sngon man ju srid gzhung gi dus su bod dang / sog po gnyis kyi sa khul du dbang sgyur bde blag ngang byed ched bod sog mi rigs rnams la nang chos shugs che spel rgyur rgyab bskyor byas yod/ chos ni dug red/ de la skyon chen po gnyis yod pa ste/ gcig ni mi rigs 'phel rgyas mi 'gro ba dang / cig shos ni/ yul gyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas la bkag 'gog byed kyi yod pa red/ man ju srid gzhung gis bod sog sa khul gnyis kyi mi dmangs rnams la sems gnag lta bu byas te chos kyi dug de spel ba red ces zhus 'dug pa des rgya mis dus dang rnam pa kun tu chos dad rang mos dang chos la srung skyob byed kyi yod lugs kyi srid byus 164

khyab bsgrags yang nas yang du byed pa de'i rdzun rkub gsal brjen du brtol ba zhig yin//gong du rob tsam spros pa bzhin/ de sngon 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog nas ma'o tse tung mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i skabs shig la ma'o yis nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de mang tshogs la phan thogs yod lugs dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal sel thabs la sman pa'i bya ba mang po gnang ba red ces yid smon ngo bstod lta bu'i rdzun gtam gyis nyams tshod blangs yod pa des 7gong sa mchog gis skabs dang bsnun pa'i rdugs zon mtha' 'khyongs gnang ste gang mkhas kyi thog gsung lan yod pa dang / de mtshungs rgya nag sa khul la gzigs bskor gnang ring nyin zhig glog 'don bzo grwa chen po zhig tu gzigs bskor la phebs skabs bzo grwa'i 'go pas 7gong sa mchog dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis la glog shugs kyi nus pa'i 'byung khungs skor 'grel bshad zhus rjes 7gong sa mchog nas/ pho glog dang mo glog sbyar skabs sgra skad chen po sgrogs pa sogs glog shugs kyi 'gro stangs dang / shugs tshad kyi gnas lugs rob tsam dri ba gnang bar der yod rgya mi'i las byed rnams dang / bzo grwa'i 'go 'dzin dang las byed bcas ha las pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis bstod bsngags zhus/ skabs der chibs zhabs lhan bcar rgya mi las byed tshos phran la tu la'i bla mas tshan rig gi mkhyen yon de gang du slob sbyong gnang ba red dam zhes 'dri brtsad byas byung /7gong sa tu la'i bla mchog nas dus rgyun du nub phyogs kyi shes yon gsar pa dang / tshan rig gi shes bya rnams la thugs snang chen po gnang gi yod lugs lan 'debs byas pa yin/ 7gong sa mchog rgya nag yul gru khag tu gzigs bskor la phebs ring deng rabs can gyi 'phrul 'khor bzo grwa bcas la gzigs zhib thugs snang chen po gnang ba dang / bzo gra'i 'go khrid dang rigs gcig rkang 'dzin mkhas pa sogs kyis 465

'grel bshad zhus pa de rnams gsan bzhes dang de tshor re re bzhin dre ba gting zab gnang ba bcas kyi gnas tshul skor skabs bsnun pe cing gi 'brel yod gong rim rnams la snyan seng zhus yod tshul dang / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog rgya nag tu bzhugs rgyun ring dus rtag tu lhan bcar yod pa'i rgya mi'i gnad yod las byed tshos gung khran ring lugs de sger sems spangs te nyam thag rnams sdug bsngal las skyo ba mkhan zhig yin lugs dang / krung go gung khyan tang 'di 'dzam gling thog 'gran zu med pa'i stobs shugs yod pa dang / su'u lan spyi mthun rgyal khab de krung gor sger sems med pa'i rogs ram byed mkhan gyi gcen po lta bu'i rgyal khab chen po gcig yin/ ma'o kru'u zhi ni ma le ring lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs der lag len gyi rnam bshad yang dag gnang mkhan phul byung mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i rlabs chen gyi gtso 'dzin zhig yin pa/ ma'o kru'u zhi med na krung go gung khran tang med/ krung go gung khran tang med na krung go gsar pa de yang yong shes kyi ma red ces dang / slad lo ngo bcu phrag tsam gyi tshun chad krung go'i rgyal khab 'di'i mdun lam 'od zer ldan pa zhig chags rgyu ma zad/ 'dzam gling yongs su stan grags chen po chags rgyu dang / de bzhin bod ljongs kyi rnam pa yang 'od mdangs bkra ba zhig yong rgyur the tshom med lugs yang yang zhus pa'i dmigs yul ni gung khran ring lugs kyis bsam gzhi'i rgya rnyi'i nang du 7gong sa mchog gi thugs 'gugs thabs kyi brtson len byas pa yin na'ang / ma'o tse tung gi gung khyan ring lugs ni lha med smra ba'i 'du shes bzung ste chos thams cad dug yin zhes pa'i bsam tshul de 7gong sa mchog la zhus pa'i skabs der 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i rnam 'gyur snang med lta bur bzhugs kyang thugs la rdugs zon chen po zhig 'khrungs pa gdon mi za/sku 'khor rnams pe cing nas bod du chibs zhal sgyur te han kha'u grong khyer bar 466

ri lir du phebs/ de nas khrung ching bar 'bre chu'i yang tso cang thog gru gzings nang phebs/ khyen tur phebs 'byor skabs bod rgya'i sa mtshams dar mdo khul gyi ri rgyud la sa g.yos byung snye 'khor lam skyon shor gyis khren tur nyin shas bca' bzhugs gnang dgos byung /khams khul dgon khag phal mo che nas 7gong sa mchog gdan zhu'i snyan seng sngon nas zhus yod kyang phebs lam dngos gzhi 'khel yul 'khor lam yod sa khag la ma gtogs phan tshun gyi dgon khag gzhan rnams la phebs stabs ma 'grig par brten yongs 'dzin sku gzhon khri byang rdo rje 'chang rin po che dang / kurma pa rin po che/ sa skya phun pho'i gdung sras rin po che/ smin gling gcung rin po che bcas 7gong sa mchog gi skya tshab tu bsko bzhag gis sa gnas khag bgos kyis phebs rgyur bka' mngags gnang ba ltar/khren tu nas khong rnam pa bzhi sngon du phebs thon mdzad/ de rjes 'khor lam rob tsam nyams gso byung ba'i gnas tshul 'byor te sku 'khor rnams khyen tu nas dar rtse mdo dang /mi nyag mgar thar dgon bcas par rim bzhin phebs te mgar thar du nyin gsum ring bzhugs zhag mdzad nas de khul 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi dmangs rnams la chos 'brel dang mjal kha 'dod blo khengs pa bstsal/mi nyag mgar mthar dgon de rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa bya lo / phyi lo 1739 lo 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos phyag btab te lo ngo brgyad tsam ring der bzhugs 'dugatu la'i bla ma sku phreng 11 pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sa khyi lo 1838 lo mgar thar dgon gyi nye 'dabs su 'khrungs pa red /de nas 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams mgar thar nas lha sa'i phyogs su 167

chibs zhal bsgyur te phebs lam rta'u nya mcho dgon dang / tre hor brag mgo dgon/dkar mdzes dgon chen bcas su rim bzhin zhabs sor 'khod de gong bzhin nyin gsum re bzhugs nas ser skya mi dmangs rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos chos 'brel dang / mjal kha legs par bstsal/dkar mdzes dgon nas dar rgyas dgon chen du chibs sgyur gyi phebs lam 'khel ba'i dge stag sprul sku'i gzhis dgon be ri dgon pa'i ser skya mi dmangs nas gsol 'debs gdan zhus ltar/ chibs bsgyur gyis zhag gcig bzhugs te sprul sku'i yang srid kyi gtsug phud bzhes/ dge stag sprul sku gong ma de nyid ni de sngon 1935 lo rgya dmar gung khran dmar dmag gis rgya nag nas byang phyogs su bros skabs dkar mdzes sa khul du dpung 'jug byed skabs de khul bod pa'i srid gzhung btsugs te sprul sku de nyid dang khul de'i mi sna gzhan dag 'ga' shas la srid gzhung de'i spyi khyab gzhon par bskos/1950 lo rgya dmar gung khran dmag bod shar phyogs nas dbus ljongs su btsan 'dzul byed skabs rgya dmar nas de sngon khong dang 'brel ba yod pa'i rkyen gyis khong chab mdo brgyud lha sar ched brdzong gis bod gzhung nas rgya dmar la mgo sgur dgos lugs bka' mol zhu bar btang don ltar/ chab mdor phebs 'byor gyis mdo spyi bka' blon lha klu brgyud lha sar bcar 'thus chog pa'i dgongs skor bka' khrel zhu ring glo bur snyun gzhi phog ste 'das/ rgya mis lha klu dang / chab mdo khul bod gzhung rlung 'phrin gtong mkhan las byed dbyin ci pho ṭi gnyis kyis dug sprad lugs ma nyes kha g.yogs rdzun gtam bzos te 'dzam gling la khyab bsgrags ji snyed byas yod/rjes su phran gyis de skor dngos 'brel yin min bka' blon lha klu dang / nga phod rnam gnyis la bka' 'dre zhus par khong gnyis gcig mthun gyis dge stag sprul sku snyun 168

gzhi phog ste ga shegs pa las dug sprad yod pa ma red ces dang / lhag par nga phod kyis rgya mis bshad pa de dngos 'brel rtsa ba nas byung yod pa ma red/ 'on kyang rgya mis dge stag sprul skur dug sprad pa red ces mthar bkag nas shod kyi yog red ces gsungs byung /de mtshungs skabs de'i dge stag sprul sku'i zhabs phyi zhu mkhan mgon po zhes bla rgan des rin po che rnam kun nas skabs re khrag rlung lta bu'i snun gzhi bzhes kyi yod pa de chab mdor phebs nas snyun gzhi 'phar ldangs kyis dgongs pa rdzogs pa las su zhig gi sman bzhes yod pa ma red ces bshad pa go thos byung gshis/ rgya mis ma yin yin tshul gyi sdum gtam brjod pa de dus rtag tu 'dzin pa'i goms gshes su gyur pa'i srid byus shig red/ de nas 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams dar rgyas dgon chen du bzhugs zhag lnga tsam bzhugs nas de khul ser skya mi dmangs bcas la gong bzhin chos 'brel dang mjal kha bstsal/ sde ge'i yid lhungs bla mtsho sa khul du sde dge rgyal po'i blon po bya rgod stobs ldan gyi sdod yul dang / sde dge dgon chen bcas su rim bzhin zhabs sor 'khod de bzhugs zhag mdzad nas chos 'brel dang mjal kha bstsal/de nas chab mdor chibs sgyur gyis nyin bdun tsam bzhugs te de khul ser skya mi dmangs khri phrag lhag tsam la chos 'brel rgya che mdzad/ de bzhin chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang zhes pas srid phyogs kyi mdzad sgor gdan zhus ltar phebs/ rgya bod dpon rigs dang las byed bcas la bka' slob bstsal/chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang zhes pa de ni de sngon 1950 lo rgya dmar gyi btsan 'dzul byas ma thag srid 'dzin gyi sgrig 'dzugs btsugs pa zhig red/sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang chab mdo mnga' khul gyi bla chen dang dpon rigs mi sna grags can 'ga' shas 'thus mi'i gras su bskos yod kyang rtsa ba'i dbang cha yongs rdzogs rgya 169

mi'i lag tu bzung / bod mi'i 'thus me rnams ni gsang thag 'then yul lta bu red 'dugaskabs der khams khul mi dmangs rnams kyis rgya dmar la ma dga' ba'i bsam tshul shugs rje cher 'gro bzhin pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig chags stabs 7gong sa mchog nas de khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams la gsung chos bstsal ba dang bsnun nas de rnams la rgya mi dang mdza' mthun byed dgos pa dang rgya mi'i legs cha rnams dang len byed dgos pa'i thog zhi 'jam gyi ngang nas dka' ngal sel thabs byed dgos pa dang / de bzhin rgya mi gnad yod las byed khag la bod mi dang dngos 'brel gyi spun rla'i 'du shes 'dzin dgos pa'i thog do 'khur byams skyong gang che yong ba'i 'bod skul yang mdzad/ lhag par du 7gong sa mchog gis dar rtse mdo nas chab mdo bar bod mi ser sku 'go byed rnams kyis sger bcar zhu skabs de rnams la rgya mi dang thabs mkhas kyi mthun lam bya rgyu gal che ba las/ de min drag po'i thog nas nam yang kha gtad gcog mi nyan zhes bka' slob nan po gnang /7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi dmangs/ zhes pa'i mdzad rnam shog grangs 134 las/ khul de'i sa mtshams nye 'khor sa phyogs gang sar mi tshang ma sems sdug gi rnam 'gyur ston zhing / bod mi tsho rgya mir zhen log gi bsam blo skye shugs rje cher 'gro bzhin 'dug rgya mi'i phyogs nas gnas tshul ma rtogs pa dang 'jigs snang gi dbang gis snying rje med pa'i btsan gnon byed shugs nge cher 'gro bzhin par brten rgya mi tshor bya spyod byams yang gang che yong ba'i 'bod skul gang thub byas pa yin zhing / bod mi tshor yang mdza' mthun zhi 'jam gyi ngang nas dka' ngal sel ba dang rgya me'i legs cha tshang mas dang len byed dgos zhes tshogs 'dzoms sar slob ston 170

gsed bkrol byas/ de ltar zhi 'jam du 'gyur ba'i re ba byung yang lo dus de tsho'i nang rgya dmar dang bod mi'i dbar 'khon 'gras kyi bsam tshul je thor song ste nga'i re ba 'bras med du gyur pa red ces gsal/dus yun de tsam ma song bar rgya darmir gyi khams khul dang a mdo khul gyi mi dmangs rnams la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zhes pa bsnyad de drag po'i btsan gnon gdug /ba spyod ngan ya nga snying rje med pa lag bstar byas par brten bod mi rtsa mar nas bzod sgom bya thabs bral ba'i rang nyid shi gson gyi 'gag rtsar thug stabs ngo rgol gyi las 'gul ma spel mthu med byung /gong zhus bzhin chab mdo nas spo yul brgyud lha sar phyir phebs kyi phebs lam du dbyar dus char zhod che skabs 'khel bas 'khor lam la skyon chag yang yang yong gi yod pa ma zad/ 'khor lam du 'grul bzhud skabs ri rtse nas bab rdo dang sa nyil yong bas nyen kha chen po yod par brten sngon la rgya dmag 'ga' shas ri'i rbab rdo gzag gi yod med nyams zhib tu gtong gi 'dug7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams spo stod thang smad ces pa'i sar shing zam thog phebs skabs glo bur ri khul nas chu log chen po zhig rgyugs yong ste sngon du skyod pa'i lam rgyus nyams zhib byed mkhan mo ṭa de dang / 7gong sa mchog gi phebs tshur de shing zam pha khar phebs ma thag sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum bzhugs pa'i 'jib 'khor de'i mjug tsam du zam steng du btang nas zam pa'i dkyil du phebs mtshams chu log gi 'ur sgra dang tshag sgra chen po bsdoms te zam pa'i byang ngos gling gcig dum bur gyur nas chu nang du lhungs/ skabs der 'jib 'khor kha lo ba des dngangs 'tshab kyi ngang nas lam seng rgyab bshig brgyab te de'i nang bzhugs mkhan srung skyob byed thub tsam byung 47ga

rjes shing zam de chu log gis gtsang mar 'khyer/ stabs legs pa zhig la 7gong sa mchog bzhugs pa'i phebs tshur nang sku'i gcen po mkhan tshab blo bzang bsam gtan dang rgya mi sku srung gcig dang gsung sgyur gcig bcas yod pas zam pa lam seng skur bzo dka' bas 7gong sa mchog de nas me le sbrug lhag tsam gyi sar klu nang zhes pa'i sa khul gyi mgron khang zhig tu gdan zhus ltar phebs pa'i dgong dro de 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i nyer chas sogs chu'i tshur rol du lus pa ma zad/ gnam gshis grang ngar che bas sku ngal chen po byung 'dugagasol gzim mchod gsum dang yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ rgyal yum chen mo dang yab gzhis sku 'khor sogs ma thar bar de nub de'i nye 'khor rgya mi'i dmag sgar zhig tu bzhugs dgos byung / de'i dgong mo mtshan gang rgya mi'i dmag mi dang rgya mi'i lam bzo ba bcas kyis zam pa nyams gso byas te sang nyin nyi ma ma shar tsam la zam pa sngar bzhin bzo thub pa byung / de lta bu'i sgrig 'dzugs kyi nus pa ni ha las dgos pa zhig red/ de nas phran tsho 7gong sa mchog gi phebs rjes su bcar/ mchog gsum gyi thugs rje nyag cig la brten nas sku 'khor tshang mar nyes skyon gang yang ma byung bar thugs gra legs 'grigs thog lha ldan rgyal khab chen po'i nor gling pho brang du bkris bde legs kyi ngang nas zhabs sor 'khod skabs lha khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis blo bde dga' skyid brjod kyi mi lang ba'i ngang rgyan gos gzab 'chor dang bcas phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus so/ 472

le tshan nyer gsum pa/ming don mi mtshungs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon khang gsar 'dzugs byas pa/da chi / /7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog rgya nag pe cing nas bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar 7zhabs sor phyir 'khod rjes rgya mis bod kyi shar phyogs 'bri chu phar phyogs khams dang / a mdo sa khul la yongs su btsan gnon gyi dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur byed 'go btsugs te de khul gnas sdod bod mi rnams nas rgya mi'i ngan spyod der rgol lan slog 'go tshugs pa'i gnas tshul bod dbus phyogs su rim bzhin grags/7gong sa mchog dang bka' shag lhan rgyas bka' gros gnang mthar bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / kum pa rin po che rnam gnyis chab mdo khul du zhi 'jam yong thabs su bsko brdzong gnang ste don smin gang yang ma byung bar phyir log phebs/skabs der rgya mis bod du bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang zhes pa 'dzugs gtan 'khel ba ltar/ phyi lo 1955 zu 4 pa'i nang rgya nag nas srid blon gzhon pa dang / phyi srid blon chen gcig lcogs khyen yi bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang la rten 'brel zhu ched sku tshab tshogs pa'i sne khrid kyis bod kyi byang shar mtsho bod lam chen brgyud lha sar 'byor nyin 7gong sa mchog lha sa grong khyer gyi nub ngos nye 'dab skyed tshal klu lding du phebs bsur phebs dgos lugs rgya phyogs nas bsam tshulabaton pa ltar/ rgya bod mthun lam gyi ched du dgongs pa bzhes nas srid blon gzhon pa 173

khren yi lha sar 'byor nyen 7gong sa mchog gi dbus bod ljongs ser skya dpon rigs yongs rdzogs dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po las sne/ bod dmag bcas phebs bsur phebs/ klu lding nas 7gong sa chen po mchog dang / khren yi phebs ṭor gcig gi nang bzhugs te lha sa grong khyer du khyen yi'i sdod sar lhan phebs skabs phebs lam g.yas g.yon du bod mi rnams kyis 7gong sa phyogs kyi zhal mjal du bcar bar rgya phyogs nas srid blon gzhon pa lha sar 'byor skabs bod mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu dpag med zhus yod lugs kyi par dang / glog brnyan brgyab te 'dzam gling yongs la dril bsgrags chen po byas 'dug dngos don ni/ lha sa'i mi dmangs rnams kyis 7gong sa mchog gi zhal mjal du bcar ba kho na las/ rgya dpon khyen yi la dga' bsu zhu bar phyin pa ma yin/ khren yi mnyam du bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gsar 'dzugs kyi rten 'brel zhu mkhan sku tshab gras su rgya mi dpon rigs dang / mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul shar tur ki si than (shingacang )nang sog de min mtsho sngon dang /kun su'u/ zi khron/ yun nan sogs bod rigs rang skyong ljongs khul gyi mi sna dang /de min grangs nyung mi rigs gzhan dag khag bcas mi grangs brgya lhag tsam slebs 'dugatshogs 'du dngos gzhi tshugs nyin/ tshogs khang gi sdings cha'i dkyil du ma'o tse tung gi 'dra par chen po zhig dang / de'i g.yas su 7gong sa mchog gi sku par chen po/g.yon du paṇa chen rin po che'i sku par bkal 'dug tshogs 'du'i nang rgya mi zhi drag las byed dang / bod gzhung ser skya dpon rigs/ paṇa chen nang ma sgang gi 'thus mi/chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i 'thus mi/ rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag gi mi 'thus bcas khyon lnga brgya lhag tsam 'dugatshogs 'du de nyin lnga lhag tsam tshogs te bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon 474

lhan khang gi tshogs mi bsdoms mi grangs 51 'dems bsko byas te 7gong sa mchog lhan tshogs de'i kru'u rin dang / de'i 'og kru'u rin las rogs paṇa chen rin po che dang /rgya mi'i dmag dpon krang go ha yin/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med drung cher 'dems bsko byas/ tshogs mi'i gas su paṇa chen nang sgang dang / chab mdo bcings 'grol lhan khang gi tshogs mi/ de 'phros bod gzhung gi tshogs mi naX lhag tsam yod thog chos lugs khag gi bla ma dang / mi sna grags can 'dems bsko byas yod/de bzhin rgya phyogs kyi 'thus mi lnga yod/ grangs 'bor la bltas na bod gzhung mang ba yod kyang / don du dbang cha tshang ma bod sdod krung go gung khran tang las don u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i mi lnga yi lag tu bzung yod/ de bzhin paṇa chen nang sgang gi tshogs 'thus dang / chab mdo bcings 'grol u yon lhan khang gi tshogs 'thus gnyis rgya mis bkod byus gang byas kyi 'og tu 'gro gi yod/skabs 'dir gsal bshad bya rgyu'i gnad don zhig la bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan khang zer ba 'di bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khyab khongs sngon yod kyi ched du btsugs pa yin kyang / 'thus mi mi grangs 51 bsdu skabs/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas mi grangs naX dang paṇa chen nang sgang khongs mi 10 chab mdo bcings bkrol lhan khang khongs nas mi grangs 10 spyi tshogs kyi mi sna grangs / cu rgya mi 5 zhes bshad yod pas/ paṇa chen dang / chab mdo gnyis bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khyab khongs rtsod med gcig red/ de gnyis sde tshan tha dad du phye ba de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam / phran gyi bsam tshod byas na/ ma 'ongs par dgos pa dang go skabs shar che sa gnas srid gzhung de yang dum bu gsum du bgos te sil bur gtong rgyu'i bsam ngan khog rtsis rgyab ste de'i sa bon zhig btab par gdon mi za/175

rgya mis phyogs gcig nas mi rigs nang khul mthun sgril byed dgos zer bzhin du lag len ngo ma'i thog bya spyod de lta bu spel ba ni/ mi rigs chen po ring lugs kyi gnag sems gting ring bcangs pa zhig yin pas bod mi chos gnad don de rigs shes rtogs thub pa dgosanges snyam/bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang ma btsugs gong bka' shag nas rtsis khang du da lam tshogs 'du tshogs pa'i dus skabs dang bskun nas drung 'khor zhabs gsar ji yod rnams sngar lam ltar/ drung 'khor rtsal rgyugs de tshogs 'du tshogs ring dga' bsu rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo dang stabs bsnun bya dgos rgyu'i bka' khyab gnang don ltar/ rtsis khang nas drung 'khor zhabs gsar ba rnams la brda khyab gnang / zla shas kyi sngon nas rta rgyugs dang / me mda'/ mda' mdung 'phen stangs dang / rgyang mda' 'phen stangs bcas sbyong brdar byed dgos stabs/ lo der phran yang drung 'khor rtsal rgyugs 'bul mkhan gyi gas su tshud yod par brten rnam kun gtsang 'brong rtse gzhis su lo ltar bod kyi lo gsar skabs mi tshang so so nas rta pa 'du 'dzoms gyis nyin gsum ring rta rgyugs dang / me mda'/ mda'/ mdung bcas rgyag 'phen 'gran srol yod gshis 'grong rtse nas dge rgan zhig bos te rla ba gsum ring grogs po dga' nye 'ga' shas mnyam du nyin bstar sbyong brdar byas pa yin/mdzad sgo dngos gzhi'i nyin mo gna' rabs kyi go chas rnams spras te go rim ltar rta rgyugs bzhin par me mda' dang / mda' 'phangs 'phral lag g.yas pas mdung bton te 'ben la 'dzugs dgos pa bcas skabs der drung 'khor gzhon skyes kyi nang du phran gnas rim mtho shos yin stabs thengs dang por rta rgyugs nas me mda' dang /mda'/ mdung bcas gsum sgrags btang ste rgya mi'i srid blon gzhon pa khyen yis gtsos 76

pa'i dpon rigs rnams dang / lha sa'i mang tshogs 'du 'dzoms sar dmag rtsal gyi gzigs mo legs 'bul thub pa byung / dmag rtsal de rigs ni dus rabs bdun pa nas dar spel byung zhing / gna' rabs kyi dmag rtsal la mthong chen dang / de'i snying stobs mi nyams gong 'phel byung thabs kyi sngar srol rgyun 'dzin byas pa zhig yin par grarngo/theg/lhag par du dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dkyil la 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dus su bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang dbu brnyes rjes bod gzhung skya bo'i dpon rigs rnams kyi bu phrug gzhung zhabs su zhugs nas rang gi rgyal khab srung skyob dang / chab srid kyi sri zhu zhu bar zhi drag gnyis kyi shes yon ldan pa zhig yong thabs su yig rtsis gtam gsum dang mda' rdo mchongs gsum/ bang rkyal spe sogs nges par sbyong brdar bya dgos yod 'dug pa dang / de bas dmag sbyong gi nyams myong gsog ched lo 'khor bcu gnyis re mtshams su drung 'khor zhabs gsar rnams rtsal rgyugs zhes dmag rtsal rgyugs sprod kyi lugs srol dar/ skabs der rta rgyugs bzhin par me mda' dang / mda'/ mdung bcas gsum sbrags gtong thub mkhan la bya dga' stsal srol yod pa der dgos pa rgyu mtshan chen po yod kyang / bar lam nas bzung sngar gyi goms gshis bzang po de spyir btang gi 'khyab ston khral 'gel lta bur gyur pa las/ gzhung sger gnyis kus dus skabs kyi 'gyur ba dang bsnun pa'i legs bcos gang yang ma gnang ba'i thog do snang de tsam med par snga rabs kyi srol rgyun 'du shes ma brlag tsam du gnas/rta rgyugs kyi 'gran bsdur de bod ljongs gang sar bod kyi lo gsar sogs dus chen skabs dar khyab chen po yod/ skabs de'i tshogs chen la rten 'brel zhu ba'i mdzad rim du da dung bod kyi gna' rabs kyi zhabs bro nang ma dang / lha mo'i gzhung sogs kyang 177

'khrab ston gzab rgyas byas/ tshogs 'du grol rjes srid blon gzhon pa khren yis bod nas rgya nag tu phyir log skabs lha sa'i byang phyogs me le 18 lhag tsam gyi sar 'dam gzhung gnam gru thang gsar bzo grub ste rgya mi'i gnam gru thengs dang po 'byor ba de'i thog rgya nag tu phyir log byas/khren yis lha par sdod ring 7gong sa mchog nas khong la mdza' brtse'i mthun lam bla na med pa'i thog nas bod kyi gnas tshul ngo sprod zhib phra mdzad stabs khong gis bod kyi chab srid kyi gnas stangs dang / goms gshis/ rig gzhung / skad yig chos lugs / bod mi dmangs rnams kyi bsam gzhi bcas rob tsam shes rtogs byung ste pe cing du phyir log rjes ma'o tse tung gis gtsos pa'i dpon rigs rnams la bod kyi gnas stangs de mi rigs grangs nyung gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal zhig gnas yod par brten slad bod kyi chab srid kyi go gnas la bsam zhib legs par byed dgos zhes pa'i bsam tshul bton yod 'dug pa dang / de'i phyi lo 1957 che 7 par rgya nag ching ta'o grong khyer du srid blon kra'o en les gtso skyong byas pa'i rgya nag gi mi rigs srid byus skor bzhugs mol tshogs 'du ma tshogs gong khyen yis krung go gung khran tang dbus rgyun las lhan tshogs thog sngar bzhin bod ljongs la dmigs bsal gyi bsam gzhigs bya 'os pa'i bsam tshul yang bskur bton pa red ces rgya mi las byed gnad yod cig gi sa nas go thos byung /bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang nang gi las khungs khag tu bod gzhung gi shes 'jon ldan pa'i dpon rigs mang che ba 'then nas phogs thob kyang chen po sprod pa'i srid byus lag bstar gyis rim bzhin bod gzhung gi srid gzhung sgrig 'dzugs de rtsa med bzo rgyu'i lkog g.yo bcangs pa de rgya che'i mang tshogs rnams kyis shes rtogs byung 178

ste/ rgya mi'i srid byus der mi 'dod par sngar bzhin 'che med zhi ba'i lam nas rgya mir ngo rgol gyi las 'gul spel te/ bod de snga rabs nas rang gi bstan pa chab srid skyong stangs bzang po zhig yod bzhin du da cha rgya phyogs nas btsugs pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang zer ba 'di bod mi rnams kyi blo dang mi 'tsham pa yin gshis 'phral du phyir 'then byed dgos zhes pa'i tshog tho zhig rgya phyogs la sprad yod pa red/ de dang dus mtshungs lha sa grong khyer gang sa gang du sbyar yig mang po sbyar ba'i nang bod de bod mi'i yin/ rgya mi rgya nag tu phyir log bya dgos/ da lta gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang zhes pa de 'phral du phyir 'then bya dgos zhes gsal ba ltar/ rgya phyogs nas bod gzhung bka' shag la mi dmangs tshogs pa'i 'go pa rnams 'phral du 'dzin bzung gis do dam btson 'jug bya dgos lugs dang / gal srid bod gzhung nas 'dzin bzung ma byas na rgya mi rang gi 'dzin bzung bya gi yin zhes nan po brjod de/ bod gzhung nas dza drag gnas babs de zhi 'jam yong thabs su tshogs mi mi 'thus 'bum thang drung yig rgyal mtshan blo bzang dang / a lo chos mdzad che ring rdo rje/lhab phyug grags pa 'phrin las gsum 'dzin bzung lta bus bzang btson do dam ma gnang ka med byung / mi gsum po de'i nang nas lhab phyug grags pa 'phrin las btson khang du 'das grongs song / gzhan gnyis po de gdan sa gsum nas khong tshos slar yang ngo rgol mi byed pa'i 'gan len zhus te bzang btson nas glod bkrol btang / a lo chos mdzad btson khang nas thon ma thag 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du gsang byol thub/ khong lha sa nas ma thon gong nyin gcig gi sngon du phran gyi sar yong ste sang nyin 'brug yul brgyud rgya gar du gsang gros bya rgyu yin lugs brjod de phran nas rogs ram gang thub byas pa yin/skabs der bod byang shar mdo stod smad sa khul la rgya mis gdug rtsub can gyi 179

drag gnon bcos sgyur gyi 'go tshugs te gnas tshul je sdug je zhan du gyur lugs lha sa'i khul du yang yang khyab cing / rgya mis 'bri chu'i shar rgyud kyi bod mi'i sa khul la dmangs gtso bcos sgyur lag len bstar bzhin pa de 'bri chu nub brgyud dang / bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi mnga' khul la gnas skabs lag len bya min skor chab mdor gnas sdod rgya mis nyin zhig de khul ser skya mi dmangs kyi 'go pa dang / bod pa'i las byed mang po tshogs chen bsdu 'gugs kyis gnas tshul gsal bshad dang sbrags bsam tshul 'dre zhib byas pa'i don snying / da lam bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gi tshogs chen thog tā la'i bla mas gnas skabs ring bod rang skyong ljong sa sa khul du dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur bya rgyu skabs su ma babs pas re zhig phyir 'gyangs bya dgos gsungs pa dang / paṇa chen bla mas dmangs gtso bcos sgyur gang myur lag bstar byas na legs tshul dgongs 'char gsungs yod pas de'i thad ji 'gab gros bsdur byed du bcug pa red/skabs de'i nang lha sa'i dmangs khrod kyi gzhas chig tu'ang / shing de gshag pa bzhag nas/ rus pa 'bud long mi 'dug tu la'i bla ma bzhag nas/ bcings 'grol zhu long mi 'dug ces dang / spang la ser sha bzhag nas/ ka sha dgos don mi 'dug tu la'i bla ma bzhag nas/ bcings 'grol dgos don mi 'dug ces pa ltar/ mang tshogs mang che bas dmangs gtso bcos sgyur phyi 'gyangs byas na legs tshul brjod de 'bri chu nub phyogs su gnas skabs dmangs gtso bcos sgyur phyi 'gyangs bya rgyu byas 'dug480

le tshan nyer bzhi pa/rgya gar gzhung gi gdan zhus ltar 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gnas gzigs su chibs sgyur mdzad pa/ra༅༅/ /phyi lo 1954 lo rgya gar gzhung dang byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs thun mong nas bdag cag gi ston pa shagrwa thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo 3500 phyi lo 1955 lor 'khel bar dran gso'i dus chen khyad par can gyi thog 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog gdan zhu byed par byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin 'bras ljongs rgyal sras don grub rnam rgyal mchog lha sar ched phebs skabs 7gong sa mchog lha sa nas rgya nag tu chibs rdog thon nas nyin gcig song yang lha sa'i nye 'gram tshal gung thang la bzhugs zhag gnang sar mjal bcar zhus te/ phyi lo 1955 lo'i dran gso'i tshogs chen der rgya gar du zhabs sor 'khod thub pa'i sngon tshud gdan zhu'i snyan seng zhus par dus chen khyad pa' can der nges par phebs thabs mdzad rgyu'i zhal bzhes bka' bzang thob/7gong sa mchog rgya nag nas bod du zhabs sor phyir 'khod rjes rgya gar gzhung dang / byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs nas 7gong sa mchog la sngon du gdan zhu'i snyan seng la bka' bzhes bzang thob ltar rgya gar gzhung gi rgya nag gzhung la gzhung 'brel thog nas bka' mol thengs 'ga' shas zhus 'dug kyang / rgya phyogs nas ka kor nar 'gyangs kho na'i thog tu la'i bla ma rang skyong ljongs gsar 'dzugs zin pas phyag las gal che'i 18

mdzad brel gyis thugs khom med nges la brten sku tshab gcig gtong rgyu yin lugs lan gsal sprad cing / lha sdod rgya mis 7gong sa mchog gi sku tshab du bla ma che ba zhig bsko brdzong gnang dgos pa'i bsam 'char zhus don bzhin yongs 'dzin sku gzhon khri byang rdo rje 'chang mchog la bsko stsal gnang yang rgya gar gzhung nas slar yang rgya nag gzhung la tā la'i bla ma sangs rgyas kyi dus dran mdzad sgor chibs sgyur gnang gal che lugs kyi bka' mol nan zhus la brten rgya nag gzhung gi tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / paṇa chen rin po che gnyis ka rgya gar du dus dran khyad par can gyi tshogs chen der chibs sgyur chog 'thus kyi khas len zhu dgos byung ste/ lha sdod rgya mis tu la'i bla ma dang / paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis rgya gar du chibs sgyur chog 'thus dbus gzhung nas lan gsal 'byor byung bas chibs sgyur gnang gtan 'khel rgyu zhes brjod cing / chibs zhabs khongs lha sdod rgya mi'i 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi bod skad legs shes gnad yod las byed gcig kyang so lta lta bur btang /de'i gong tsam la rgya phyogs nas 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du sangs rgyas kyi dus dran chogs chen la phebs rgyur bkag 'gog byas rkyen chibs sgyur mi thub pa'i gnas tshul byung stabs/ 7rgyal yum chen mo mchog dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma/ skya'i gcung po mnga' ris mchog sprul rin po che bcas rgya gar la gnas gzigs su phebs rgyur thugs gtan 'khel te 7gong sa mchog gis phran yang khong rnams dang lhan du phyag rogs su bcar 'thus kyi bka' phebs ltar lo de'i rla 10 pa'i nang lha sa nas gro mo bar 'jib 'khor thog nyin gsum las ma 'gor bar slebs shing / de nas rta thog tu sgang thog bar bskyod/ sgang thog nas mo ṭor thog bka' sbug tu 'byor nas nyin shas sku ngal gso skabs 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor gang 'tshams shig ring min lha sa nas rgya gar 182

du chibs sgyur gnang gtan 'khel lugs kyi lan gsal 'byor te a ri khul du bzhugs pa'i sku'i gcen po stag 'cher mchog sprul rin po che mchog dang / rgya gar du gtan bzhugs skya'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog rnam gnyis dang lhan du bka' sbug nas sgang thog bod 'bras sa mtshams rna thod la rtser phebs bsur bcar/ de bzhin bka' sbyag khul gtan bzhugs rtsis dpon zhu skab pa dang / tshong spyi rnying pa mkhan chung blo bzang rgyal mtshan bcas kyang phebs bsur bcar 'dugarna thod la rtser rgya gar srid 'dzin dang srid blon lhan gnyis kyi sku tshab 'bras ljongs bca' bzhugs rgya gar gyi chab srid don gcod spyi khyab a pa panaḍi dang / srung skyob mi sna dang las byed bcas phebs bsur bcar te mjal dar dang me tog gi phreng ba phul/de bzhin byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs kyi dbu 'dzin 'bras ljongs rgyal sras don grub rnam rgyal mchog gi chos tshogs kyi sku tshab zhus nas phebs bsu'i mjal dar phul/7gong sa mchog lha sa nas gzhis rtse brgyud chibs sgyur gnang ste bkras lhun dgon nas paṇa chen rin po che dang lhan du phebs 'dug 7gong sa mchog gi chibs zhabs su yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bka' blon zur khang / bka' blon mdo mkhar ba/ bka' blon nga phod sogs ser skya gang 'tshams lhan bcar zhus shing / paṇa chen rin po che lhan du yang sku 'khor gang mang bcar 'dug7gong sa mchog sgang thog tu ma phebs gong nyin gcig sngon gyi zhag sar rgya gar du bca' sdod rgya mi'i gzhung tshab ngo ma phebs bsur bcar/ de'i sang nyin 'bras ljongs kyi rgyal sa sgang thog tu chibs sgyur ma gnang gong me le gcig dang phyed tsam gyi sar 'bras ljongs rgyal po bkris rnam rgyal mchog phebs bsur bcar te 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du phebs tshur thog gdan zhus kyis 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i pho brang gtsug lag khang du phebs 183

dus lam gzhung g.yas g.yon du 'bras ljongs ser sku mi dmangs rnams dang / sa gnas der gtan sdod bod mi dang / gnas bskor ba bcas mi grangs khri phrag lhag tsam gyis phebs bsu zhal mjal du bcar 'dug pa de rnams kyis lag tu mjal dar dang /me tog bdug spos bcas khyer te bdug spros kyi dre bsung phebs lam khyon yongs su 'thul bzhin 'dug7gong sa mchog dang / 'bras ljongs rgyal po lhan du bzhugs pa'i phebs ṭor gyi g.yas g.yon du 'bras ljongs dang / bod kyi rgyal dar chung ngu re btsugs te pho brang la phebs nye'i sar dga' bsu zhu mi mang tshogs 'tshang kha che sar phebs byor shar gtong ma thub bar yud tsam bkag ma thag mi tshogs chen po'i khrod nas rgya mi las byed pa gcig gis glo bur du 'tshang kha gshags nas phebs ṭor gyi zur gcig tu btsugs pa'i bod kyi rgyal dar de phab ste de'i tshab tu rgya mi'i rgyal dar zhig btsugs song bar der yod rgya gar gyi las byed dang / bod mi do snang can bcas rgya mi'i bya spyod de blo la ma babs pa chen po byung / mi de ni rgya mi'i gzhung tshab pas mnyam du khrid pa'i las byed cig yin 'dug zer/de sngon bod 'bras gnyis kyi snga rabs gus srol ltar bod gzhung gi dpon rigs dza tha'i yan 'bras ljongs khul du phebs skabs 'bras ljongs rgyal pos sgang thog nas me le gcig dang phyed tsam sar bsu mar phebs dgos pa'i lam srol yod lugs lcang lo can gung zur bsod nams rgyal pos phran la gsungs gsal/ de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng 13 pa chen po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs bod gzhung gis rgya gar nas go lag 'or 'dren du khong rang gtong gnang gi lam 'khel sgang thog tu ma 'byor tsam car me le (me le bzhi / zhes pa'i sa gnas su 'bras ljongs rgyal po skya ngo ma bsu mar phebs lugasadang / 'bras ljongs rgyal po rim byung la bod gzhung gi gnas rim ba zhi pa'i go gnas 184

bstsal srol yod pa der gzhung srol yig lam du 'bras ljongs sa spyod pa zhes 'bod 'dug dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mjug tsam la dbyin jis 'bras ljongs khul yongs rdzogs dbang sgyur byas rdzis bod 'bras gnyis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mchod yon gyi 'brel ba rim bzhin nyams chag gyur lugs bcas gsungs myong ba de lhang nger dran byung /7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams sgang thog nas phebs ṭor thog chibs thon gyis shi li gu ri nas gnam thog ldi lir zhabs sor 'khod skabs ldi li gnam thang du rgya gar gzhung gi srid 'dzin gzhon pa radha )shin mchog dang / srid blon niha ru mchog rnam gnyis kyis gtsos rgya gar gzhung gi gnad yod mtho rim dpon rigs khag dang / rgya gar du bca' bzhugs phyi rgyal gzhung tshab khag skabs der nang pa'i rgyal khab khag dang phyi rgyal gzhan khag gi nang chos mi sna bcas nas chos tshogs su phebs 'byor yod pa'i chos rje dang / mkhas grags can gyi mi sna bcas kyis 7gong sa mchog la chos phyogs kyi gus srol dang bskun pa'i dga' bsu gzab rgyas zhus/ldi li gnam thang nas 7gong sa mchog dang rgya gar srid 'dzin gzhon pa gnyis phebs tshur lhan bzhugs kyis srid 'dzin pho brang du phebs te srid 'dzin ra 'jen dra par gta dang / mjal 'phrad gnang nas bzhugs yul ha'i rdar bta rgyal po'i pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ pho brang der deng sang ha rdar bta ha'u si zer/ der bzhugs khang ha cang rgya che zhing / gzim chung kha grangs mang ba/ gzim chung rnams kyi 'dzin chas rgyas spros che ba bcas yod pa de ni rgyal sa ldi li'i snyan grags yod pa'i khang chen zhig yin zhing / der rgya gar gzhung gis phyi rgyal sku mgron gtso chen gyi rigs la sne len zhu yul zhig red/185

7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs gnas de sgo ra khe gtsang zhig tu go sgrig zhus 'dug cing / de'i g.yon ngos sgo ra chung ngu zhig gi nang rgyal yum chen mo mchog gis dbus yab gzhis sku 'khor rnams kyi bzhugs yul/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bka' shag rnam pa gsum gyi bzhugs yul yang sgo ra khe gtsang zhig tu gra sgrig zhus 'dugabazhugs gnas 'brel mtshungs yin gshis phan tshun 'brel ba gnang bde byung / chibs zhabs gzhan rnams mgron khang gzhan dag tu gra sgrig zhus 'dug pa dang / kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku 'khor rnams kyang khang chen gzhan zhig tu go sgrig zhus 'dug de'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog nas rgya gar gyi mes po sems dpa' chen po ma ha ta ma lhan rdo'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul zhus pa'i dran brten pur khang du chibs bsgyur gyis me tog gi phreng ba 'bul sgron thog thugs smon legs par mdzad/ de nas srid 'dzin bgres gzhon rnam gnyis dang / srid blon bcas kyi bzhugs shag so sor 'tshams zhu mjal 'phrad du phebs/ de bzhin khong rnam pa gsum nas kyang 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs gnas su mjal 'phrad 'tshams lan du phebs/skabs der khyad par can gyi dus dran tshogs 'du der 7gong sa mchog nyin ltar chibs bsgyur bskyangs te chos tshogs su phebs mkhan rgyal khab khag gi chos rje dang /mkhas grags can mang pos 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad tshul la rang bzhin gyi yid smon gus bkur zhus shing / skabs der lha sa nas rgya mis bzos pa'i 7gong sa mchog gi gsung bshad de tshogs 'du'i dngos yod dang ma mthun gshis/ chab srid kyi tshos mdog gang yang med pa'i thog nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang / rang cag bod kha ba can du sangs rgyas kyi chos ji ltar dar tshul skor dang / lhag par nga cho bod du yod pa'i bka' 'gyur mdo zhig gi nang gsal/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi lung bstan du/ nga mya 186

ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya song ba na/ gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs yod/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shī sogs mkhas pa kha cig gis bod du bstan pa dar rgyu'i lung bstan du 'dod kyang bod du sangs kyi bstan pa snga sa nas dar zin par brten bshad tshul de mi 'thad cing / gdong dmar can gyi yul zhes pa nub phyogs yul khag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgyu'i lung bstan yin min skor mkhas dbang rnams kyis brtag dpyad gnang dgos zhes sogs kyi gsung bshad gnang bar tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan tshang mas do snang dga' gus dpag med dang /dad pa'i spya long g.yo ba'i ngang nas thal mo yun ring brdabs/nyin shas ring 7gong sa mchog nas phyi rgyal gyi chos rje dang / mkhas dbang grags can bcas lhan 'dzoms mjal 'phrad thog phan tshun gyi dgongs 'char spel res gnang ba dang sbrags 7gong sa mchog nas/ deng 'dzam gling thog rgyal khab che chung dbar gcig 'og gcig gnon ma yin par mdza' mthun zhi 'jam yong thabs skor dang / nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos de e sha ya'i yul gru gcig pu ma yin par nub phyogs pa'i yul du dar khyab yong ba'i thugs smon gnang gi yod pa'i skor gsung mol byung 'dug pa de rnams kyis dga' gus chen po zhus 'dugaskabs der bka' lhag khul gtan bzhugs sku gcen rgya lo don grub dang / bod gzhung tshong don rnying pa 'jam dbyangs dkyil mkhan chung blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan bcas kyis dbu khrid de snga lo 1954 lo bod rang btsan sor gnas las 'gul ched du btsugs pa'i bod kyi bde don tshogs pa zhes pa'i tshogs 'thus rnams ldi lir phebs nas byes phebs bka' shag tu bcar te rgyal blon mtshan 'khod gyi snyan zhu zhig phul ba'i nang / rgya dmar gyi zhi drag las byed yongs rdzogs 87

bod nas phyir 'then ma byas bar 7gong sa mchog gnas skabs ring rgya gar du gtan bzhugs yong ba dang / de min rgya dmar gyis btsan dbang byas nas bzhag pa'i gros mthun de legs bcos thog mdo stod smad kyi sa khul du rgya dmar gyi dmangs gtso bcos sgyur zer ba'i drag po'i gdub rtsub can gyi las 'gul lag bstar gyis dmar gsod btang dang gtong bzhin pa'i spyod ngan de mtshams 'jog yong ba'i ched du rgya gar sa thog la rgya mi dang bka' mol gnang dgos zhes 'khod 'dugade nas 7gong sa mchog dang / sku 'khor rnams rgya gar gzhung gi phebs sgrig ltar gnas mchog byin can khag la gnas gzigs dang / rgya gar yul gru khag gi 'dzugs skrun yar rgyas phyin pa rnams la gzigs bskor du gdan zhus ltar/ chibs sgyur gnang ste pan 'jab sa khul gyi lhag ra nang ghal zhes pa'i chu glog khang gsar bskrun sar gzigs bskor du phebs skabs sa gnas de gar sku gcen spyi khyab mkhan tshab blo bzang bsam gtan glo bur rgyu lhag gi snyun gzhi bzhes te sa gnas der sman bcos kyis gshags bcos byed dgos pa byung ste phran dang / bla phyag phreng ring gnyis dang / rgya gar gzhung gi las byed yin pa 'bras ljongs yar pa che rnam bcas nas khong la phyag rogs zhu dgos byung / gshag bcos byas nas sku khams dwangs skyes ma byung bar zu gcig min tsam sa gnas der sku ngal gsos/ 7gong sa mchog de nas gzigs bskor mu mthud gnang rjes rgya gar lho phyogs kyi gnas mchog dang / grong khyer grags can khag tu gzigs bskor grub rjes slar yang ldi lir chibs sgyur gnang /skabs der rgya dmar gzhung gi srid blon kra'u en len dang / srid blon gzhon pa dmag spyi ho lung gnyis rgya gar rgyal sa ldi lir 'byor te 7gong sa mchog dang mjal 'phrad skabs/ bar lam bod shar phyogs a mdo dang / khams khul gyi mi dmangs 88

rnams la dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i gnas lugs yong rkyen zhib phra gsung mol gnang ba'i thog drag po'i btsan gnon gyi bcos sgyur bya ba de mtshams 'jog gnang dgos tshul bcas kyi thugs re 'don gnang mdzad pa ltar kra'u en len yis/ bod shar phyogs su rgya mi'i las byed rnams kyi bya spyod la blo pham yod lugs dang / tā la'i bla ma'i dgongs tshul dang / thugs re gnang ba rnams kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung la lam seng snyan seng zhu gi yin zhes lan gsal zhus 'dug7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi dmangs kyi mdzad rnam shog grangs 157 las/ de'i nub mo khong kra'u en le dang mnyam du gleng mol yun ring byung bar shar phyogs sa khul gyi gnas tshul ji sdug tu 'gro tshul sa gnas de'i gnas tshul dang / mi dmangs kyi re 'dun dang mi bsnun par rgya mi'i las byed pas btsan dbang gi bcos sgyur byas lugs skor brjod par/ khong nas blo pham gyi rnam pas brjod don/ sa gnas de khul rgya mi 'go khrid tshos nor 'khrul byung tshul dang / kho bos gang bshad pa rnams ma'o tse tung la zhib gsol zhu 'thus zer ba tsam las yar rgyas su gtong thabs kyi khas len gang yang byas ma byung / zhes gsal/nyin gcig gi rjes su rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang du sku gcen stag 'cher rin poche dang / rgya lo don grub gnyis nas kra'u en le mjal 'phrad thog rgya mi las byed rnams kyis gdug rtsub can gyi bya spyod lag len bstar pa'i rkyen gyis bod sa gnas gang sa gang nas bod mi rnams kyis blo pham chen po'i ngang nas rang bzhin gyis ngo rgol ma byed mthu med byung ba'i skor/ lhag par rgya mi'i las byed tshos tu la'i bla ma'i srid dbang nyams nyes gtor brlag gtong ba'i gzhi rtsa de gzhung bla'i dbar 'phung dkrug byed pa'i rkyen gyis yin pa'i skor bcas la skyon brjod drag po gnang bar/ kra'u en le yis/ gcig byas na 189

sa gnas kyi rgya rigs las byed pas gnas tshul ma rtogs par dka' ngal 'ga' shas 'phrad srid kyi red/ rgya rigs tsho bod la rogs ram byed par yong ba red/ bod kyis rang mgo thon 'phral rgya mi'i las byed rim bzhin phyir 'then byas 'thus/ da lam bod nang byung ba'i gnas tshul rnams ma'o kru'u zhi la snyan seng zhus te sa gnas su rtog zhib byed kyi yin zhes brjod 'dug pa las khams dang a mdo khul bcas dmangs gtso bcos sgyur gyi las 'gul lam seng phyir 'then byed kyi yin lugs gang yang bshad mi 'dugaskabs der kra'u en les kyis khong rnam gnyis la khyed tsho rgya gar du bzhugs na 'grigs/ nga tsho sa lag len ji byed la gzigs dgos/ gal te nga tshos lag len ji bzhin ma bstar ba yin na/ khyed chos skyon brjod ji byed kyi rang dbang yod zer ba dang /yang khong gis/ nga'i go thos la tu la'i bla ma rgya gar du bzhugs rtsis yod tshod la khyod chos khong bod la phebs rgyur skul ma zhu dgos/ gal srid tu la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs gnang ma bcug pa yin na/ mi yul la khungs 'khyol gyi ma red/ ces bshad/nyin shas rjes 7gong sa mchog sa gnas gzhan zhig la gzigs bskor du phebs te ldi lir phyir phebs skabs/ ri li babs tshugs sar rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang gi las byed kyis phebs bsur bcar te 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i gzhung tshab khang du kra'u en len sar thad kur gdan zhus kyis kra'u en les 7gong sa mchog la deng sang bod nang gi gnas tshul ji sdug tu song 'dug pas/ tu la'i bla ma 'phral du bod la phyir phebs gnang na legs tshul dang / gal srid zing langs byung che drag gnon bya rgyu yin/ langs phyogs ma nor ba sngon tshud nas thag gcod gnang dgos zhes sngar bzhin 'jigs skul gyi chig rtsub zhus yod pa red/190

de'i sang nyin snga dro khong gi las rogs srid blon gzhon pa ho lung 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs gnas su mjal 'phrad du ched bcar gyis tu la'i bla ma 'phral du bod la phyir phebs dgos lugs kra'u en les bshad pa ltar bskyar ldab thog kho pas 7gong sa mchog la rgya'i gtam dpe/ seng ge gangs la gnas na seng ge dang / seng ge klung la babs na khyi yis brnyas bcos byed/ ces zhus pa de'i go don ni/ gal srid tu la'i bla ma rgya gar du bzhugs pa yin na tu la'i bla ma'i gzi byin gyi nus pa de brlag gi red zer ba yin/ rgya mis/ 'phags bod dbar lo ngo stong phrag lhag ring gnas pa'i 'brel lam der gdengs 'jog ha cang dma' po byas pa de ni rtsis nor thebs pa zhig red/bka' rdor khul gtan sdod bod mi rnams dang / yul mi bcas nas skabs der 7gong sa chen po mchog bod du phyir phebs ma gnang gong de khul khyug tsam zhabs sor 'khod thabs kyi snyan zhu sngon phul ltar zhal bzhes gnang yang / rgya mis bka' sbug khul la bod mi log spyod pa gang 'tshams yod par brten tu la'i bla ma de khul phebs na de rnams kyis khyog zing slong rgyu dang / sku phya'i thog 'gan blos bzod min gyi bsam tshul yang bton/ 'on kyang de khul bod mi gang 'tshams gnas yod stabs gal srid zhabs sor 'khod ma thub pa byung na bod mi dang / 'brug pa/ shar pa/ 'bras ljongs/ ta mang /lab chi sogs bod rigs kyi rgyud pa sha stag yin pa ma zad/ de tsho tshang ma sangs rgyas kyi chos la dad pa byed mkhan dang / lhag par 7gong sa mchog la dad gus chen po zhu gi yod par brten mi de tshos blo pham chen po byed kyi red dgongs te/ de khul khyug tsam chibs sgyur gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel/ rgya gar sa gnas khag tu gnas mjal dang / gzigs bskor yongs su grub rjes rgya gar srid 'dzin bgres gzhon dang / srid blon niha rus gtsos pa'i mtho rim 9

dpon rigs khag la thon mjal gyi mjal 'phrad gnang ste/ ldi li nas ka la ka ta brgyud bka' lhag tu chibs sgyur bskyangs/srid blon niha rur mtha' ma'i mjal 'phrad zhu skabs 7gong sa mchog dang bar lam rgya mi'i srid blon kra'u en le dang bka' mol ji byung skor khong la gsungs te srid blon niha ru nas/ de sngon lo gnyis tsam gyi sngon du bod don skor kra'u en le dang gleng mol ji byung 7gong sa mchog la zhib gsal zhus shing / kra'u en les/ bod de dus yun ring po'i sngon nas rgya nag gi cha shas shig yin na'ang / rgya nag gi zhing chen lta bur ngos 'dzin byed kyi med / bod mi rigs 'di bzhin rgya mi rigs dang tha dad yin stabs mi rigs rang skyong 'dzugs rgyu dang / de rang dbang yod pa'i sa khul zhig la ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod ces dang / da dung kra'u en les/ rgya mis bod la dmar po'i ring lugs mtha' gcig tu spel rtsis kyi bsam tshul med/ rjes lus thebs pa'i yul lung la dmar po'i ring lugs spel mi thub/ mi de tsho'i 'dod par yang yong gi ma red/ 'on kyang rim bzhin bsgyur bcos byed 'dod yod ces bshad pa'i skor 7gong sa mchog la zhus pa red/skabs der rgya gar bas hin rdi ci ni lha ye lha ye zhes pa rgya dkar nag gnyis bu spyan yin pa'i g.yo sgyu'i gtam bshad 'dra chags shig byas pa des deng rabs 'dzam gling du chab srid mkhas can du grags pa'i rgya gar srid blon de yang spyang po spyang thal lta bur shor te/ rgya nag gi g.yo sgyu'i dra rnyi'i nang tshud nas lo ngo stong phrag ring chos ldan gyi bya ba kho nar spyod pa'i khyim mches rgyal khab nyam chung de ngo tsha khrel gzhung sogs shes ldan mi chos las 'das pa'i gdug rtsub lugs ngan 'dzin pa rgya dmar gyi lag tu rtsis sprod byas pa des/ rgya gar rang nyid la'ang dka' skyong chen po 'phrad dang 'phrad bzhin pa red/492

niha rus/ kra'u en le'i skad char tu la'i bla mas yid ches gnang dgos pa dang / bod nang gi rang dbang de 'dzin skyong thub pa/ spyi tshogs kyi bcos sgyur de gang 'tsham rgya mi dang mnyam du phyag len bstar dgos lugs sogs kyi slob ston phul 'dugaskabs der 7gong sa mchog bod du phyir phebs gnang dang ma gnang skor gleng mol mang dag byung ste mang che bas bka' lhag bde don tshogs pa'i bsam 'char la rgyab bskyor gyis gnas skabs ring rgya gar du bzhugs na legs gnas kyi dgongs tshul shugs che byung yang / mtha' mar 7gong sa mchog nas bod kha ba'i ljongs 'di bzhin gang gi gdul bya thun mong ma yin pa'i skyong yul du thugs bskyed dam bca' btsan pos 'brel skabs sku ngal 'dzims med thugs stobs chen po'i ngang nas phyir phebs gnang rgyur thugs gtan gtsang mar 'khel ba des dus skabs de'i dngos yod gnas stangs dang mthun pa'i phyag len bstar ba hang cang legs po byung yod par snyam/ gal te skabs der rgya gar du bzhugs yod pa yin na rgya gar gzhung la ngo tsha kha skyengs yong rgyu dang / lhag par 1959 lo glo bur bod nas chibs sgyur gnang ba ltar gyi 'dzam gling nang g.yo 'gul chen po thebs dka' ba dang / bod nang du yang 'phral mar rgya mis drag gnon gyi bcos sgyur lag bstar bya rgyur gdon mi za ba yin par snyam/7gong sa mchog ston 'khor rnams ldi li nas ka la ka ta brgyud bka' sbyag tu zhabs sor 'khod/ der nyin shas bzhugs ring de khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams dang /'brug pa sogs la chos 'brel zab mo dang / mjal kha sogs kyis 'dod blo yongs su tshoms par mdzad/skabs der bka' rdor khul bod rigs mi dmangs rnams nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog kyang de khul gdan zhu byas yod kyang / rgya mi'i kha dbang du song 193

nas phebs ma thub par shi li gu ri nas gnam thog bod du phyir phebs gnang / de bzhin khong dang lhan du bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyang rang gi bza' zur phru gu btsas kyi yod lugs la bsnyad btags nas paṇa chen rin po che dang lhan du phyir log gnang /7gong sa mchog bka' sbug khul du phebs skabs lha sa nas bod gzhung gi gdan zhu dang po bka' tshab g.yu thog bkris don grub dang / mkhan drung ngag dbang don grub rnam gnyis bka' sbug tu 'byor/ 7gong sa chen po ston 'khor bka' sgug nas 'bras ljongs rgyal sa sgang tog rgyal po'i pho brang gtsug lag khang du zhabs sor 'khod/ skabs der rna thod la rtse sogs la gangs chen babs te phebs lam bde bgrod med rkyen zu 1tsam ring de khul bzhugs dgos byung /1957 zla na ches 14 nyin sgang thog nas chibs zhal bsgyur te sna thod la rtse bar rgya gar gzhung gi phebs skyel a pa pan ta gtsos pa'i mi sna dang / 'bras ljongs rgyal sras don grub rnam rgyal/ de bzhin bka' rdor khul gtan bzhugs gzhung zhabs ser skya khag gcig dang / 7rgyal ba'i sku gcen stag 'tshor rin po che dang / rgya lo don grub/ mkhan tshab blo bzang bsam gtan bcas phebs rjes su bcar/ skya gcen mkhan tshab mchog skabs der sku khams bde min gyis re zhig rgya gar khul du sman bcos su bzhugs rgyur dgongs 'khrol gnang ste rjes su rgyal yum chen mo dang lhan du phyir phebs gnang rgyur brten phran 7gong sa mchog gi chibs zhabs su bcar/sna thod la rtser phebs skyel zhu mi rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab sku zhabs a pa pan ta der yod phebs skyel dang / phebs bsur 'byor ba'i mi mang tshogs sar khong gis/ de ring tu la'i bla ma mchog bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi dran gso'i dus chen 94

du chibs sgyur gnang bar nga tsho rgya gar mi dmangs dang gzhung bcas ha cang skal pa bzang po thob byung / tu la'i bla ma ni bod gcig pu'i bla ma min par nga tsho rgya gar mi dmangs rnams kyi bla ma yang yin/ khong ga dus rgya gar la phebs 'dod yod na yang nga tsho'i gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis khong la dga' bsu snying dbus nas zhu gi yod ces phebs skyel zhu ba'i gsung bshad gnang ba dang sbrags mjal dar dang me tog bcas gus zhabs chen po'i sgo nas 7gong sa mchog gi phyag tu phul zhing / phebs bskyel zhu mi rnams dang zhal gyes skabs mgron sbyin tshang ma 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i gdung ba zad mi shes pa byung /sna thod la kha'i shar ngos bod gzhung gi phebs bsu dang / rgya mi'i dmag dpon cin hra'u hran zhes pa bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon gzhon pa'i go gnas yod pa des zhi drag dpon dmag brgya lhag tsam la sne khrid kyis phebs bsur 'byor 'dug de nas la gsham gro mo bye ma bar chibs thog dang / de nas phebs tshur thog rgyal rtser phebs skabs bka' tshab bla ma sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / drung rtsis/ gdan 'thus/ gtsang spyi sogs phebs bsur bcar 'dug7gong sa mchog rgyal rtser phebs skabs de khul gnas sdod rgya me'i zhi drag dpon rigs dang / bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs phebs bsur bcar 'dug pa de'i sar 7gong sa mchog nas de rnams la gsung bshad snying bsdus shig gnang don du/ nye lam ldi lir bod shar phyogs sa khul khag gi rnyog zing skor srid blon kra'u en le dang bka' mol byung ba'i snying bsdus dang slad rgya bod las byed dang mi dmangs rnams la rgyun du brjod don ltar rgya mi rnams nga tshor dbang sgyur byed mkhan min pa dang / bod mi rnams rgya'i me ser yang min/ nga tshor nang gi rang dbang yod pas rang skyong ljongs zhes pa btsugs yod stabs de dag lag len 'khel thabs la tshang mas hur thag byed dgos/195

rgya mi las byed rnams kyis bod du rogs ram byed par yong ba yin pas gal srid kho tshos bod mi la phan thogs ma byas na rgya nag tu phyir 'then bya rgyu dbus gzhung gis khas len byas yod ces gsung bshad gnang /7gong sa mchog rgyal rtser dpal 'khor chos sder nyin shas bzhugs zhag mdzad de bod kyi me bya lo'i dgung gsar mdzad sgo yang sngar lam ltar gnang ba dang sgrags ser skya mi dmangs khri phrag lhag tsam la gsung chos dang mjal kha bstsal/de nas gzhis rtser chibs zhal sgyur te de nyin gtsang khul rdzong gzhis khag gi lha sde mi sde rnams nas dwang dod dang ldan pa'i ser sgreng dang / bro gzhas sogs mtshar du dngar ba'i phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus te gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/gzhis ka bsam grub rtse pho brang de bzhin/ rab byung dgu pa'i shing glang phyi lo 1555 lo rin spungs pa'i blon po sde pa zhing shag pa tsho brtan rdo rjes rin spungs par gyen log byas te gzhis ka bsam grub rtse bdag bzung gis chab srid kyi lte gnas byas te mi thog gsum ring dbus gtsang yongs rdzogs dbang sgyur byas shing / de nas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta phyi lo 1543 lo gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi sog dmag dang ram 'degs bod dmag dang bcas nas gtsang pa cham la phab ste 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i phyag tu bod ljongs yongs rdzogs phul ba ltar bdag gir bzhes thog bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i gzhung gsar du btsugs pa'i mdzad sgo rten 'brel mdzad yul yang gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i pho brang khyad par can 'dir yin pas skabs 'dir gtsang khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams nas gsol ba btab pa ltar 7gong sa mchog nas 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod/ der nyin shas bzhugs ring de khul 196

ser skya mi dmangs khri phrag 'ga' shas la chos 'brel dang mjal kha sogs kun gyi 'dod blo khengs par mdzad/gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i chags yul ni gzhis ka rtse grong khyer gyi byang ngos rgyab ri'i ri sna zhig gi steng du chags yod cing / de'i nub 'gram la bkris lhun po'i dgon pa yod/ rdzong gi mdun du chags pa'i gzhis rtse grong khyer der gser dang zangs lcags kyis mtshon lag rtsal bzo rigs sna tshogs kyi thon bskyed byed pa'i bod dbus gtsang yongs kyi grong khyer ang gnyis par grags/ de'i lho nas byang bar nyang chu rgyugs pa dang / rgyab ngos nub nas shar bar rta mchog gtsang po rgyug nas grong khyer gyi byang shar mtshams chu gnyis 'dres te dbus phyogs su rgyugs 'gro ba red/ chu chen de gnyis kyi g.yas g.yon lung gzhung gi gnam gshis tsha grang snyom la sa bcud legs po yod par brten gtsang khul gyi zhing las sa khul gtso bor grags/kho bo phyi lo 1979 lor bod ljongs su lta bskor du bskyod skabs sngar gyi gzi brjed dang ldan pa'i gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong de rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs khang chen de'i sked pa'i mtshams nas gris gtub pa ltar gtor bshig btang ste gyang ro zing nger bsdad 'dug pa de ni bod kyi gna' rabs thun mong ma yin pa'i bzo bkod ldan zhing / rgyal rabs lo rgyus can gyi rdzong khang de rgya mis 'char gzhi dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gtor bshig btang ba'i dpang rtags kyi gras shig yin/ bkras lhun bla brang gi gdan zhus ltar/ 7gong sa mchog nyin gsum ring bkras lhun dgon du chibs sgyur mdzad de paṇa chen rin po che mjal 'phrad dang / gnas gzigs sbrags bkras lhun 'dus tshogs rnams la bsnyen bkur gsung chos dang mjal 497

kha bstsal te slar yang gzhis rtse rdzong gi pho brang du phyir phebs kyis de'i nye 'khor zha lu dgon pa dang / ngor dgon/ snar thang sogs la gnas gzigs bskyangs skabs der rgya mis g.yo 'phrul dkrug shing byas pa'i shugs rkyen gyis 7gong sa chen po bkras lhun dgon du gdan zhu byas pa tsam las kun gzigs rin po che nas 7gong sa mchog chos srid kyi bdag por sngar srol ltar gus lugs kyi go babs ji bzhin ma gnang stabs bod mi ser skya yongs la blo pham chen po byung /7gong sa mchog ston 'khor rnams gzhis rtse khul bzhugs skabs chibs zhabs su bcar mkhan bod mi rnams kyis dga' mos chen po yod pa'i bka' blon dmag spyi mdo mkhar ba phun tshogs rab rgyas glo bur du sku che ma zin pas 7gong sa mchog thugs pham dang sbrags dam pa de nyid dal rten rim brgyud kyi bla med byang chub kyi go 'phang thob pa'i bsngo smon legs par mdzad cing / nged cag chibs zhabs rnams kyang dam pa de nyid glo bur sku gshegs pa der yid gdung chen po byung /bkras lhun dgon ni dbus gtsang dge dgon che khag bzhi'i ya gyal zhig yin/rab byung brgyad pa'i me yos phyi lo 1447 lor 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pas phyag btab cing / rab byung bcu pa'i lcags glang lo paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan bkris lhun po'i khrir phebs/ rang byung bcu pa'i shing byi lo phyi lo 1534lo gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis khong la paṇa'i ta chen po dang / sog skad du 'bog to ste/ bod skad du blo gros stobs ldan zhes pa'i mtshan gsol bar brten paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan de byung / de nas bzung paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon rnams bkras lhun gdan sa chen po'i khri 'dzin du gyur/ dgon pa der rnam kun dge 'dun stong phrag bzhi lnga tsam 'dus shing mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas che ba yod/498
