7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams bod zu 1 ches na1 nyin gzhis ka bsam grub rtse nas chibs thon gyis gtsang chu brgal te shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dang / bde chen rab rgyas dgon du nyin lam gnyis chibs thog phebs te de khul ser skya mi dmangs rnams la mjal kha chos 'brel gyis chims par mdzad nas slar yang phyir phebs kyis gtsang chu'i lho ngos gser mdog can dgon par gnas gzigs dang sgrigs ser skya mi dmangs rnams la gsung chos dang mjal mang gnang nas phebs ṭor thog 'od yug mda' stag gru kha ra lag g.yung drung gling dgon gsham du gtsang chu kha'i bzhugs sgar du zhabs sor 'khod de/ de khul nyin gcig bzhugs zhag mdzad thog khul de'i ser skya mi mang la gsung chorme dang mjal kha gnang rjes de nas stod lung chu mig lung gi bzhugs sgar du chibs bsgyur mdzad skabs gzhung gnas nas bka' tshab shan kha 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / gdan sa gsum gyi slob dpon las sne/ lha sdod rgya mi'i dpon rigs 'ga' shas bcas phebs bsur bcar/ de'i sang nyin lha sa'i nye 'gram skyed tshal klu sdings su zhabs sor 'khod skabs bod rgya gnyis kyi zhi drag dpon rigs yongs rdzogs phebs bsur bcar ba dang / de bzhin lha khul mi mang yongs nas zhal mjal dang sbrags phebs bsur bcar zhing / de nas sngar srol chibs sgyur lam bzhin phebs byam dang / chibs rag gis bskor nas dung rgya gling dang / rnga rol sogs 'bud brdungs dkrol gsum gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog shing / mtshar du dngar ba'i ser sgreng gis phebs bsu brjid nyams ldan pa'i sgo nas 7gong sa mchog nor gling pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/199

le tshan nyer lnga pa/bod sdod rgya mi'i mtho rim nang khul brnag sems lkog gnod kyi 'thab rtsod skor/phyi lo 1949 lo nas rgya dmar gyis rgya nag rgyal yongs la dbang sgyur byasarjes bod ljongs su bcing 'grol zhes pa lag bstar byed rgyu'i gzhi gtan 'khel ba ltar sa gnas phyogs bzhi nas dpung 'jug byas/ lho nub dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi bkod 'doms pa li'u we'i khren dang / ho lung / teng zha'o pheng bcas kyis thad ku'i 'go khrid byas pa'i dmag sde ang bco brgyad pa des gtso shugs dmag dpung byas te zi khron sa khul nas mdo stod smad phyogs brgyud bod ljongs su dpung 'jug byas pa dang / de bzhin yu nan khul du yod pa'i dmag sde ang 14 pa'i khongs kyi gzhung sgrig ru khag 'ga' shas sa tham brgyud bod sar dpung 'jug byas/ nub byang dmag khul khang nas kyang de dang dus mnyam du rta dmag khag gcig mdo smad nas rim bzhin mdo stod brgyud bod dbus phyogs su dpung 'jug byas/ de'i yan lag dpung sde khag gcig shar tur ki si than (shingacang /lho brgyud nas bod kyi nub brgyud mnga' ris sa khul du dpung 'jug byas/gong gsal dpung sde khag rnams dmag dpon krang go ha'i khongs su zu sgril nas de'i bkod 'a doms 'og bod ljongs mdo stod smad bar gsum brgyud sa khul yongs su rim bzhin btsan 'dzul byas pa'i rkyen gyis phyi lo 1951 lor pe cing du bod zhi ba'i 201

gros mthun don tshan 17 zhes pa btsan 'jog bya dgos byung / nyin de nas bzung rgya mi'i zhi drag dpon dmag rnams bod ljongs yongs su chu rgyun drag po rgyugs pa lta bur lhags/ dmag sde 18 pa'i 'go byed dmag dpon krang go ha dang / chab srid 'gan khur ba dmag dpon than kon san gnyis gtso bo yin zhing / mdo smad khul nas yong ba'i zhi drag dpung dmag gi 'go pa dmag dpon phan ming zhes pa de yin/ gong gsal zhi drag dpon rigs phud/ rgya nag dbus gzhung nas thad kur bsko brdzongs byas pa'i sku tshab krang cing u pe cing nas rgya gar brgyud lha sar sngon du 'byor/1953 che 1 ches 10 nyin gong gsal dpung sde khag gsum thun mong thog dbus gzhung gi bka' bkod ltar/ bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar krung go gung khran tang bod las don u yon lhan khang zhes pa de gsar 'dzugs byas te krang cing u la hru'u ci (drung che )gtso bo dang / krang go ha dang / phan ming gnyis la tru'u ci gzhon pa dang gnyis bsko bzhag byas 'dugaphyi lo 1952 zu 3 tshes na nyin rgya dmar gyis lho nub dmag khul khang gi 'go khrid 'og bod ljongs dmag khul khang zhes pa gsar du btsugs te krang go ha si ling yon dang (dmagaspyi / than kon san chab srid u yon dang po/ dmag dpon phan ming dmag spyi gzhon pa bcas bskos/ de nas bzung bod ljongs yongs kyi chab srid dang /'dzugs skrun/ dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung / dmag don sogs la the gtogs kyis dbang bsgyur 'go btsugs/ de dang chabs cig 'go khrid de rnams so so'i gsham 'og las byed mi sna rnams kyis las gnas rkub stegs 'phrog rtsod kyi 'go tshugs/bod phyogs la srid byus lag len bstar phyogs kyi 'du shes kyang mi 'dra ba 'dzin gyi yod pa dper na/ nub byang nas yong ba'i dmag dpon phan ming gis gtsos 202

pa'i mi khag gcig gis bod ljongs dbus gtsang sa khul de bzhin dum bu gnyis su khag bgos nas dbang sgyur byed rgyu'i srid byus lag len bstar na bod kyi bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs de sgyur bkod las sla po gtong thub pa ma zad/ tu la'i bla mas dbu khrid pa'i sa gnas srid gzhung de rang bzhin gyis nyams rgyad du gtong thub pa dang / paṇa chen gyi chab srid sko gnas de ṭī la'i bla ma dang 'dra mnyam gyi nus pa thon thub na/dbus gzhung gis bod ljongs de rang 'dod ltar kha lo sgyur bde yong gnas zhes pa'i bsam tshul bton 'dug bsam tshul der dgag pa rgyag mkhan gtso bo'i gas 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal yin zhing / skabs der khong krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi rgyun las u yon gyi gras shig yin/ 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi bsame tshul de la sku tshab krang cing us rgyab skyor byas pa'i thog dbus gzhung la dgongs skor snyan seng zhus te dbus gzhung nas phun chogs dbang rgyal gyi bsam 'char la mos mthun byas thog bod kyi mtho rim mi sna rnams la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyi srid byus lag len mthar phyin pa bstar te mes rgyal la sha blun yong thabs kyi las 'gul la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa las/ g.yon lhungs long mchong gi bsam blo lag len bstar mi rung zhes dbus gzhung gi bka' 'byor skad dang / skabs der dmag dpon krang go ha yis babs lta'i rnam 'gyur zhig bstan tshul bcas gzhan las go thos byung /dmag dpon krang cing us dbus gzhung gi bka' 'byor ba ltar/ dmag dpon phan ming gi bsam tshul la dgag pa brgyab nas dbus gzhung gi bka' de gsal bshad byed skabs bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun bzhag nas dus yun gang yang ma song bar da lta gros mthun gyi yig 'bru'i snag tsha yang ma skam gong nas lam seng gros mthun de brtsi med du btang na bod mi rnams nas dbus gzhung la ma dga' 203

ba'i bsam tshul shugs cher 'gro rgyu dang / da lta'i gnas babs 'di las sdug tu 'gro rgyu red/ lhag par du bod de rgyal spyi'i thog tshor ba rnon po'i shugs rkyen yod pa zhig yin pas/ rgyal spyi'i gleng phyogs ji sdug tu song na rang rgyal dang hin rdu'i dbar gyi mdza' 'brel la yang gnod pa yong gi red ces bshad 'dug par brten dmag dpon phan ming gi ngan byus de mngon du 'gyur ma thub/'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis 'go khrid pa'i bod shar phyogs dmangs gtso gzhon nu rang skyong mna' sbrel tshogs pa'i chogs mi mang po yod pa de rnams rgya dmar gyi zhi drag gong rim las byed dang / gzhi rim las khungs khag nang gi las byed dang skad sgyur bcas kyi las 'gan khur yod pa ma zad/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim dang / gdan sa chen po gsum gyi nang du shugs rkyen chen po thebs yod gshes/krang cing u can gyis phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi bsam tshul la brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa ni rgyu mtshan dang ldan pa zhig yin/ dmag dpon phan ming gi g.yo sgyu che ba'i re ngan de pham nyes byung ba nas bzung kho pas rang nyid kyi dbang cha bed sprod kyi phun tshogs dbang rgyal ni kho pa'i mig nang gi gra mag dang / sha nang gi skran lta bu yin pas de ma bkog na 'gregs thabs med pa'i bsam tshul 'khor te dus rtag tu phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi nor 'khrul btsal nas ma nyes kha g.yogs mi bden rdzun sgrig gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal ni tu la'i bla ma dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi gnad yod mi sna 'ga' shas dang ngan pa kha mthun yod lugs dang / sa gnas mi rigs ring lugs dang / kha bral ring lugs kyi ming sna tshogs btags te gsang ba'i thog nas dbus gzhung la snyan seng yang yang zhus rkyen pe cing gi mtho rim re zung nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal la rdugs pa chen po byung /204

1957 lo zu 8 ches 4 nyin rgya nag ching ta'o grong khyer du mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis gtso skyong byas pa'i mi rigs kyi bya ba'i bzhugs mol tshogs 'du'i thog mi rigs sa khul rang skyong lag len bstar phyogs skor gyi tshogs 'du grangs nyung mi rigs khag 39 yod pa khyon bsdoms 'thus mi 105 yod khongs bod rang skyong ljongs nas bod mi nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / phun tshogs dbang rgyal/paṇa chen nang ma sgang nas ces 'jigs med/ chab mdo mnga' khul nas sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus bcas bskyod pa red/tshogs 'du de'i thog srid blon kra'u en les de sngon gyi lo rgyus thog 'khod pa'i yig cha 'i nang du krung go gung khran tang gis ma 'ongs pa'i rgyal kha thob rjes mi rigs grangs nyung sa khul rnams la rang thag rang gcod dang / yang na rgya nag dang kha bral chog pa'i dbang cha sprod rgyu dang / rogs ram bya rgyu'i skor 'khod yod pa de da cha krung go'i dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhir bzung nas brtsi med sgyur bcos btang nas mi rigs sa khul rang skyong zhes pa 'dzugs rgyu gtan 'khel byas lugs 'grel bshad byas/ skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs mnga' khul gyi 'thus mi phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / mdo smad nas bkris dbang phyug mdo stod nas sangs rgyas ye shes sogs mnyam sbrel thog le nyin gyi 'byor med gral rim gyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i 'og mi rigs rang thag rang gcod kyi don snying ldan pa sogs kyi skor bsam tshul bton par/ kra'u en les dang / rlos lī han sogs kyi 'dod par ma babs pa'i thog bsam tshul shod mkhan mi re ngo rer slob gso dang / dgag pa rgyag rgyur shugs smon brgyab rkyen bkris dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas ye shes nas bsam tshul nor 'khrul byung bar ngos len byas/ skabs der phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis ma khe si dang / le nyin ring lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs nang 205

gsal ltar/ gung bran tang gis 'go khrid byas pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab nang gi mi rigs grangs nyung rnams 'dra mnyam gyi mang gzhi'i thog phan tshun 'brel ba gsar du btsugs nas mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril de rang mos kyi 'dra mnyam yong rgyur gnad 'gag yod pa'i nus shugs shig 'don thub na mi rigs 'dra mnyam gyi mthun sgril de ji srid bar gnas thub/ gal te mi rigs phan tshun dbar gyi 'brel ba de 'dra mnyam gyi thog nas ma byung na mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril zhes pa'i chig de don med du 'gyur ba ma zad/ mi rigs mthun sgril zhes pa de gzugs brnyan lta bu zhig tu 'gyur rgyu red ces bsam tshul bshad pa de pe cing gi dbang 'dzin pa tshor phog thug chen po byung bar brten shod sa bu dang / phog sa mna' ma'i dpe ltar/ sdus we han gyis kha rdung drag po btang zhing / tshogs 'du grol rjes phun tshogs dbang rgyal pe cing nas khyen tu brgyud bod du phyir log ched khren tu la 'byor ma thag khong pe cing du phyir log dgos rgyu'i dza drag gi tar 'phrin zhig 'byor bar brten slar yang pe cing du phyir log gis mi rigs don byed las khungs khongs gtogs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi spyi khyab kyi go ming stong pa zhig sprad de khong bod du ma btang bar pe cing du btsan nyar thog rang skyon ngos len byed dgos pa'i dgag pa shugs che brgyab kyang khong gis zhum pa med pa'i thog ma le ring lugs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi mi rigs srid byus skor dag 'bud kho na byas par brten pe cing gi dbang 'dzin pa tshos pe cing grong khyer 'gra ma du yod pa'i snyan grags can gyi ching khyeng btson khang zhes pa de mi rnams kyis thos pa tsam gyis skrag snang byed dgos pa'i btson khang ang dang po'i nang lo bco brgyad ring khong gcig pur btson 'jug byas/ khong la rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la rnyog rtsod bzo ba'i sa gnas mi rigs kha bral ring lugs dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim pa re zung dang lkog 'brel byas pa/206

dpung tshogs chung ngu 'dzugs skyong gi bya spyod spel ba sogs kyi nag nyes btsugs pa ma zad/ de rjes bzod bsran bya thabs med pa'i nyes chen bcu zhes pa bkal thog khong gi nang mi bza' tshang bu phrug dang / bu spun bcas kyang gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis do dam btson 'jug byas/ skabs der khong gi gcung po thub bstan dbang phyug btson du bcug sa btson khang gcig pa yin na yang glod dkrol rjes gnas tshul gzhi nas shes rtogs las/lo mang btson khang gcig tu bcug kyang khong gnyis phan tshun gyi gnas tshul shes rtogs gang yang ma byung / phun tshogs dbang rgyal btson khang du gcig pur bcug pas ma tshad lo nas lo bskud rang skyon ngos len byed dgos pa'i dre btsor byas par 'grel bshad ji byas la nyan shes gtan nas ma byas stabs/ khyed tshor skad ca bshad pas phan thogs mi 'dug pas da cha skad ca gang yang shod rgyu min zhes lo shas ring ngag bcad lta bur bsdad rkyen btson khang nas glod dkrol skabs spyir btang kyi skad cha yang shod ma thub pa'i skugs pa lta bur gyur zhing / de sngon gzugs stobs shin tu rgyas pa'i mi de nad gcong can zhig tu gyur/ 1957 lo phun tshogs dbang rgyal la nag nyes phog pa'i skabs der dmag dpon phan ming snying chim gyis dga' snang chen po byung ba gzhir bcas kyang / dus yun de tsam ma song bar 1958 lo rla 10 pa'i nang / ma'o tse tung gis rgyal srung spyi khyab pheng te ho la nyes pa bkal rjes de'i mnga' 'og mi sna rnams la skyon zhib las 'gul lag len bstar skabs krang cing u dang / krang go ha sogs la rnam kun phan ming gis nga rgyal khengs dregs byed pa der mi 'dod pa'i snying nad yod stabs go skabs de bzung nas krang gnyis kyis phan ming ni pheng te ho'i dang ngan 'brel yod lugs dang / kho pas las byed bu mo 'ga' shas la btsan g.yems byas pa dang / gzhung dngos sger bed spyod pa 207

sogs kyi skyon 'dzugs byas te phan ming bza' tshang gnyis ka 'dzin bzung do dam thog rang yul du btson srung dmag dang sgrags skyel sgrol do dam byas te lo ngo bco brgyad lhag tsam btson 'jug byas yod 'dug de bzhin bod du yod pa'i phan ming gi rjes 'brangs rnams kyang 'dzin bzung dang / slob gso btang ba dang / yang na las gnas 'phos nas zur du 'jog pa bcas byas/phyi lo 1978 lo phan ming btson khang nas glod dkrol btang rjes pe cing du dag sel yong thabs su bskyod skabs kho pas phun tshogs dbang rgyal sar yong nas de sngon ngas khyed rang la ma yin yin tshul gyi gnod 'che btang ba de la 'gyod sems chen po byung bas/ da res khyed rang la dgongs sel zhu gi yod ces bshad 'dugaphan ming la nyes pa phog rjes nub byang ru tshogs nas de'i tshab tu mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mi rigs don byed las khungs kyi kru'u rin hran bod du btang ste phan ming gi tshab tu bskos kyang dmag sgar bco brgyad pa'i 'go khrid krang go has gtsos pa'i zhi drag gnad yod rnams kyi 'dod blor ma babs pa'i rkyen gyis dus rtag tu phan tshun gyi bsam tshul mi mthun nang 'gal sha stag byung bar brten rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs krang go ha'i 'og gi dmag dpon wang chi mi yis gtsos pas kru'u rin hran la 'thab rtsod drag po byas pa'i 'og rang shi rgyag dgos byung / de bzhin kru'u rin hran gyi phyogs gtogs rnams kyis wang chi mis sa gnas rnying zhen shog khag gi 'go khrid byas te rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul la ngo rgol byed mkhan yin tshul nyes ming btags te wang chi mi yang gong bzhin 'thab rtsod 'og shi 'dugadamag dpon krang go hwa ni g.yo sgyu che la shes tshad mthon po yod khul gyis rgyun du gna' rabs kyi snyan tshog mang po shod mkhan zhig yin/ kho pa rang lo nyer lnga'i skabs 208

dmar dmag nang zhugs te srung dmag dang / bcu dpon / lding dpon / brgya dpon/ ru dpon bcas kyi las khur rim bzhin byas te phyi lo 1934 lo bar dmar dmag rgyang skyod nang zhugs pa'i gras shig red/1950 lo ma'o tse tung gis thad kur kho par bka' phab nas dmag sgar ang bco brgyad pa'i sne khrid kyis bod du dpung 'jug tu btang / lo de'i zla 10 nang dkar mdzes nas chab mdo bar dpung 'jug gis btsan 'dzul byas/ 1951 lo rla 5ches 33 nyin pe cing la bod rgya dbar rgya phyogs kyis btsan dbang 'og bzhag pa'i gros mthun la rgya'i sku tshab ming rtags bkod mkhan gyi gras yin/ phyi lo 1951 zla 10ches 33 nyin dmag sde bco brgyad pa'i sngon bskyod dmag bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar 'byor/1953 rla 3 ches 3 nyin rgya dmar gyis bod du lho nub dmag khul khang gi khongs gtogs bod dmag khul khang zhes pa de gsar 'dzugs byas te krang go hwa dmag khul khang de'i si ling yon (dmagaspyi dang ) krung go bod las don u yon lhan khang gi tru'u ci gzhon pa gcig lcogs kyi las 'gan sprad / de nas bzung krang go hwas zhi drag gnyis kyi dbang cha bzung stabs pe cing nas ched brdzongs byas pa'i dbus gzhung gi sku tshab dang / krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi tru'u ci gcig lcogs krang cing u las dbang shugs che skyed kyis krang gnyis dbar rim bzhin 'gal ba byung nas yang nas yang du phan tshun 'thab rtsod byas/1955 lo krang cing u bod nas lho nub sa khul gyi tru'u cir 'phos te krang go has bod kyi tang srid dmag gsum gyis dbang cha yongs rdzogs bzung / mi tshos kho par bod kyi rgyal po zhes ming 'dogs grags/phyi lo 1955 lo ma'o tse tung gis rig gnas gsar brje skul slong byed 209

skabs krang go hwa yis bod du yod pa'i ma'o tse tung gi bsam blo'i rjes 'brangs pa tshor rdung rdeg btang ba dang 'dzin bzung do dam byas/ 1957 lo zu 4 pa'i nang krang go ha yi rgyab rtsa ho lung la rig gnas gsar brje'i shugs rkyen phog rjes ma'o tse tung gis krang go hwa pe cing du bskongs nas sems gso bslu bred kyis lho nub sa khul gyi hru'u ci dang po dang / khren tu dmag khul khang gi chab srid spyi khyab tu bskos/ phyi lo 1958 7 5nang mi bzhi shog kha nas krang go hwa la kho pa'i lo rgyus zhib gcod ji len byed pa'i tshogs 'du snga rjes thengs 'ga' shas byas skabs khrag skyug nas shi 'dugakrang cing u ni gshis rgyud bzang po dang kha ri kha thug byed mkhan zhig yin na yang rna ba srab cing / dogs pa chen po byed mkhan dang / bzod bsran byed mi thub mkhan / shes yon de tsam med pa bcas yin/ 1930 lo krung go gung khra na tang nang 'dzul/ go min tang gi dmag nang gung khran tang gi gsang ba'i las 'gul spel myong yod/phyi lo 1934 lo ma'o tse tung dang mnyam du le dbar nyis khri lnga stong gi rgyang skyod dmag sde'i nang du gzhi rim sde tshan byi las 'gan 'khur myong zhing / 1949 lor gung khran tang gis rgya nag yongs su dbang sgyur rjes kho pa krung gung da bus dmag don u yon lhan khang gzhung don khang gi kru'u rin gyi las 'gan 'khur/ 1951 lo bod zhi ba'i gros mthun zer ba btsan 'jog skabs rgya phyogs kyi dbang cha cha tshang yod pa'i sku tshab gras shig yin/gros mthun la ming rtags bkod rjes rgya dmar gzhung gis kho par bod bskyed sku tshab kyi ming btags nas bod gzhung sku tshab dza sag khe smad ngo las dang mnyam du pe cing nas hong kong dang / rgya gar bcas brgyud bod du sngon la 'byor/ kho pa pe cing nas ma thon gong ma'o tse tung dang / kra'u en le gnyis kyis bod kyi las don bya phyogs skor zhib mngags byas 'dug lhag par ma'o tse tung gis pe cing grong khyer nang gi skad grags can gyi za khang 2 0

tsha'i yon zhes pa'i nang kho pa thug 'phrad kyis dga' skyel gsol ston bshams skabs ma'o tse tung gis kho par/ bod kyi las don byed phyogs de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i do snang chen po'i thog mtho rim mi sna rnams la 'thab phyogs gcig gyur gyis 'gugs thabs gzab nan bya rgyu dang / khyim tshang gcig ltar gyi mes rgyal sha zhen yong thabs/ lhag par tu la'i bla ma lha sar phyir phebs thub pa'i go bskon blo 'gugs thub pa dgos rgyu bcas nang mngags byas yod pa red/phyi lo 1959 lo bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod mi dmangs rnams kyis bod rang btsan sger langs ched btsan rgol gyi las 'gul byung rjes kho pa lho nub kyi tru'u cir gnas spos byas/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs dbus gzhung gi 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'i pu'u krang gzhon par gnas spos byas/ phyi lo 1957 lo mi bzhi shog khag gis kho pa da lta'i gsar brjer ngo rgol byed mkhan zhes pa'i nyes ming btags te 'dzin bzung btson 'jug dang / khrims gcod tsha 'dre sna tshogs byas 'og phyi lo 1971 lo lkog gsod btang nas kho pa'i ro yang gang du yod med sus kyang brtsad gcod ma thub pa red zer/dmag dpon than kon san ni lung khug gi mi dkyus ma zhig yin zhing / rigs gnas kyi shes tshad kyang mtho po med mod/ yin na'ang gung khran tang gi spyir btang gi g.yo byus dang / 'thab rtsod byed stangs la byang chub pa zhig red la/ rnam kun kho pa dmag dmangs mnyam du dka' ngal mnyam myong byed pa'i goms gshis yod mkhan zhig kyang yin 'dug de sngon ma'o tse tung cing kung ri bor sdod pa'i skabs su kho pas ma'o yi rjes su 'brangs shing / phyi lo 1935 lo mdo smad rnga pa khul brgyud rgyang bskyod byas te lo de'i zu 10 pa'i nang yan an sa khul du slebs thub tsam byung 'dug de rjes krang go 24 1

ha mnyam du rgya nag gi sa khul 'ga' shas su dmag 'thab kyi las 'gul spel/ phyi lo 1950 rla 7 pa'i nang / lho nub dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi ho lung dang / chab srid kyi spyi khyab ting zha'o pheng gnyis kyi bka' bkod 'og krang go hwa yi las rogs su bod la dpung 'jug byed par btang / phyi lo 1953 rla na nang bod dmag khul khang gsar 'dzugs byas rjes kho pas chab srid spyi khyab kreng u zhes pa'i ming khur byas te bod kyi mtha' mtshams srung skyob kyi las 'gan gtso bo byed mkhan skyi gas shig yin/ phyi lo 1955 lo krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi tru'u ci gzhon pa'i las khur blangs/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 10 nyin bod mi ser skya mi dmangs kyis rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon la 'gog rgol byed skabs kho pa gcig pu lha sar bsdad pa ma gtogs krang gnyis rgya nag tu yod pa red/ glo bur dza drag gi gnas tshul de byung skabs kho pas dus babs tshod dpag ma thub par ci bya gtol med kyi dngangs skrag dang / khong khro chen pos bod mi'i bden don gyi las don der deng rabs can gyi drag chas spras pa'i stobs ldan dmag dpung khri lhag tsam bed spyod byas nas drag gnon byed dgos pa'i bka' bkod 'go 'doms gtso bo lag dmar zhig yin zhing / phyi lo 1952 lo ston dus bod dang rgya gar sa mtshams su rgya dkar nag gi dmag 'khrug byung skabs kyang rgya dmag gi 'go 'doms gtso bo yin/ 1955 zu 9 pa'i nang kho pas bod las don u yon lhan khang gi tru'u ci byas/ 1957 lo pe cing du dbus gzhung gi ches mtho'i khrims khang gi 'gan khur ba'i gras su bskos te dus yun de tsam ma song bar grib skyon phog nas lus po 'gul bskyed ma thub pa'i thog tshor ba zar zir gyi ngang nas lo shas shi gson thag ma chod par sdug bsngal chen po myong dgos byung ba de ni kho pas bod mi khri phrag mang 242

po dmar gsod gtong mkhan byed gte gtso bo zhig byas pa'i las 'bras kyi rnam smin cha shas shig che 'dir rang thog tu myong ba yin nges snyam/rgya dmar gyi zhi drag dpon rigs nang du krang gnyis dang / than kon san las shes tshad mtho ba ji snyed yod pa dper na/ bod dmag khul khongs kyi tshan mo krang rli co dang / chab srid pu'u yi pu'u krang hun li'u / mkho sgrub pu'u chin kre kres dang wang chi me bcas mtho rim slob grwa thon pa zhe gcig yin pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang dmag dpon rlo co ni 'grogs bde gshibs bde dang / blo rgya che ba zhig yin pas rgya dmar zhi drag las byed rnams kyis brtsi bkur chen po byed yul zhig red/ kho pas skabs der las don thog 7gong sa tu bla ma mchog gis sku mdun du bcar skabs don gnad snying po mdor bsdus kyi bka' mol zhus zin rjes mang che ba me tog 'debs stangs dang / shing sna dang /bya dang ri dwags gso skyong byed stangs/ rang byung khams chags tshul gyi skor bcas zhu ba las/ rgya dpon gzhan pa ltar/ gung khran ring lugs kyi khyad chos yang dag pa'i skor dang /rlabs chen mes rgyal stobs chen yin pa/ bod rgya mi rigs gnyis dus snga rabs nas khyim tshang gcig yin tshul/ mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i rlabs chen kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung bcas kyi skor 'ud shob kyi skad cha tshig zur tsam zhu gi ma red/skabs re bod dmag khul khang gi khongs 'brel mthud sde tshan gyi pu'u krang zhu'i than lu'u dang / dmag dpon rlo co gnyis nas phran la mgron 'bod dang / yang na khong gnyis phran gyi sar gsol ston du 'dzoms skabs dmag dpon rle co yis rgya bod mi rigs kyi goms gshis tha dad skor dang / bod rgya mi rigs kyi snga rabs lo rgyus bcas kyi skor mang po shod pa las/ gcig 'og gcig 'dus yin lugs kyi ham tshig gcig kyang shod kyi med/ phyi lo 1955 lo ma'o tse tung gis me tog mnyam bzhad dang / mkhas 243

brgya 'gran gleng gi las 'gul zhes pa skul slong byed skabs bod du slebs pa'i rgya dmar gyi zhi drag gzhi rim las byed dang / mtho rim las byed bcas nas de sngon rgya nag nang khul gyi dmag 'khrug byas pa'i ring dang / gzhung gsar pa btsugs rjes bod du 'byor te mtha' mtshams srung skyob byas pa nas bzung da bar gyi rang rang so so'i lo rgyus dang /bsam tshul ji byung skor gyi bsam char gang yod shod dgos lugs kyi bka' khyab 'byor ba ltar/ phyi lo 1955 lo'i rla 3 pa nas 3 pa bar kun spyod dag ther gyi las 'gul sprel te mi tshang ma'i bsam tshul shod du bcug pa de ni ma'o tse tung gi rgya nag yongs kyi zhi drag mtho rim las byed so so'i lo rgyus shes thabs dang gung khran tang dang lhag par ma'o yi dbang sgyur sra brtan yong ched las byed nang khul phan tshun kun spyodadag ther gyi skyon brjod byed du bcug nas gcig gi gcig la 'khon 'dzin bzos te ya bral du btang nas mnyam sdebs kyi mgo bo bkyag mi 'jug pa'i thabs byus ngan pa gdug rtsub gting zab can gyi las 'gul spel ba zhig red/zu gsum pa'i ches bdun nyin bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon than kon san gyis de nyin nas bzung / las 'gul de mtshams 'jog dgos rgyu dang / sang nyin nas bzung g.yas phyogs shog khag la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul spel dgos pa'i skor cadabus gzhung gi bka' 'byor yod lugs dang / de bzhin kho pas/ bar lam kun spyod dag ther gyi las 'gul de'i ring la las byed rim pa khag gi kun spyod dag ther gyi go skabs bzung nas 'char gzhi dang ldan pa'i thog nas tang dang / rgyal khab/ mi dmangasabacas la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul byas pa de gsal po shes tshor byung / de ni tang dang /gsar brje'i snyan grags la gtor bshig tshabs chen btang ba red/ mi de rnams g.yas phyogs pa red/ sang nyin nas bzung de tsho'i nor 'khrul yo bsrang byed dgos zhes 244

gsal bsgrags byas te zhi drag dpon rigs mang por g.yas phyogs pa'i zhwa mo g.yogs/g.yas phyogs shog khar gyur pa rnams ni kun spyod dag ther gyi las 'gul nang rang nyid bod du yong nas dngos yod kyi gnas stangs mthong ba rnams drang bden gyi lam nas shod mkhan rnams yin zhing / khong tshos/ bod ljongs sa khul de krung go gung khran tang gi dril bsgrags byas pa bzhin btsan rgyal ring lugs dang / go min tang gi so myul gyis las 'gul spel sa zhig yin zhes pa de drang bden ma yin pa dang / bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs rnams ni brtan snying babs chags kyi mi rigs snyom chung zhig yin pa des krung go'i mnga' khongs kyi bdag dbang der skyon gnod gang yang mi 'dug ces bsam tshul 'don mkhan mang po byung 'dug bsam tshul 'don mkhan gtso bo'i gras bod dmag khul khang gi tshan mo krang rle co dang / bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid pu'u yi pu'u krang ton le'u/ mkho sgrub pu'u yi pu'u krang chin kri kris bcas kyis gtsos pa'i dmag dpon de gsum yin zhing / dmag dpon de gsum gyis bod la rgya'i zhi drag gi mi 'bor de tsam bzhag dgos don med lugs dang / de ni mes rgyal nang khul mi rgyu gnyis kyi nus shugs de chud zos su 'gro gzhi yin lugs/ lhag par rgyal spyi'i thog gi bar gnas rgyal khab kyi gtso bo rgya gar gzhung gi 'brel ba rje rgyang du 'gro rgyu der rang rgyal la gnod pa ma gtogs phan pa med lugs bcas yang dag pa'i bsam tshul bton pa red/da dung khong gsum gyis / da lta dbus gzhung gis bod du dmag dpung phon chen po bzhag pa'i srid byus de nor 'khrul red ces skyon brjod shugs che byas pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1957 zla 11 ches 30 nyin bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon than kon san ma brgyud par ma'o tse tung la thad kur gong gsal gnas tshul rnams btang 'dugaskabs der krang cing u dang / krang go ha gnyis pe cing du yod skabs yin/ gong gsal 245

dmag dpon gsum po des bod sa khul ni ri stong la rgod dang / bod mi rnams rjes lus rnying zhen che ba bcas la brten gnas skabs gsar brje spel rgyu'i mthun rkyen de tsam med lugs dang / de bzhin bod du dpung dmag thon gcig (gsum stong tsam ) bzhag pa'i 'gro gron de mes rgyal nang khul du hri gsum lhag tsam (gsum khri lhag tsam ) gyis 'gro gron ldeng gi red ces dngos yod bsam tshul bton te da lta'i dbus gzhung gi srid byus der sgyur bkod yong thabs ma'o tse tung la snyan zhu btang yang / ma'o tse tung ni rnam kun don chen bsgrub rgyu dang / byas rjes 'jog rgyur dga' ba/ dmag 'khrug langs rgyur dga' ba bcas kyi mi zhig yin stabs dmag dpon de gsum gyi bsam tshul la rgyab bskyor bya rgyu phar bzhag rgya'i gtam dpe bzhin bang sor mchod 'bul zhu mkhan de bang so bsdogs mkhan la ngos 'dzin byas te/ dmag dpon gsum po'i bsam tshul dang /ma'o tse tung gi bsam tshul rgyab 'gal du gyur nas ma'o yis dmag dpon de gsum ni deng bod ljongs rgya khyon che ba'i dka' ngal la kha g.yar nas mtha' mtshams mnga' khul phyir tshong gi lkog g.yo 'chang mkhan yin par nyes ming bkal te g.yas phyogs kyi zhwa mo g.yogs nas 'dzin bzung gi rgya nag tu btsan khrid kyis btson 'jug byas/ dmag dpon gsum po de ni krang go ha dang / than kon san phud/ dmag khul khang gi dmag dpon mtho shos yin/ khong gsum ni shes yon can yin pa ma zad/ deng rabs kyi dmag don shes tshad kyang krang than gnyis las mtho ba yod/ ma'o tse tung gis me mda'i kha nas srid dbang thob ces pa'i 'bod tshig de'i 'og blo bden spyod bzang gi dmag dpon gsum po de la nag med nyes 'gel byung ba red/246

le tshan nyer drug pa/bod ljongs mdo stod smad sa khul du btsan rgol gyi me lce des rim bzhin dbus phyogs su mched pa/ —༄༅༅/ /rgya mis bod kyi mdo smad r+sā khul du gung khran tang gi srol rgyun drag po'i lam nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zhes pa mi bsad khrag sbyor gyi las 'gul lag len bstar dang bstar bzhin pa'i gdub rtsub can gyi gnas tshul de dbus phyogs su rim bzhin khyab skabs rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams kyis da lta mdo stod smad sa khul la kla klo'i bya spyod ji byung de ltar mgyogs myur dbus gtsang phyogs su yang lag bstar byed rgyu gdon mi za ba red ces mi tshang mar 'jigs snang chen po skyes pa'i skabs der rgya mis 'jam mkhas blo 'gugs kyis rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig lhan khang zhes pa'i mnga' khongs su phyi lo 1957 lo nas bzung lo lnga'i 'char gzhi gnyis pa'i nang dmangs gtso bcos sgyur bya rgyu yin/ gal srid don 'khyol ma thub rnge lo lnga'i 'char gzhi gsum pa'i nang byed dang mi byed bod kyi 'go khrid dang / mi dmangs tshang ma'i bsam gros mthun pa'i thog nas dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur bya rgyu yin zhes khyab bsgrags byas yod pa dang / de bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang zhes pa'i nang gi las byed sang po zhig khu bsdu byas yod kyang don dngos thog mngon chung gi sgo nas mtshan mo drag po'i dpung dmag dang 247

go lag sogs bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa dang / gnad yod sa khul sa mtshams bcas su 'or 'dren byas yod pa red/ 'on kyang bod rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams kyis sngar dang mi 'dra bar rgya dmar gyi bya spyod rim pas shes rtogs byung bar brten phar rgol gyi sems shugs rje cher 'phel nas rdugs zon byas/ yin na'ang bod gzhung gi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun dang mthun pa'i thog rgya mir mthun lam gang zab dang sbrags rang gzhung gi dbang cha srung skyob la 'bad brtson thabs mkhas gang thub gnang ba'i mur rgya mis tu la'i bla ma dang / bod gzhung gi dpon rigs nyung shas sheg la phyi rgyal gyi shugs rkyen thebs yod lugs kyi rdugs pa'i rnam 'gyur nyin re bzhin mngon gsal du gyur/skabs der rgya dmar gyis rgya gar bka' sgug khul du bzhugs pa'i rang rigs 'ga' shas kyis rgya bod dbar gyi mthun sgril la dkrugs shing byed mi log spyod pa zhes zer ba dang / de dag la bod mi drag zhan su rung nas 'brel gtugs nam yang byed mi chog pa dang / rgya gzhung nas rgya gar gzhung la phyi 'brel thog nas ngo rgol tha tshog drag po bsgrags pa ma zad/ rgya mis rgyal bstan chab srid la lhag bsam stan grags can gyi rang rigs mi dgu ming smos byas pa'i khongs / 1 srid tshab zur pa bde mkhar ba che dbang rab brtan dang / 3 sku'i gcen po stag 'tshor thub bstan nor bu dang / 3 rgya lo don grub/ 4 'jam dkyil mkhan chung blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ ba rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ 5 rtse drung thub bstan nyin byed/ 7 rtse drung byams pa dbang 'dus/ra rtse drung byams pa brtson 'grus/ 9 a lo chos mdzad che rdor bcas mi dgu bod mi'i khongs nas phyir 'bud byas pa yin zhes lha zhol gnyis la khyab bsgrags dang rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la bkod rgya gtong dgos bka' shag la btsan shed byas rkyen de don gsal bsgrags gnang dgos byung /248

de 'brel rgya mi'i dpon rigs krang cing u dang / krang go ha sogs kyis phran bza' tsho gnyis la yang nas yang du brjod gsal/ rgya gar du yod pa'i spyan mched tsho lha rab byung na bod la phyir 'gugs thabs dang / de min khong tsho dang 'brel ba ma byas na legs gnas/ khyed gnyis kyi bu phrug 'phral du tshur blangs nas pe cing du slob grwa yag shos sheg tu slob sbyong gtong thub na rgyal khab dang bod mi dmangs rnams la zhabs 'degs yag po zhu thub kyi red/ phyi rgyal la bzhag na 'phro brlag 'gro tshul bcas bslab bya yin khul kyi skul ma yang yang byas byung /dus skabs der rgya dmar gyi bod shar phyogs sa khul du gnam sa gnyis thog nas sngar las lhag pa'i drag po'i btsan gnon shugs chen byas par brten 'bri chu shar rgyud sa khul dang / a mdo sa khul gyi bod mi stong phrag mang po lha sar btsan byol du 'byor te lha sa'i nye 'khor du sdod sgar chags pa'i gnas tshul des bod mi dmangs kyi mdun du rgya mi rnams ngo tsha kha skyengs byung /nyin zhig dmag dpon than kon san gyis bod ljongs rgyal gces bud med tshogs pa zhes pa'i tshogs 'du bskong tshogs kyis tshogs 'du'i sar kho pas deng sang lha sa khul la sbrang bu mang po 'khor gyi yod/ sha rul pa gar yod sar sbrang bu 'khor ba chos nyid red/ sbrang bu med pa bzo ched du sha rul pa de med pa bzo dgos kyi red ces bshad 'dug pa de'i nang don ni shar phyogs kyi bod mi btsan byol pa rnams tu la'i bla ma'i zhabs 'og tu skyob rogs zhu bar bod kyi rgyal sar bca' sdod byed pa de rnams sbrang bu red zer ba dang / 7gong sa mchog dang bod gzhung la sha rul pa red ces zer ba red/ snga lo 7gong sa mchog rgya gar gnas gzigs su chibs sgyur skabs rgya gar gzhung nas sne len gzab rgyas gnang bar brten 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma'i mtshan thog nas 249

rgya gar srid blon naha ru bod du gzigs skor 'tshams 'dre zhig tu khyug tsam phebs thub pa'i gdan zhu gnang bar khong gis kyang zhal bzhes gnang yod pa ltar/ rgya mis dang thog khas len rob tsam byas yod kyang / mtha' ma rgya mis rgya gar srid blon bod du phebs na/deng sang bod du yod pa'i log spyod pa tshos skabs dang bstun nas zing slong bya rgyu yin pas khong gi sku'i bde 'jags la 'gan 'khur byed mi thub pa sogs ka kor kho nas dgag cha byas te 7gong sa mchog gis gdan zhu de phyir 'then gnang dgos byung /de rjes 1958 zu ra nang rgya gar srid blon ne) ru 'brug gzhung gi gdan zhus ltar 'brug yul du phebs lam bod sa gro mo brgyud nas phebs gtan 'khel ba ltar bod gzhung bka' shag nas gro mor 'tshams zhu 'bul bar bka' blon zur khang dang /khong mnyam du lha sdod rgya mi'i dmag dpon than kon san bcas bskyod pa red/rgya mis rgya gar srid blon lha sar phebs ma bcug pa de rgya gar srid blon |ha rus bod kyi gnas tshul dngos yod ji yin shes su ma bcug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa byas par mgron sbyin gnyis la blo pham tshad med pa zhig byung /srid blon deha ru 'brug yul du phebs te 'brug yul rang btsan rgyal khab yin par khas blangs thog slad phyin 'brug la phyi rgyal su 'dra zhig gis btsan 'dzul byas pa yin na rgya gar gyis srung skyob bya rgyu yin zhes gsal bsgrags kyang byas/ de ni sngon chad rgya mi'i srid blon kra'u en les rteta ru la bod don skor khas len 'dra chags de lag len du ma bstar ba'i thog bod ljongs sa khul la mi dmangs sdod bzod mi bde ba'i btsan gnon gyi bya spyod lag len bstar ba de zhi 'jam du gtong dgos lugs dang / lhag par sngon du khas len byas pa rnams kha dan tshig la gnas pa byed dgos rgyu'i rnam 'gyur bstan pa zhig yin kyang rgya dmar nas rgya gar gyi rnam 'gyur bstan pa der kha ya ma byas 220

pa'i thog sngar las lhag pa'i sdug thog sdug brtsegs kyis bod mi rnams la btsan gnon gyi bya spyod kho na lag len shugs chen bstar bas/ phyi lo 1957 nas 1958 dang 1959 bcas su rgya dmar gyi mdo smad sa khul du dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur gong bzhin lag len bstar skabs bod mi ser skya mi dmangs rnams nas rgya dmar gyi btsan gnon la bzod sgom bya thabs bral te lo ngo gsum tsam ring ngo rgol shugs chen byas rkyen rgya dmar gyis dmag dpung 'phon che btang nas deng rabs can gyi lci ba'i mtshon cha'i rigs bed spyod byas pa ma zad/ gnam gru'i thog nas 'bar mdel dbyugs te drwa thang thog gnas pa'i 'brog pa'i sde tshogs dang / dgon pa mang po bcas rtsa gtor btang ba dang / yul sde 'ga' shas kyi mi rgyud rtsa stong ji snyed byung yod pa dper na/ mgo log rta'u smad tshang 6 4 rdzong )gi rtsa thang zhig tu bod mi bsad pa'i mi ro stong phrag mang po bdag med kyis bzhag te rla shas ring sa khul der dri ngan gyis khengs nas mi phyugs 'tsho gnas ma thub pa'i gnas tshul byung 'duga.a rig ra rgya dang / brag dkar sprel rdzong / 'go log a mchog sogs dang /de bzhin rma chu'i g.yas g.yon du gnas pa'i zhing 'brog pho mo rgan gzhon stong phrag mang po rgya dmar gyis lug khyu 'ded pa lta bus rma chu'i nang du btsan ded byas rkyen lcebs rgyu las bros sa gang yang med gshis bod mi de tshos / 7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa dang / paṇa chen rin po che mkhyen zhes smon lam 'debs bzhin rma chur mchongs 'dug pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul nges gsal thos skabs/ bod kyi yig rnying nang snga rabs sa skya 'gro mgon 'phags pas kub la'i se chen han la bka' dbang thengs gsum pa gnang rjes kub la'i han gyis bla ma'i dgongs pa ltar rgya'i mi yur chen mo zhes pa dbang yon du phul ba'i lo rgyus byung yod pa de ni/ skabs der sog po'i btsan gnon la ngo rgol byed mkhan rgya mi 224

rnams sog pos 'dzin bzung gis rgya mi pho mo brgya phrag mang po btsan 'ded kyis rma chur mchongs bcug nas gsod pa der rgya'i mi yur chen mo zhes zer/ lugs srol ngan pa de bod kyi sa skya'i bla chen 'gro mgon chos 'phags kyis med pa bzos te rgya mi mang po srog skyob mdzad yod pa der da cha rgya dmar gyis dren lan log 'jal lta bus sog po'i byed stangs ngan pa de rgya mis bod mi'i thog lag bstar byas pa zhig yin nges red/'bri chu'i shar phyogs dang / a mdo rma chu'i g.yas g.yon/ 'go log sa khul bcas su rgya mis sa gnas khag gi bla dpon mi drag mang po 'dzin bzung dmar gsod btang ba dang / btson 'jug byas pa dang / snyan grags can gyi dgon sde mang po gnam sa gnyis thog nas gtor bshig tshod med btang zhing nyes med ser skya rgan byis mang po btson 'jug gis ngal rtsol rwa ba'i nang du gshin rje'i grong khyer mi yul du mngon sum 'phos pa lta bu'i sdug sbyong sna tshogs dang lkog gsod btang ba dang / ltogs shi rgyag tu bcug pa bcas bod mi rtsa gtor gtong ba'i ngan byus dngos su lag len bstar ba ma zad/ phyi rol du lhag pa rnams la yang rnam pa 'dra min gyi sdug sbyong sna tshogs btang bar brten bod mi mang po 'u thug thabs zad kyis rang gi khyim tshang gi pha ma bu phrug dang /grogs bza' rla bcas blos btang ste nags tshal ri khul bcas su ri dwags lta bur gnas te rgya dmar la ngo rgol 'thab 'dzings kyi 'jab dmag gi las su zhugs nas rgya mi'i mkho sgrub skyel 'dren mo ṭa dang / go mtshon/ bza' chas kyi mdzod khang chung gas 'phrog bcom byas pa dang / rgya mi'i zhi drag dpon dmag nyung sar 'jab rgol bcas kyis 'thab 'dzings byas pa'i gnas tshul de gang sa gang du byung 'dugs gnas de tshor gnas pa'i rgan byis mang po rang nyid kyi gces pa'i pha yul du gnas thabs bral te dngos nor khyer gang thub dang / rta zog gang yod bdas te gang 222

thar gyi sar bros yong skabs rgya dmar gyis rjes 'ded dang gdong bkag byas nas dmar gsod grangs las 'das pa btang 'phros nyung shas shig sngon bsags las bzang gi 'bras bu dus su smin pa lta bus chos kyi zhing sa lha sar 'byor thub pa byung yang /skabs der lha sdod rgya mis bod gzhung bka' shag la khams pa gsar 'byor log spyod pa de rnams rang yul du phyir log ma btang na bcings bkrol dmag gis phyir skrod bya rgyu yin zhes brjod de khams rigs sdod khul du rgya mi'i las byed btang nas mi so so'i ming dang / sngar phan gyi lo rgyus bcas zhib phra tho 'god byas par brten mi de rnams rgya mis 'dzin bzung byas mi yong ngam snyam pa'i rdugs pa chen po skyes pa'i ngang 1958lo 'go tsam la a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis sne khrid 'og mdo stod smad gnyis kyi bod mi bsam yod tshang ma bsam gros byas mthar bstan don rdog rtsa gcig sgril thog rgya dmar la drag po'i thog nas ngo rgol bya rgyu'i sgrig 'dzugs shig ma byung mthu med gyis bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs shig 'dzugs rgyu'i mna' gan bzhagabastan srung dang blangs dmag sgar 'dzugs rgyu'i gsang gros byed pa'i tshogs 'du'i nang bod gzhung dmag sgar khag gi 'thus mi btang yod kyang dang blangs dmag nang dngos su zhugs rgyu skabs su ma babs pas dmag sgar tshang mas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas go mtshon sogs mthun rkyen rogs ram bya rgyur phyar gru mnyam 'dregs byas yod pa dang / slad skabs dang bstun nas mthun rkyen rogs ram zhu rgyu'i kha dan byas/skabs der gros mol byed mkhan gas su kha dang dmag sgar gyi brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul bod gzhung dmag sgar gyi spyi 'thus bskos te a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis gtsos chu sgang gi mi sna gnad yod dang / lhan du gong gsal gsang gros nang zhugs te zhabs 'degs hur skyed zhus yod/ a 'brug mgon po bkres can gyis/ phyi rgyar bod 223

gzhung bka' shag la bar lam rgya mis mdo stod smad phyogs su drag po'i dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas rkyen rang yul du gnas thabs bral te chos kyi zhing sa lha sar bros byol thub tsam byung nas da bar 'gro bzo sdod mkhas kho na byas kyang da cha rgya mis nga tsho nyam thag rnams la bsdad mi chog pa'i btsan shed brdabs gsig gis bsam sbyor ngan pa byas rkyen da lta rang yul du log thabs bral yang / rgya dmar bod nas phyir log rjes bdag cag rang rang so so'i yul du phyir log bya rgyu yin lags na de yi bar nga tsho dbus gtsang khul la gnas sdod chog pa zhes snyan zhu phul don bka' shag nas khams rigs rnams gnas skabs zhi 'jam du gnas thabs rgya phyogs la bka' mol gnang yang / rgya mis der brtsi 'gro ma btang bar slar yang lha sdod khams pa dang / a mdo sdod sgar khag tu rgya mi'i zhi drag mi sna btang ste mi grangs dang / pho mo ji yod ming tho blangs/ khong tsho'i go mtshon tshang ma gzhung 'bul zhu dgos bshad rkyen a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis gtsos pa'i mdo stod smad phyogs kyi mi 'bor khyon che rta dmag go mtshon rang 'grigs lo de'i rla ba bzhi pa'i nang lho khar bskyod/lha sa dang / gzhis rtse/ rgyal rtse bcas kyi grong khyer khag tu gnas sdod byas pa'i khams pa dang / a mdo rnams kyang rim bzhin lha sa'i lho phyogs gri gu sa khul du gsang bskyod kyis chol gsum bstan srung dang blangs dmag sgar zhes pa gsar 'dzugs byas te rgya mir 'thab rgol gyi 'char gzhi btings/ 'on kyang bstan srung dang blangs dmag sgar so so'i mtshon cha ha cang zhan pas rgya dmar dang 'thab rgol byed dgos na de 'phral dka' ngal 'phrad rgyu nyag gcig la brten go mtshon gang mang ma byung mthu med kyis bsam gros byung ste a 'brug mgon po bkris nas mgron che pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan la de'i skor bka' slob zhus par de sngon bod gzhung gzhis rtse ga dang dmag sgar gyis shangs 224

dga' ldan chos 'khor du bcol bzhag pa'i dmag grangs 500 yi go mtshon rang 'grigs yod pa rnams len thabs bya dgos pa'i mgron ches bka' slob gnang don/ a 'brug mgon po bkris rang nyid kyi bstan srung dmag lnga brgya lhag tsam khrid de byang lam brgyud shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor du thon skyod byas/ mdo khams pa rnams lha sa nas lho khar ma thon gong tsam la lha sa'i nye 'khor gdong dkar sa gnas su rgya mi'i me sgrogs dmag sgar gyi dmag dpon gzhon pa phu'u thon krang go gnas tu lhas yin pa cang ha thing zhes pa de khong tsho nang khul ma mthun pa'i rkyen byung ste glo bur dmag sgar de nas mtshan mo mtshon cha rang 'grigs dang / rta zhig bzhon nas bod gzhung kha dang dmag sgar du bros yong ste khong gis rgyu rkyen zhib gsal bshad pa de dag la nyams zhib brtag dpyad nan tan thog srog skyob mgo len gyis nyin shas dmag sgar nang du gsang nyar byas te a 'brug mgon po bkris la mkho gal yod pa'i mi zhig yin stabs kho pas 'khyer ba'i mtshon cha rang 'grigs dang bod chas g.yogs nas li thang dbra phrug ngag dbang can mnyam du lho khar btang ste a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis cang ha thing la bod ming blo bzang bkres zhes btags/a 'brug mgon po bkris lho kha nas shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor du bskyed skabs snye mo 'du 'gag gsum mdo sa gnas su rgya dmag gi sngon tshud nas rgya rnyi bkram pa lta bu'i mtha' skor dmag 'thab byed skabs cang ha thing gis dmag byus btang ste rgya dmag lnga brgya lhag tsam rtsa gtor pham nyes btang ste bstan srung dmag rgya rnyi'i nang nas thar thub pa byung /lo de'i dpyid dus 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po gdan sa chen po 'bras spungs dang / se ra gnyis la gra bskor dam bcar chibs sgyur legs grub rjes ston dus 225

gdan sa dga' ldan du chibs sgyur gnang ba'i nyin snga dro nor gling pho brang nas phebs tshur thog lha sa skyid chu'i zam pa'i khar phebs skabs bka' blon rnams phebs skyel du bcar gnang sar bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis kha sa kha nyin khams pa'i mi bzhi brgya lhag tsam lcags zam brgyud chu shur nas thon te snye mo khul du 'gro gi yod 'dug par bcings 'grol dmag gis sngon tshud nas sgug ra sprad de khams pa rnams 'byor ma thag phan tshun 'thab lag 'phrod de bcings 'grol dmag mang po shi mas kyi pham nyes chen po byung 'dug pa de khams pa'i nang du bod dmag khul khang khongs gtogs kyi me sgrogs dmag sgar gyi thon krang bzhon pa cang ha thing gis dmag byus btang nas bcings 'grol dmag gis sngon tshud nas gra sgrig byas pa'i rgya rnyi lta bu btsugs nas bkag 'doms byas pa'i g.yul sa de gtor bshig btang ba red ces 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus song zhing / nyin shas kyi sngon du bka' blon nga phod kyis/ khams pa rnams lho kha nas byang bskyod byed kyi yod kyang bcings 'grol dmag gis snye mo sa khul du sgug ra sprad de gra sgrig byas yod pas khams pa gcig kyang thar gyi ma red ces snyan seng zhus 'duga.a 'brug mgon po bkris kyi sne khrid pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag rnams shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor nas go mtshon rnams 'khyer nas lho kha phyogs su phyir log skabs lam bar rgya dmag dang gdong thug gis 'thab 'khrugs ji snyed byung rkyen bstan srung 'go dmag rnams kha 'thor nas rim bzhin lho kha phyogs su phyir log thub pa byung zhing /de rjes rgya blo bzang bkris kyis 'bri gung sba ga dang / rmar gzhung / lho kha rtse thang bcas su rgya dmag dang 'thab 'dzings thengs mang byed skabs gzengs su thon pa'i byas rjes mang po bzhag yod pa dang / dmag 'thab dza drag skabs khong gis 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen por gsol ba smon lam rtse gcig tu btab nas tā la'i bla ma zhes 'bod pa des lus la 226

me mda' mang po phog kyang mas skyon tsam yang ma byung ba'i gnas tshul dngos su byung ba rnams mi thug tshad la shod kyi yod pa red/ 1959 lo 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du btsan byol phebs rjes khong yang bstan srung dang blangs dmag dang mnyam du btsan byol du yong nas bod mi spyi byings dang mnyam du rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor bye la kob be gzhis chags su lo mang zhing las byas te bod mi drag zhan rnams dang 'cham mthun gyi thog gnas shing / 7gong sa mchog ma'i sor gzhis chags su nam phebs skabs khong gi sdod khang du ched mngags chibs sgyur gnang ste khong la dmigs bsal gyi byams brtse'i gzigs skyong gnang yod/ khong lo na mtho zhing nad mnar gyis rkyen pas 1987 lo 'das grongs song yang khong gi snying stobs ldan pa'i lo rgyus de bod kyi lo rgyus thog bsub thabs med par gnas rgyu red/cang ha thing dang thog bod gzhung kha dang dmag sgar du mgo btags zhu ba'i nyin gnyis kyi rjes su rgya mis bod gzhung bka' shag la nga tsho bod dmag khul khang khongs me sgrogs dmag sgar gyi thon krang gzhon pa cang ha thing zhes pa dang / de min zhi ba'i las byed gzhan zhig gar song cha med kyis bros 'dug pa de gnyis lha sa nye 'khor sa gnas las gzhan rde bskyed thabs mi 'dug na de gnyis bod gzhung gi dmag sgar khag dang / se 'bras/ yang na lha zhol mi dmangs kyi khyim du bdag nyar byas yod che 'phral du rtsis sprod dgos lugs rnyog rtsod bshad de bod gzhung nas lha sa'i grong khyer spyi khyab las khungs snang rtse shag dang / zhol gnyer las khungs khag gnyis dang / dmag sgar khag gdan sa ser 'bras dga' gsum bcas dang / nye 'khor ri khrod khag bcas la gong gsal rgya mi'i las byed gnyis gal srid bdag ltar dang / mthong thos ji byung skor gong rim la skabs 'phral snyan seng zhu dgos rgyu las/ rang bzhin bdag ltar mi chog pa'i bka' khyab 227

gnang yang 'di yin 'di min gyi gnas tshul gang yang ma byung zhing / skabs der tsha rong nang du sdod pa'i rgya mi'i zhi ba'i las byed gcig gis dngul phran bu lkog zos byas pa'i skor gleng rnyog byung ste kho pa gar song med lugs kyi gtam 'chal zhig khyab pa de ni/ rgya mi'i gsang nyul las khungs kyis cang hwa thing bros pa'i gnas tshul byung rjes zhi ba'i las byed de gsang gros byas pa yin khul gyi lho kha gong dkar du bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi khongs su mgo btags zhu ru btang ba der bod dmag gis do snang ji bzhin ma byas par mnyam 'khrid kyis bstan srung dmag lho kha nas byang du bskyod skabs lam bar chu shur sa gnas nas kho pas lha sar gsang bros kyis bstan srung dmag gi sgrig 'dzugs kyi gnas tshul sogs dang lhag par mgon po bkris kyis 'go khrid pa'i bstan srung dmag byang skyed kyi dmigs yul lam phyogs bcas zhib rtogs kyis phyir log byas 'dug rgya mi'i gsang nyul de bros phyin rjes khams pa'i 'go khrid 'ga' shas kyis cang ha thing yang rgya mi'i so nyul min nam snyam pa'i rdugs pa chen po skyes yod kyang / khong gis de'i sngon tsam du zhi ba'i las byed de rgya mis btang ba'i so nyul min nam zhes gsang gnas bshad yod kyang rang bzhin snang med du gyur te rgya mi'i so nyul de bros shor ba nas bzung mgon po bkris nas cang hwa thing la sngar las lhag pa'i yid ches chen po rnyed de khong gis bton pa'i dmag byus rnams brtsi 'jog dang lag len bstar te snye mo'i dkar khang dang / 'du 'gag gsum mdo bcas su rgya dmar dang 'thab 'khrug byed skabs rgya dmag mang po pham nyes btang ba ma zad/ cang hwa thing gis khong gis ngo shes pa'i rgya mi'i thon krang gzhon pa zhig khong rang gis lag 'og du bsad 'dugade sngon cang hwa thing bod gzhung kha dang dmag sgar du mgo btags zhu skabs/khong gis gal srid lha sar zing 'khrug langs pa yin tsho lha sa'i nye khul du yod pa'i rgya 228

mi'i dmag sgar khag gis glo bur dus gcig la bod gzhung gi dmag sgar khag dang / rtse pho brang / gdan sa ser 'bras gnyis/ gtsug lag khang / nor bu gling kha bcas me skyogs kyis rtsa gtor byed rgyu'i 'char gzhi zhig bkod zin yod lugs zer ba ltar sa khra zhig bkod de bod gzhung la phul ba red/rjes su 1959 lo rla 3 nang bod mi dmangs rnams kyis rgya mi'i btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol dang / rang dbang sor gnas sger langs kyi las 'gul byung skabs de sngon cang hwa thing gis sa khra bkod pa'i 'char gzhi de bzhin du rgya mis nor gling dang / rtse po ta la/ gtsug lag khang / bod gzhung dmag sgar/ gdan sa ser 'bras bcas su me sgyegs kyi rdzas mdel drag char babs pa ltar drag gnon byas yod pa red/bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi sgrig lam dang / dam ga don gyi sgrig chas/dmag mkho'i dngos rdzas/ mi 'bor sogs stobs shugs shin tu zhan po yin pa des deng dus can gyi drag chas spras pa'i rgya dmag gi kha gtad gcog dka' ba zhig yin yang /khong tshos sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu mdzad 'phrin/ rang gi mi rigs dang rgyal khab bcas kyi ched du bden pa'i phyags re snying dbus su bcangs nas blo brtan 'gyur med rang srog blos btang gi snying stobs rtse mor son pa der bod mi dmangs rnams kyis snying dbus nas dga' zhen thog dngos shugs brgyud gsum gyi rgyab skyor byas yod pa ma zad/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi bsam yod ser skya mi dmangs dang / bod gzhung dmag sgar khag gi khongs nas kyang go mtshon rang 'grogs khyer te bstan srung dang blangs dmag khongs su 'dzul zhugs byas pa ji snyed cig byung yod/khams pa dang a mdo ba rnams lha sa nas lho kha khul phyir thon rjes rgya mes bod gzhung la sngar bzhin rtsod rnyog bshad rkyen bod gzhung nas khams rigs rnams zhi 229

'jam du gnas thabs slob ston go bkon byed par bka' shag gi sku tshab dza sag smon gling pa dang / gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas bstan srung dmag sgar chags yul gri gur ched brdzong gnang yang / phan tshun sne 'phrod tsam ma byung mur/ rgya phyogs nas bka' shag la/ bod gzhung dang khams pa log spyod pa gcig pa yin dang min gyi rdog kha blangs par skabs der chab srid kyi gtso 'gan bdag gir bzhes mkhan 7gong sa mchog dang /bka' shag bcas la mdzad dka' shin tu chen po byung nas bod gzhung dang khams pa 'brel ba gang yang med lugs kyi lan 'debs gnang bar rgya phyogs nas de 'dra yin na bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khams pa log spyod pa de rnams rtsa gtor gtong bar bod dmag gtong dgos kyi 'dug de'i go mtshon dang mthun rkyen sogs rgya mes rogs rgyab bya rgyu yin lugs sogs brjod par bka' shag nas bod dmag gis dngos 'grel khams pa mthar bskrod gtong ma thub pa med kyang / gal srid bod dmag rnams kyi lag tu go mtshon khyer te khams pa mthar bskyod ma btang bar khams pa dang mnyam du me mda'i kha tshur slog na las rnyog de las che ba yong gzhi 'di lta bu nga tshos blos 'gan bzod min la de las krung dbyang dgongs pa dwangs thabs dang / khams pa'i zing cha 'jags thabs su bod gzhung rang gis mes 'chigs mer gtugs kyi zhi mol zhu rgyur gnad yod mi sna do chod slar yang khams pa'i gnas sar gtong gi yin zhes lan sprad de mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan bsam mchog dang / rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med bcas gri gur zhi gros sru ched brdzong gnang / khong gnyis gre gur 'byor rjes bstan srung dmag sgar gyi 'go khrid do chod pa de tsam med pas bka' mol gnang ma thub par re zhig lho kha lhun rtse khul du bzhugs dgos byung 'dugagal srid skabs der bod gzhung bka' shag nas rgya mi'i kha la nyan te ci 230

gsung bka' sgrub gnang yod na bod dmag gis bstan srung dang blangs dmag rnams bdun gcig las mi 'gor ba ra rtsa med du gtong thub rgyu yin par the tshom mi dgos/'on kyang bod gzhung bka' shag nas bstan srid dang / mi rigs gcig rgyur gyi la zhen la dgongs te rgya mi'i ngan byus las g.yol thabs kyis dka' ngal la gdong len byed pa'i rla bas po che zhig 'dzin yod pa red/1958 zla 8 tshes 39 nyin a 'brug mgon po bkris kyi lho kha nas bstan srung dang blang dmag khag gcig sne khrid de chu shur brgyud gtsang khul shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon du yod pa'i bod gzhung ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi go mdzod nas go mtshon 'don par bskyod cing / chu shur du 'byor skabs bstan srung dang blang dmag gi khongs su yod pa de sngon rgya dmar gyi lha sa skyid chu'i lho 'gram du yod pa'i dmag mkho'i go mdzod khang gi srung dmag sde tshan gyi pha'i krang (zhal ngo )khren kru'u ning zhes pa de glo bur bstan srung dang blang dmag khongs nas lha sar bros grol song ba red/khong ni zla shas gong kha tsha ra (bal po dang bod rigs rgyud 'dres phru gu ) kha btags lan par gyi bu mo pad ma lags zhes pa dang bza' tshang gi 'brel ba byung bar brten rgya dmar gyi mtho rim mi sna tshos kho par nyes chad gcod rgyu nges pa kho pas shes shing / de skabs bza' zla pad mas gros bton pa ltar kho pas go mtshon rang 'grigs khyer te bstan srung dang blang dmag la mgo btags zhu bar phyin nas rim bzhin rgya gar du bros rtsis yod pa red/a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis kho par bod ming bstan pa dar rgyas zhes btags pa dang / kho pa ni de sngon rgya nag khrun chin rkang dmag dmag dpon slob grwa 23 1

nas thon pa zhig yin stabs dmag rtsal dang / lag rtsal me mda' rgyag rtsal bcas la mkhas pa zhig red 'dugabastan srung dmag khongs su zla shas sdod ring 'tsho ba'i gom gshis thad nas dka' ngal 'phrad de lha sar phyir bros byas pa zhig red/ kho pas lha sar 'byor ma thag rgya dmar gyis 'dzin bzung byas nas dmag dpon ting hra'o tung ngo mas kho par dri zhib byas yod pa dang / kho pas bstan srung dang blangs dmag khongs su zla shas sdod ring phyi nang gi gnas tshul mthong thos ji byung rigs dang / mgon po bkris kyis 'go dmag bdun brgya tsam khrid de chu shur dang / snye mo brgyud shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon du bod gzhung ka dang sku srung dmag sgar gyi go mdzod nang du yod pa'i go mtshon rnams gsang ba'i thog nas 'don rgyu'i gnas tshul dang / de bzhin thon 159 khongs me skyogs sde tshan gyi kru'u rin (thonakrang gzhon pa ) cang hā thing (rgya mislo bzang bkris ) yang mnyam du 'khrid yod lugs bcas bshad pa red/rgya dmar gyis gong gsal gnas tshul gsal po rtogs ma thag a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis gtsos pa'i bstan srung dmag rnams bstor bcom bya rgyu dang /rgya mi blo bzang bkris nges par gson bzung bya rgyu bcas kyi ched du thon zhes pa'i dmag sgar 159 dang 155 gnyis dmag dpung chu shur byang rgyud dang / yangs pa can/ snye mo bcas khag gsum bgos te 'phral du bskyod dgos pa'i bka' btang /tshes 38 kyi tho rengs su yangs pa can dang / snye mo phyogs su phyin nas 'du 'gag gsum mdor sgugs ra sprad yod stabs bstan srung dmag dang gdong thug 'thabs 'dzings byung ste dpa' bo cha phreng g.yang 'phel tshe ring sogs cha phreng pa mi grangs bco lnga tsam dgra lag tu shor/ de bzhin rgya dmag kyang mang po bsad mas 232

btang ba skabs der rgya mi blo bzang bkris kyis ngo shes 'dres 'brel yod pa'i dmag dpon zhig dang gtam bshad mang po byas mthar me mda' rgyag res byas te rgya mi blo bzang bkris nas dmag dpon de gsod dgos byung 'dugade nas sa rub mtshams bstan dmag rnams yangs pa can gyi nub byang brgyud nas gar song cha med du gyur stabs rgya dmag rnams lha sar phyir 'then byas/rla 9 pa'i zla smad tsam la bstan srung dmag rnams shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor nas go mtshon bton nas tshur lam rang 'jags snye mo dang chu shur brgyud lho kha phyogs su bskyod rtsis byas kyang / snye mo dang / yangs pa can bcas la rgya dmar gyi thon zhes pa'i dmag sgar ang 155 dang 159/150 de bzhin me skyogs dmag sgar ang 30/301 gi ying (5 khag gcig 'phrul 'khor drong cha dmag) bcas snye mo khul du snga sa nas 'byor te sgugs ra sprad bsdad yod par brten bstan dmag gi mdun skyod dmag snye mo dkar khang sar rgya dmag dang gdong thug gis phan tshun 'thabs 'dzings byas te bstan dmag gi dpa' bo cha phreng gzim 'gag rgya lag tu shor/ rgya dmag kyang mang po bsad mas btang yod pa red/ bstan dmag rnams nas rgya dmag gi mtha' bskor ba las g.yol te yangs pa can gyi byang shar brgyud kha phyogs nas 'bro gung brgyud lho kha phyogs su phyir log byed rtsis byas/ lam bar 'dam gzhung du rgya dmar gyi mo ṭa gnyis dang 'phrad de rtsa gtor btang /de nas rim bzhin 'bre gung du 'byor skabs rgya dmag gi sngon tshud nas sgugs ra sprad de bsdad yod par brten phan tshun dmag 'thab chen po thug ste a 'brug mgon po bkris la mas skyon phog pa'i thog dmag dpon dbra phrug ngag dbang dang / rgya mi blo bzang bkris sogs kyang kha thor ste a 'brug mgon po bkris nas 233

'khor g.yog hrag bsdus shig khrid de khyung po steng chen dang / tsha ba dpa' shod khul phebs/ de khul dmag bskul rgyab te rim bzhin kong po brgyud lho khar 'byor skabs 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po sku 'khor hrag bsdus bcas lha sa nas gsang stabs kyis skyid chu brgal nas lho kha yar lung dang / gnyal lhun rtse rdzong bcas brgyud rgya gar phyogs su phebs thon zin zhing / bod gzhung byes bka' shag gis bka' mngags ltar lho kha khul srung skyob bya rgyu'i dam bca' bzhag yod pa red/ 'on kyang rgya dmar gyi dmag shugs chen po btang stabs mang nyung dang / go lag bzang zhan la thug ste gdong len bya thabs bral ba'i gnas tshul 'og re zhig mon yul du phyir 'then gyis slar yang lho phyogs su 'dzul rtsis kyi 'char gzhi yod kyang mthar rgyu rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad de 'u thug gis 7gong sa chen po mchog phebs rjes su mon rta dbang brgyud rgya gar du btsan byol du phebs dgos byung ba yin no/da ni dkyus su 'jug par bya ste/ phyi lo 1955 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya gar nas bod du zhabs sor ma 'khod bar der lha sa khul du dgrog gtam gyi rlung 'tshub drag pos rkyen pas bod mi rnams la rgya mis glo bur du btsan gnon byas mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag gi dus 'da' ba zhig byung yang / 7gong sa mchog lha sar zhabs sor 'khod rjes dza drag gi gnas babs de chu 'khol ma'i nang grang mo blugs pa nang bzhin zhi 'jam du gyur/ 'on kyang rgya mis lha sa grong khyer nang gi nye 'khor dmag sgar khag dang /zhi ba'i las byed sdod yul las khungs khag tshang mar sa 'og tu gab khung gsar bzo dang /sdod khang gi yang thog dang sgo sge'u khung bcas su bye ma blugs pa'i phad gog brtsigs pa'i 'dzing ra gsar bzo byas thog nyin mtshan kun tu so lta dmag mi bzhag pa/ de bzhin lha sa'i nye 'gram skyed chu'i lho ngos grib kyi dmag sgar dang / lha sa nub brgyud nor stod gling 234

ga shar ngos dpal sdings dmag skar sogs nas rtse pho brang dang / nor gling pho brang / bla steng gtsug lag khang / bod gzhung da mag sgar khag bcas su me sgrogs kha bsgrigs nas rgyab chog chog gi gra sgrig byas yod pa de khul mi dmangs kyi shes tshor byung bar brten/ rgya mis de'i g.yas g.yon du sdod pa'i bod mi rnams dmag sgar gyi nye 'gram du bskyod mi chog pa'i bkag 'doms byas/gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og nyin zhig nor gling gyi chibs g.yog kun bzang zhes pa de lha sa'i skyid chu'i pha kha nas ther ge btang te rdo g.yam 'or 'dren du bskyod nas skyid chu'i zam sner slebs skabs zam srung rgya dmag dang kha rtsod shor te rgya mi'i dmag mis lam seng chibs g.yog kun bzang la me mda' 'phangs te bsad lugs skor rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan mchog la gnas tshul 'byor ma thag pha lhas lam seng sa gnas su gnas tshul ji byung rtogs zhib byed par phran rang gtong gnang byung ba ltar sa gnas su bskyod skabs bod dmag khul khang gi dmag dpon gzhon pa wang khang tshan mu'u krang dang / de 'og dmag dpon 'ga' shas bcas slebs 'dug pa dang bcings 'grol dmag brgya lhag tsam zam pa'i g.yas g.yon du bkrams 'dug dmag dpon wang khang des/ phran mthong ma thag khyed tsho'i mi 'ga' shas kyis nga tsho'i zam srung dmag gi go mtshon 'phrog rtsis byas rkyen nga tsho'i bcings 'grol dmag gis rang nyid kyi go mtshon srung skyob ched me mda' mi rgyag mthu med byung 'dug rjes su gnas tshul thabs sdug de lta bu 'phrad na lag len de nang bzhin bstar rgyu las gzhan gyi bya thabs med/ rjes 'bras ji byung khyod tshos 'gan khyer dgos zhes shod skabs kho pa'i ngo gdong smug nag tu gyur nas gdug rtsub can gyi mig gnyis phran la sdir sder bltas nas 'jigs skul gyi rnam pa bstan byung / rnam kun dmag dpon de gshis rgyud 'jam po dang /235

shes yon yod mdog gi rnam 'gyur ston mkhan zhig yin yang / skabs der gnas tshul des rkyen pas mi gshis la ha las dgos pa'i 'gyur ldog byung 'dugaphran gyis nga tsho'i ther ge gtong mkhan de'i lag par go mtshon khab tsam med par khyod tsho'i zam srung pas rgyu med rkyen med du bsad pa des bcings 'grol dmag la ming chad ngan pa yong nges ma zad/ da lta khyod tsho'i zam srung gis bsad pa de dang mnyam du bod dmag 'ga' shas yod tshul bshad pa de bden pa rtsa ba nas ma red/ bsad pa de mnyam du rogs pa gcig las med/ rogs pa mi 'di yin/ mi de'i kha thabs gang 'dra zhig 'dug gam/ khyod tshos bsad pa'i mi de yang de dang khyad med pa zhig yin/ rgyu mtshan gang yang med par mi nyams chung la thub tshod dang dmar gsod btang na yag po rtsa ba nas mi 'dug des bod rgya mi rigs dbar gyi mthun sgril la gnod skyon chen po byung nas bod mi dmangs kyis bcings 'grol dmag la khong khro 'khon 'dzin gyi gting nad chen po chags kyi red/ rjes su gnas tshul de rigs mi 'byung ba wang khang tshan mu krang nas bcings 'grol dmag rnams la bka' slob nan po gnang ba'i re skul zhu gi yod ces bshad par dmag dpon wang khang gis/ ngo gdong phran bu'i zhi 'jam du gyur te da lta khyod kyis brjod pa de rnams khas len bya thabs med/ nor 'khrul de khyed tsho'i mis bzos pa red/ bcings 'grol dmag gi go mtshon 'phrog na srog 'phrog pa dang gcig pa yin/ nga tsho'i bcings 'grol dmag gis me mda' mi rgyag mthu med byung ba red/ 'on kyang da res byung ba'i gnas tshul de mi legs pa zhig red/ khyod tsho'i mi la do dam yag po byed dgos/ krung dbyang gis khyed la yid ches chen po byed bzhin yod/ mi ngan log spyod pa gzhan gyi kha la nyan 'jog ma byed/ mi ngan log spyod pa ches nyung shas kyis rgya bod mi rigs kyi 'brel lam bzang po de rtsa gtor gtong rgyu'i lkog g.yo'i 'char gzhi lag 236

len bstar gyi yod kyang lkog rtsis de dag nam yang 'grub thabs med/ de ni nyin mo'i rmi lam zhig yin zhes kha rdung mang dag cig btang bar/ phran gyis da lta zam srung pas bsad pa'i mi de'i bza' zu bu phrug 'tsho ba ha cang skyo po yin/ 'das po des rgyun du bza' zu bu phrug gso skyong byed dgos gyi yod pas mi de khyod tshos bsad par brten bza' mi bu phrug rnams kyi 'tsho bar dka' ngal shin tu chen po 'phrad kyi red ces brjod par/dmag dpon wang khang gis de'i skor ngas si len pu'u (dmag spyi khang )la phyir log rjes sang gnangs shig khyod la lan gsal sprad chog da lta khyod tshos mi btang nas phung po de lam seng rtsis len gyis khyer 'gro rogs byed/ de bzhag na rnyog zing ji yong nga tshos shod khag po red ces mtho rim gyis dma' rim la bka' btang shag lta bu byas nas ru sus bzos pa'i 'jib 'khor zhig nang 'dzul te brel 'tshab ngang phyir log byas song / de bzhin kho dang mnyam du yod pa'i dmag dpon gzhan rnams kyang kho ba'i rjes su 'jib 'khor gzhan zhig tu 'dzul nas phyir log byas song yang / zam pa'i g.yas g.yon du rgya dmag 3༷༷ nas 400 skor slebs 'dug pa de rnams la deng rabs can gyi drag chas spras shing dmag sa chen por slebs pa ltar me mda'i kha zam pa'i phyogs bzhir gtad nas sdigs skul lta bu byed bzhin 'dug de rnams kyi khrod nas dmag dpon chung ba zhig phran sar yong nas/ khyed rang lam seng thon na ma gtogs 'dir sdod rgyu mi 'dug ces brjod byung ba de dmag mi de rnams kyi bkod 'doms pa zhig red 'dugaskabs der phran phyir log mi byed mthu med byung zhing phung po de gnas skabs zam pa'i steng rang la bzhag nas gong gsal gnas tshul rnams gong rim la snyan seng zhib gsal zhus/rjes su rgya mi'i dmag dpon cang hwa thing gis brjod gsal la/ skabs der rgya phyogs kyis skyid chu zam pa'i steng bod mi gcig bsad pa de'i rkyen gyis bod mi tshos zing 237

'khrug bslangs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i rdugs pa skyes nas lha sa'i nye 'khor rgya mi'i dmag sgar grib dang / nor stod gling ga dpal sdings/ gra zhi glog 'phrul khang bcas la me sgrogs kha bsgrigs nas dus gcig tu rgyag rgyu'i 'char gzhi bzos pa red ces brjod byung /skabs der bod gzhung 'bangs gnyis kur yang rgya mis yag po byed kyi ma red snyam pa'i rdugs 'char je cher song zhing / rgya mi tshor yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim nyung shas kyis khams pa rnams lag sbrel gyis zing 'khrugs slong gi red snyams pa'i rdugs pa chen po chags te drag gnon lag len bstar chog gi gnas bab 'og rgya mis lha sa khul slob grwa khag dang / gzhon nu sde tshogs/ bud med tshogs pa/ las byed slob shā bod rang skyong ljongs khongs yod rgya bod las byed bcas khungs so sor tshogs 'du bskong tshogs yang yang byas pa'i sar rgya mi'i mtho rim dpon rigs khag gis/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim pa'i nang zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang /sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa/ pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ rnam sras gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med/ bkris dpal ra ba sogs kyi mtshan spros te de tshos log spyod pa dang 'brel ba byed kyi 'dug pas 'brel mtshams ma bzhag na 'dzin bzung khrims gcod bya rgyu yin zhes sdigs ra mang dag bskul ba dang / lhag par rgya mi'i dpon rigs tshos bar lam nas bzung 7gong sa mchog la brtsi 'jog zhu rgyu de yang je zhan du gyur te lha sa'i slob grwa chung 'bring khag gi slob phrug tsho sngar gyi mdzad lam ltar lo re dbyar kha mjal thengs re zhu gi yod pa de yang gzhon skyes rnams la skongs dad 'gos rgyur khag btags nas bkag 'doms mtshams 'jog byas shing / de bzhin rnam kun 7gong sa mchog chibs sgyur chen mo'i skabs lha sdod mi dmangs rnams nas kyis btud zhal mjal zhu sar rgya mi'i zhi drag dpon rigs gang 'tshams nas kyang gus btud zhu srol yod pa de yang 238

mtshams 'jog byas/ gong gsal gnas stangs de 'dra'i 'og bod dmag dang rgya dmag bar 'khrug rtsod yang yang byung yod/phyi lo 1957 zla 10 ches 11 nyin kha dang dmag mi gsum me shing dbor 'dren du bskyed de lam gzhung nas dmag sgar du phyir log yong skabs rgya dmag rkang sga ril bzhon pa zhig dang 'phrad de phan tshun lab gleng phran bu byung bar sa gnas de'i nye 'gram gra bzhi shar tshal zhing nang du sdod pa'i rgya mis rgya'i dmag sgar khag tu kha par btang nas lha sa dang / de'i nye 'khor dog sde khul gyi rgya mi'i dmag sgar nang nas yong min mngags par glo bur du rgya dmag go mtshon rang 'grig brgya lhag tsam 'byor thog mtshon cha khab tsam yang med pa'i bod dmag de gsum la rgya dmag gis mtha' bskor te phyogs rub byed skabs bod dmag gsum kha dang dmag sgar du phyir bros gang thub byed bzhin par shig gsad par sta re'i dpe ltar rgya dmag rnams nas me mda'i kha bsgrigs nas bod dmag gsum po der 'phangs te dmag kun bzang dang spen pa gnyis de gar bsad pa dang / dmag bu chung kha dang dmag sgar du bros thar/ rgya dmag de rnams kyis kha dang dmag sgar gyi nye 'gram nub phyogs bye rags kyi rgyud dang / lho phyogs zhing steng bcas mtha' skor 'jab yib kyi chu tshod 'ga' shas bsdad de phyir log byas/ gal srid skabs der kha dang dmag sgar nas ya lan sprad na dmag 'khrugs kyi zing cha de nyin rang nas langs rgyu yin nges snyam/ kha dang 'go dmag rnams rgya dmag la 'jigs pa ga la srid/ 'on kyang gong rim gyi bka' la brtsi bskur zhus te btsan gnon la bzod sgom kho na byas pa zhig yin/de rjes 1958 zla 9 ches 14 nyin bod dmag ka dang sku srung dmag gsum gyi dmag sgar gyi phogs 'bru 'don 'dren du lho kha khul gyi gzhung lam thog ther 239

kha'i nang zhugs te 'gro bskyod tshul mthun byed skabs lho kha'i gtsang chu gling kha'i 'gram nas rgya dmag brgya skor gyis log spyod pa red zer nas mtha' bskor gyis 'dzin bzung thog de rnams rtsed thang rgya mi'i dmag sgar du btsan khrid kyis nyin bdun btson 'jug mnar gcod btang thog khrims gcod dang dri ba mang po blangs zhing nyin re chu 'khol phor pa gang re las ma sprad pas ma shi tsam du phyir log gtong skabs ther khe dang / rta bza' nyal sogs tshang ma gtsang 'phrog byas 'dug lo de'i zu ba 10 ches 15 nyen kha dang dmag bzhi rtse pho brang gsham gyi bod gzhung dmag spyi khang gi go mdzod nas lha sar phyir log yong skabs g.yu thog zam pa'i 'gram nas rgya mi'i dmag mi gcig dang kha rtsod shor skabs rgya dmag gis lag mda' bton par brten bod dmag gsum 'u thug thabs zad kyis rang srung gi ched du rgya dmag gis lag mdar lag pa 'ju skabs de'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i rgya dmag mang po yong ste bod dmag bzhi la me mda' 'phangs rkyen bod dmag dbang phyug zer ba de rang sar bsad pa dang / bkris stobs rgyal la mas skyon chen po byung / de min dgra 'dul dang yon tan gnyis 'dzin bzung do dam byas par brten bod gzhung bka' blon sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa nas rgya mir bod dmag de gnyis glod dkrol yong thabs kyi bka' mol thengs mang gnang yang glod dkrol gtong rgyu ltar bzhag bod dmag de gnyis gsod bzung ji byas kyi gnas tshul tsam yang bshad mi 'dugade bzhin skabs der sa gnas gang sa gang du gong gsal gnas tshul ltar rgya mis rang snang gang dran ji snyed cig byas rkyen btsan 'dzul pa dang / btsan gnon myong mkhan bar gyi 'gal che'i rang bzhin je sdug rje zhan du gyur pa'i gnas tshul 'og rgya mis 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog rgya nag pe cing du tshogs 'dur gdan zhu bya rgyu'i skad cha lha 240

sa'i mang tshogs kyi khrod du lhang lhang khyab cing / bod mi dmangs mang che bas gal srid rgya mis gdan zhu byed pa ltar 7gong sa mchog rgya nag tu phebs na rgya nag tu btsan nyar gyi bod du phebs mi chog pa bzo gi red ces yid gdung sems khral chen po byung ba ma zad/gong gsal gnas tshul de dang de lta bu'i 'og rgya phyogs nas nged cag bza' mi gnyis la lta stangs ji yod skor rob tsam gleng na/ 1951 lo nas bzung rgya dpon krang cing u'u dang / krang go hā gnyis sogs kyis ngos bza' mi gnyis la khyed bza' tsho gnyis kyis rgya bod mi rigs kyi mthun sgril dang / mes rgyal la sha zhen gyi bya ba shugs nus dang ldan pa byas te mes rgyal la legs skyes 'bul ba'i mthun rkyen ha cang legs po tshang yod/ krung dbyang dang ma'o kru'u zhis khyed bza' tsho gnyis la thugs re chen po yod/ khyed ga/nyis kyi tu la'i bla ma'i phyag rogs zhu rgyu de ha cang gal chen po yin / khyed gnyis la mkho dgos ji yod kyi bsam tshul thad kur 'don rogs gnang / nga tshos rogs pa byed kyi yin zhes bslab bya'i tshul gyi bslu brid yang yang byas byung /1955 lor nyin zhig krang cing u yis ched mngags mi zhig phran 'bod du btang ba ltar bskyod skabs/ kho pas phun tshogs bkris khyed rang da res nga'i sar khyug tsam 'bod don ni bar lam khams dang mtsho sngon bod rigs sa khul re zung la mi ngan nyung shas kyi mes rgyal la rgyab bltos byas pa dang / rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi bde phan la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul bslangs yod pa de rim bzhin bod rang skyong ljongs kyi sa khul yongs su khyab spel byed bzhin yod pa de la do snang byed dgos/ lhag par du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mtho rim mi sna nyung shas kyis zing 'khrugs bslangs pa der dga' po byed kyi yod pa ma zad/ rgyab bskyor yang byed kyi yod/ khyed rang bza' tsho gnyis nas mi ngan de rnams kyi gtam brjod la rdugs zon byed dgos pa'i thog kho tsho'i g.yo thabs la mgo ma 244

'khor bar dgra gnyen dbye ba gsal po phye dgos/ nga tshos khyed gnyis la re ba chen po byed kyi yod/ dgos mkho gang yod nga la thar kur shod rogs/ khyed kyis shes gsal ltar nga phod la khang pa gsar pa zhig brgyab yod pa de las lhag pa zhig khyed gnyis la rgyag gi yin/ (skabs der bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang tshugs skabs bka' shag nas yab gzhis stag 'tshor gyi gzim shag de gnas skabs rang skyong ljongs tshugs sar g.yar po zhus gshes rgyal yum chen mo nor gling chibs ra'i gzim chung dang / rgya mtsho gzhis gnyis la bzhugs shing / bod gzhung nas phran bza' mi gnyis sdod shag lha sa sne stod pa'i shag tu g.yar po zhus pa'i skabs yin / gal srid khyed gnyis rtsed mo rtse 'dod yod na nga tsho mnyam du rol rtsed rtse na yag po 'dugang tshos khyed gnyis la sems 'khur ha cang chen po byed kyi yod ces zer byung bar phran gyis khyed nas bka' slob gnang ba yag po byung / nga khyed rang gi sar yang yang yong gi yin/ khang pa rgyag rgyu'i thad gnas skabs dgos gal mi 'dug rjes su dgos gal byung na zhu gi yin/ da lta bod gzhung gis gnas skabs g.yar pa'i khang pa de yod ces bshad/de rjes nyin zhig krang go ha yis sar bskyod skabs/ kho pas phran la khyed rang dang krang cing u gnyis bka' mol byung ba de ngas shes kyi yod/ khyod bza' mi gnyis hur thag bya dgos/ dngul ga tshod dgos kyang lha sa mi dmangs dngul khang nas blangs na nga chos ga tshod dgos dgos sprod kyi red/ nga tshos dngul khang gi 'gan 'khur gtso bor mngags yod/ ga dus blangs na yang 'grig ces brjod pa dang chabs cig dngul 'dzin zhig kyang sprad byung / lan du da lta dngul zhu gi min rjes su dgos gal 'byung mtshams zhus chog ces bshad pa yin/phyi lo 1955 dang 57 lo tsam la rgya mis 7gong sa mchog la lha sa'i khul du bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs 'ga' shas kyis gza' nyi ma nam yin 242

mnyam 'dzoms kyis lkog tshogs byed kyi 'dug mi ngan de tsho dang rma nyam du sku srung mda' dpon phun tshogs bkris kyang 'gro gi yod pa 'dra/ de yag po ma red/ tu la'i bla mas sku srung mda' dpon la bka' slob dang bkag 'doms gnang dgos lugs kyi bsam tshul zhus 'dug skabs der rgya mis bod gzhung mtho rim mi sna nyung shas nas gza' nyi ma'i 'du 'dzoms kyi tshogs 'du byas te rgya mer ngo rgol bya phyogs skor gros sdur byed kyi med dam snyam pa'i rdugs pa chen po byas 'dugade sngon lha sa khul du spro seng rol rtsed bya yul gang yang med gshis gza' spen pa'i gung gseng nyin dga' nye blo dkar rnams mnyam 'dzoms byas te rgyan btsugs nas rtsed mo rtsed srol yod pa de/ phyi lo 1951 lor rgya mi bod du 'byor pa nas bzung sngar las dar khyab shugs che byung ste mtho dma' tshang mas rang nyid kyi dngul la zhen chags med pa lta bu'i goms gshis ngan pa rgya yan du khyab nas sngar srol gza' spen pa'i gung gseng de 'dzam gling spyi srol gza' nyi mar sgyur nas dga' nye spyan mched 'khor res mnyam 'dzoms thog sho sbag la rgyan btsugs te rtsed mo rtse gi yod pa'i nang nas rgyan che shos 'dzugs mkhan ni bod gzhung mtho rim mi sna dbang 'dzin nyung shas shig yin/ mi de tshos ha las pa'i rgyan chen po btsugs nas rtsed mo rtse gi yod/skabs re phran yang ngo shes grogs pos mgron 'bod byas pa ltar rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dang / kha dang mda' dpon bkris dpal ra ba sogs kyi nang du rtsed mo rtsod bar 'gro gi yod pa ra brten rgya phyogs nas kho gnyis khams pa log spyod pa dang 'brel ba byed mkhan gtso bo'i gas su rtsis te rdugs pa chen pos dus rtag tu so nyul btsugs yod pa de la rang nyid nas do snang dang bag zon bya rgyu ma byung rung / rgya mis gnad don de chen po zhig tu brtsis nas mi ngan log spyod pa de tshos gza' nyi ma'i 'dzoms tshogs 243

byed pa zhes pa'i ming btags nas rdugs yod mi sna'i bya spyod dang mi su dang 'brel ba byed kyi yod med so lta byed kyi yod 'dug de ni bod kyi gtam dper/ rgya rdugs pas 'phungs/ bod re bas 'phungs zhes pa de don dang mtshungs pa zhig red/dza drag dang sne mang 'dres 'dzing gi skabs der rgya mis btsugs pa'i bod ljongs rgyal gces bud med tshogs pa zhes pa'i 'go khrid yang kung (dmag dpon phan ming gi bza' rla / zhes pa des sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma de nyid la/ phun tshogs bkris kyis mi ngan dang mnyam du rtag tu 'dzoms kyi yod lugs go thos byung ba de yag po ma red/ khyed kyis nges par du bkag 'gog byed dgos/ dgra gnyen gsal 'byed kyi dgongs pa bzhes dgos kyi red/ nga tshos gung khran tang gis dus rgyun du rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi khe phan la thug skabs the tshom spu tsam med par rgyal khab kyi bka' la srung brtsi byas te rang gi snying nye ba yang blos gtong gi red/ khyed tā la'i bla ma'i gcen mo yin pas nga tshos khyed rang la re ba chen po yod/ khyed kyi mdun lam ni 'od zer ldan pa zhig red ces ngo bstod g.yo sgyu'i thabs ngan la brten nas bsam blo'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs sgyur du 'jug rgyu'i bslu 'brid bya rtsis byas 'dug de ni gal srid phran gyis rgya mi'i brjod don bzhin log spyod mi ngan zer ba dang 'brel thag ma bcad na nged bza' mi gnyis 'brel thag bcad na legs tshul gyi go rgyu btang ba zhig yin pa de gung khran gyis dus rgyun du pha ma bu phrug dbar dang / grogs bza' zla'i dbar phan tshun bsam tshul ma mthun pa'i rigs la 'gal rla chen po zos te dkrug shing btsan bskul gyi ngan byus lag bstar bya thabs gtso bo zhig red/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og gal srid rang nyid blo rtsa brtan po med na de'i rgya rnyi'i nang du tshud nas mi che 'di'i ring 'gyod gdung rtas mi zin pa zhig dang / bsam yul las 'das pa'i chag sgo zhig yong rgyu gdon mi za/244

1955 lo zu bzhi pa'i nang bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang gsar 'dzugs rjes sku gcen che ring sgrol ma srid blon gzhon pa hreng yi lhan du pe cing du tshogs 'du zhig la phebs skabs dgong dro zhig srid blon kra'u en les bza' cho gnyis kyis mdza' brtse dang / spro sems 'khol ba'i sne len byas nas kra'u gis/ che ring sgrol ma khyed rang bsam blo rgya chen po gtong thub mkhan phugs re yod pa zhig yin pa nga chos gsal po shes kyi yod/ khyed rang yar thon can zhig yong bar nga tshos rogs ram byed kyi yin/ khyed rang tu la'i bla ma'i gcen mo red/ khyed bza' mi gnyis nas tā la'i bla mar phyag rogs legs par zhu thub pa'i re ba chen po yod/ khyed nas 'jigs snang nam yang byed mi dgos/ krung dbyang nas dus rtag tu khyed gnyis kyi rgyab tu langs kyi yod/ rlabs chen mes rgyal gyis bod ljongs rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi bde skyed 'tsho ba 'dzugs bskrun byed ched dka' tshogs la 'jigs zhum med par hur brtson dang yar thon yong rgyur 'bad brtson bya dgos/ slad bod ljongs kyi 'gan de khyed bza' mi gnyis kyi phrag par 'khur dgos/ rang re'i rgyal yongs bud med 'go khrid khong rnams kyis skyed la spro sems 'khol ba'i sems 'khur dang re ba chen po bcol gyi yod ces skad cha 'di shod skabs kra'u an les khong gi bza' rla teng ying khra'o mdzub mo btsugs nas / phyin cha da khyed kyi bsam tshul ji yod teng ying khra'o la gsungs rogs gnang / khong gis gang ci'i thad khyed rang la phyag rogs zhu gi redaces bshad 'dugasrid blon kra'u en le'i byams brtse'i gtam des nged bza' mi gnyis mgo bo mongs su bcug pa lta bus nged cag bod yul de lha yul lta bu zhig tu 'gyur gyi med dam snyam pa'i re stong 'khrul snang byung myong /phyi lo 1958 11 ches 30 nyin phyi dro grogs po zhol khang thub bstan 245

nyi ma sku srung dmag sgar du nged rang thug 'phrad du slebs byung / bar lam ngos gnyi sa lhod 'phrad ma byung bar lo gcig lhag tsam song ba de ring khong glo bur du nga'i sar phebs par ya mtshan phran bu skyes byung / de sngon khong phran gyi sar yang yang phebs pa ma zad/nyin ma mang po kho bo'i shag tu bzhugs myong yod/ de'i dgong mo khong lhod lhod byas nas bzhugs te nged gnyis sngar bzhin phan tshun gyi bsam tshul shod dgos zhes gros gzhi lta bu bton/ khong ni 'jon thang che ba'i na gzhon yid smon skye dgos pa zhig yod/ de sngon rgya mi bod du ma slebs gong khong nas nub phyogs kyi dmangs gtso'i ring lugs la ha cang mos po byed pa ma zad/ rgya gar de dbyin ji'i 'og nas rang btsan thob pa de la dga' mos chen po byed cing / rang re bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khab 'di yang deng rabs can gyi rang dbang rang btsan gtsang ma yong thabs la re ba chen po byed pa dang / bod gzhung gi lam lugs rnying pa de dang mtho rim dbang 'dzin par lkog nas skyon brjod byed mkhan zhig yin par brten/ bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs gas zhig yin na yang / khong gi lta spyod rna mas bod gzhung dbang 'dzin pa'i spyan lam du mi 'jug pas gnad yod las 'gan gang yang sprad ma song /phyi lo 1951 lo rgya dmar gyis bod ljongs yongs su dbang sgyur byas rjes/khong bod mi na gzhon rnams la spyi mtshungs gung khran ring lugs kyi rba rlabs des g.yo 'gul chen po 'thebs te khong gis 'khrugs cha chen po'i thog nas krung gung bod ljongs rgyal gces na gzhon sde tshogs zhes pa gsar 'dzugs nyin khong la gzhon nu sde tshogs kyi kru'u rin gzhon pa ang gnyis pa 'dems bsko byas/ nyin de nas bzung / sngon chad bag med longs spyod kyi rtsed dgar rol ba'i mi drag gi sras de mar khe ring lugs dang /ma'o rtse tung gi bsam blor dga' mos shin tu chen po byed mkhan zhig tu gyur song / dus 246
