yun de tsam ma song bar gung khran tang gi rjes snon tang mi'i gras su zhugs/ rnam kun gung khran tang gi khrims srol ltar na/ tang dang rgyal khab la byas rjes chen po 'jog thub mkhan zhig min phyin gral rim mi sna'i bu phrug tsho gung khran tang nang zhugs chog gi med kyang rgya mi'i zer skad la/ bod kyi gnas tshul de dmigs bsal can zhig yin pas bod kyi mi drag gi bu phrug yin na yang mes rgyal la sha zhen dang / mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon/ bsam blo yar thon bcas yin na gung khran tang gi nang du zhugs pa'i cha rkyen bskrun gyi yod cing / gang ltar rgya mi'i kha nyan yo byad cig yin na/ na gzhon gang 'dra zhig yin na'ang gral rim la dbye ba med par bar brga la gyi dus su bed spyod byed rgyu'i srid byus de lag bstar byed kyi 'dugade'i dgong dro khong gis/ grogs po khyed kyis mes rgyal la rgyab ltos byed mkhan mi ngan 'ga' shas kyi mgo bskor 'og ma tshud par rdugs zon bya rgyu gal chen po yin/nged gnyis lo mang song ba'i grogs po yin pas/ grogs po'i 'du shes kyi bsam pas ma bzod par khyed la gnas tshul zhu gi yod/ nga tsho'i mtho rim mi sna nyung shas dang / shes yon med pa'i mi dmangs nyung shas kyis lho kha khul du khams pa nyung shas de tshor re ba bcol ba de ha cang nyen kha chen po zhig yin pas/ de ni rang nyid 'phung ba'i rgyu las ma 'das/ phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab bam/ yang na rgya gar rgya bskyed ring lugs sogs kyis bod rang btsan bya rgyur rogs ram bya rgyu shin tu dka'/ gang yin zer na/ krung go rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs de sngon chad kyi man ju srid gzhung dang / go min tang rul sung can de 'dra ma yin par krung go gsar pa de stobs dang ldan pa zhig yin stabs 'dzam gleng yongs kyi rgyal khab tshos de la brtsi bkur byed kyi yod/ lhag par bcings 'grol dmag dpa' mdzangs brtul phod kyi ngar shugs de ni de sngon nga tsho bod mi'i zer srol du 247

yod pa'i lha dmag dang mtshungs pa zhig yod pas kho chos chu chod 'ga' shas sam/nyin ma gcig gnyis de las 'gyangs na bdun phrag gcig ma 'gor bar log spyod khams pa rtsa med bzo rgyur the tshom med/ rang cag bod du snga rabs nas 'phros lus bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyis lam lugs de bsgyur bkod gtong dgos/ lo rgyus kyi 'gro phyogs de g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin pas spyi tshogs kyi bcos sgyur nges par du bya dgos/ da bar krung dbyang nas bzod sgom chen po gnang gi yod pa red/ 'on kyang bzod sgom bya rgyu de mtshams chig med pa zhig ma yin/ grogs po khyed rang rgyal ba rin po che'i gnyen 'brel mi sna zhig yin pa ma zad/ sku srung mda' dpon gyi 'gan 'khur yod pas 7rgyal ba'i sku phyu srung rgyu gal 'gang shin tu che/ krung dbyang nas khyed la brtsi mthong shin tu chen po gnang gi yod pa de ngas phran bu shes kyi yod/ ngas grogs por sha tsha'i thog nas zhu gi yod/ 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phyu'i nyen srung la 'thus shor med pa gnang dgos zhes bshad byung bar phran gyis grogs pos bslab bya byas par dga' po zhe drag byung / ngas mi ngan dang ngan 'brel byas rigs med la da phan do snang yang ma byung / rjes su sems la bzhag gi yin/ khyed kyi gsungs gsal ltar nga rang gi las 'gan de ngas shes kyi yod/7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phywa srung 'doms bya rgyu de bod mi tshang mar 'gan yod pa red/grogs po khyed rang thugs blo bde po gnang rogs gnang / ngas dus dang rnam pa kun tu lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs 'degs zhu rgyur 'gyur ba med/ rgya mi bod la yong nas da bar las ka yag po mang po byas yod pa der nga tshos bstod bsngags byed 'os pa zhig red/ 'on kyang bar lam zhig nas bod mi dmangs kyi blo dang ma 'tshams pa'i gnas tshul yang mang po byung yod/ gnas tshul de la brten nas mdo smad sa khul gyi rang rigs spyan zu rnams kyis rgya mir zhen log byas nas ngo rgol gyi las 'gul nang zhugs yod/248

khyed kyi mkhyen gsal ltar/ de sngon 1949 lo nas 1951 lo bar rgya mi smad phyogs nas bod dbus phyogs su yong skabs smad phyogs kyi bod mi tshos rgya mir re ba chen po bcol ba'i thog dga' bsu dang rogs ram yang gang thub byas yod cing / dang thog rgya mi yong skabs de khul mi dmangs tshos gnas dus tshod rtsis kyi bod gzhung la rgyab gtod kyi rnam 'gyur mang po bstan yod/1951 lor gros mthun bzhag nas bcings 'grol dmag dbus gtsang khul du bde blag tu yong thub pa des bod gzhung ngam/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis gros mthun bzhag pa nas bzung gang thub ci thub kyi rogs ram byas pa dang / las 'gan rnams bsgrubs yod pa de khyed kyis mkhyen gsal red/ 'on kyang srid tshab gnyis nas rgyal gces kyi dpa' sems zhum pa med pas rgya mir dge skyon 'thab rgol gnang rkyen mtha' ma khong gnyis dgongs pa zhu dgos byung 'dug de nas bod mi tshos sngar las lhag pa'o rgya mir zhen log gi ngo rgol gyi las 'gul gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyi byung yod/khyed kyis gsungs gsal ltar nga chos khams rigs nyung shas la re bcol byas na nor 'khrul yin pa de dngos 'grel red/ de dag zhi 'jam thabs mkhas kyis 'gugs thabs byed thub na yag po min nam snyam pa las drag po lag len bstar na nyes med kyi mi dmangs mang po sdug bsngal tshad las 'das pa myongadagos kyi red ces bshad pa yin/nyin de nas bzung nged gnyis phan tshun gyi gnas tshul gang yang shes rtogs ma byung bar lus song /smras pa//'jig rten lta ba mthun pa'i 'o mtsho'i nang //lar rgya'i chu rgyun gcig tu 'dres na yang /249
da rbe'irgya

sa bcad drug pa/le tshan nyer bdun pa/bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod rang btsan slar gso'i btsan rgol gyi las 'gul langs pa/༄༅༅/ /bod rgya gnyis kyi 'gal ba je cher gyur cing / bod kyi sa khul yongs su bkra mi shis pa'i rtags mtshan ji snyed cig byung ba dper na/ rgya dmar dbus gtsang gi sa sner btsan 'dzul ma byas sngon tsam dwags kong sa khul du sa g.yos shugs chen byung ba dang / phyi lo 1954 zla 5 ches 15 nyin rgyal rtse rdzong khongs nye ro'i phu nas mtsho brdol te rgyal rtse mnga' khul myang chu'i chu lam 'khel yul la chu log gis sa khang mi phyugs tshad las 'das par gegs skyon tshabs chen byung ba/ lha sa jo khang gi yang thog gser zangs rgya phebs kyi chu srin kha nas chu don pa/ skar ma du ba mjug ring shar ba/1959 lo bod rla dang po'i tshos gnyis nyin sku srung dmag sgar du rgyal dar bslangs nas chu tshod gcig song rjes/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub langs nas rgyal dar gyi lcags hreng chag mi shes par dum bru gsum du hrag chag song ba/ sku srung ru dpon dang po / ming 'dogs la khrung khrung zer ba de rgyu mtshan gang yang med par rang mda' 'phangs nas rkyen lam du song ba bcas la 'go dmag tshang mas ya mtshan dogs 'dregs kyis bla lhar thugs dam 251

bka' lung zhus pa'i phyir phebs su/ bod gzhung gi chab srid la ha cang 'tshub cha chenapo yod lugs spyi mtshungs dang / de'i bzlog thabs zhabs rim gang mang bsgrub dgos lugs phebs/lo der 7gong sa mchog gi sngar srol bod kyi lo gsar mdzad sgo grub rjes lha sa gtsug lag khang du chibs sgyur gyis/ phyi lo 1959 bod rla dang po'i cho 'phrul smon lam dus chen skabs lha sa gtsug lag khang du gdan sa chen po gsum gyi lung rigs smra ba'i dge 'dun nyis khri lhag tsam gyi dbus su 7gong sa mchog nas mtshan nyid kyi gzhung chen bka' pod lngar gsan bzhes mthar phyin gnang ste lha ram dam bca'i mtshan bzhes kyis mdzad sgo skyong bzhin pa'i skabs/ nyin gcig rgya dpon than kon san gyis las rogs dmag dpon khyen ming yi zhes pa de gtsug lag khang yang steng gi gzim chung du 7gong sa mchog gi mjal khar bcar nas tā la'i bla ma'i chos kyi mdzad sgo legs grub byung bar bkris bde legs zhu bar ched brdzong byas byung zhes dang / 7gong sa mchog la nye char bod dmag khul khang gi dmag spyi gzhon pa teng hra'u tung gis rtse dgu gtor nyin tā la'i bla ma mjal 'phrad skabs bar lam bod dmag khul khang gi chos gar tshogs pa de rgya nag tu slob sbyong legs grub zin nas phyir 'khor byung bar tu la'i bla ma dmag khul khang du gzigs mor gdan zhus kyi ches cha de ring zhal gsal yong ba zhes zhu dgos lugs dmag dpon than kon san gyis mngags byung zhes zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas nyin shas rjes nor gling du phyir 'khor mtshams lan gsal sprad 'thus zhes bka'aganang /gnas tshul de'i thog yong rkyen gong du 'khod pa ltar/ rtse dgu gtor nyin lo ltar 'char can rgya phyogs kyi dpon rigs khag gdan zhu byed srol yod pa ltar 1958 252

lor bod sa khyi zu 13 ches 29 de nyin dmag dpon teng hra'u tung dang de'i las rogs su krung gung bod sdod las don u yon lhan khang gi drung che ku'o zhi lan dang skad bsgyur bcas 'cham mjal du slebs pa'i thog 7gong sa chen po'i mjal khar bcar skabs dmag dpon teng hra'u tung gis/ bar lam bod dmag khul khang gi zlos gar tshogs pa khren tur slob sbyong byas nas phyir 'khor de rnams kyi 'khyab ston ha cang yag po yod lugs dang / der tu la'i bla mas nges par du thugs zhib gnang dgos/ nga tshos bod dmag khul khang du gra sgrig zhu gi yin pas nges par chibs sgyur gnang thub na legs tshul sogs zhus par 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog nas lha ldan gtsug lag khang du smon lam dam bca' ma grub bar khom gyi mi 'dug pas de rjes dus skabs gang 'os la lan gsal sprad 'thus zhes bka' gnang yod pa red/7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang / ngos kyi mi mang / zhes pa'i mdzad rnam shog grangs 191 nang rgyugs sprod kyi mdzad sgo de dag gi brel stabs su gnas pa'i nyin zhig rgya mi'i las byed pa gnyis nas phran thug 'phrad dgos tshul zer/ khong gnyis las byed che gras min zhing / dmag dpon than kon san gyi btang lugs zer gyi 'dug khong nas rgya mi'i dmag sgar nang zlos gar zhig ston rgyu'i gra sgrig byas pa ltar/ dus tshod gtan 'khel byed dgos zer/ de'i skor spyir btang gi gros gleng zhig nyin 'ga'i sngon byung zhes gsal/ de bzhin rgya phyogs nas 'grems spel byas pa'i bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha 'dems sgrigs/ 'don thengs gsum pa'i shog grangs 33 nang lha klu tsho dbang rdo rjes sa khyi bod zu 13 ches 39 nyin 'char can rtse dgu gtor 'cham gzigs la krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang gi 'go khrid rnams gdan zhus ltar 253

phebs te tu la'i bla ma dang mjal 'phrad gnang skabs ltad mo'i skor bka' mol byung zhor/ deng sang cun chus la yang blos gar gsar pa 'khyab ston byed kyi yod pas tu la'i bla ma gzigs mor phebs zhus par/ tā la'i bla mas nga bod rla dang po'i nang lha sa smon lam chen mor chos kyi mdzad sgo yod stabs smon lam tshar 'phral yong gi yin zhes gsungs pa red/ de nyin spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang nas de skor bka' shag la bshad song zhes gsal 'dug par gnas tshul de'i skor lha klu che dbang rdo rjes blo gzu bor gnas pa'i sgo nas don dngos cung zad zhig bris pa de lo rgyus kyi bden don dpang po zhig tu gyur zhing / skabs der dmag dpon gzhon pa teng hra'u tung ma gtogs dachag dpon than kon san slebs yod pa ma red/1988 che 10 ches 17 nyin gyi lha sa rlung 'phrin du nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis bris pa'i gal che'i rtsom yig ces pa rgya phyogs nas brgyud bsgrags byas pa de'i nang don dngos rdzun bzo dang lo rgyus 'khyog bshad mang dag cig byas 'dug pa de ni nga phod rang nyid kyi chab srid dgos mkho'i ched du yin pa'i rtsom yig de'i rdzun rkub lha klus gsal rjen du brtol 'dugaskabs der rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gdan zhu byed don skor 7gong sa mchog gis dbus pa'i bka' shag dang / sku bcar gnad yod mang che bar rnam rtog dang rdugs pa byung med/ 'on kyang skabs der lha khul gnas sdod rgya mi'i zhi drag las byed rnams dmag sar slebs pa nang bzhin nyin mtshan dus drug drag chas spras nas sdod pa dang /phyogs mtshungs phan tshun dmag snon yang yang 'byor ba bcas byed pa ma zad/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gtsug lag khang du bzhugs ring gtsug lag khang gi nye 'khor lho ngos rgya mi'i las khungs khag gi yang thog dang / sge'u khung bcas su phad khog nang bye ma blugs te 254

'dzing rags brtsigs nas de'i e khung nang nas me mda'i kha gtsug lag khang du bsdigs ra sprad kyi yod par brten bod zu dang po'i ches bco lnga'i nyin snga dro 'char can cho 'phrul smon lam mdzad chen du gsung chos ra bar 7gong sa mchog chibs sgyur gyis sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs rjes dran gyi gsung chos gnang srol yod pa ltar/ chibs sgyur gnang rgyur tshang mas blos 'gan mi bzod par brten/ mdzad sgo de phyir 'then gnang dgos byung ba red/ dper na/ gsung chos gnang yul gsung chos ra ba dang / rgya mi'i las khungs bar gyi bar thag mi ṭar 13 nas 15 yas mas tsam las med pa'i nyen kha che/cho 'phrul smon lam thog gra bskor mtshan bzhes kyi mdzad sgo grub rjes 7gong sa ṭī la'i bla ma mchog nor gling pho brang du chibs bsgyur chen mo'i lam bzhin phebs blos bzod dang bzod min skor mgron che pha lha sogs 'brel yod rnams bka' bsdur mang po gnang mthar/ chi bas sgyur sngar bzhin gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel te 7gong sa mchog phebs byam dang / chibs zhabs rnams rta hrag gis phebs par de nyin bod mi bsam yod tshang mar blo g.yeng shin tu chen po byung rung / 'gal rkyen gang yang med par nor gling du bde phebs mdzad/ de'i gnangs nyin rgya phyogs nas spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang blo bzang rig 'dzin sar rgya mi'i las byed btang ste tu la'i bla ma gzigs mor phebs rgyu'i ches grangs gang myur gtan 'khel yong ba zhes ched mngags zhabs skul thengs gsum zhus pa ma zad/ kha par thog la yang thengs 'ga' shas zhus yod pa red/phyi lo 1959 zla 3 ches 9 nyin snga dro chu tshod drug pa tsam la kho bo malalas langs tshar tsam zhig la sku srung dmag sgar gyi sgo 'gram du rgya mi'i las byed gnyis mo ṭa 'jib 'khor zhig khrid de kho bo thug 'phrad du yong lugs lan 'byor bar rgya mi de 255

gnyis kyi nang nas gcig ni rnam kun ngo shes pa 'thab phyogs gcig 'gyur gyi las byed shus hun shi dang / cig shos de dmag khul khang gi las byed yin pa kho gnyis kyis khyed rang da lta bod dmag khul khang du yong rogs zhes teng phu si ling yon / (dmag spyi gzhon pa teng hra'u tung / dang / phu'u tshan mo krang rnam gnyis kyis sang nyin tu la'i bla ma bod dmag khul khang du gzigs mor phebs kyi yod pas phebs sgrigs zhu stangs skor khyed rang la go bsdur zhu ched dmag sgar du 'bod par btang byung zhes zer nas/ khong gnyis mnyam du lam seng yong rogs zhes u tshugs byed kyi 'dug pas/ skabs der rang nyid mal las langs tshar tsam dang / khrus kyang rgyag rgyu yin par brten khong gnyis la tog tsam thug rogs / ngas lam seng 'khrud rgyab te ja 'thung nas mnyam du 'gro zhes brjod par/ khong gnyis kyis/ da lta rang phebs na ma gtogs khong tsho sgug nas bzhugs yod/ lam seng phebs dgos zhes brjod byung / phran gyis de 'dra yin na khyed gnyis sngon la 'gro rogs/ngas lam seng 'khrud rgyab nas slebs yong mo ṭa gar yod ces bshad par/ khong gnyis lam seng phyir log byas rjes kho bos 'khrud rgyab nas zhog ja dkar yol gang btung tsam la yang bskyar 'bod par slebs byung ba de gnyis mnyam du dmag khul khang du bskyod skabs dmag dpon teng hra'u tung dang / phu'u tshan mo krang gnyis kho bo sgug nas bsdad 'dug kho gnyis kyis phran mthong ma thag rlung 'tshub 'tshub kyi rnam 'gyur bstan thog sang nyin tu la'i bla ma cun chus su bod dmag khul khang phebs rgyu yin pa khyed rang gis shes ma byung nga ma/ de ring khyed rang skad btang nas gra sgrig byed stangs skor go bsdur bya rgyu yin/ tā la'i bla ma bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tshogs 'dur phebs skabs khyed rang gis dmag mi sku srung du khrid pa nang bzhin da res cun chus la phebs dus khrid na 'grigs kyi ma red ces nan po bshad byung bar/ phran gyis rnam kun tu la'i bla ma sa gnas gar 256

phebs la sku srung dmag mi nyi shu nas sum cu'i bar bcar gyi yod/ da res cun chus su phebs skabs nges par du sku srung bcar na ma gtogs 'grigs thabs med/ gal srid sku srung ba ma btang ba yin na bod mi mang rnams kyis bsam 'char dang / skyon 'dzugs mang po yong gi red/ lar nas hā la'i bla ma cun chus la phebs rgyu'i ches grangs sang nyin thugs gtan 'khel ba nga 'bod mi gnyis kyis shod dus ma gtogs shes ma byung zhes lab par/ khong gnyis de bas rlung 'tshub che ru phyin te / khyed rang tu la'i bla ma'i sku srung mda' dpon gyi las 'gan yod pas tā la'i bla ma phebs rgyu'i skor ma shes pa ga 'dra yin nam/ spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang gis khyed la bshad ma byung ngam/ de 'dra gang yin nam/ zhes zer bar kho bos da lta bka' gnang ma byung yang phal cher de ring bko' gnang gi red ces bshad pa yin/nam rgyun yin na dmag dpon phu'u tshan mo krang de blo bag yangs po dang / chang rag la dga' po/ kha shob shod rgyur dga' ba bcas yin zhing / nga tsho bod kyi dmag dpon rnams dang 'brel 'dris chen po yod/ da res kho pas/ ngo gdong smug nag bsdus shing 'jigs skul gyi rnam 'gyu ra bstan nas rnam kun gyi mi de ma yin par lta bur gyur 'dug kho pas sang nyin tā la'i bla ma phebs rgyu de bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tshogs 'dur phebs pa dang 'dra gi ma red/ da res khyed rang la skad cha kha re kha thug la shod kyi yin/bod rang skyong ljongs kyi tshogs 'dur phebs skabs khyed rang tsho'i dmag mi rnams phebs lam du srung cha 'dzugs pa dang / tshogs 'du 'tshogs yul du khyed rang gi dmag mi gang sa gang du srung byar btsugs kyi yod pa red/ da res de 'dra byas na 'grigs kyi ma red/'di cun chus red/ bod dmag khul khang du tu la'i bla ma dang khong gi zhabs phyi zhu mkhan 'ga' shas ma gtogs sku srung dmag mnyam du 'khrid dgos don mi 'dug pas 'khrid 257

na 'grigs kyi ma red/ srung cha nga tshos zhu gi yin/ de tsho nga tsho'i las 'gan red/ de bzhin phebs lam khag tu khyed rang tsho'i srung cha 'jog mi dgos/ gal srid 'jog dgos na nga tshos bcings bkrol dmag mi 'jog gi yin zhes zer byung bar/ kho bos da lta phu'u tshan mo krang gi gsungs pa de ngas thag gcod thub kyi ma red/ gal srid khyed rang gis gsungs pa nang bzhin lag len bstar na/ bod mi dmangs rnams kyi blo la bab kyi ma red/ bsam tshul mang po yong gi red/ nga'i bsam tshul byas na/ rnam kun tu la'i bla ma bod rang skyong ljongs la phebs pa nang bzhin phebs lam khag tu bod dmag srung cha 'jog rgyu dang / sku srung dmag bcu nyi shu mnyam du 'khrid chog pa byung na yag po 'dugades khyed tshor mdzad dka' gang yang yong gi ma red/ gal srid phebs lam du nga tshos srung cha ma bzhag na deng sang log spyod pa tshos rnyog dra ga re bzos yong shod dka' ba red/mang tshogs tshor yang blo 'tshab yong gi red/ der nga tshos dgongs pa bzhes dgos pa dang / dogs zon gnang dgos rgyu de gal chen po red ces bshad par/ kho pas gal srid phebs lam du srung cha 'jog dgos kyi 'dug na/ rdo zam phan chad ma gtogs bzhag na mi 'grigs/ rdo zam nas dmag sgar bar nga tshos bcings 'grol dmag bzhag gi yin/ de tshun chad mi su zhig kyang yong chog gi ma red/ tā la'i bla ma'i lhan du sku srung dmag khrid dgos don mi 'dug gal srid khrid kyi yin na mi re gnyis khrid na 'grigs/'on kyang go mtshon nam yang 'khyer chog gi ma red/ ces nan bshad byas byung /skabs der kho bo'i bsam par/ gnas tshul de 'dra bod mi dmangs tshos go na blo mi bde ba chags mi yong ngam snyam pa byung / de nas dmag dpon teng hra'u tung gis khong khro de tsam med pa'i thog nas tā la'i bla ma sang nyin phebs rgyu'i go sgrig bya rgyu'i skor da lta phu'u tshan mo krang gis khyed rang la bshad pa de yin/ nga tsho'i dmag khul khang 'di'i 258

nang mi gang byung yong chog gi ma red/ tu la'i bla ma'i srung cha nga tshos khas len gyi yin/khyed rang dogs pa byed mi dgos/ bod mi dmangs tsho yang bsam tshul gang yang yong gi ma red/ gal srid gnas tshul lhag na de ni log spyod mi re zung gis skul slong byed pa zhig red/ sang nyin tā la'i bla ma dang lhan du phebs mkhan khyed tsho ga nad yod dpon rigs bka' blon tsho yod pa khong chos kyang mi res g.yog re ma gtogs 'khrid mi chog pa dang / go mtshon yang 'khyer mi chog pa'i lan sprad yod ces zer/kho bos tā la'i bla ma 'dir phebs skabs sku ngal gso yul dang / gzigs mo gzigs sar khyug tsam lta bskor la 'gro chog pa zhes bshad par/ khong gnyis kyis gsham 'og las byed gcig la mngags te de dang mnyam du sku ngal gso yul dang /gzigs mo gzigs sa bcas par zhib 'jug tu bskyod skabs gra sgrig gang yang med par khang pa'i nang du ca lag dza re dzo re bzhag 'dug par brten rdugs pa sngar bas che ru song ba'i ngang nor gling du phyir log gis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan la zhib phra snyan seng zhus par/ khong dang mnyam du spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang gi sku mdun du snyan seng zhu bar 'gro zhes bka' gnang ste nged gnyis kyis dga' brang la gong gsal gyi gnas tshul rnams snyan seng zhus/ dga' brang gis gnas tshul der thugs snang chen po gnang nas gsan pa'i thog skabs re tshig gnad re zung yang nas yang du rdugs 'ji mdzad/ de nas khong gis gnas tshul de ha cang dza drag dang /nyen kha chen po chags rgyu yin gshis blos 'gan bzod min la nga tsho gsum 7gong sa chen po'i sku mdun du snyan zhur bcar dgos kyi 'dug ces gsungs te lam seng yar bzhengs nas nga tsho gsum gzim chung du snyan zhur bcar/spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang gis gong gsal gnas tshul rnams zhib cing phra ba 259

snyan seng zhu gnang mdzad song / kho bos kyang mgo nas mjug bar gyi gnas tshul ji byung skor dang / dmag dpon gnyis kyi rnam 'gyur ston stangs/ gzigs mo gzigs sa dang sku ngal gso yul gyi gnas tshul ji mthong bcas kyi skor chad lhag med pa snyan seng zhus/7gong sa mchog nas gnas tshul rnams gsan nas dgongs pa yud tsam bzhes te/ de 'dra'i sdug po e yong / sang nyin 'gro rgyu rang byas na ma gtogs 'grigs kyi e yod ces bka' gnang byung / nga tsho gsum nas da res rgya mes dmag sgar du gdan 'dren zhu stangs dang / nam rgyun dang mi 'dra ba'i phebs lam khag la bod dmag srung cha 'jog mi dgos pa dang / de bzhin sku srung dmag mi khrid mi chog pa / gal srid khrid na go mtshon 'khyer mi chog pa bcas zer tshul la gzhigs na/ rdugs pa skyes dgos pa zhig chags kyi 'dug zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas de 'dra'i rdugs pa byed dgos e yong / phyin na skyon e yong / dga' brang gi sang nyin 'di nas rgya mi'i dmag sgar du 'gro rgyu'i skor 'brel ba da mus bzhin byed dgos zhes bka' gnang song ba ltar sang nyin 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du dus thog phebs rgyu'i thag gcod gnang ba red/de nas kho bo gzim chung nas thon rjes sku srung dmag sgar du sang nyin chibs bsgyur gyi phebs lam khag dang / chibs zhabs sku srung dmag re zung khrid phyogs skor go sgrigs bya rgyur phyir log skabs gzim chung ltag sgo'i phyir sku sger yig tshang gi las bya mkhan chung rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin 'phrad de khong gis gnas tshul go thos su sang nyin 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gzigs mor gdan 'dren zhu gi yod lugs zer 'dug pas sku ngo khyed rang la sku srung mda' dpon gyi las 'gan yod pa ma zad/7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku'i nye 'brel gyi gras yin pas sku phya'i 'gan chen po yog red/gnas tshul de dngos 'brel yin na nyen kha chen po red/ de khyed rang gis mkhyen gyi yod 260

shag zha sgo gang cir gzab gzab gnang dgos kyi 'dag ces gsungs par/ kho bos da 4 ༄ 4 4 4 ༄ 4 stonang zhags pa rgya mi'i dmag sgar du 'bad pa' skar dang / skad cha ja byung bcas rab tsam zhus pa'i skabs der rtse mgron ye shes lhun grub dang / rtse mgron bar zhi ngag dbang bstan skyong gnyis kyang nged gnyis gleng mol byed sa der phebs nas gong gsal gnas tshul de gsan pa'i thog khong rnam gsum gyis sang nyin 7gong sa chen po rgya mi'i dmag sgar du rtsa ba nyid nas phebs rgyu mi 'dug de ha cang nyen kha chen po red/ bar lam rgya mis mdo smad sa khul gyi bla chen khag dang / mi sna grags can khag la mgron 'bod yin tshul gyis mgo bskor bslu brid thog 'dzin bzung byas pa ji snyed byung yod stabs nges par du dogs zon byed dgos kyi 'dug nye lam lha sa'i mang tshogs kyi khrod du rgya mis 7gong sa chen po pe cing du tshogs 'du zhig la gdan 'dren zhu rtsis yod lugs kyi gnas tshul lhang lhang go rgyu 'dug gal srid sang nyin rgya mi'i dmag sgar du phebs na gnas tshul ji yong shod khag po red/ da lta nga chos rtse mkhan mgron pha lha mchog gi sku mdun du bcar nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po sang nyin rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs bsgyur mi mdzad pa zhes snyan seng zhu bar phebs dgos zhes gsungs pa'i mur rtse phyag mkhan chung rgyal mtshan lags kyi nga tsho 'dzoms sar phebs nas gong bzhin bsam tshul shugs che bton te de nas nga tsho pha lha'i sku mdun du bcar te khong tshos 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs sgyur gnang thabs med lugs skor nan che zhus song bar pha lhas sku zhabs khyed rnam pas dgongs 'char gsungs pa de dngos 'brel red/ khyed tsho da lta sku ngo spyi khyab mkhan po'i sku mdun du snyan seng zhu bar bcar na yag po 'dug ces bka' slob gnang don ltar/ tshang mas spyi mkhan dga' brang gi sku mdun du bcar te gong gsal gnas tshul snyan seng zhus par/ skabs der phan tshun bsam tshul go rtogs ma mthun 2rmye

par cung zad rtsod gleng byung yang mtha' don go rtogs sel thub pa dang / tshang ma'i zhu don snying po de sang nyin 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs bsgyur ma gnang rogs gnang / gal srid chibs sgyur gnang na nyen kha chen po red/ gdan 'dren zhus na rtsa ba nas 'grigs kyi mi 'dug ces nan po zhus par/ spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang gis de'i skor 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus na ma gtogs nga tsho mi gcig gnyis kyi thag chod kyi ma red/ mgron che pha lha dang sku srung mda' dpon gnyis kyang mnyam du snyan seng zhu bar yong dgos zhes bka' gnang ste dga' brang / pha lha/ phran bcas nga tsho yang bskyar gzim chung du bcar nas khong tsho'i bsam tshul ji bshad skor snyan seng zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog nas sang nyin 'gro rgyu khas len byas zin par 'gyur ba btang shes e yong de 'dra rang nyen kha e yod/ khong tshor sems 'tshab dang zang zing ma byed ces lan sprod/sang nyin 'gro na yag gi red ces thug thag bcad pa'i bka' gnang ba ltar/ sang nyin chibs bsgyur gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba red/de nas sku ngo rnam gnyis kyis 7gong sa mchog nas bka' gnang ba'i dgongs don rnams khong tshor brgyud bsgrags gnang song bar/ khong tshos de ni blos 'gan mi bzod pa'i dza drag gi gnas tshul zhig yin pas gcig gis gcig la lan sprad de gnas tshul de de nyin rang lha sa yongs su khyab rkyen sang nyin snga dro lha sa'i mi dmangs rnams nor gling gzim sgo'i 'gram du yong ste glo bur 'ur zing langs pa las/ dang thog nas 'char gzhi yod pa zhig ma red/ 'on kyang bar lam nas mi dmangs rnams kyis rgya mi'i byed stangs la blo rdugs chen po yod mus thog de'i dgong dro rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs sgyur gyi gnas tshul thos pa red/ lha sa khul gyi mi mang rnams la bzod thabs bral ba'i sems 'tshab chen po byung /262

de nyin kho bo sku srung dmag sgar du phyir log rjes ru brgya rnams dza drag gis bskong tshogs byas te da nang zhogs pa rgya mi'i dmag sgar du bskyod pa'i skor khong rnams la gses bkrol zhus par ru brgya rnams kyi rgya mi'i shod tshul la blo ma bde ba'i dogs pa chen po skyes kyang 'di byed 'di min gyi gnas tshul su zhig gis kyang shod dka' ba byung /sang nyin snga dro 7gong sa chen po chibs bsgyur ma gnang sngon sku srung dmag grangs brgya lhag tsam phebs lam khag tu zhi chas spras te mang tshogs khrod du gtong rgyu'i srung cha bkod sgrig byas/ de bzhin dmag sgar kha nga cha gsum mda' dpon rnams la sang nyin snga dro 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs bsgyur gnang gi yod pa'i gnas tshul gong rim dmag spyi khang nas bka' khyab gnang yod shag kyang / gal po che la nan tan gyi dpe ltar/ phebs lam khag tu dus thog srung cha zhu phyogs 'phyugs med dgos skor khungs so sor bang mi ched brdzong byas/de'i dgong mo rnam kun ltar kha khu sem bu yin kyang sems nang 7gong sa mchog sang nyin rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs bsgyur gyis nyen kha che ba'i gnas tshul ji 'dra yong snyam dngangs skrag gis gnyid ji bzhin ma khug pa'i ngang nam langs pa dang sbrags thag ring nas khyi skad dang bya skad mi skad bcas kyi sgra thos mur/ nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu yod pa'i sku srung sdod cha brgya dpon srid dar phun tshogs kyis dza drag gi kha par zhig btang 'byor la/ da lta lha sa nas mi dmangs mang po skad cor rgyag bzhin par nor gling gzhung sgo'i phyir 'dzoms nas mi tshogs je mang du gyur bzhin yod pa de rnams kyis nor gling pho brang nang yar 'dzul rtsis byed kyi 'dug pa da lta gzhung sgo brgyab nas phyir bkag 'doms byas yod/ de skor ji 'gab bka' lan 'phral mar gnang skyong zhes dza drag gi gnas tshul de 'byor par gzim sgo rnams phye thal ma byed / gnas tshul de sku ngo spyi khyab 263

mkhan po mchog dang / rtse mkhan mgron pha lha rnam gnyis la lam seng snyan seng zhu dgos pas/ da dung gnas tshul ji byung skor skabs 'phral snyan seng zhu dgos zhes mngags pa'i thog ru dpon dang po sreg shing pa blo bzang don grub lam seng gzhung sgor rtog zhib tu ched btang byas/ de mtshams kha dang mda' dpon bkras dpal rdo rje che brtan dang / bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub/ nga dang mda' dpon mdo mkhar bsod nams stobs rgyal/cha dang mda' dpon 'jun pa ngag dbang dpal mo bcas khong bzhi glo bur du sku srung dmag sgar du phebs 'byor gyis/ 7gong sa mchog de ring rgya mi'i dmag sgar du phebs rgyu mi 'dug lha zhol gnyis nas mi dmangs chu lud pa ltar nor gling du yong bzhin 'dugakha sa dmag spyi khang gi bka' khyab dang / khyed rang gi lan 'byor ba ltar phebs lam du nyen zon dang ru sgrig zhu rgyu bcas go sgrig byas yod/ da nangs lha zhol mi mang 'ur ba'i gnas tshul de thos ma thag nga tsho bzhi khyed rang la go bsdur zhu bar yong ba yin/ gal srid 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gnang na mi dmangs rnams nas phebs lam du phyag 'tshal nas phebs su 'jug gi ma red/ da ji 'dra zhus na legs zhes gros bsdur byed pa'i skabs mkhan mgron pha lha mchog nas kho bo 'phral du nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gram du yong dgos zhes bka' 'byor ba ltar bcar skabs khong gis gzhung sgo'i phyir mi dmangs je mang du 'dzoms bzhin yod stabs nor gleng phyogs bzhi'i gzhung sgo khag la srung cha dmag mi mang du gtong rgyu dang / mi gang byung su zhig phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed ma 'jug pa dgos zhes bka' gnang ba ltar khungs so sor bkod mngags byas/ skabs der gzhung sgo'i phyir mi dmangs 'du 'dzoms byed bzhin 'dug da dung lha zhol gnyis nas gzhung lam brgyud mu mthud mi mang po rgyugs yong ba dang / mi 'ga' shas kyi lag tu gri dang dbyug pa yang 'khyer 'dug skabs der lha sa nas bka' blon shan kha 'gyur med bsod 264

nams stobs rgyal dang / sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa rnam gnyis nor gling du phebs/de'i rjes tshotsam la bka' blon bsam pho che dbang rig 'dzin yang lha sa nas nor gling gzhung sgo'i mdun phyogs phebs skabs der yod mi dmangs tshos mtha' bskor nas 'jib 'khor gtong mkhan rgya mi yin pa dang / bsam pho rang yang rgya mi'i phu'u si len yon te/ dmag spyi gzhon pa'i go gnas yod stabs rgya mi'i sku srung zhig gi me mda' 'khyer yod pa mthong ste mi dmangs kyis rdo zhus pa de bsam pho'i dbu la phog snye mas skyon byung / skabs der gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu yod pa'i gzhung zhabs 'ga' shas kyis mthong ste lam seng bka' blon bsam pho'i sar rgyugs phyin nas 'jib 'khor nang du bzhag ste de'i nye 'gram bde skyed gling kha'i rgya gar don byed las khungs kyi sman khang du 'phral skyob byed par gdan zhu byas kyang ring min rgya mis rgya'i sman khang du blangs 'dugade'i rjes tsam la bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs nor gling du phebs skabs gzhung sgo'i phyir mi dmangs 'dus 'dzoms che ba gzigs 'phral chab 'go zam pa'i nye 'gram nas mo ṭar bshol te zhabs thang mar mi mang la gus 'dzum ston bzhin phebs par/ der yod mi dmangs rnams kyi khrod nas 7rgyal ba rin po che rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gdan 'dren ma zhu rogs gnang zhes skad 'bod byed pa dang / yang mi 'ga' shas kyis / kus/ mgo gnyis ma tsho/ nga tsho'i 7rgyal ba rin pa che rgya mi'i tshogs 'dur gdan 'dren zhu rgyu bzhag na dga' gi red ces dang / yang khag cig gis/ rgya mi'i dngul rda yang dang nga tsho'i 7rgyal ba rin po che brje po rgyag rgyu bzhag na dga' gi red ces pa sogs ngo rgol gyi tshig ngan ji snyed brjod pa dang / bud med khag gcig gis ngu 'bod thog nas sku ngo rnam pa tsho thugs rjes gzigs/ nga tsho'i snying dang 'dra ba'i 7rgyal ba yid bzhin nor bu rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gdan 'dren ma zhu rogs zhes pho mo tshang ma khong khro 265

me ltar 'bar ba'i skad cor mang po rgyab/ zur khang phebs dus gzhung zhabs rtse drung 'ga' shas gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu mi dmangs kyi bya spyod la rtogs zhib lta bur bsdad yod pas de tshos phyag rogs zhus te zur khang gzhung sgo'i nang du gdan 'dren zhu thub tsam byung /gzhung sgo'i phyir mi dmangs kyis phebs lam bkag 'doms byas pa dang / gzhung sgo srung phyir sku srung dmag gis gzhung sgo brgyab thog yar 'gro ma 'gro byed mir brtag zhib rdugs zon chen po byed dgos byung / de nas kho bo gzim chung du bcar te da lta'i gzhung sgo phyi nang gnyis kyi gnas tshul skor dang / da dung mu mthud mi dmangs yong dang yong bzhin pa bcas kyi skor snyan seng zhus par/ 7gong sa mchog cung zad thugs skyo snang gi rnam pa'i thog nas pho brang rtse thog tu chibs bsgyur gyis mkha' dbyings su gzigs te de ring gnam gshes de tsam sdug po mi 'dug a'u tsam mi yong ngam/ zhes gsungs skabs nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin pa gtan nas med par sngo la dwangs shing / shar phyogs nas rta bdun dbang po mkha' dbyings su 'char ba des kyang da cha bod kha ba can gyi mgon skyabs 7gong sa chen po mchog dang / gang gi rjes 'brangs bod 'bangs rnams dza drag la thug pa'i sdug bsngal der btang snyoms kyi rnam pa zhig ston gyi 'dug snyam pa sems nang lhang lhang 'char zhing / yid blong blong por gyur / chu tshod bcu gcig tsam la gzhung sgo'i phyi'i mi dmangs kyi skad cor sngar bas shugs che ru 'gro ba dang sgrigs me mda'i sgra skad gnyis thos pas 'jigs snang dang hang sangs pa'i ngang nas lam seng gnas tshul ji byung skor gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu brtsad gcod kyi kha par btang ba'i lan du da lta chab mdo 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal gyi gcen po mkhan chung bsod nams rgya mtsho zhes pa de mi dmangs rnams kyis mthong ma thag rgya mi'i so pa red ces kha brdung btang ba dang sbrags 'dzin bzung bya rtsis byed skabs kho pas me mda' thung mda' zhig bton te nam mkhar 266

gnam mda' gnyis 'phen bzhin par phyir bros skabs mi dmangs rnams kyis rdo gzhus te sa gnas de rang du bsad song zer gnas tshul thos ma thag rkyen ngan ji byung gi gnas tshul zhib dpyad du phyin pas/ mi dmangs rnams kyis bsad pa'i mkhan chung de nyid kyi phung po de gzhung sgo'i lho ngos kyi rdo'i seng ge'i 'gram du bzhag 'dug pa mthong ba tsam gyis ya nga snying rje'i bsam pa zhig skyes byung /chab mdo 'phags pa lha dge legs rnam rgyal rin po che ni chab mdo dgon pa'i bla ma che shos yin par brten bod gzhung nas khong gi gcen po de nyid la rtse skor mkhan sde chung ba'i go ming gnang yod/ khong ni rgya dmar la 'brel 'dres che ba'i na gzhon zhig yin stabs mang tshogs tshos khong la dga' po med/ de nyin snga thog drung jar bcar nas phyir log rjes skya chas dang kha ras gyon nas rkang 'khor zhig bzhon te noragling gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu slebs pa dang / der yod mang tshogs tsho'i khongs nas khong ngo shes mkhan zhig gis rgya mi'i so pa slebs 'dug ces skad 'bod byas te mi tshang mas khong gi mtha' bskor te 'dzin bzung lta bu bya rtsis skabs/ khong gi 'jigs snang gi thog nas gnam mda' gsum rgyag bzhin du bros rtsis byed pa'i ngang mi dmangs rnams nas khong so pa yin par ngos 'dzin byas nas mtha' bskor te gri dang rgyug pa rdo bcas glo bur drag char babs pa ltar gzhus te sa cha de rang du bsad 'dug7gong sa mchog gi ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi dmangs zhes pa'i mdzad rnam shog grangs 305 nang ngas bod mi'i 'go khrid yud tsam byas ring snga dro de'i gnas tshul lta bu byung ma myong / phran ni 'bar la khad kyi me ri gnyis kyi bar na gnas pa lta bur gyur zhing / phyogs gcig na rgya mi'i gzhung la ngo rgol sgo kun nas byed pa'i mi dmangs kyi skad sgra zhig yod pa dang / phyogs gcig na mtshon cha'i dpung stobs che ba'i rgya mi'i 267

dmag dpung rnams yod/ gal srid de gnyis gdong thug gyur na 'bras bu ji byung tshang mas shes tshod ltar/ bod mi mang stong phrag mang po bsad mas yong rgyu dang / dbus gtsang lho dwags rgya khyab tshang mar btsan gnon dang mnar gcod bzod thabs dka' ba'i drag po'i dbang sgyur cha tshang zhig mthong gi red/ de 'dra'i 'phral rkyen ni ngos rgya mi'i dmag sgar du 'gro dgos min de yin/ de'i nang zhi bder bsgyur ba'i nus pa yod pa yang ngos rang gcig pu'i thog tu bab ste/ ngas mi dmangs kyi zhe sdang je chung du gtong ba dang / rgya mi'i khong khro che ru mi 'gro ba'i thabs shes gang yong byed dgos pa byung zhes gsal ba ltar/ de nyin 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du chibs bsgyur ma thub pa'i gnas lugs rgya mir babs gses byed dgos par brten de dus nor gling du phebs 'byor yod pa'i bka' blon zur khang dang / shan kha/ sne'u shar bcas rnam gsum dang /spyi khyab mkhan po bcas gzim chung du lhan tshogs gnang ste bka' blon gsum 'phral du rgya mi'i dmag dpon rnams thug 'phrad du phebs dgos rgyu'i bka' mngags gnang ba ltar/gzhung sgo'i phyir yod pa'i mi dmangs rnams la bka' blon zur khang gis gzhung sgo'i yang steng sgra skyel 'phrul chas thog nas/ de nyin 7gong sa mchog rgya'i dmag sgar du phebs rgyu min/ nga tsho bka' blon gsum rgya mi'i sar 7gong sa mchog chibs sgyur ma thub pa'i gnas lugs shod par 'gro rgyu yin pas mi dmangs rnams thugs blo bde po gnang dgos zhes gsungs par/ mi dmangs nang nas 7gong sa mchog da res rgya mi'i sar chibs sgyur gnang ma dgos pa ma zad/ dus de ring nas bzung rgya mi'i tshogs 'dur nam yang phebs ma dgos pa'i bka' shag gis khas len byed dgos tshul sogs skad 'bod byas pa de dag zhal bzhes gnang dgos byung 'dugade nas bka' blon rnam pa gsum nor gling gzhung sgo nas thon te lha sar phebs 268

skabs mi dmangs tshos bka' blon gsum gyis 7gong sa mchog gsang ba'i thog nas gdan 'dren zhus med dam snyam ste 'khor lo bkag ste/ khyod tshos yid bzhin nor bu gdan 'dren zhus yod med zhib bsher dgos lugs zer nas mi dmangs mang pos 'jib 'khor la zhib bsher byas rjes gzhi nas phebs thub tsam byung / khong rnam gsum rgya mi'i dmag sgar du phebs 'byor skabs dmag dpon than kon san can zhi drag gnad yod dpon rigs rnams dang / bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med bcas mnyam du tshogs 'du 'tshogs bzhugs pa'i sgang yin 'dug khong rnam gsum gyis dmag dpon than kon san mjal 'phrad skabs bka' blon gsum g.yas gral du bzhugs su bcug pa dang / rgya mi'i dpon rigs rnams dang / bka' blon nga phod bcas g.yon gral du bzhugs/ dang thog bka' blon zur khang gis de ring 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog dmag khul khang du gzigs mor chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu gtan 'khel yang / lha sa nas bod mi ser skya pho mo mang po da nang zhogs pa nor gling du bcar te chibs bsgyur gnang mi dgos pa'i gsol 'debs zhus pa sogs kyis rkyen pas de ring chibs bsgyur gnang thabs ma byung bar dgongs 'gal med pa zhes gsungs par dmag dpon than kon san rab tu khros te nga rgyal drag po'i thog nas bka' blon gsum gyi zhal ras la mdzub mo btsugs nas mig bsdir bsdir lta ba dang / yar mar 'gro bzhin du ngar skad drag po kha nas gang thon gyis tshig ngan mang dag bshad pa dang / kho pas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lkog tu mi dmangs sgrig 'dzugs btsugs nas krung dbyang la ngo rgol byed du bcug pa dang /khams pa'i ngo log par rogs ram byed pa ma zad/ da zhogs 'phags pa lha mkhan chung bsod nams rgya mtsho nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu dmar gsod btang ba'i phung po de da lta rdo ring sgang brgyud drud nas 'gro ba bcas byung 'dug na/ khyed rang bka' blon tshor 269

de'i 'gan yod/ krung dbyang nas khyed rnams la nyes chad lkog tu gtong gi ma red/ mi dmangs kyi dkyil du nyes chad gtong rgyu yin zer ba sogs kha rdung mang dag btang / der yod rgya mi'i dpon rigs gzhan rnams dang / bka' blon nga phod bcas kyis kyang rnam 'gyur ngan pa bstan gshis khong rnam gsum da res phal cher 'dzin bzung byas mi yong ngam dgongs kyang / bka' blon shan khas krung dbyang gi nga tsho bod la rogs ram gnang mus la bod mi dmangs shes yon dman par brten bya spyod mi bzo ba ji ltar byas kyang krung dbyang nas bzod pa bzhes te 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog gi chos kyi mdzad sgo legs par bskyangs thub pa'i mdzad rjes chen po byung yod/ nga tshos bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kyi mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril 'byung thabs gtso bzung las bsam sbyor phyin ci log pa byas rigs med/ de ni 'dir bzhugs bka' blon nga phod kyi dgongs par gsal por rtogs kyi yod stabs/ da lta bka' blon nga phod kyis dgongs 'char zhig gnang rogs zhes gsungs par/ dmag dpon teng hra'o tung gis/ khyed tsho lho khar khams pa tog tsam yod pa la re ba bcol na nor 'khrul red/ ha las na khams pa stong phrag 'ga' shas yod 'gro yang na khri gcig tsam yod 'gro 'di 'dra zhig la nga tsho bcings 'grol dmag gis 'jigs zhum byed kyi ma red/ nga tsho bcings 'grol dmag gisakhams pa rtsa gtor gtong rgyu'i dus la bab yod/ da bar krung dbyang gis bzod sgom byas yod/ de sngon go min tang gi dmag mi khri brgyad brgya tsam mthar skrod rtsa med btang ba red/ de 'dra yin tsang khyed tshos dgongs pa yag po bzhes rogs zhes brjod pa dang / de nas dmag dpon phu'u tshan mo krang zhes pa des khyed tshos don snying lung pa'i nang la dmag 'khrugs dus zing mi yong ba'i dgongs pa bzhes dgos/ gal srid dmag 'khrugs byung na rang gzhan gnyis kur legs rgyu gang yang med/ nga tsho lo 'di la ma 270

slebs bar dmag kho na brgyab nas bsdad pa yin/ khyed tshor ngas nyams myong gi thog nas zhus pa yin zhes bshad de dza drag gi gnas bab de cung zad zhi 'jam du gyur/dmag dpon than kon san gyi rnam 'gyur ngan pa de yang phran bu zhi 'jam du gyur te/ kho pas skad gsang mthon po'i thog nas bka' blon shan kha/ nga tsho krung dbyang nas bzod pa sgom pa de ha go gi mi 'dug gam/ bzod pa sgom pa der mtshams chigs shig nges par bzhag dgos pa red ces bshad par/ bka' blon shan khas/ bzod pa'i mtshams tshogs de bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa de la zer gyi yod ces gsungs ma thag der yod bod rgya dpon rigs tshang ma dgad mo shor te tshang ma'i rnam 'gyur lhug tu song /than kon san gyi da cha tu la'i bla ma'i sku phyu'i 'gan 'khur de khyed rang bka' blon gsum la yod ces brjod par/ khong rnam gsum thugs bde zhi lhod du gyur nas tu la'i bla ma'i sku phyu'i 'gan len nga tshos zhu rgyu de nga tsho rang gi las 'gan gtso bo zhig yin/ de don khas len nges par zhu gi yin zhes gsungs te phyir log phebs zhor bka' blon bsam pho dmag sgar de'i sman khang du sman bcos su bzhugs yod pa'i sar khong rnam gsum phebs nas bsnun 'ji zhu skabs bsam pho'i dbu la rma ras dkris te sku gzim gnang 'dug gshis phan tshun bka' mol gang yang zhu stabs mi bde bar nor gling du phyir phebs gnang / skabs der bka' blon zur shan sne gsum bsam pho'i sar bsnyun 'drer phebs dus bsam pho'i g.yas g.yon du rgya me mang pos so lta bya gi yod stabs bka' mol gnang bde med pas khong gis mnal khug pa lta bu'i rnam pa zhig ston gnang ba min na34 snyam/bka' blon bsam pho dang thog nor gling gi gzhung sgo'i 'gram du phebs skabs mi dmangs rnams kyis rgya mi'i sku srung khrid yod pa'i 'jib 'khor nang yod pa de bka' 27ga

blon nga phod min nam snyam te mi dmangs nas der rdo gzhus pa las bka' blon bsam pho yin pa shes bzhin min pas der nor rdo zhes zer gyi yod pa red/ rjes su rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su mang tshogs kyi bka' blon bsam phor 'thab 'dzing gis dre ba len skabs/ khong gis skabs der nga la nor rdo phog pa red/ der go don gnyis yod/gcig ni skabs der rdo gzhus pa ni nor ba zhig dang / go don gzhan ni/ mang tshogs kyis rdo gzhus pa'i rkyen gyis phan thogs byung ba der nor bu'i rdo yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yog red ces gsungs 'dugabaka' blon zur shan sne gsum rgya mi'i dmag sgar nas ri dwags rngon pa'i lag nas thar ba ltar nor gling du phyir log gnang ste 7gong sa mchog la gnas tshul ji byung skor snyan seng zhus/ gnas tshul je sdug tu gyur par brten kho bo bza' mi gnyis kyis rgyal yum chen mo mchog dang / sku'i gcung po mnga' ris sprul sku gnyis lha sa yab gzhis stag 'cher du bzhugs yod pa khong rnams kyi sku phywa nyen 'gan ji yong blos 'gan ma bzod par nor gling du gdan zhu byed par 'jib 'khor mngags gtong byas kyang / mi dmangs kyis bkag nas re zhig gdan 'dren zhu ma thub pa'i mur dus yun gang tsam song rjes mi dmangs phran bu'i zhod 'jags byung bsnun nged bza' mi gnyis kyis 'jib 'khor gnyis khrid de nyen khar ma 'dzems par gdan zhur bskyed nas nor gling pho brang du gdan 'dren zhu thub pa byung de ngos bza' mi gnyis la bkrin gyi bdag nyid rgyal yum chen mo mchog la zhabs 'dregs cung zad zhus nas bkrin gsab thub pa ni mi ཿ 'di'i ring blo bde yid tshim gyi bya ba rlabs chen zhig bsgrubs yod snyam pa 'dug7rgyal yum chen mo lha sa yab gzhis stag 'cher nas nor gling du gdan 'dren zhus rjes tsam rgya mi'i dmag mi 'ga' shas 7rgyal yum chen mo'i sku sdo srung ched yin 272

khul gyis yab gzhis su btang 'byor byung 'dug kyang 7rgyal yum chen mo nor gling du gdan 'dren zhus zin stabs kha skyongs bzhin par log dgos byung 'dug de nyin nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis 'thus mi sum cu skor bdams te pho brang lcags ri'i nang la bka' shag dang spyi khyab mkhan po bcas lhan tshogs sar bcar nas 7rgyal ba'i sku phya'i nyen 'gan blos kyis bzod bral la brten da yod sku srung dmag gis lcags ri'i nang du nyen srung ltar sngar bzhin zhu rgyu dang / lcags ri'i phyir mi dmangs rang gis sku phyu'i nyen srung 'dzugs chog pa bcas kyi snyan seng zhus/de bzhin gzhung zhabs khag dang / mi dmangs bcas kyi tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du 'tshogs skabs gzhung zhabs rnams dang mi dmangs 'thus mi'i dbar gyi bsam tshul phyogs 'gal ji snyed byung zhing / gzhung zhabs khag cig gis /bya ma 'grogs par sgo nga len thabs bya dgos/ rgya mir ngo rgol byed pa'i tshogs 'du tshogs sa de nor gling pho brang du 'tshogs na yag po mi 'dug sa gnas gzhan zhig tu spo na legs gnas dang / gzhung zhabs khag cig gis zang zing de 'dra ma byas na legs/gal srid gang byung gis zing cha bslangs te rgya mis me sgyegs rgyab che nga tsho tshang ma sran ma thor ba ltar 'gro rgyu nyag cig red ces zer/ mi dmangs kyi tshogs 'thus khag cig gis bod gzhung dbu brnyes nas lo sum brgya lhag tsam phyin yod cing / khyed rnam pa tsho da lta bar bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi thugs rje'i bka' dren gyis 'tsho yod pa red/ da cha nyen kha chen po 'di 'drar slebs dus rang srog blos btang gi bsam blo gtong dgos kyi 'dug ces bshad pa dang / yang khag cig gis mdo stod smad sa khul la rgya mis bla ma dang mi drag mang po gsol tshig tu gdan 'dren zhus rjes tshur log rgyu med pa byung ba ltar da cha 7gong sa yid bzhin nor bu rgya mi'i tshogs 'dur phebs rgyu blos 'gan bzod min 273

dang / 1950 lo'i sngon du bod de rang btsan gya la khab cig yin/ rgya mi gung khran gyis bod shar byang gnyis nas btsan 'dzul rim 'byor gyis 1951 lo gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun bzhag kyang / rgya mis gros mthun bad la bshigs snga phyir btang zin pas da cha bod mi dmangs nas rang btsan slar gso brtson len gyis bsam gros gcig mthun yin lugs bshad/ da phan rgya mi'i las khungs nang las ka byed bzhin pa'i gzhung zhabs rnams la da phyin rang gi gnas phyogs 'dems ka byas te rgya mir 'brel mtshams gcod dgos pa'i brda khyab dang 'brel khas len gan rgyar sa yig len dgos lugs/ 7rgyal ba'i sku phyu'i nyen srung zhu phyogs dang / rtse pho brang dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang sogs srung skyob zhu phyogs skor gros bsdur rim pa gnang / de nyin nor gling du sku sdo'i srung 'doms ched bcar 'dzoms mang tshogs la bkod byus 'go byed du mkhan chung rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin dang / rtsi sa dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub gnyis 'dems bsko byas/ lcags ri'i phyir yod pa'i srung bya mi dmangs dang blang rnams nas 'dzings rags gsar bskrun gyi gra sgrig dza drag gi thog nas byed pa ma zad/ rang rang so sor yod pa'i go mtshon 'khyer te srung bya zhu sgo yang 'gan len zhus/ 'di nyin mi dmangs 'thus mi khag cig gis rgya mi'i ngan rgu tshang ba'i bya spyod rnams lha sar bca' bzhugs rgya gar don byed khang dang / bal po'i sku tshab bcas kyi sar gsal po ngo sprod byas thog khong tshos bod mi'i bden dpang yong ba'i yig thog gnas tshul phul/ mi dmangs khag cig gis gzhung sgo'i 'gag nas chab mdo 'phags lha'i mkhan chung bsod nams rgya mtsho de nyid kyi phung po drud de lha sar rngam ston khrom bskor du bskyod pa'i thog bod 'di gna' snga mo nas rang dbang rang btsan yin/ rgya mi gung khran gyis las byed zhi drag rnams 'phral du bod nas phyir log bya dgos/ btsan dbang 'og tu bzhag pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun de ngos len byed kyi min/ bod 'di bod mi'i yin zhes skad gsang mthon pos 'bod chig bsgrags/de mtshungs bod gzhung dmag sgar khag gis mda' dpon rnams nas slar yang 274

dza drag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te bar lam rgya mi gung khran nas sprad pa'i go ming med pa bzos pa dang / rgya mi'i dmag chas phud de sngar bzhin bod gzhung gi dmag chas skyon rgyu/de nyin nas zhi snying ma byung bar pho brang yas mas dang / lha sa gtsug lag khang bcas srung skyob zhu phyogs skor dmag sgar so sor sa bgos byas te kha dang gra bzhi dmag sgar phyed ka tsam gyis gra bzhi dmag sgar rang du nyen srung bya rgyu dang de 'phros rnams rtse pho brang dang /dmag spyi khang / go mdzod yas mas lcags po ri bcas srung skyob bya rgyu/ nga dang rgyal rtse dmag rnams nor gling pho brang nye 'khor byang rgyud dang / rgya mtsho stod smad/ shar nub sbyar rag gling kha bcas srung skyob bya rgyu/ cha dang me sgrogs dmag sgar gyis lha sa grong khyer dang /gtsug lag khang srung skyob bya rgyu/ ka dang sku srung dmag rnams nor gling pho brang dang / spyan bsal pho brang / skyid chu phar kha'i bya skyag ri bcas srung 'doms bya rgyu/ gang ci'i gnas tshul gtong ched sa gnas 'brel ba byed ched phan tshun dbar kha par gsal mthud dang /nyin mo shel 'od brda ston gsang brda/ mtshan mo glog shu'i gsang brda bcas kyi thog nas 'brel ba yang yang bya rgyur gros mol gyis dmag spyi mkhan chung blo skal mchog la snyan seng bka' 'khrol thob pa ltar khungs so so rang sar phyir log gis las khur blangs/ gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og mi dmangs mang che bas rgya mi gung khran bod kyi sa thog nas mthar skrod gtang gi yin zhes sems shugs me 'bar ba lta bu yod cing / de nyin nas bzung kho bor las 'gan sngar las lji ba phrag par babs pa ltar nor gling phyi nang du nyin mtshan dus drug la skor g.yeng yang nas yang du bskyed de 'thus shor phra mo tsam mi 'byung bar brtson pa bskyed/de nyin 7rgyal ba'i mtshan zhabs 'bras sgo mang rgya mtsho gling sprul sku snga thog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gzigs mgron khongs gdan zhus ltar phebs te dmag dpon than 275

kon san gyi rgya mtsho gling sprul sku brgyud 7gong sa mchog la zhu yig cig phul ba der tshang ma hang sangs pa byung / sprul sku de rnam kun nas rgya mi dang 'brel 'dris che ba zhig red/phyi ches 11 nyin bka' blon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis bla phyag sman stod pa blo bzang dbang 'dus brgyud kho bor sa gnas gang rung zhig tu khong khyug tsam thug 'phrad du yong rogs zhes lan bskur 'byor byung yang / da cha gnas bab 'di lta bur nga phod thug 'phrad byas na phan las gnod che yong rgyu nyag cig la brten dgra gnyen dbye mtshams kyis lan gsal gang yang ma sprad par bla phyag sman stod pa re zhig sku srung dmag sgar du kho bo mda' dpon gyi las rogs su bzhugs dgos zhus par zhal bzhes gnang ba bzhin bka' shag la snyan zhus bka' 'khrol byung yang dus yun de tsam ma song bar bka' shag nas mi dmangs kyis bla phyag sman stod pa sku srung dmag sgar du bzhag na rtsa ba nas 'grigs kyi ma red ces snyan seng nan po zhus byung stabs khong rang da lta bka' shag tu 'phral bcar dgos lugs bka' phebs pa ltar khong thugs pham chen po'i ngang nas spyan chab bsil bzhin du dmag sgar nas bka' shag tu bcar dgos byung song /bka' shag nas khong la lha ldan gtsug lag khang nyen srung gi spyi khyab bsko bzhagamadzad/ de nyin kho bo'i grogs po dza sag phreng ring gi lcam rin chen sgrol ma sku srung dmag sgar du nyen g.yol lta bur phebs bzhugs la mi dmangs kyi 'thus mi dang / gzhung zhabs khag cig bcas kyis phreng ring lcam sku srung dmag sgar du bzhugs 'dug pa dza sag phreng ring la bsam tshul gang yang zhu rgyu med kyang / phreng ring lcam rgya mi dang ha cang 'brel mthun yod stabs sku srung dmag sgar du bzhugs pa des 7rgyal ba'i sku phyar 'gan blos bzod min la bka' shag gis sku srung mda' dpon la phreng ring lcam skya srung dmag sgar nas 'phral du thon dgos zhes bka' khyab gnang dgos tshul snyan seng byung don ltar/276

bka' shag nas kho bor bka' brtsad gnang ste bya thabs dka' ba zhig byung ste re zhig dmag sgar nas rang shag tu phyir phebs gnang na legs tshul zhus kyang zing cha zhod 'jags ma byung bar rang shag tu spo rgyur dka' ngal 'dug pas lha rab byung na gnas skabs ring dmag sgar rang du da mus bzhin bsdad 'thus skyabs 'jug yod pa dang / de min nyen kha med pa'i btsan sa gang rung zhig tu sdod rgyur rogs ram mi 'dor bar thugs rjes gzigs zhes gsungs kyi 'dug par brten/ dmag sgar du nyar blos bzod bral gyis nor gling spyan gsal pho brang gi lcags ri phyi rol rgya mtsho smad du re zhig bzhugs rgyu dang / de nas gnas tshul la gzhigs te dgongs pa bzhes zhus par khong gis gnas skabs ring snying 'jags yong dka' ba 'dug na yul gzhan du thon rtsis yin zhes gsungs te de nas rgya mtshor phebs bzhugs ring sku srung dmag gnyis srung skyob rogs ram du btang / gal srid yul gzhan du phebs rgyu gtan 'khel na thugs blos 'khel ba'i phyag rogs gnyis tsam gtong rgyur mngags cha byas pa dang / phebs lam la phan thogs yong min la ma ltos par kho bo'i ming thog nas lam yig gcig kyang bzos nas phul/ de rjes phreng ring lcam rgya mtshor bzhugs blos ma bzod par ma gling du nyin shas bzhugs rjes 'brug yul phyogs su phebs te lam bar khams pa tsho khag cig 'phrad nas dka' ngal chen po bzo skabs de sngon kho bos phul ba'i ngo sprod lam yig de khams pa de rnams la mig ston byas par yi ge de ngo brdzun ji yin kurma pa rin po cher spyan bstar zhu skabs/ rin po ches yi ge 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku srung mda' dpon gyi yi ge red/khyed tshos phreng ring lcam la rdugs pa byed ma dgos par rogs ram byed rogs zhes bka' gnang 'dug rjes su kurma pa rin po che rgya gar rda ram sa lar 7gong sa mchog gi mjal khar phebs skabs kho bor khyed rang gis phreng ring lcam la yi ge de sprad med na khong 277

gi sku srog la sku ngal 'phrad rgyu rang yin zhes gsung byung ba de da lta yang gsal lham mer dran bzhin 'dugaphyi tshes 11 nyin nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du tshogs 'du mu mthud tshogs te mang tshogs kyi 'go byed kha snon dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang /mkhan chung skal bzang ngag dbang / bla phyag lha sding sras/ rim bzhi zhwa sgab pa bcas gsar bsko byas/phyi chis 12 nyen lha sa'i bud med stong phrag 'ga' shas rtse pho brang mdun du 'dzoms te rgya mi gung khran tang gi rgyal dar dang / ma'o tse tung / kru'u te/ kra'u en len bcas mi gsum gyi 'dra par dang 'dra sob bcas mer bsregs btang thog rngam rngam brjid brjid kyis lha sar rngam ston khrom bskor byas shing / khong tsho'i 'bod tshig tu bod mi ser skya rnams rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis btsan rgyal rgya dmar bod nas mthar sgrod gtong dgos/ snga rabs nas bod 'di rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab gcig yin/bod 'di bod mi ra nga gi yin/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po tu la'i bla ma skya che khri lor brtan par shog bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid yun du brtan pa shog ces skad 'bod byas/ bud med kyi 'go khrid gtso bo lha sa'i kun bde gling du bzhugs pa'i gur steng kun bzang lags yin zhing / rjes su dam pa de nyid rgya mis 'dzin bzung btson 'jug gis lo mang mnar gcod sna tshogs btang / 'on kyang dpa' ngar ldan zhing gnya' rus mi chag par gsang thabs kyi sgo nas rgya mir 'thab rtsod kyi las 'gul brtsams par brten kun bzang lags khong rang dang / 'thab grogs lho kha ba rta mgrin mtsho mo gnyis rgya mis dus gcig tu dmar gsod btang / bod mi rjes ri'ajug rnams kyis lo rgyus kyi dpa' mo de'i snying stobs dang mdzad rjes rnams nam yang brjed thabs med pa zhig yin/278

de skabs rgya mes bka' blon nga phod la bkod byus byas pa ltar nga phod kyis gzim 'gag rab sgang gzhon pa ched btang mdun gsang ba'i thog spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang brgyud 7gong sa mchog la snyan zhu zhig phul bar bka' lan bstsal kyang / rab gzhon nga phod kyi shag tu bskyod skabs nga phod dang nang mi tshang ma rgya mis dmag sgar du 'khrid zin par brten bka' lan phyag bris de 'phrod ma thub par nor gleng du rang sar phyir 'bul zhus/ nga phod kyi ye ge'i nang rgya mis nor gling du yod pa'i log spyod pa rnams 'phral du phyir log gtong thabs gnang dgos/ gal srid khong tsho nor gling nas phyir 'then ma byas na me sgrogs 'phang ste rtsa med bzo rgyu yin pas/ ṭī la'i bla ma bzhugs pa'i gzim chung gar yod sa bkra zhig bkod thog bzhugs gnas der rtags shig bskyon nas 'phral stsol yod pa dang / lha rab byung na tu la'i bla ma gsang thabs kyis bod dmag khul khang du byol phebs gnang na gang legs yong rgyu zhes gsal 'dug gnas tshul der zhib tu dpyad na/ bzhugs sa gar yod kyi sa khra btang na de la me sgrogs ma phog pa bya rgyu yin dang / de la ched dmigs bya rgyu yin sus kyang brjod mi thub/rjes su 7gong sa mchog nor gling pho brang nas lho kha phyogs su gsang thabs kyi phebs rjes phyi zu 3 ches 30 nyin nor gling dang / rtse pho brang / lha sa bcas la me sgrogs tshad med drag char babs pa ltar 'phangs ste rnam kun 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs gnas rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang la yang me sgrogs 'ga' shas brgyab ste skyon chags btang yod pa ma zad/ skabs der nor gling pho brang gi g.yas g.yon du mi rta stong phrag 'ga' shas bsad yod pa'i ro gang sar mthong rgyu yod pa red/ de'i dgong mo nor gleng du rgya mi'i dmag 'dzul nas mi ro mgo ril yod tshad la tā la'i bla ma yin min dmigs bsal gyi zhib 'jug nan tan byas 'dug pa de dbang la gzhigs na 7gong sa 279

chen po nor gling pho brang du bzhugs yod shag byas tshod 'duga'adi ches 13 nyin mi dmangs kyis 'dems bsko byas pa'i tshogs 'thus dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya gdan sdo/ gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas nor gling zhabs brtan lha khang du sngar bzhin tshogs 'du tshogs skabs gnas tshul dza drag je sdug tu gyur par thugs kyis ma bzod par bka' shag dang / drung rtsis/ mi mang gi tshogs 'thus mi grangs bdun cu lhag tsam gzim chung du bka' 'gugs gnang ste/ 7gong sa mchog nas ngos dang rgyal bstan chab srid kyi don du yin tshul gyis khyed tshos pha rol po'i dpung stobs nus shugs dang / deng dus kyi go mtshon la brtag dpyad gang yang med par hol rgyugs long mchongs lta bus rgya mir ya bzung ngo rgol byas na rang cag rnams la pham nyes chen po yong rgyu las gzhan rme/da pa dang / khyod tsho'i 'dod par ngos re zhig yul gzhan du phyin na dge mtshan yod snyam yang / ngos sngon gyi smon lam dbang gis bod kha ba can gyi skye 'gro rnams la phan nus thon na las/ yul gzhan du phyin pa yin na phan thogs med par brten rang rigs rnams nas dus dang rnam pa kun du thabs mkhas zhi 'jam nges par dgos pa dang / lhag par nor gling pho brang nang tshogs 'du mang po 'tshogs rgyu de bzhin rgya phyogs nas don med mthong tshul rdugs pa'i dbang gis rkyen ngan ji yong ma nges pas lha rab khyod chos phan med gnod gzhi'i zing cha dang / mi dmangs kyi tshogs 'du sogs phyir 'then dgos pa dang / ci ste tshogs 'du mi tshogs thabs med yin na nor gling pho brang nang tshogs ma dgos pa byas na legs pa sogs dus gsum gsal gzigs kyi bka' slob gsal rjen zhib cha bstsal ba ltar/ de'i sang nyin nas bzung mi dmangs kyi tshogs 'du de rtse pho brang gi mdun phyogs zhol dpar khang du tshogs/ 'on kyang mi dmangs rnams kyis 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu'i nyen srung mu mthud zhu rgyu dang / bod kyi gnad don 280

bod rang gis thag gcod bya dgos sogs kyi re 'dun 'khod pa'i snyan zhu zhig phul/ches 13 nyen mi dmangs tshogs 'du zhol dpar khang du spos pa'i nyin tshogs 'dus gros sdur gyis rgyun du da yod tshogs mi mang po 'tshogs mi dgos par rgyun las tshogs mi 'dems bsgrug bya rgyu gtan 'khel te gzhung zhabs khongs nas mi 40 dang / se 'bras dga' gsum nas mi 30 mi dmangs khongs nas mi 3༷bcas 'dems bsgrugs byas te khungs so sos 'dems bsko byas pa'i rgyun 'thus gyi ming tho tshogs 'dur phul te/ ming tho sgrogs sbyang byas par tshogs mi yongs nas mos mthun byas/ gzhung zhabs kyi rgyun 'thus khongs nas nor gling bka' bkod khang gi gtso 'dzin kun gleng dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chung rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin/ mkhan chung skal bzang ngag dbang / rtsis dpon shud khud pa 'jam dbyangs mkhas grub / bla phyag lha sding sras bcas tshogs 'thus su 'dems bsko byas par brten zhol dpar khang gi tshogs 'du nas gong gsal kun gling dza sag sogs tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi yin mus thog nor gling gi las 'gan gnyis lcogs thub min la bsam snye nor gling du bka' zur lha klu tsho dbang rdo rje dang / mkhan chung blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ thon pa mkhan chung byams pa mkhas grub/ phogs dpon pha lha sras rdo rje dbang 'dus/ rim bzhi shag byang zur pa ngag dbang rgyal mtshan bcas 'dems bsko byas kyang nor gling du 'dus sdod mi mang nas lha klur yid ches ma byas stabs mgron che pha lha sogs bka' gros kyis da lta yod mus khong rnam pas 'thus nges las/ gsar pa dgos don mi 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar la gnas /zla 3 ches 10 nyin nor gling pho brang gi gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu lha sa'i mi dmangs khri phrag lhag tsam glo bur du 'dzoms pa de'i 'phral rkyen gtso bo 7gong sa mchog 281

rgya mi'i dmag khul khang du gdan 'dren zhu rgyu/ de las byung ba gong smos bzhin yin kyang da dung rgyu rkyen gzhan yang yod pa dper na/ bod mi rnams rnam kun rgya mi'i bya spyod la zhe 'khon drag po skyes mus thog de sngon bod sdod rgya dmar gyi dbang sgyur pa chos btsan po dbang yod kyi thog nas srid tshab rnam gnyis dgongs zhu gnang du bcug rjes rgyal gces lhag bsam can gyi bod mi khag cig nas gsang ba'i thog nas sngon gyi mi dmangs tshogs pa'i ming de shul 'dzin byas te sgrigs 'dzugs shig btsugs yod par mngon zhing /gnyis pa/ 1951 lor rgya dmar gyis bod la dbang sgyur byas rjes bod mi na gzhon khag cig gsar brjer mos te rgya nag pe cing sogs la slob sbyong du bskyod nas rim bzhin gung khran ring lugs kyi lta spyod gnad don gsal po rtogs mtshams de la zhen log gi bsam pa bskyed de phyi lo 1955 lor rang yul bod du phyir log byas pa ngag dbang seng ge sogs kyis 'go khrid pa'i rang btsan mna' 'brel tshogs pa'i gsang ba'i sgrigs 'dzugs shig kyang yod/gsum pa/ rgya gar bka' sbug khul du yod pa'i bod kyi bde don tshogs pas mgron che pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang 'brel gtugs kyis bod mi'i bde don tshogs pa'i yan lag gsang ba'i sgrigs 'dzugs shig kyang yod pa bcas kyis skabs 'di'i mi mang gis gyen langs bya rgyur shugs rkyen chen po thebs nas de nyin bod rang btsan slar gso'i btsan rgol gyi rlabs chen las 'gul de bde blag tu langs thub pa byung / gong gsal sgrigs 'dzugs gsum po de yong khungs mi 'dra ba yin na yang rang cag bod mi rnams kyi snying dang 'dra ba'i spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu'i nyen srung zhu rgyu de ni tshogs pa de gsum thun mong gi rtsa don zhig yin la/ bla srog dang 'dra ba'i las 'gan zhig kyang yin/ de bzhin bod mi dmangs rnams nas rgya dmar dbang 'dzin pa'i lo ngo dgu'i ring 282

gi btsan gnon la zhen log gis ngo rgol byed pa de dang / bod rang btsan slar gso'i dmigs yul gcig gyur yi na stabs/ bod kyi rgya che'i ser skya mi dmangs rnams la 'bod bskul byas ma thag tshang mas blo sems rtse gcig gi snying stobs che bskyed dang du blangs nas btsan rgol gyi dpung chen nang du zhugs pa zhig yin/ rgya'i gtam dpe las/'khyag pa mthug tshad chags pa des/ nyin gcig grang ngar byung ba yin zhes zer ba ltar ro gong smos ltar/ de nyin nas bzung dmag dpon than kon san gyis 7gong sa chen po mchog la zhu yig snga rjes gsum phul ba'i nang log spyod pa chos tā la'i bla ma dmag khul du gzigs mor phebs rgyu bkag 'gog byas pa de rtsa 'gal zhig yin pa dang /tu la'i bla ma'i sku phyar blo g.yeng yod tshul/ nor gling pho brang gi mtha' 'khor du gnas pa'i log spyod pa rnams 'phral du phyir slog dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang dgos/ yar thon can gyi bsam blo yod mkhan dang / ngo log pa tsho khag gnyis su dbye dgos/ lha rab byung na tu la'i bla mas thugs blo 'khel ba'i sku srung 'ga' shas 'khrid de gsang ba'i thog nas rgya mi'i dmag sgar du byol thabs gnang dgos zhes gsal 'dugaskabs der 7gong sa mchog nas dza drag gi gnas tshul de zhi 'jam du 'gyur thabs su dmag dpon than kon san gyi re 'dun dang bsnun te thabs mkhas zab mo'i sgo nas bka' lan re re bzhin gnang ba des than kon san re rwags som nyi'i dra bar tshud/mi dmangs ser skya mchog dman rnams la thabs mkhas zhi 'jam dgos rgyu'i bka' slob nan tan gnang ba dang / de bzhin bka' shag brgyud mi dmangs tshogs 'thus rnams la thengs mang bka' slob gnang yang / mi dmangs tshogs 'thus rnams kyis bsam tshul 'gal ba chen por gyur/ bka' blon rnams rgya mi'i phyogs su lhung gi yod 283

pa'i rnam rtog gis nor gling bka' shag tshogs yul du so lta lta bur srung dmag btsugs te bka' blon tsho gang byung phebs mi 'jug pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/dza drag gi gnas tshul je sdug je zhan du gyur pa'i skabs der bka' blon nga phod kyis nor gling du bzhugs pa'i bka' blon gzhan rnams la phyag bris shig btang 'byor du/rgya mis nor gling du yod pa'i log spyod pa tsho rtsa brlag gtor bshig gtong rgyu gtan 'khel yin tshul dang / bka' blon rnams kyis log spyod pa dang 'brel ba gtsang bcad dgos rgyu/ 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul gyi sa khra zhig 'phral du gtong dgos lugs dang / phyi rgyal la phebs rtsis yod rdugs med kyang gal srid gdan zhu gnang na mtha' 'khor du bcings 'grol dmag dpung gi skor yod gshis thar thabs med lugs/ gal te gsang bros thub srid na yang krung go'i rgyal khab kyi stobs shugs dang / rgyal spyi'i gnas bab kyis bod du slar yang phyir phebs nam yang mi thub tshul sogs ces gsal/nga phod kyis btang ba'i yig ge'i brjod bya'i nang rgya mis nor gling pho brang dang /lcags ri phyi nang du sdod pa'i mi dmangs dang blangs srung skyob dmag rnams rtsa gtor gtong rgyu dang / lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyur nyen kha yod lugs shugs kyis bstan par mngon/ zing 'khrugs langs nas bzung rgya mis lha sa'i nye 'khor du yod pa'i zhi drag las byed yongs rdzogs la bod mir drag gnon bya dgos pa'i bka' btang ste lha sa grong khyer nang du rgya mi'i dmag sgar dang / las khungs/ sdod khang bcas su rgya mi'i dpung shugs gcig sdud kyis dmag 'thab gra sgrig dza drag gis byas pa ma zad/ lha sa'i shar ngos kyi me le bcu tsam gyi sar dpal sding zhes pa'i sa khul la rgyun du bzhag pa'i dpung dmag rnams dang deng rabs can gyi go mtshon lci ba bcas ches 14 nyin gyi nub mor lha sar gsang thabs kyis 'or 'dren byas/ nor gling pho brang gi nub brgyud nor stod gling 284

kha'i phyogs su rgyun gnas rgya mi'i zhi drag rta dmag rnams kyis kyang dmag 'thab kyi gra sgrig byas 'dug de bzhin mtsho bod lam chen dang / khams bod lam chen gnyis nas rgya dmag grangs las 'das pa lha sa phyogs su 'byor dang 'byor bzhin par brten rgyal bstan chab srid chags 'jig ji yong dang / lhag par 7rgyal ba don gyi bdag po'i sku phyu'i nyen ka tshabs chen bzod bral dngangs skrag gi ngang nas ci bya gtol med du gnas/ 285

le tshan nyer brgyad pa/ 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor hrag bsdus dang bcas nor gling pho brang nas gsang stabs kyis chibs sgyur bskyangs pa/༄༅༅/ /phyi che 3 ches 17 nyin gyi dgong dro tshud bzhi pa tsam la rgya mis me sgyegs gnyis brgyab pa'i sgrogs mdel nor gling pho brang byang ngos lcags ri'i phyi rol chu 'dam dkyil du babs nas de'i nye 'gram la gtor skyon gang yang ma byung ba de ni rgya mis tshod lta lta bur me skyogs gnyis brgyab pas/ 7gong sa chen po'i skya phyu'i nyen 'ag( bzod bral gyi skabs su slebs yod par brten gnas skabs ring sku phyu'i nyen g.yol du gsang stabs kyis phyi rgyal gang rung zhig tu gdan zhu yong ba zhes mi mang gi 'thus mi rnams nas bka' shag lhan rgyas la snyan bskul nan tan zhus par brten chab srid kyi mdzad po bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan po/ rtse mkhan mgron pha lha ba bcas shin tu dza drag gi lhan tshogs thog bka' gros gzab nan rgyun ring gnang ste nor gling pho brang nas gsang ba dam zab thog re zhig lho kha phyogs su phebs rgyu dang / de nas rgya gar du gdan zhu zhu dgos min lha sa'i gnas tshul la 'gyur ba ji chags la gzigs te dgongs pas dpyad rgyu dang / phebs phyogs thad nor gling pho brang gi lho 'gram skyed chu brgal ba'i ra ma sgang gi gru kha brgyudaphebs sam/ yang na nor gling pho brang byang rgyud gzhung lam nas shun gdong dkar dang chu shur brgyud nas gdan 'dren zhu rgyu ji 'gab bka' gros gnang mthar/ dgongs tshul dang po der tshang mas thugs mos gcig gyur byung zhing / de nas 7gong sa mchog la bka' 287

shag gis nga phod kyi phyag bris 'byor don dang / da lta rgya mi'i me skyogs chod lta lta bu brgyab pa der gzhigs na sang gnangs tsam 'gyangs med rgya mis nor gling pho brang du drag gnon me sgrogs kyi char pa 'bebs rgyu mngon mthong la brten da cha 7gong sa mchog re zhig nyen g.yol du lho kha'i phyogs su chibs bsgyur mdzad na dge gnad chen po yod tshul zhus/bod sa phag zu 3 ches ra phyi lo 1959 zla 3 ches 17 nyin dro skyed ldan pa'i nyin 'od sa gzhi kun tu nye ring med par 'phros te gnas yod kyang / nged cag bod mi rnams yid gdung drag pos mnar ba'i skabs der 7gong sa mchogadang bka' blon lhan tshogs bka' gros zhib tu gnang rjes do nub nor gling pho brang nas gsang bros gnang rgyu'i thag gcod gnang / 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi dmangs zhes pa'i shog grangs 335 nang gal srid nga'i lus srog rgya mi'i mtshon 'og tu chud zos phyin na bod kyi srog kyang chad par yid ches byed pa red/ der brten 'chi ba'i tha tshig lta bu rgya mi'i me mda'i sgra skad de dag thos 'phral pho brang nang gzhung zhabs las byed tsho dang nye 'khor mi dmangs tshang mas bsam blo'i thog ma ngos kyi srog skyob nges par bya dgos pa dang / pho brang nas bros te lha sa grong khyer la gnas spo byed dgos sam/ de ltar na yang de 'dra'i thag gcod byed pa ni don gnad chung ngu zhig min zhing /ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi gnad don de la thug yod stabs don gnad shin tu chen po zhig yin/ lar nas/ nga phod kyis bros byol mi thub tshul brjod pa ltar bros byol thub min yang nges pa med/ gal te lha sa nas bros byol thub pa yin na gros yul gang du yod/bod mtha' mtshams kyi sa gnas shig srung thub bam/ yang na phyi rgyal zhig tu skyabs bcol gang nas thob/ gal srid ngos phyin na/ rgya mis rtsa che'i grong khyer de gtor bcom 288

dang / mi dmangs dmar gsod gtong rgyu yin nam/ yang na ngos phyin pa thos na mi dmangs rnams kha 'thor du phyin te srog skyob thub kyi e yod/ de lta bu'i lan 'debs thag gcod dka' ba'i dri don mang pos klad pa ljid non chen po byung / mi tshang mar rgya mis mi gsod gtor bcom 'go 'dzugs ma byas gong ngos gyi srog skyob byed snyam pa'i dngangs 'tshab tsam las de min bya byed kyi blo gdengs nges gtan gang yang med pa'i gnas su slebs/ gal srid ngas bsdad pa yin na mi dmangs dang / nye ba'i mdza' grogs tshos blo g.yeng je sdug tu 'gro rgyur brten thabs gzhan gang yang med pas mi bslu ba'i skyabs gnas ni dkon cog rin po che rnam gsum de gcig pu las med pa ltar bden pa las 'bras la bdar nas dkon cog la gsol ba btab te 'gro rgyur thag gcod byas pa yin/ lam ston yong ba'i smon lam ji btab brjod dgos pa med kyang /mig 'khrul lam sgyu ma lta bu'i bya ba de ltar 'grub thub pa byung zhes/ gsal ba ltar thugs mi 'dod bzhin du mtha' ma phebs rgyur thugs thag gcod pa gnang ba bzhin /7gong sa mchog dang bka' shag gis mtshon sku 'khor rnams phebs phyogs kyi go sgrig thad mkhan mgron pha lha thub bstan brod ldan la 'gan dkri gnang ba bzhin khong gis phebs lam du sku phyar nyen srung zhu phyogs skor dang / sku bcar gsol gzim mchod gsum/yo ngas 'dzin rnam gnyis/ bka' shag rgyal yum chen mos dbus yab gzhis skya 'khor bcas kyi phebs phyogs skor kho bo dang bka' sdur zhib nan thog kho bo sku srung mda' dpon la 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i gam bcar zhabs 'degs dang / sku'i nyen srung zhu sgo'i go sgrig zhu rgyu'i 'gan dkri gnang / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog gi phebs lam gyi phebs sgrig dang nyen srung zhu phyogs thad dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / dbus mda' bkras dpal rdo rje che brtan gnyis la 'gan dkri gnang / rgyal yum chen mo mchog dang /289

skya'i gcung po mnga' ris sprul skya bstan 'dzin chos rgyal/ sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma bcas nor gling pho brang gi nye 'khor du bzhugs yod stabs 7gong sa mchog dang lhan du phebs sgrig zhus/ de bzhin yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas bcas kyi phebs phyogs gra sgrig gnang /nyin shas sngon nas bka' blon rnam pas snga dgong gnyis la na bza' phyogs chas stabs bde bzhes te nor gling lcags ri'i phyi nang khag la bskor g.yeng yang yang phebs mus yin par brten pho brang du gnas pa'i sku srung dmag bcas la do snang gang yang ma byung / bka' shag nas rtse mkhan mgron pha lhar phebs lam gyi phebs sgrig mdzad phyogs gsang ba nan tan mdzad dgos bka' phebs ltar/ nor gling chibs rar gzhung gi chibs pa chibs drel mang po yod na yang / snye de dag bed spyod gnang na gsang ba shor ba'i nyen kha yod stabs kun bde gling bla brang gi skyed chu phar kha'i tsha gur gzhis kur yod pa'i bla brang gi rta drel rnams gra sgrig zhu rgyu dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan la bka' mngags gnang ste mtshan mo skyed chu'i 'gram du phebs sgug zhu rgyu byas/ de bzhin yab gzhis stag 'tshor gyi chibs rta 'ga' shas skyed chu'i pha kha sne'u gzhis su sngon tshud nas snang med thog btang ste rgyal yum chen mo sku 'khor dus thog phebs thon go sgrig zhu rgyur mngags/ yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bka' blon rnam pa/ gsol gzim mchod gsum sogs nor gling nas skyed chu'i gru kha bar gdan zhu go sgrig byed stangs thad rang gzhung gi mo ṭa chen po bcu yod pa de dag gyen langs byung ba'i nyin gyi dgong mo sa rub pa nas bzung rtse pho brang gi zhol go mdzod nang mtshon cha yod rigs rnams nor tsheng du dbor 'dren byed bzhin yod stabs lcags ri'i phyi nang du gnas pa'i mi dmangs rnams la rdugs 'grogs mi yong ched yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bka' blon gsum/290

gsol gzim mchod gsum bcas mo ṭa'i nang gdan zhus kyis rtse pho brang gi go mtshon len mkhan yin tshul gyis nor gling nas byer 'gro ba'i gzhung lam du btang ste lam bar bde skyid gling khar yod pa'i kun gling dza sag gi shag bar gdan zhus kyis de nas kun gling bla brang gi chibs pa stabs bde'i thog skyid chu'i khar gdan zhu bya rgyur go sgrig byas/ lhag par du 7gong sa mchog nor gling rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang nas bskal bzang pho brang brgyud nor gling lcags ri'i phyi nang gnyis kyi lho sgo brgyud gdan 'dren zhu phyogs thad kho bo nyin ltar ma tshan mo bskor g.yong du bskyod bzhin pa lta ra de'i dgong mo tshud 9 pa tsam la kho bo dang / sku srung dmag mi gnyis khrid nas pho brang gzhung sgo khag dang / sa srung khag la bskor g.yeng du 'gro ba'i tshul gyis 7gong sa mchog gi gzim sgo'i phyir bcar te 7gong sa mchog gdan zhus gyis kho bos sngar rgyun ltar sngon du 'gro rgyu dang / 7gong sa mchog sku srung dmag mi yin tshul gyis kho bo'i rgyab tu chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu/ sku rgyab tu sku srung dmag gnyis bcar nas bskor g.yeng du sngar rgyun bzhin bskyed tshul gyis skal bzang pho brang du gdan 'dren zhu rgyu dang / de'i sar rtse mkhan mgron pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan nas snang med thog phebs sgug zhu rgyu/ de nas pha lha dang phran gnyis sngon bskyed kyis rgyab tu 7gong sa mchog dang / sku srung dmag gnyis lhan du nor gling pho brang lcags ri ser po'i lho sgo nas gdan zhu bya rgyu/ de mtshungs spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang dang / sku srung dmag gnyis gsum tsam bskor g.yeng du phebs tshul gyi lho sgo'i phyi 'gram du phebs sgug zhu rgyu/ de nas lcags ri phyi ma'i lho sgo thon ma thag shing dang cher ma skyes pa'i sa gshongs brgyud gdan 'dren zhus te/ de dang bar thag mi ring ba'i sar shing dang 'cher ma dang rlung gis bsags pa'i bye ma 'ubar 'bur yod sar 7gong sa mchog gi chibs pa go sgrig zhu rgyu dang / de nas 7gong sa mchog dang sku 'khor hrag bsdus g.yas g.yon dang rgyab 291

mdun du rgyang thag mi ring ba'i sar kha gram nas skyed chu'i 'gram du phebs rgyu/ skyed chu'i 'gram nas kha dang mda' dpon bkras dpal rdo rje che brtan gyis kha dang dmag go hrag gang 'tshams bcas gru kha'i g.yas g.yon dang phebs lam bcas srung cha bkod sgrig zhu rgyu/ de bzhin 7rgyal yum chen mo mchog sku 'khor rnams nor gling sku srung dmag sgar nas de'i nub mo 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyi sngon tsam gsang thabs kyis skyed chu'i gru khar gdan zhu bya rgyu bcas kyi go sgrig 'char 'god byas/ chibs bsgyur ma gnang gong tsam la kho bos nga dang mda' dpon mdo mkhar sras bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / sku srung ru dpon bsod nams bkris gnyis la 7gong sa chen po gal srid nor gling pho brang nas chibs thon gnang che de'i sang nyin dgong dro tsam la sku srung dmag lo gzhon drag gas brgya tsam 'dems sgrug mnyam khrid kyi phebs mjug gi nyen srung du bcar dgos lugs mngags cha byas/ de bzhin sku srung ru dpon sreg shing blo bzang don gru ba dang /brgya dpon bcas la yang nor gling pho brang gi nyen srung 'thus shor mi 'gro ba sngar bzhin hur bskyed gnang dgos zhes nan po mngags pa ma gtogs chibs skyur skor sreg shing pa las brgya dpon tshor ma bshad/ de'i dgong mo 7rgyal yum chen mo sku 'khor dus thog gdan zhu'i skor sku zhabs blo bzang chos 'phel (canacan lags / dang nye 'khor zhabs gas gzhan la mngags cha byas/ skabs der skyed chu pha kha nas me mda' 'ga' shas kyi sgra thos skabs nor gling pho brang phyi nang du gnas pa'i drag zhan mchog dman tshang mas dngangs 'tshab chen po byung /kho bos gnas tshul de thos ma thag me mda' rgyag sar dmag mi ched brdzong kyis gnas tshul ji byung so ltar btang thog phran rang mgron che pha lha'i sar bcar te/de'i skor gnas tshul snyan seng zhus par yang bskyar gnas tshul rtogs zhib byed mi gtong 292

dgos zhes gsung 'dug chu phar kha nas dza sag kun gling gis me mda' kha shor ba'i skor bang mi'i gdong gnas gsal 'bul 'byor byung bar brten nga tsho tshang ma'i dngangs skrag zhi 'jam gyur/de nas 'char gzhi gong gsal ltar dgong mo chu tshod 10 par kho bos rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang du 7gong sa mchog gdan zhur bcar skabs gzim chung g.yas g.yon gyi glog zhu'i 'od snang chung ngu'i khrod du 7gong sa mchog na bza' phyu chen bzhes te gzim sgo'i phyir byin can lha mo gsung byon ma'i sku thang de bsnams nas bzhugs 'dug cing / de nas 7gong sa mchog nga'i rgyab tu phebs pa dang / sku rgyab tu sku srung lding dpon bkras bzang dang / dmag bu a nu gnyis phebs mjug la bcar/ rnam kun skor g.yeng du bskyod pa ltar bskyod/ tshur zhor skal bzang pho brang du chibs bsgyur skabs mkhan mgron pha lhas de khul gyi glog zhu tshang ma bsad de phebs sgug zhus 'dug 7gong sa mchog nas mgon po khang gi phyogs su zhal gzigs kyis thugs smon gzab rgyas gnang rjes lcags ri ser po'i lho sgo'i sar phebs skabs spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang gi sku srung re zung 'khrid de bskor g.yeng du phebs tshul gyis phebs sbug zhus 'dug de nas rgyang thag mi ring ba'i lcags ri phyi ma'i lho sgo'i phyir phebs ma thag mi ṭar gnyis tsam gyi bskor lam brgal te shing dang cher ma yod sa'i gshongs sa der mar babs nas zhabs gom 500 nas 500 lhag tsam sar zhabs thang du phebs te rlung gis bsags pa'i bye phung dang chu yur yod sa zhig tu dza sag kun gling pa dang / kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul / kha dang dmag bzhi lnga tsam bcas chibs pa khrid nas phebs sgug zhus 'dug par 7gong sa mchog nas khyed su yin pā zhes bka' 'dre gnang bar/ kha dang brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul yin zhes zhus par ming sgra legs po byung zhes bka' bstsal/293

de nas skyod chu'i ra ma sgang gru kha bar chibs zhabs bcar mkhan rnams g.yas g.yon dang / rgyang thag de tsam mi ring ba'i sar snga rteng gis khag gram nas gdan 'dren zhus/nor gling pho brang gi lcags ri phyi ma nas ra ma sgang gru kha bar gyi phebs lam la dbur dus chu rgyugs shul gyi sa kong kong dang / dgun dpyid gnyis su rlung bus gsag pa'i bye phung dang cher ma/ rdo rob bcas phebs lam 'bar 'bur thog phebs dgos byung yang sku ngal khyad bsad mdzad/ de'i dgong mo thal rlung de tsam med cing / phebs lam du ches brgyad zu ba byang shar phyogs kyi ri rtse'i sprin gseb nas 'od mdangs de tsam med par shar ba des phan thogs cung zad byung yang / dgra phyogs nas shes rtogs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i blo 'tshab kyang chen po byung / phebs lam g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i bye phung dang / cher ma/ shing gseb bcas la zu 'od rab rib phog pa des mi'i gzugs brnyan lta bur mthong nas de dag nga tsho'i phyogs su yong gi yod pa'i snang ba 'char te dgra phyogs kyi dmag mis sgug ra sprad med dam snyam pa'i rnam rtog dang / dngangs skrag skyed bzhin mdun du gom pa spo skabs bye mas kyang brnyas bcos byed pa lta bus gom pa gcig mdun du spos rjes rkang par nus shugs med pa ltar phyir bshig rgyad gi yod pa'i tshor snang byung /'on kyang bslu med dkon cog gi thugs rje nyag cig la brten nas skyid chu'i 'gram du phebs skabs bstan srung dmag nang zhugs pa'i rtse drung las tshan ngag dbang seng ges sne khrid byas pa'i chu sgang dmag spyi le thang kun dga' bsam gtan/ chab mdo byang ri lha rgyal dang chu rdo shu dbang phyug che ring sogs 'go dmag 'ga' shas dang / kha dang mda' dpon bkras dpal rdo rje che brtan dang dmag bcas skyid chu'i lho 'gram du ko gru gra sgrig gis phebs sgug zhus 'dug 7gong sa mchog dang / spyi khyab mkhan po dga' brang /mkhan mgron pha lha/ kho bo bcas lhan bcar gyis phebs ko'i nang skyid chu pha khar gdan 294
