'dren zhus pa dang / chibs zhabs byings rnams gru nang du chu pha khar phebs/ 7gong sa mcho ga skyed chu'i lho ngos su zhabs sor 'khod 'phral bstan srung dmag sgar gyi tre hor bstan pa dar rgyas can nas phebs bsu mjal dar du bcar ba 7gong sa mchog nas khyod kyi ming la gang zer zhes bka' 'dre gnang bar/ kho pas bstan pa dar rgyas yin zhes zhus par brten rten 'brel yag po byung zhes bka' bstsal/kho bo nyin shas ring pho brang gi phyi nang du bskor g.yeng la yang nas yang du bskyod dgos byung bar brten mtshan mo gnyid ma byung ba'i dbang gis skyed chu'i lho ngos su 'byor ma thag cung zad blo bde byung nas rta bzhon te 'gro skabs rang dbang med par skabs re gnyid cog rgyag gin skyed chu'i 'gram nas bskyod skabs nor gling nub ngos nor stod gling kha'i rgya mi'i dmag sgar dang / zhing rwa / sman khang bcas kyi glog zhu khra thing nger —gur nas kha khu sim por gnas 'dug gal te de rnams kyis shes tshor byung yod na nga tshor sa gnas de rang du dka' ngal 'phrad rgyu rang red snyam pa byung /7gong sa mchog gi dbus chibs zhabs rnams la dza sag kun gling pas sngon tshud nas rgyas spros med pa'i chibs pa go sgrig gnang ba ltar skyid chu'i lho 'gram du phebs rim bzhin tshang mas chibs pa chibs te mun nag gi khrod du 'gran sdur lta bus lam 'phreng dog po de brgyud nub ngos su kha gtad de yang ses la brgyud lam bar chu tshod bzhi dang phyed ka tsam phebs nas rnam rgyal sgang zhes pa che smon bla brang gi 'dzin khongs gzhis kur ma phebs gong tsam la 7gong sa mchog gis gnam gshis ha cang grang ngar che bas de khul du phran bu'i sku ngal gso ba gnang rgyu byung na zhes bka' phebs don ltar mkhan mgron pha lhas 7gong sa mchog gi chibs pa'i thur thag phran la rtsis sprod gnang snye sngon du bzhugs sa brtan khungs shig 'tshol bar phebs skabs / mkhan drung tu bla ma thub bstan 295

nor bzang de'i sngon du phebs nas rnam rgyal sgang gzhis mar sku ngal gso sa zhig gra sgrig mngags cha gnang 'dug pa der 7gong sa mchog chu tshod gcig min tsam sku ngal gso ba gnang rjes rnam rgyal sgang nas chibs sgyur bskyangs skabs nam mkha'i shar phyogs nas skya mda' btang ste rim bzhin nam langs nas phebs lam g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i ri klung dang / rtsi shing grong sde bcas khra lam mer mthong / so nam pa rnams dpyod las byed bzhin 'dug pas/ khong tshos rta pa mang po 'gro ba mthong skabs bstan srung dmag min nam snyam pa las/ rang cag kha ba can pa'i lha skal 7skyabs mgon yid bzhin nor bu nor gling pho brang nas glo bur du gzhan yul du gsang byol phebs kyi yod pa de mi su zhig gi blo yul la ma shar/rnam rgyal sgang nas chu tshod gnyis ring phebs te bod tshes 9 dang / phyi ches 18 nyin gyi snga gro'i chu tshod 8 pa tsam la bye la'i ri gsham du phebs skabs stag brag dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin gyis chibs drel gcig thog gzim 'jo zhig dang gsol zhib lngags smin dang / gsol dkrum bcas phul/ de skabs snga dro gsol ja gnang rgyur brten tshang mas brel ba 'tshub 'tshub kyis me shing btsal te gsol ja 'khol skabs ri rtse nas nyi ma shar tsam red 'dug da dung gan ma gshis grang ngar che la/ grang rlung gis shugs chen brgyab nas zhal dkar nang gi gsol zhib phyed tsam lhag pas 'khyer ba dang / gsol ja de 'phral grang mo chags pa dang / grang rlung gis ded pa'i bye mas mchod zhal bkang yang / tshang mas phor pa'i nang gi ja dang bye ma 'dres pa de brel 'tshab ngang khyur mid btang nas lus por drod phran bu khug thabs byas /nam rgyun yin na 7gong sa mchog chibs sgyur skabs bzhugs sa dang / gsol tshigs nyin shas sngon nas gra sgrig zhu dgos pa ma zad/ phebs lam 'khel sar lam 296

bcos kyang zhu dgos kyi yod kyang / skabs der yo langs che ba'i gegs dbang gis skyen pas glo bur gzhan yul du gsang bros phebs dgos kyi gnas babs ya nga ba de lta bu byung ba de ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i chos nyid cig red snyam pa'i yid skyo lhang nge ba zhig byung /gsol ja grub mtshams tshang ma'i lus por drod phran bu khug pa dang dus mtshungs rta bdun dbang po'i dro skyed 'od zer de sa gzhi kun la khyab cing / mi tshang ma dngangs skrag dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa de cud zad yal ba lta bu byung / skabs 'dir shel grong du bkris nor bu zer ba zhig gis 7gong sa mchog 'di gar chibs sgyur gnang gi yod pa'i gnas tshul thos ma thag rang nyid kyis rgyun du gces gso byas pa'i rta gro dkar zhig chibs sga rang 'grigs 'bul bar slebs te mjal kha zhus/ kho pa ni de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng 13 chen po sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nor gling chibs ra'i nang du chibs g.yog zhabs zhu lo mang zhu myong pa'i mi rgan zhig yin 'dug cing / kho pas chibs pa gro dkar zhig phul ba der chibs zhabs rnams kyis dga' spro'i ngang nas de ni ma 'grigs lhun 'grub kyi bkris pa'i rtags rten gang legs byung song zhes phan tshun gleng mol byas/de nas mu mthud chibs zhabs tsho rgyang thag gang 'tsham bzhag te so so'i chibs pa chibs nas bye la brgal rtsis byed skabs chibs pa 'bul mkhan bkris nor bus bye lar phebs lam bde po yod kyang lo ltar lha sa'i tshogs mchod grol skabs bsam yas su blud 'gong gtong skabs bye la brgyud nas 'gro gi yod pa de nas phebs rgyu mi 'dug de'i shar ngos lum pa la brgyud phebs na phebs lam cung zad rtsub pa yod na yang / der phebs na legs zhes zhus par brten/ mi rgan de'i kha la nyan nas lum pa 297

la brgyud nas gdan 'dren zhus/ la gsham du phebs skabs 7gong sa mchog gi chibs pa 'khrid mkhan brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul la 7gong sa mchog nas mdun du yod pa'i nag rdog rdog de gang red ces bka' 'dre gnang skabs skal dgram nas rta babs te bltas par rtsu ram pa red 'dug zhus par/ che'i dngos grub thob pa'i rten 'brel red ces bka' gnang / de nas dal bu'i thog nas la de brgal skabs bye ma'i nang du chibs pa rnams 'gro bskyod dka' bar brten tshang ma chibs las bshol te dal bu'i ngang nas zhabs thang mar phebs/ de ni rnam kun bod mi rnams la rgyag skabs sems can gyi dka' ngal sel thabs snying rje byed pa'i goms srol zhig yin/ lum pa la'i phar nang la bye mas lam bkag nas 'gro lam 'di yin med par mi long bas rta zhar ba bzhon pa ltar 'gro rgyu las gzhan gyi thabs shes gang yang ma byung / lum pa la ni la thag ring zhing bye rong rtsub pas shin tu bgrod dka' ba byung / skabs re gom spo ma dgos par mi ṭar gcig gnyis sar bye mar 'dred nas 'gro ba dang / skabs re mar ril nas yar langs ma thub par go lag dang dngos po khyer ba rnams kyang zags 'gro ba bcas ngal dub chen pos mnar yang / nged cag gis 'bad 'thab byed pa'i rtsa don 'di la dran skabs ngal dub kyi snang ba yang yal nas phan tshun gcig gis gcig la lag gdangs sbrel nas bskyod/skabs re tshang ma sdebs gcig la ril skabs dgod bro ba yang 'ga' shas byung / la de mthon po de tsam med na yang tshur nang gi la gsham nas phar nang gi la gsham b.rachu chod gsum lhag tsam 'gor song / lum pa la'i rtse nas lho nub phyogs su lta skabs/skyed chu dang gtsang chu 'dres te nub nas shar tu rgyugs pa'i yar klung gtsang po de g.yu 'brug sngon po zhig dang 'dra bar snang / la gsham nas sban tsa gru kha de tsam sa thag ring po med stabs khyug tsam la phebs te gru khar phebs skabs de gar ko gru phebs sgrig zhus 298

'dug gtsang po pha ba/ 'i 'gram du bstan srung dang blangs dmag dang / de khul gyi mi dmangs gang tsam zhig 7gong sa mchog zhal mjal du bcar 'dug pa de rnams kyis phul ba'i bsangs kyi dud sprin dang / nyi ma nub kha'i mtshams sprin dmar po mnyam du bsdebs nas nam mkha' 'ja' tshon kyis khengs pa lta bu'i mdzes sdug gyi rnam pa shar/'on kyang skabs der rlung bus rkyen pas ko gru gtong dka' tsam byung yang / gru pa rnams kyis 'bad brtson chen pos 7gong sa mchog chu'i pha rol du 'phral mar gdan 'dren zhu thub pa byung / yar klung gtsang po'i lho 'gram du phebs 'byor skabs/ mi mang po dga' bsu'i mjal khar bcar ba'i gras su bstan srung dang blangs dmag dang / de khul gyi grong gseb pa bcas 'dug/de nas sa srib mun nag gi khrod du mu mthud chibs thon mdzad/ de nub kyi bzhugs zhag mdzad yul de rgyang thag de tsam med kyang / mdang nub mtshan mo chu tshod bcu pa nas de nyin dgong dro chu tshod drug par chu tshod 18 lhag tsam ring chibs thog mgyogs myur phebs te rta pa'i nyin lam gnyis kyi sar bskud mar phebs dgos byung bar brten mi rta tshang ma 'ar chad ma thebs tsam du skyed gshongs ra smad dgon du bzhugathag zhag 34dzad/ra ma sgang gru kha dang / rnal rgyal sgang / ban tsa gru kha so sor bstan srung dmag yod pa ma zad/ lho kha'i khyon yongs kyi sa khul khag la bstan srung dmag gi shugs nus khyab yod pa dang / de'i nye 'gram gong dkar rdzong du bstan srung dmag 'bor chen yod zer zhing / nyin 'di nas bzung sku phyu'i nyen srung gi las 'gan 'khur phyogs thad nang 'khor dang / bar 'khor/ phyi 'khor bcas khag gsum du bgos te nang 'khor du sku srung dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag tshos sngar bzhin nyen srung zhus pa dang / bar 'khor du kha dang 299

'go dmag rnams kyis srung cha zhus pa/ phyi 'khor du bstan srung dmag gis bskor nas srung bya zhus pa bcas la brten sku phyu'i nyen kha phran bu yol ba lta bu byung ste de'i dgong dro tshang ma thugs bde'i ngang nas sku ngal legs po zhig gso rgyu byung / 'on kyang de'i dgong mo bka' blon tshos dbus pa'i chibs zhabs phal mo cher nyal chas med par grwa pa'i zla gam rtsab ral dang / phying pa'i nyal chas g.yar dgos byung /7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin de'i dgong dro bka' blon gsum dang /spyi khyab mkhan po/ dza sag kun gling pa/ mkhan mgron pha lha/ kho bo bcas dza drag gi tshogs 'du 'tshogs te sang nyin gyi phebs phyogs skor bka' sdur zhib tsam gnang ba dang /de'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog gi mtshan thog nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog la da res glo bur rkyen ngan gyis lha ldan rgyal khab nas re zhig lho kha phyogs su gsang bros phebs dgos byung song bas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog nas bod kyi bstan srid kyi bde don skor grogs phan gang thub gnang skyong yong ba zhes lhag dam sbyar ma'i phyag bris gnang ba dang / bka' shag gis nye lam 7gong sa mchog nas smon lam grwa skor chen mo'i mdzad sgo legs grub kyis bkras lhun dge 'dun rnams la sku 'gyed sku skal ṭam rdo 5000 'bul bskur gyi mi sna che brdzong mdzad/ de bzhin bka' blon nga phod dang / bsam pho gnyis la nged cag rnams rang dbang gi don du bsam phyogs gcig mthun yin stabs rnam gnyis nas rang gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi rgyal bstan chab srid dang / rgya che'i mi mang gi bde don du grogs phan gang thub gnang dgos zhes bka' shag gi mtshan thog nas phyag bris gnang /gzhan yang mdang nub bka' bsdur gnang 'phros phebs phyogs skor thad kur 'brug yul brgyud phebs na lam thag nye ba yod kyang 'brug gi sa mtshams su ma phebs 300

gong rgya mis gzhis rtse dang rgyal rtse sa khul du yod pa'i rgya dmag rnams bod 'brug sa mtshams su sngon du btang 'byor byung yod na sku ngal chen po 'phrad rgyu'i nyen kha yod gshis de bas 'phyongs rgyas su chibs bsgyur gyi re zhig lha sa'i gnas tshul gyi 'gyur ba la gzigs te gnas skabs de khul bzhugs dang / mtsho sna brgyud nas rgya gar du phebs rgyu bcas ji legs bka' sdur gnang don ltar/ 'phyongs rgyas su phebs thog 'phyongs rgyas nas rgya gar sa mtsha mas su mi sna ched brdzong gnang rgyur thugs thag chod/de sngon nor gling nas chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu gtan 'khel ba'i nyin mo mgron che pha lhas gal srid lho kha nas rgya gar du chibs sgyur gnang dgos byung na rgya gar gzhung gis bod rgya'i sa mtshams su bkag 'gog rnyog dra mi yong ched mkhan chung chang khyim thub bstan rtse dpal lha sar bca' sdod rgya gar gzhung tshab me car ci par sar ched brdzong gis de skor bka' mol zhu bar gtong gnang mdzad par rgya gar gzhung tshab nas 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu'i dus tshod dang / sa gnas gang yin bcas sngon tshud nas lan gsal gnang rogs zhes bshad pa ltar/ skabs mtshams lan gsal 'bul rgyu byas 'dugade nas bka' shag gi mtshan thog nas ding ri'i ca dang dmag rnams 'phral du rgyal rtse sa srung du bcar dgos rgyu dang / gzhis rtse ga dang dmag dang / rgyal rtse nga dang dmag rnams lha sar 'phral 'byor dgos rgyu/ byang spyir byang rgyud kyi 'gro lam khag dang /kha par lcags skud bcas rtsa gtor gtong dgos pa dang / lhag par 'dam gzhung khul gyi gnam thang gtor bcom / yang na gnam thang bzung thabs bya rgyu bcas bka' rgya khag bang mi ched brdzong mdun bskur/ 'di nas mtshan 'grul lam/ nyin 'grul ji legs bka' bsdur gnang mthar nyin 'grul gnang na sku phya'i nyen srung zhu rgyu legs gnas dang / 304

phebs lam du tshogs chung khag bgos kyis phebs gnang / ra smad dgon nas chibs thon ma gnang gong tsam la phebs rjes su nyen srung la bcar mkhan mda' dpon mdo mkhar sras bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / sku srung ru dpon bsod nams bkris gnyis kyis sku srung dmag brgya tsam khrid de phebs rjes zin/ bka' shag nas lho nub khul gyi spyi 'doms dmag spyi dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan la phyag 'khyer dang sbrags bsko bzhag gnang don ltar/ sku srung ru dpon bsod bkras dang dmag sum cu bcas mnyam du rdo rje brag gru kha'i srung char mngags brdzong byas/ nga dang mda' dpon mdo mkhar sras bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / sku srung dmag sum cu bcas gra nang mda' yan gru kha'i srung char mngags brdzong byas/ tsho chung khag mang bgos te 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor hrag bsdus dang / bka' shag yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis/ rgyal yum chen mo bcas snga rteng gis ra smad dgon nas nyin dgung ma zin tsam la phebs thon gnang /lam bar mi dmangs rnams kyis 7gong sa mchog phebs bsu'i mjal khar bcar te phebs sgug zhus yod kyang 7gong sa mchog chibs zhabs rnams dang gcig mtshungs kyis na bza' phyu chen bzhes yod stabs su gcig gis zhal ma tshor/ skabs der chibs zhabs su bcar ba'i ka dang sku srung dmag dang / kha dang dmag bsdoms nyis brgya tsam dang / bstan srung dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam yod pa de rnams gong gsal ltar phyi nang bar gsum khag bgos kyis sku'i mtha' skor nyen srung gzab nan zhus/ de nyin phebs thag ring po rang ma phebs par lce bde zhol gyi rdo phud chos 'khor dgon du bzhugs zhag mdzad/lce bde zhol de ni grong gseb chung ngu zhig yin na yang / bod ljongs su skad grags khyab pa'i snam bu thig ris sogs snam rigs sna tshogs kyi thon khungs legs pa'i 302

lag shes bkal 'thag byed sa zhig red/ de'i sang nyin snga dro chu tshod brgyad pa tsam la gra nang gi gra thang dgon par sku bzhugs gnang 'char yod na yang / khul de'i zhing pa 'byor ldan ji snyed bar lam rgya mis bslu brid byas nas 'ga' shas kyis rang gi rgyal khabadang /mi rigs bcas kyi gnas babs de'i khe phan la ma bsam par rgya mi'i dngul la zhen chags byas te dgra bor dga' zhen chen po yod lugs gnas tshul gsan thos kyis skye bo re zung gi spyod tshul rtogs dka' bar brten 7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu'i nyen 'gan chung khyad de nas me le bcu tsam gyi sar zu phu la gsham du yod pa'i rgyang sgo rgyal bzang zhes pa'i grong sde chung ngu zhig tu chibs sgyur mdzad de so nam pa'i mi tshang chung ngu zhig tu bzhugs zhag mdzad/ 'di nub sku 'khor tshang mar gang ci'i cha rkyen shin tu zhan/smin gling gcung rin po ches yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis smin gling dgon du gdan zhu gnang ba ltar/ phebs nas bzhugs zhag mdzad cing / rgyal yum chen mo sku 'khor yab gzhis stag 'char gyi sgos gzhis bya yul du sngon phebs gnang ba des tshang ma blo bder gyur/ sku'i gcung po mnga' ris rin po che 7gong sa mchog gi lhan du phebs/bka' blon zur bshad sne gsum gra nang du bzhugs zhag gnang /nyin gsum ring chibs thog mgyogs myur phebs dgos byung bar brten 7gong sa mchog sku ngal chen po byung zhing / de'i sang nyin nam ma langs gong nas zhag sa de nas chibs thon gyis za phu la rtser phebs lam ha cang gis gzer po yin stabs chibs sna chibs te phebs dgos byung / chu tshod gsum min tsam phebs te la rtser phebs pa dang shar phyogs nas nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs la rtse de nas phyogs mthar gzigs skabs brjid chags ke la sha yi ra bas mu khyud du bskor ba'i mdzes sdug gi yul ljongs lta bas chog mi shes pa de ni nged cag gi pha yul 'di la gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i zhing 303

khams zhes 'bod pa de ming dang don mtshungs pa zhig tu snang /de nas spyan g.yas dgon du chibs thon mdzad/ za phu la rtse'i mtho tshad rgya mtsho'i ngos las phu ṭi 1700 tsam yod zer/ de nas spyan g.yas dgon par me le 50 tsam phebs nas nyi ma dang su mgyogs 'gran pa lta bu byung nas dgong mo sa ma rub tsam la spyan g.yas dgon du zhabs sor 'khod de bzhugs zhag mdzad/spyan g.yas dgon pa ni yar klung khul gyi rten gnas gsum gyi gras shig yin pa dang / de ni spyan g.yas rin chen rla ba'i snang brnyan bzhugs gnas yin zhes su grags/de'i dgong dro rgyal blon lhan tshogs kyis ma 'ongs pa'i mdzad phyogs skor bka' gros zhib par mdzad/ kho bo nor gling dmag sgar nas ma thon gong gsar 'gyur nyan byed phi leb si sgra sdud rlung 'phrin chung ngu zhig khyer yod pas dgong dro zhag sar slebs ma thag 'dzam gling gi dus kyi 'pho 'gyur ji byung gi gnas tshul a ri dang / spi phri si rgya skad thog nas gang thub nyan gyi yod pa de'i nub mo a ri'i rlung 'phrin nang / bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod mi khri phrag mang pos rgya mi gung khran tang la btsan rgol gyi zing 'khrug chen po langs te tu la'i bla ma gar phebs shes rtogs med lugs bshad pa thos te tshang mas rang cag bod mi rnams kyi rang dbang las 'gul de 'dzam gling yongs su shes rtogs byung ba des dga' snang chen po byung / 'on kyang bod la sha zhen yod pa'i 'dzam gling mi dmangs dang / lhag par gzhis byes gnyis su yod pa'i bod mi rnams blo 'tshab chen po'i ngang gnas yod pa red/sa khul de'i nye 'dabs rtsod thang du rgya mi'i dmag sgar chen po zhig chags yod stabs de nas 'phyongs rgyas phyogs su gang mgyogs chibs sgyur gnang na legs gnas dgongs tshul gcig gyur byung ba ltar/ de'i sang nyin mu mthud chibs bsgyur gnang 304

rgyur thugs thag bcad/ zhogs pa chu tshod 8 tsam la 7gong sa mchog nas spyan g.yas dgon gyi rten gtso'i spyan sngar mchod sprin dang / gnas gzigs/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas dang sgrags thugs smon gnad smin gnang ste chibs thon gyis phebs lam phyed tsam du phebs skabs gong spros ltar snga lo de gar bka' shag nas bsko brdzong gnang ba'i don gcod rtsis dpon rnam gling pa dpal 'byor 'jigs med dang /lho spyi mkhan chung thub bstan bsam mchog lho spyi las tshan 'byor rgyas pa bcas phebs bsur bcar te 'tshams zhu mjal dar phul/rtsis dpon rnam gleng bod gzhung gis lho khul du gnas pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag tshor rgya mir ngo rgol byed rgyu mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i slob ston du bsko brdzong gnang ba zhig yin kyang / nang don bstan srung dmag la mdzub ston gnang mkhan zhig red/ skabs der khong 7gong sa chen po'i mjal khar ched bcar gyis nye char lha sa khul gyi rgya mis de sngon nas bod mi rnams la drag gnon gyi 'char gzhi yod pa ltar gdug /ba chen pos dngos su lag len bstar ba'i gnas tshul ji thos 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus rjes thugs pham chen po byung song /bod kyi rgyal sa lha sar bod mi dmangs rnams kyis bod rang btsan slar gso'i skad 'bod khrom skor byed skabs ma'o tse tung gi gtsos pa'i rgya dmar dbus rgyun las tshogs 'du'i thog bod kyi zing 'khrug snying 'jags su gtong rgyu'i byed phyogs kyi gros gleng byed skabs drag gnon zhod 'jags gtong rgyu'i bka' btang lugs dang / de'i rjes tsam la ma'o tse tung gis tā la'i bla ma gsang bros phebs pa'i gnas tshul thos skabs dga' snang chen po'i ngang nas da nga tshor las sla po byung song zhes bshad pa red ces khungs ldan zhig gi sa nas thos byung /305

phyi lo 1959 che 3 ches 17 nyin gyi dgong dro 7gong sa mchog sku phyu'i nyen g.yol du yul gzhan du gsang gros ma gnang mthu med byung rjes bod rla 3 ches 11 phyi rla 3 ches 30 zhogs pa chu tshod gnyis pa tsam nas bzung nyin gang me sgrogs dang me mda' bar ma chad pa drag char babs pa ltar brgyab nas nor gling pho brang khag dang / sku srung dmag sgar/ rtse po ta la/ lha sa grong khyer/ lha sa'i nye 'khor dgon pa se ra dang / gra bzhi dmag sgar bcas la drag gnon gyis nor gling pho brang gi lcags ri'i phyi nang gcig pur bod mi stong phrag brgal ba 'chi skyon dang mas skyon / nor gling chibs ra mdo sgug gi chibs rta bsad mas/ de mtshungs lha zhol grong khul du mi rta bsad mas/lhag par 7gong sa mchog rgyun du bzhugs gdan 'jags sa'i gzim sgo'i 'gram du me sgrogs kyi mdel babs te de'i nye 'khor la gtor skyon chen po byung yod/ de bzhin skal bzang pho brang dang / de'i g.yas g.yon lha khang bcas kyang gtor bshig byas/ rtse po ta lar me sgrogs grangs las 'das pa brgyab yod kyang / gtor skyon phran tsam las ma byung ba de ni mi rnams kyis blo yul las 'das pa'i ngo mtshar can gyi gnas tshul byung 'dugalha sa ba tshos brjod gsal/ rtse pho brang la me sgrogs grangs med dus gcig tu brgyab 'phral gtsag dmar po dang / du ba/ thal rdul bcas bar snang du 'phyur nas re zhig rtse pho brang mi snang bar gyur skabs da ni gru 'dzin pho brang de rmeg med du gtor brlag zin song snyam pa'i dngangs skrag dang / gdung bas mnar yang thal rdul rnams yal rjes yang skyar rtse pho brang khra lham mer mjal rgyu byung skabs mi rnams la dga' ba brjod kyis mi langs pa dang / ngo mtshar dpag tu med pa skyes byung zer/grong khyer lha sar sgrogs mdel char pa babs pa ltar 'phangs te mi ser dkyus ma'i khang pa yang mang po gtor skyon dang / mer bsregs btang zhing / gtsug lag khang gi 306

'dab 'brel shing ra'i yang thog bod gzhung legs bcos las khungs dang / ra che gtsug lag khang gi rgya phebs la me skyogs brgyab ste rtsa gtor btang ba dang / po ta la'i mdun phyogs kyi rtse rig gnas slob grwa dang / dmag spyi khang sogs la gtor skyon chen po btang /lo ngo brgya phrag 'ga' shas kyi sngon nas lha khang sogs chags shing / de rjes gso rig slob grar gyur pa snyan grags can lcags po ri la me sgrogs brgyab ste rtsa gtor chen po btang /de'i dgong dro sa rub tsam la/ skyed chu'i lho rgyud dang / nor gling pho brang dang nye ba'i bya skyag dkar po'i ri de dgra lag tu shor/ de nas nor gling pho brang yas mas dang / sku srung dmag sgar/ skyid chu'i lho byang / ra ma sgang gru kha bcas su rgya mis me skyogs dang / me mda' sbag sbag gi mde'u drag char babs pa ltar 'phangs te nor gling lcags ri phyi nang gnyis dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du gnas pa'i mi dmangs rnams phar bros tshur bros byed mkhan mang po bsad pa dang / de bzhin skyed chu'i lho byang gnyis su bros pa'i mi rta stong phrag 'ga' shas dmar gsod btang ba bcas skabs der bros thar mkhan nyung shas las byung mi 'dug mi mang po skyed chu brgal nas bros bzhin pa'i skabs me mda' 'phangs te gtsang chu dwangs shing sngo ba de khrag mdog tu gyur 'dug pa de ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i gnas tshul zhig red/bya skyag dkar po'i ri rtse nas me mda'i sgra mtshams chad rjes rgya dmag rnams shar nub byang gsum gyi phyogs nas nor gling pho brang gi lcags ri phyi nang du 'dzul te me skyogs dang / me mda' sbag sbag gis bsad pa'i moro rnams la lta zhib byas thog/ lhag par mi ro mgo ril rnams ngo gdong la nan zhib chen pos bltas pa dang / rgya dmag dang mnyam du yong mkhan bod mi nang rul rkang 'dren pa re zung gis 7gong sa mchog bzhugs sa'i gzim chung yas mas la phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs kyis tā la'i bla ma ga par yod 307

ces skad 'bod byed bzhin 'tshol zhib byas 'dug pa de'i thog nas rgya mi'i bsam par tu la'i bla ma nor gling pho brang du 'das gson ji byung cha ma rtogs pa las/ gsang bros su phebs pa de ma tshor zhing / de rjes gzhi nas tā la'i bla ma ma bzhugs pa de shes rtogs byung 'dug de'i sanganyin lha sa grong khyer nang bod dmag pu li si'i dmag sgar gyi ru dpon sgur sgur zhes pas sne khrid 'og bod dmag gis gtso shugs byas nas bod mi dmangs kyis mu mthud nas dpa' ngar chen pos rgya dmar la rgol 'thab byas/ rgya mi'i me sgyegs sogs deng rabs can gyi go mtshon sna tshogs kyis gdug rtsub can gyi drag gnon byas nas bod mi mang po shi mas tshabs chen byung ba de'i nang srang lam du nyal ba'i sprang po yang 'ga' shas yod pa red/ dmag 'thab mu mthud byas mthar bod rla gnyis pa'i ches 13 zhogs pa tho rengs bod gzhung gi bka' blon bsam pho che dbang rig 'dzin nas rgyang bsgrags thog 7gong sa mchog gsang bros grub tshul dang / nor gling dang / lcags po ri/ rtse pho brang bcas mgo btags zin pas lha sa grong khyer nang khul yang mgo btags zhu dgos zhes bshad du bcug rjes gzhi nas grong khyer lha sa khul du zhi 'jags byung 'dugagal srid 7gong sa mchog gsang bros ma phebs par bzhugs yod na rgya mis kha dan tshig gnas med par rgya mi'i me sgrogs kyi rgol rdung 'og sku phyur nyen che 'phrad rgyu gdon mi za ba gsal por mngon/ gal te skabs der sku phyur 'gal rkyen ma byung ba'i dbang du btang na yang / lo shas rjes rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che las lhag pa'i sku ngal 'phrad rgyu nyag cig yin pa der bsam gzhigs skabs 7gong sa mchog sku phyur nye zho med par rgya gar du chibs bsgyur gnang thub pa des bod kyi rang dbang slar gso'i rtsa don 'thab rtsod kyi me lce rtsa brlag tu ma song bar gzhis 308

byes mi mang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis 'bad 'thab byas nas bod kyi rin thang bral ba'i chos dang / rig gzhung srung skyob kyis mtshon pas bod rang btsan slar gso'i rlabs chen las 'gul spel ba'i go skabs bzang po 'di lta bu byung ba ni gangs can mgon po gang de'i thugs skyed smon lam zab mo'i byin mthu dang / bslu med mchog gsum gyi thugs rje nyag cig yin la/ bod gzhis byes mi mang spyi mthun gyi bsod nams zhig kyang yin par bsam bzhin bsam bzhin brjod kyis mi langs pa'i dga' tshor zhig yong gi 'dugaskabs de'i bod sdod rgya mi'i dbang 'dzin pas bod mi'i btsan rgol gyi las 'gul zhod 'jags gtong ched lan kro'u dmag khul khang la/ rtse po ta lar 'bar mdel g.yug mkhan gnam gru gtong rogs zhe sa re 'dun bton pa ltar/ gnam gru gtong rgyu khas len byas kyang / pe cing nas nyin gnyis ngang 'then thog lag len bstor dgos rgyu dang / gal srid de'i ring der yod log spyod pa rnams mgo ma sgur che rtse po ta la gnam gru'i thog nas rtsa gtor gtong dgos zhes lan gsal btang 'dug mtha' ma rtse pho brang du yod pa'i bod mi rnams nas nyin gnyis rjes mgo btags zhus par brten bod mi tshos sngar lo ngo stong phrag gi sngon nas khyad du 'phags pa'i lag rtsal dang dka' spyad snying rus 'gran med kyis bskrun pa'i gna' bo'i shul bzhag 'dzam gling yongs su snyan pa'i grags can de rgya dmar gyi 'bar mdel 'og rtsa brlag gtong rgyu de las g.yol thub pa byung zhing / gal srid skabs der nyin shas mu mthud nas ngo rgol byas na gnam gru'i thog nas 'bar mdel dbyugs te gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang de yang gzhis ka bsam grub rtse dang 'dra ba'i rtsa gtor gtong rgyu red 'dugabod chis 13 phyi ches 33 nyin dgong dro'i chu tshod gsum pa tsam la 7gong 309

sa mchog sku 'khor 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen dgon du phebs 'byor skabs dgon gsham du dge 'dun rnams kyis spos sna ser sdeng gis phebs bsu zhus te dgon pa'i 'du khang yang steng gi gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod bzhugs mdzad/ 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen ni / 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi nye 'gram nub phyogs ri bo'i khrod du gnas pa'i dgon sde de ha cang dben po zhig yin pas sgrub pa nyams len gnang yul zhig red 'duga'aphyongs rgyas rdzong ni dgon pa de'i dgon gsham du gnas yod/ de'i lho rgyud yar lha gsham po'i chu bo'i nub ngos dang / yar klung gtsang po'i lho ngos su gnas/ rdzong gi lho rgyud nye sar bod snga rabs kyi srong btsan sgam pos dbus pa'i btsan po gong ma rnams kyi bang so bcas gnas yod pa ma zad/ lo ngo stong phrag lhag tsam gyi sngon du 'phyongs rgyas rdzong de pho brang phying dbar stag rtse zhes su grags shing / chos rgyal stag ri gnyan gzigs sogs kyi bzhugs gnas bod rgyal khab kyi lte gnas dang / 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i 'khrungs gzhis kyang khul der yod/skabs der 7gong sa chen pos 'phyongs rgyas rdzong sdod shod drung sding yon lngu dbang mgon pos sger gyi rta drel gang yod gal che don cher brten rtsa 'bul zhus pa yin zhes phul ba des 'gag rtsa'i dus su thugs phan gsos nges byung ba ni/ gzhung bsam bkrin bsam shes kyi dam pa'i rang rtags mngon pa zhig red/bod zu 3 ches 14 phyi zu 3 ches 33 nyin ri bo bde chen dgon nas chibs thon ma gnang gong lho kha khul du gnas pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi 'go 'dzin li thang a lo rla ba can 7gong sa mchog gi mjal khar bcar 'byor byung skabs bka' shag dbu bzhugs kyis chibs zhabs gnad yod rgyun las tshogs mi rnams dang lhan 'dzoms thog lho kha sa khul rnams srung skyo ba kyi bkod sgrigs byed phyogs skor dang /3 0

slad rgya dmag btsan 'dzul par rgol 'thab bya phyogs skor/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi phebs rjes su nyen srung gi go sgrig zhu stangs bcas kyi skor bsam tshul go bsdur mdzad pa ma zad/ bod spyi'i rgyal bstan chab srid dang / bod mi dmangs rnams kyi rang dbang bde don gyi ched du rang srog blos btang gi sems shugs che bskyed byas pa der bka' shag nas bsngags brjod gnang zhing / 7gong sa mchog gis kyang dgyes mnyes chen pos khong tshor mjal kha stsal grub bstun nyin dgung chu tshod 11 tsam la ri bo bde chen dgon nas phebs thon gyis 'phyongs rgyas rdzong gi lho ngos mdun gyi gdong dkar lar 'dzags te chu tshod gnyis tsam la la rtser phebs skabs gangs 'khyag gis 'khyags rom du mi rta gnyis ka 'dred brdar shor ba dang / la la gangs dkyil du rkang pa dim nas 'gro bskyod dka' ba ma zad/ grang ngar ha cang che bas 7gong sa mchog gis dbus chibs zhabs tshang ma sku ngal chen po byung yang / dkon mchog gi thugs rjes mi rta tshang mar nyes skyon gang yang ma byung ba'i ngang yar stod thos bsam dar rgyas gling dgon du zhabs sor 'khod/dgon pa de rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin sku bgres gling rin po che'i gzhis dgon yin par brten ri bo bde chen dgon nas nyin gnyis kyi gong du yongs 'dzin rin po che sngon la phebs te bzhugs zhag gi phebs sgrig gnang gshes/ de'i dgong mo 7gong sa mchog gis dbus chibs zhabs tshang mar sne len gzab rgyas gnang ste sku ngal gang legs gso rgyu byung zhing / de'i sang nyin snga dro chu tshod lnga pa'i thog chibs thon gnang nas yar klung khul gyi grags can yar stod brag la zhes pa'i la ha cang mthon po de brgal skabs sku 'khor tshang ma sngar bas sku ngal chen po byung zhing / gangs lhag bu yug 'tshub pa'i grang ngar gyis rkang lag 'khyags che bar brten 7gong sa mchog gis dbus mang che ba chibs pa bshol te chu tshod gnyis gsum gyi ring zhabs bgrod gnang dgos byung thog yang rlung mi 'dang bas 3 ga

ljags dbugs hal ba bcas kyis sku ngal chen po byung stabs chibs pa chibs te dal bu'i ngang phebs dgos byung /la rtse de shin tu mtho yang / de'i khor yug tu mchi'u dang / rtsi shing sna tshogs/rtsu kha yang skye bzang ba bcas 'brog sa yul ljongs mdzes sdug can zhig tu slebs skabs rang bzhin gyi spro snang 'phel/ de nyin phebs lam la nyin gang tsam phebs te e chu mdo gyang zhes pa'i grong sde chung ngu dbul zhing phongs pa zhig tu phebs 'byor gyis grong mi dbul phongs kyi khyim zhig tu bzhugs zhag mdzad/ de khul mi tshang 'ga' shas las med gshis chibs zhabs rnams khang pa'i nang mi shong bar phyugs ra'i g.yab 'og tu bzhugs dgos byung yang / dbul phongs mi dmangs kyi skyed sdug gnas stangs ji yod la nyams zhib byed pa'i go skabs shig kyang byung /e chu mdo gyang ni sa bab ha cang mtho la ri klung kun la rtsa chu shin tu dkon pa'i dbul zhing phongs pa'i yul lung zhig yin pa der mi tshos/ e chu mdo gyang gi mi lus thob pa las/ rtsa chu 'dzoms pa'i ri dwags yin na skyid/ ces zer srol yod pa don dngos dang mtshungs pa zhig red 'dug khul der bstan srung dmag la gnam thog nas dbyugs 'byor byung ba'i go lag rnams spyan zhu dang 'brel snyan seng zhus/ de'i sang nyin chibs thon mdzad de sho bo rta la brgal te de'i nub rgyud la gsham du mkhar steng dgon par bzhugs zhag mdzad/de'i sang nyin de nas chibs thon gyis phebs lam skyar log bkris sgang zhes pa'i sa gnas su phebs skabs g.yul rgyal lhun po rtse'i rdzong sdod rtse drung sgo mang ngag dbang chos bzang dang / shod drung lcogs spe che brtan 'byor rgyas gnyis dang / gnyal dre'u lhas sprul sku sogs phebs bsu 'tshams zhur bcar/ g.yul rgyal lhun po rtse'i pho 342

brang gi nye 'dabs su chibs bsgyur skabs der yod ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang / rol mo 'bud dkrol / dung rgya'i snyan seng / ser sbreng / bro gzhas bcas tshar du dngar ba'i phebs bsu'i 'tshams zhu gzab rgyas zhus/ de nas pho brang yang steng gzim chung kun dga' 'od snang du gdan zhus kyis sku ngal 'khyug tsam gso ba gnang ste rdzong gi tshom chen nang du 7gong sa mchog dbus ston 'khor rnams dang / de cikhul gyi ser skya gnad yod khag/ gzhan yang bstan srung dmag gi 'go 'dzin sogs 'du 'dzoms thog bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa'i lugs zung chab srid kyi dbu 'dzin 7gong sa mchog dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas sogs btsan 'dzul rgya mi'i gdug rtsub bya ngan gyi rkyen pas lha sar bzhugs thabs ma byung bar brten g.yul rgyal lhun rtse pho brang du bod gzhung gnas skabs spo 'dzugs gnang ba'i mdzad sgo'i thog 7gong sa mchog sku che zhabs pad bskal rgyar brtan pa'i brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs skabs yongs 'dzin bgres pa gling rin po che mchog nas rgyal srid sna bdun dang / rdzas brgyad rtags brgyad sogs rim bzhin bstar 'bul gnang / mdzad sgo grub bstun 7gong sa mchog gi mtshan thog nas kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che mchog la sbug dam bka' yig stsal/ de khul 'dzoms pa'i ser skya mi dmangs rnams la bka' blon khri pa zur khang dbang chen dge legs nas nye char rgya dmar gyis lha sar btsan gnon ji byas skor dang / da cha lho khul g.yul rgyal lhun rtse pho brang du rang gzhung gnas spos gsar 'dzugs gnang lugs khyab bsgrags dang / byed sgo'i rtsa tshig sgrog byings gnang zhing / rgya khyab rdzong gzhis so sor rtsa chig gi zhal bshus re dang / byed sgo rgyab smon bka' rgya re bcas stsal/ rdzong gi mdun du bstan srung dmag gis rang gzhung de khul gnas spos gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i dga' ston rtags rten slad me sgrogs gsum 'phangs pa'i rjes su ma sgrig lhun grub kyis nam 343

mkha' nas 'brug skad chen po zhig bsgrags pa de ni dpyid dus 'brug skad bsgrags thengs dang po yin stabs der yod ser skya mi dmangs tshang mas rten 'brel bzang por rtsis te spro snang chen pos dga' mchongs kyis lha rgyal lo zhes dang/ bod rang btsan myur du thob rgyu'i rtags mtshan bzang po zhig yin no zhes skad gsangs mthon pos 'bod sgra shugs chen bsgrags/de nas de'i nye 'gram gnyal dre'u lhas bla brang nas gdan zhus ltar g.yul rgyal lhun po rtse pho brang nas chibs bsgyur gyis phebs lam chu tshod gcig min tsam las ma 'gor bar gnyal dre'u lhas dgon du zhabs sor 'khod de bzhugs zhag mdzad/ de'i sngon tsam gyi nyin zhig mkhan drung tu bla ma thub bstan nor bzang nas 'brug yul brgyud chibs bsgyur gnang na legs gnas zhes pa'i dgongs tshul zhus kyang / da cha gnas tshul dza drag tu gyur te rgyal blon bka' gros zhib gnang gis mtsho sna brgyud chibs bsgyur gnang rgyu thugs gtan gtsang ma 'khel ba ltar/ rim bzhi pha lha sras dbang phyug dang /chang khyim zhabs sdod skal bzang thub bstan gnyis mon khul rgya gar sa srung brgyud rgya gar gzhung la 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor rgya gar 'phags yul du phebs bskyod chog pa'i bka' mol zhu bar nam nyin ltos med bshar bskyod dgos pa'i bka' brdzong mdzad//344

le tshan nyer dgu pa/rgya gar la btsan byol du bskyed pa/gcom༅/ /gnyal dre'u lhas nas nam ma langs gong tsam la chibs thon gnang dgos byung zhing / 7gong sa mchog gi phebs phyogs de yang mngon gsal du gyur yod stabs rgya gar sa mtshams bar gang myur chibs sgyur ma gnang che glo bur rgya dmag gi rjes 'ded yong nyen yod pa dang / de nyin gyi lam thag ha cang ring ba ma zad/ phebs lam gyi ri klung thams cad kha bas bkab nas skabs re chu chod gcig gnyis ring gangs kyi khrod du phebs lam brlag ste slar yang rkang rjes ded nas phyir log gnang dgos byung ba sogs kyi sku ngal chen po byung ba dang / chibs zhabs phal che bar gangs shel med stabs skra ring po yod mkhan gyis rang nyid kyi mig 'gebs pa dang / la las ras nag po cung zad thabs 'tshol gyis mig bkab te bskyod pa de ni 'grul bzhud mang po byed myong mkhan tsho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams myong gangs phyid mi rgyag pa'i thabs shes yin 'dugagla rgod la rtser phebs skabs gnam sa gnyis ka smug pas bkab shing / kha char bu yug 'tshub ste grang ngar shin tu che bas rkang lag 'khyags 'khums kyis tshang mas lus por drod khug thabs su gangs kyi dkyil du gom bgrod byas stabs phran bu'i 'gro bskyod bde ba byung / de nas nub phyogs su chu tshod gnyis tsam phebs bskyod skabs rim bzhin gnam gshis phran bu dwangs par brten phebs lam g.yas g.yon gyi gangs kyang bzhus te 315

mdun gyi lam kha gsal por mngon/ de nyin sa ma rub tsam la sbyor ra grong sder phebs 'byor rjes de khul mi dmangs rnams kyis phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus nas sbyor ra dgon par bzhugs zhag mdzad/7gong sa mchog sbyor rar ma phebs gong tsam la rgyal yum chen mo mchog dang /sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma ston 'khor bcas gnyal bya yul nas de gar sngon du phebs 'byor gyis phebs sgug zhus nas bzhugs 'dug sa gnas de ni mon gyi thag nyer slebs yod pa ma zad/ mtsho sna nas mon yul brwa phebs lam khag lnga tsam yod zer ba ltar sa mtshams brgal nye'i sar phebs stabs mi tshang ma blo bde bag phebs su gyur/ de'i sang nyin sbyor ra nas nam langs tsam la chibs thon gnang skabs gnam gshis ha cang dwangs po yod kyang ri klung thams cad kha bas bkab yod pa'i thog zhogs pa'i lhags bsil dang / gangs 'khyags kyi grang ngar 'doms nas mdun bskyed byed par dka' ngal 'phrad bzhin dal bu'i thog dkar po la brgal te gangs kyi dkyil du phebs pa'i mur lho nub thag ring phyogs nas lhung lhung zhes pa'i sgra skad cig glo bur thos te tshang mas sgra skad de ji yin cha ma rtogs par dngangs skrag skyes pa'i ngang rgyal khab su yin gyi rgyal rtags dang / ang rtags sogs gang yang med pa'i gnam gru dngul skya mdog can rlung 'khor gnyis ldan zhig nga tsho'i steng gi mkha' dbyings su 'phur yong ba mthong ste tshang mas gnam gru yong gi 'dug ces rang dbang med par skad shor te rta babs nas brag gseb dang / shing gseb/ na kha spo rdog bcas sar kha 'thor te gab yib byas/7gong sa chen po mchog dang / lhan du sku'i gcung po mnga' ris rin po che bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dang / spyi mkhan dga' brang / kho bo bcas gangs bzhus zin pa'i kong sa zhig tu gab yib mdzad/ chibs zhabs tshang mas 7gong sa mchog gi skya phyur 316

'gal rkyen mi yong ba'i bslu med dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba drag po 'debs pa las gzhan gyi bya thabs ma rnyed/ sku srung du bcar ba'i bstan srung dmag mi 'ga' shas kyis rang nyid kyis khyer ba'i me mda' gnam grur kha gtad de rgyag rtsis byed skabs 7gong sa mchog nas mgron che pha lha brgyud bka' bstsal don du/ me mda' gang byung hol rgyug tu mi rgyag par khu sem po byas nas sdod dgos zhes bka' gnang ste tshang mas nam mkha' la lta skabs gnam gru des lding bskor ma brgyab par byang shar phyogs su nga tsho ma mthong ba lta bus 'phur nas rim bzhin mkha' dbyings las mi snang bar gyur/ chibs zhabs nang nas khag cig gis gnam gru de rgya gar gyi gnam gru yin 'dug pas nga tsho gar yod sar nyams zhib tu btang ba 'dra zer ba dang / la las rgya dmar gyis 7gong sa mchog gsang bros su phebs pa shes te rjes 'ded lta zhib tu yong ba yin srid zer bzhin 'tshab 'tshub dngangs skrag gi ngang nas bgrod lam du zhugs/ gnam grur rgyal khab su yin gyi rgyal rtags dang / ang rtags med dbang la gzhigs na rgya mi'i nyul zhib gnam gru min nam snyam/ gnam gru de nga tsho'i thog tu 'phur yang mthong tshor byung ba'i rnam 'gyur gang yang ma mngon pa dang / de'i rjes su yang gnas tshul de'i skor gang yang ma bshad pa der bltas na phal cher khong tshos nga tsho ma mthong ba min nam snyam pa dang / gang ltar da lta bar gnam gru de rgyal khab su'i yin min gyi ngos len ra 'phrod byed mkhan su gcig byung med/de nas mi ring bar/ mtsho sna rdzong khongs kyi go po la brgyud phebs 'byor skabs mtsho sna rdzong sdod dang / mnga' khul gtso drag rnams kha bas g.yogs pa'i sa steng du phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus 'dug de rnams kyis 7gong sa chen po'i mthong grol zhal dkyil mjal ma thag rang dbang med par dad pas yid 'gul gyi mchi ma lhung lhung du 347

'bab pa las gzhan gang yang zhu ma thub par lus/ de nas mi ring bar mtsho sna dgon pa rtse'i gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod/sa gnas der nye dus lha sar drag gnon byas pa'i nyin gyi dgong dro lha sa'i skyed chu brgal nas bros phebs pa'i mkhan chung rta ra ba mdo sngags mthar phyin dang / khong dang lam bar mnyam 'phrad kun gling dza sag 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ nga dang mda' dpon mdo mkhar sras bsod nams stobs rgyal bcas mjal khar bcar/ de min lha sa nas brag g.yab che tshang hu thog thu blo ldan shes rab rin po che mtsho snar phebs 'byor gyis gnas tshul rnams snyan seng zhus/rjes su go thos byung don/ 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur grub rjes rgya dmar gyis phyi tshes 31 nyin bar shes rtogs byung med lugs dang / phyi ches 30 nyin snga dro chu tshod gnyis pa'i thog nor gling pho brang phyogs bzhi la me sgrogs mang po kha bsgrigs nas brgyab ste dgong dro chu tshod drug pa bar me skyogs khri lhag tsam bar mtshams med par brgyab rkyen nor gling pho brang gi lcags ri phyi nang dang / 7gong sa chen po bzhugs yul gzim chung 'gram du me mdel phog ste gzim chung gi g.yas g.yon la skyon chen po btang zhing / de bzhin mi lo 1300 lhag tsam gyi gong du chags shing / de rjes 7gong sa rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po dang/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs rgya bskyed kyis bzhengs pa gnang ba'i pho brang po tā lar me sgyegs brgyab ste de'i shar rgyud la me skyon yang byung 'dugadus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su bskrun pa'i gso ba rig pa'i slob grwa lcags po ri 'gro phan rig byed gling dgon par me phyogs mang po brgyab ste rtsa gtor btang /de nyin gcig pur nor gleng phyi nang bcas par me sgyegs dang / me mda' sbag sbag tshod med brgyab ste bod mi shi mas grangs las 'das pa byung / der yod mi mang po phyogs 348

gzhan du bros skabs me sgrogs dang / me mdas grangs med bsad pa dang / lhag par nor gling lho rgyud gtsang chu brgal te lho kha phyogs bros mkhan dang / 'dam ra brgyud byang ngos bros mkhan khag gnyis la rgya dmar nas snying rje spu tsam med par me sgrogs dang /me mda' sbag sbag brgyab nas bsad pa dang / mas nas chus khyer ba bcas grangs kyis ma chod pa byung /skabs der rgya dmar gyis grong khyer lha sa dang / 'bras spungs / se ra bcas su myul ma btang snye nor gling du bod mi rnams la rgyal kha 'thob tshul 'chal gtam bsgrags stabs mi dmangs rnams nas dga' ba'i 'bod sgra sgrog bzhin thon yong ba dang /lha rgyal 'then pa bcas byed skabs rgya mis lha sa'i grong khyer phyi nang dang / gdan sa se ra/ra che gtsug lag khang bcas par me phyogs dang / me mda' sbag sbag mang po brgyab ste mi ser dkyus ma mang po bsad 'dugaches 33 nyin lha sa'i nye 'khor grong gseb dang / ri khrod khag skyid chu dang /yar klung gtsang po'i nye 'khor / grong gseb phan tshun bcas par gnam gru btang ste stod lung dang 'phan po sogs su bros byol du 'gro mi ser skya mi dmangs la gnam gru'i thog nas me mda' sbag sbag dang / 'bar mdel mang po dbyugs te nyes med mi ser dkyus ma grangs las 'das pa bsad pa dang / khyim tshang ha cang mang po rtsa gtor btang 'dugagadug rtsub can gyi drag gnon de lta bu ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog rtsa ba nas byung ma myong ba'i gnas tshul shin tu ya nga ba zhig red/de'i dgong dro mtsho snar bka' blon zur shan sne gsum dbu bzhugs kyi tshogs chung thog nas mon rta dbang dgon par phebs lam khag lnga tsam yod pas phebs lam gang du gdan 'dren zhu 'gab mchos min skor dang / slad lho kha sa khul srung skyob kyi 319

mdzad phyogs/ lhag par 7gong sa mchog phebs rjes mtsho snas gtsos gnad yod sa gnas srung skyob byed phyogs skor bcas bka' sdur gnang ste lha sa nas sku srung zhabs zhur ched bcar dmag sgar ka kha gnyis kyi 'go dmag 300 skor yod pa de nas mang mang bar sku srung zhabs zhu nyung shas bcar rgyu las de byings rnams gnas skabs ring mtsho sna sa gnas der srung byar 'jog rgyu dang / mtsho sna nas mon khul 'gro lam de mang mang brgyud phebs na nyin gcig gi nyen kha yod pa dang / rta dbang na nyin shas 'gor rgyu yin na yang / phebs lam bde po yod tshod/ de min lam khag gzhan rnams rta dbang bar lam thag nye po yod kyang / phebs lam mang che ba ha cang rtsub po yod par brten yul mi tshos dbyar dus ring 'grul bzhud byed pa las ston dgun dpyod gsum ring mang mang brgyud nas phyin na 'grul lam bde ba yod ces zhus pa ltar/ nyin gcig gi nyen khar ma 'dzems par mang mang brgyud nas phebs rgyur thugs thag bcad/— de'i sang nyin mtsho sna nas chibs thon skabs gnam sngo thing nger bsdad yod pas tshang mas gnam gru slebs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag chen po skyed pa'i ngang mig rna gnyis kyis gnam la lta nyan byed bzhin par mdun skyed byas/ phebs lam du gangs chen po babs yod kyang de khul mi dmangs rnams nas ma skul dang blangs kyis phebs lam lam bcos kyis gangs bshangs gtsang sel gang thub byas te sku ngal de tsam ma byung ba'i ngang rim bzhin mtho sa nas rong mtshams kyis sa mtshams su phebs te dngul skya mdog can gyi ri klung de brgal nas/ shing nags dang ne'u gsing rnam par bkra ba'i mar gad mdog can gyi mdzes ljongs su phebs nas nyin zhag mang po'i ring mi tshang ma sdug bsngal dang dngangs skrag gi rnam pa de dga' ba'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas pa'i rnam par gyur/ de nas chibs thog tu chu tshod gnyis tsam phebs te mtsho sna'i mnga' khongs 320

mang mang du zhabs sor 'khod/ de khul gnas pa'i mi dmangs phal mo che mon pa yin zhing / mon pa zhes pa ni lung tshan gyi tha snyad 'bod pa zhig las/ mi rigs de ni skad dang yi ge gang gi cha nas kyang bod mi gcig gyur yin pa las mi rigs tha dad pa zhig gtan nas ma yin/nye sngon lhun rtse rdzong nas rgya gar sa srung sar btang ba'i rim bzhi pha lha'i sras dbang phyug dang / chang khyim skal bzang thub bsta na gnyis de gar phebs sgug zhus nas bzhugs 'dug pa rgya gar gzhung nas 7gong sa mchog dang / sku 'khor rnams rgya gar du phebs 'thus kyi rgya gar gzhung gi bka' 'khrol yod ces 'phrin bzang 'khyer 'dug pa ma zad/ rgya gar gyi sa srung las byed tshos dz+wa dwangs mo'i sar dga' bsu phebs sgrig zhu gi 'dug ces snyan seng zhus/ gnas tshul bzang po de thos skabs tshang ma 'dzum mdangs rgyas shing thugs bde bag phebs kyi dga' ba brjod kyis mi langs ba byung / de ni lo shas kyi sngon la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo 3500 'khor ba'i dus dran la 7gong sa skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma ched phebs kyis 'phags bod kyi mdza' 'brel dang / yang sgos 'phags bod mi rigs gnyis po lo ngo stong phrag lhag tsam ring dam tshig gtsang zhing / chos dang rig gzhung gi mdza' 'brel shin tu legs pa'i gnas tshul bzang po'i 'du shes de la brten nas byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin/da cha bod ljongs su rgya dmar gyis btsan gnon brnyas bcos ma bzod par 7gong sa mchog dang rjes 'brangs rnams kyis sku ngal la ma 'dzems par glo bur lha sa nas rgya gar du btsan byol du phebs pa de la rgya gar gzhung gis the tshom spu tsam med par dga' bsu gnang ba'i bkrin de ni nga tsho bod mi rnams kyis nam yang brjed mi srid/321

mang mang sa khul de grog rong zhig tu chags 'dug pa gnam gshis char zhod chen po yod stabs brlan gsher yang chen po 'dug 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs sa dbu gur gra sgrig byas 'dug pa de'i dgong dro sku bsil te gsol grod bshal ba'i snyun gzhi tshabs chen bzhes nas sku ngal ha cang chen po byung zhing / lo de'i snga lo gdan sa dga' ldan du grwa bskor chibs bsgyur skabs kyang snyun gzhi 'di dang 'dra ba lci po bzhes myong yod pa dang / lha sa nas glo bur dza drag can gyi gnas tshul 'og chibs bsgyur gnang snyedagos byung stabs bla sman pa gcig kyang chibs zhabs su lhan du phebs rgyur go sgrig zhu ma thub pa der tshang ma blo 'gyod rtas mi zin pa zhig byung yang re zhig bya thabs gzhan med par 7gong sa mchog dgu gur de nas yul mi'i shing khang chung ngu zhig nang spo bzhugs mdzad/'on kyang bslu med mchog gsum gyi byin mthu nyag cig la brten kho pos snang med du khyer ba'i sman kra ri man sin ril bu gcig yod pa de'i gras shig sngon chad dga' ldan du phul ba gsol grod bshal ba'i snun gzhir thugs phan gsos pa ltar skabs der yang gsol sman ril bu gcig pu de phul bas cung zad thugs phan gsos song / skabs der gsol sman de khyer rgyu gang 'dra se dran pa yin nam snyam da lta yang ya mtshan skye bzhin 'a dugamang mang la bzhugs zhag gcig gnang ste chibs zhabs su bcar ba'i kha dang mda' dpon bkras dpal dang / ru dpon dbang ldan/ brgya dpon skal bzang dgra 'dul/ ka dang sku srung brgya dpon blo bzang bkris/ de min dmag grangs 50 bcas dang / bstan srung dang blangs khongs nas sku srung lhan bcar 'ba' pa phyag mdzod bkris dang / smar khams bstan 'phel/ se ra ba'i ser dmag sum cu skor bcas mtsho sna khul dang / lhun rtse sa khul bcas su sa srung du phyir log gtong rgyur thugs gtan sngon 'khel ltar khong tshor mjal kha bstsal/ de rnams nas dgra 'thab kyis rang sa srung skyob zhu rgyur 322

dang du blangs pa der 7gong sa mchog nas khong tsho'i rgyal gces kyi sems stobs der bsngags brjod gnang ba dang sbrags bka' mngags gnang nas khong rnams mtsho snar phyir log byas/ skabs der kho bos khyer ba'i rgyang shel legs pa gcig dang / me mda' ṭin lhan bcas skyid sdug mnyam myong gi 'thab grogs kha dang mda' dpon bkras dpal la phul te nged gnyis gcig gi gcig la 'khur 'gan dang len bya rgyur dam bca' 'jog res dang / mngags bcol byas shing / sngon las mtshams sbyor gyis phan tshun gnyis 'bral mi phod pa'i skyo snang chen po byung / khong ni rang bzhin gyi dmag mi'i dpa' nyams ldan pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ lhag bsam zol med kyi mi zhig yin zhing / dus ngan de lta bu'i nyams sad theg pa'i rang nyid kyi 'thab grogs blos thub zhig yin/7gong sa mchog sku'i snyun khams lci po bzhes yod kyang bdag cag chibs zhabs rnams sems ngal gyis mi non ched snun gzhi de tsam med pa'i rnam pa zhig ston gnang mdzad de skyes chen byang chub sems pa'i bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i thugs stobs kyi cha shas tsam mtshon par snang /bod rla 3 ches 33 phyi rla 3 ches 31 nyin 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i snun gzhi'i babs kyis phebs lam du stabs bzo'i ched chibs sna go sgrig zhus te gdan zhus kyis phebs lam lam 'phrang dog po de chu'i rgyugs phyogs dang bskun nas me le bcu tsam phebs te rgya gar gyi sa srung sdod sa skas 'dzeg ma ṇi zhes pa'i sa gnas su phebs skabs mon rta dbang du bca' sdod rgya gar gyi dpon rigs gtso bo mur ti sab ces pa dang / las byed 'ba' sgu bla ma/ chu dwangs mor gtan sdod rgya gar sa srung las byed bod mi blo bzang zu ba lags/ skyes yul 'phan po dang rwa sgyeng bla brang gi zhabs gras yin pa/sa srung dmag 30 lhag tsam bcas nas phebs bsu mtshams zhu dang / gus 'dud 323

zhus te 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor dang bcas pa rgya gar du phebs chog pa'i thugs 'dun zhu skul gnang ba ltar/ rgya gar gzhung dang mi dmangs rnams kyis rgya gar gyi sku mgron ltar dga' bsu zhu gi yod ces snyan seng dang sbrags phebs sgrig zhus pa'i dgu gur nang du gdan zhus kyis sku ngal phran tsam gso ba gnang ste de'i nye 'gram chu dwangs mo sa gnas su bzhugs zhag dbu gur phebs sgrig legs po sngon zhus la zhabs sor 'khod nas bzhugs zhag mdzad/ de nyin nas bzung 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i snyun gzhi gnam gshis tsha drod dang bstun nas sgron bu'i dwangs skyes byung bar chibs zhabs tshang ma blo bde bag phebs byung /de'i sang nyin chu dwangs mo nas chibs thon ma gnang gong de khul gtso rgan dang /grong gseb g.yas g.yon nas 'dzoms pa'i mon pa mi dmangs brgya phrag lhag tsam la mjal kha bstsal grub bsnun me le bcu gnyis lhag tsam gyi sar yod pa'i sgo zam mchod rten zhes pa'i grong sde chung ngu zhig tu zhabs sor 'khod/ grong sde der sgo zam mchod rten zhes pa'i ming thogs don ni/ de khul mchod rten chen po gsum yod pas yin/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor las chung ba yod kyang dbyibs ha cang 'dra po 'dug 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul de mchod rten gyi nye mtshams lha khang zhig tu phebs sgrig legs po zhus 'dug de nas mon rta dbang bar bzhugs zhag gnang yul/ shag te dang / rlung la/mthong legs bcas brgyud bod rla na ches 32 spyi zu 4 ches 5 nyin mon rta dbang du chibs sgyur mdzad/mang mang nas brtsis na phebs lam du nyin lnga tsam 'gor ring nyin re me le bcu bdun dal bu'i thog gdan zhu byas/ phebs lam gyi bzhugs zhag so so'i sar mon pa mi dmangs rnams kyis rang cag bod mi rigs gcig gyur thog sngar gyi thun mong ma 324

yin pa'i 'brel ba/ lhag par bstan pa gcig 'gyur gyis dad zhen che bas chos 'bru dang mjal dar sogs khyer te phebs bsu zhus pa dang / 7gong sa mchog bzhugs yul rnams kyi yang steng du dar lcog gsar 'dzugs kyis mtshon bzhugs sgrig gzab rgyas zhus 'dug phebs lam g.yarnga g.yon du 'tshang ga gshig gshig gis zhal mjal zhu ba dang / bzhugs yul gang 'khel sar mtshan sgang bskor ba rgyag pa dang / phyag 'tshal ba/smon lam 'debs pa bcas dad gus dag snang shin tu che thog yul lung tsho khag so so nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin ma ṇi dang / ltungs bshags/ sgrol ma sogs kyi ljags lung gang zhus pa thugs dgyes mnyes chen pos dgos 'dod kyi re ba yongs su bskong bar mdzad/ snga dro bzhugs zhag sa nas dgong dro bzhugs zhag gnang sa bar gyi phebs lam 'khel sa'i g.yas g.yon gyi grong sde'i mi dmangs rnams kyis phebs lam du dre zhim bsangs kyi dud sprin lang long du 'phyur ba de dang snga dro'i smug pa gnyis 'dres nas dbye 'byed dka' bar snang /mon pa mi dmangs rnams kyis chibs zhabs tshang mar mon gyi yul skad du phebs bzang / phebs bzang zhes smon tshig 'bod pa dang / 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ring min lha sa'i pho brang dmar por phyir phebs skabs phebs lam 'di rang brgyud gdan 'dren zhu rogs zhes kha zhe gnyis med kyi re skul zhu gi 'dug de bzhin phebs lam du phran bu'i sku ngal gso ba gnang skabs khong chos chibs par smyug ma'i lo 'dab gsar pa ster ba sogs yul babs thon khungs kyi sri zhu gang thub zhus/phebs lam 'khel yul gyi grong sde'i mi tshang tshang ma'i thog steng du dar lcog gsar pa bsgrengs pa dang / dre zhim bsangs kyi dud spron gyis nam mkha'i khyon kun 'gengs par byed pa/ phebs lam du gad bdar dang dkar thig 'then pa/ phebs lam 325

g.yas g.yon du me tog sna tshogs 'dzugs pa bcas dad gus kyi sri zhu shin tu legs pa zhu ṣ+pe/ 'dug pa ma zad/ rang cag rnams nas myangs pa'i sdug bsngal la gdung sems mnyam skyed byed pa'i rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug rlung lar phebs pa'i nyin mo de mon sa khul du bca' bzhugs rgya gar gzhung gi chab srid spyi khyab har man dar sing (57740bsku'i( 51balha'i/ zhes pa de phebs bsur ched bcar gyis dga' bsu 'tshams 'dre gzab rgyas zhus rjes chibs zhabs su lhan bcar zhus/ de'i sang nyin rlung la bzhugs sgar nas chibs bsgyur ma gnang gong 'brug shar phyogs bkris sgang gi rdzong dpon 7gong sa mchog gi 'tshams zhur ched bcar zhus par mjal kha bstsal/ rlung la sa khul dang 'brug shar phyogs bkris sgang gnyis sa 'dres red 'dug mon rta dbang du chibs bsgyur bskyangs nyin rta dbang bla grwa dang / yul mi bcas kyi gtso 'thus rnams phebs lam du 'tshams zhur bcar/ skyid 'dzoms la rtser rta dbang dgon pa'i gsol tshar gra sgrig zhu sar dgu gur du ngang tsam sku ngal gso ba gnang / dge 'dun rnams nas ser sbreng dang / dung rgya'i snyan seng phul nas rta dbang du bca' sdod rgya gar gyi las byed rnams dang / yul mi gtso 'thus bcas kyis phebs bsu mjal dar phul/ rgya gar sku srung zhabs zhu ba dmag 35 skor ru bsgrigs kyis gus btud zhus par gzigs zhib mdzad de bzhugs yul gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod de bzhugs zhag 34dzad/ mon rta dbang sa khul de mon chu rgyud kyi lung shur nang chags yod pa dang / de ni lung pa phu thag thung la mda' ring ba/ rgyab ri mtho la gug pa/ mdun ri rnams ni rtse mo nang du gug pa/ g.yas ri rnams dpa' bo gdan la bzhugs pa dang 'dra ba/ g.yon ri rnams gzhon nu ma glu gar la rol ba dang 'dra ba dbus kyi rta dbang ni g.yu yi gzhong 326

pa'am maṇ+ḍal ltar mdzas pa ste/ mon pa rnams kyi de'i bstod gzhas su/ ya gi'i la chen po'i rtse nas bltas pa'i chi/ la 'og yul gsum g.yu yi gzhongs pa 'dra zer ba'o/rta dbang sa khul de rgya mtsho'i ngos las phu ṭi brgyad stong bdun brgya tsam yod/rta dbang gi chu nub nas shar lhor rgyugs pa'i brong nang chu byang bar dang / lhor rgyugs pa'i sung bur rnams la sngar rabs nags tshal stug pos khengs yod pa dang / zhing sa gshin po dang / grong tsho marjes pa/ mon yul gyi byang du mtsho sna rdzong bar me le drug bcu re gsum lhag tsam yod/ mon yul sa khul yongs rdzogs de byang gi 'phred thig 33 nas 38 bar gnas pa dang / shar gyi gzhung thig 91 dang skar cha 40 nas 93 bar gnas / mon yul de sa babs dma' la gnam gshis dro zhing / nam dus bzhi la dbye ba chen po de tsam med/ mon pa rnams gong spros ltar bod rigs yin pa dang / skad yig gcig gyur yin par bya chig re zung tsam bod skad dang cung mi mthun pa yod pa de ni 'bras ljongs dang 'grug pa bcas dang gcig mtshungs yin/ mon pa rnams ni chos lugs rnying ma dang dge lugs par dad mos che zhing mon yul du dge lugs kyi dgon pa che ba rta dbang dga' ldan lha rtse dgon pa dang / rnying ma'i dgon pa bcas khag gnyis gsum yod/mon yul de snga rabs su khyim mches yul gzhan dang 'gro 'ong gi 'brel ba nyung ba'i lung khug cig yin stabs de'i ming la sbas yul skyid mo ljongs zhes zer/ rjes su rnying ma'i bla ma gter bton pad+ma gling pas yul de lta bu zhig yod pa mkhyen te rang gi gcung po u rgyan bzang po bya ba yul de 'tshol du btang ste de'i mnga' bdag mkhar pa jo bo bya ba'i bu mo u chung rdo rje 'joms pa bdag mor bzhes te/ sangs rgyas gling /tshogs rgyas gling / o rgyan gling bcas gsum la dgon pa btabs/ tshogs rgyas gling rjes 327

su me skyon gyis 'jigs pa phud/ o rgyan gling dang / sangs rgyas gling deng sang yang yod pazang gragathag/snga rabs su rta dbang gi yul la yul maṇ+ḍal snang yang zer zhing / rjes su o rgyan bzang pos mon pa rnams la rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur sa yin pas na yul der rta dbang zhes pa'i ming du thogs pa red zer/ rta dbang dgon pa ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i slob ma me rag bla ma blo gros rgya mtshos phyag btabazug/dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i chu phag lo phyi lo 1583 lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng drug pa rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho rta dbang o rgyan gling zhes grags par sku 'khrungs/ mon yul de mon shar nub gnyis su gyes pa dang / rta dbang gi nub ngos skyid stong la rtse nas shar nub 'byed mtshams yin pa de nas brtsis pa'i nub rgyud du dwags po dang / spang chen/ legs po bcas yod pa de rnams la mon nub ma zer/ shar rgyud du nyi ma tsho gsum dang / lho dang byang dwags/ seng ge rdzong / gnyug ma gdong / sbrang nang chu rgyud/rong nang bcas yod pa de rnams la mon shar zer/ mon yul gyi sa mtshams ni mtsho sna'i 'gram gyi spos la nas rgya gar mnga' sde a sam gyi rgya thang dang ri mtshams bar gyi sa mtshams yin/ mon yul gyi ring tshad la rta pa'i nyin zhag 15 tsam gyi lam thag yod pa dang / zheng tshad la rta pa'i nyin zhag gsum gyi lam thag yod zer/ sa khul desngon chad bod gzhung mtsho sna rdzong gi mnga' khongs yin kyang / phyi lo 1914 lor bod dbyin rgyal khab gnyis kyis sem la'i chings yig 'jog skabs leg ma hon bod gzhung gi dbyin jis bod rang btsan yong ched rgyab rten lta bu sprad pa zhig 'dug par brten mig ma 328

ton sa thig nang du tshud yod pa ltar/ phyi lo 1950 lo rgya dmar gyi bod shar phyogs brgyud rim bzhin dpung 'jug byed pa'i skabs der rgya gar gzhung gis sngon chad bod dbyin gnyis kyis bzhag pa'i chings yig gi nang du 'khod pa'i mon yul sa khul de rnams la glo bur zhi drag mi sna btang ste rtsis len byas pa de nas bzung mon rta dbang gis gtsos pa'i mon yul gyi tsho sde 33 rgya gar gzhung gis bdag tu bzung nas yod pa red/de yang gong gsal phyi lo 1950 lor rgya gar gzhung nas mon yul rnams meg ma ton sa thig khong tshud par bsnyad btsan bzung byed skabs bod gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs nas lha sar yod pa'i rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab si nar mon sa btsan bzung gnang ba mi 'grig pa'i skor bka' mol nan po gnang bar sku tshab nas rgya gar gzhung la de skor snyan seng zhus pa'i phyir lan du/ da lta rgya mis bod sar btsan 'dzul byed kyi yod stabs nga tshos mon yul meg ma ton sa thig ltar snga 'phros bdag bzung byas pa tsam las ma 'ongs par bod rang btsan byung mtshams mon sa khul rnams bod gzhung la phyir sprod byed kyi yin zhes rgya gar gzhung gis lha sdod sku tshab si na brgyud gsungs pa skabs de'i bod gzhung phyi 'grel las khungs kyi do dam dza sag sne'u shar thub bstan thar pas phran la gsungs myong ba yin/ rta dbang du bzhugs zhag gsum gnang ring rta dbang dgon gyi bla gra spyi mgrin nas gsol 'debs zhus pa bzhin dgon gnas su chibs bsgyur bkrin che stabs dgon pa'i 'du khang yang steng nas dung rgya'i snyan seng phul/ dgon gsham nas dge 'dun rnams kyi ser sbreng dang / spos sna/ spyan rgya sogs kyis byin bsus te 'du khang yang steng gi gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod/ de nas 'du khang gi bzhugs khri sngon bsgron thog gdan zhus kyis dgon pa'i bla ma las sne 'dus dmangs rnams dang / yul mi sogs 329

la dga' ldan lha brgya ma dang / yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ yig drug bcas kyi ljags lung bstsal te 'du khang du gnas gzigs gnang / bod gzhung nas rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang / dge 'dun rnams la mang 'gyed sogs gzab 'bul gnang / de nas bzhugs sgar du phyir phebs kyis rta dbang khul gyi ser skya mi drag 'ga' shas la gzim chung mjal kha bstsal/de nyin lha sa nas dga' gdong sku rten mkhan chung dang / 'bras blo gling mkhan po pad+ma rgyal mtshan bcas phebs rjes su phebs 'byor byung / de nyin bka' sbug khul nas sngon ma 'byor pa'i bod kyi bde don tshogs pas gnyal khul lhun rtser bstan srung dang blangs dmag sgar la rogs ram du gtong gnang ba gzhung zhabs rtse drung byams pa dbang 'dus can 7gong sa mchog gi mjal khar bcar/rta dbang du nyin zhag gsum bzhugs rjes bod zu 3 ches 1 phyi zu 4ches 8 nyin chibs thon gyis ze la ri gsham ljang zhes pa'i grong sde'i dkyil la phebs sgrig sngon zhus ltar de gar bzhugs zhag mdzad/ de'i phyi dro de khul gyi yul mi rnams kyis gsol ba btabs pa ltar mjal dmangs bstsal/ de'i sang nyin snga dro chibs thon gyis ze la brgal nas seng ge rdzong dang / rdi rang / ra 'ong bcas sa gnas so sor bzhugs zhag mdzad de yul lung so so'i mi dmangs rnams la mjal kha dang / ma ṇi'i ljags lung bstsal/bod rla 3 ches 4 nyin 'bum sde lar chibs bsgyur gnang la nye ba'i skabs rgya gar dbus gzhung gis ched brdzong zhus pa'i sku tshab phyi 'brel las khungs kyi dpon rigs sku zhabs me non sab dang / las rogs sku zhabs rla dpal/ gsung sgyur 'bras ljongs ri nag yar pa bsod nams stobs rgyal/ sku srung 'gan khur zhu mkhan a 330

phrug che ring bcas ngo las rnams phebs bsur bcar te 'tshams zhu mjal dar phugade dang nye ba'i sar dga' bsu'i rgyal sgo gzab rgyas gsar bzos kyi 'gram du der yod rgya gar gzhung gi las byed gnad yod rnams dang / yul mi gtso 'thus bcas gral bstar bsgrigs nas phebs bsu'i mjal dar phul/ sdings cha'i thog zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / rgya gar sa srung dmag mi lnga bcu lhag tsam gyis ru sgrig gus btud zhus par dgyes mnyes kyis phyag stabs gus lan mdzad/ de'i gsham du de khul mon pa mi dmangs rnams kyis bstar bsgrigs te mjal dar dang / me tog lag tu 'thogs nas dga' bsu zhal mjal zhus/ de nas 'bum sde la'i spyi khyab har man dar sing gis ched du gsar bskrun zhus pa'i gzim chung bzhugs khri chen mor zhabs sor 'khod 'phral khong gis gsol ja zhal tog gi sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ de nas sku tshab me non gyis 7gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du bcar te khong gis de sngon rgya gar gzhung gi lha sar bca' bzhugs sku tshab gnang myong yod pa ma zad/ phyi lo 1955 lo 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du gnas gzigs phebs skabs lha sa nas mnyam bcar gyis sne shan gyi zhabs phyi zhu myong / khong gis srid blon niha rus 7gong sa mchog la rgya gar gzhung dang mi dmangs kyis dga' bsu zhu ba'i tar 'phrin de phyag tu phul/ de skor 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam las/ de dus srid blon sku zhabs niha ru nas mdza' brtse'i rlung 'phrin zhig gnang 'byor nang / nga dang nga'i las rogs tshos khyed la dga' bsu zhu rgyu dang / rgya gar du bde phebs thub par bkris bde legs yod/ khyed dang khyed kyi sku 'khor tsho rgya gar du bzhugs rgyu'i mthun rkyen ji dgos nga tshos dga' sgrub zhu rgyu yis rgya gar mi dmangs nas khyed la sngar bzhin gus bkur zhu rgyu the tshom med/( 331

'tshams zhu bcas zhes gsal/ de nyin 'dzam gling rgyal khab mang po'i chos tshogs khag dang / zhi bde srung skyob byed pa'i tshogs pa/ lhag par rgya gar gzhung 'dzin kong re se sogs mang tshogs kyi tshogs pa khag bcas kyis rgya gar a sam khul gyi dmag sgar ang lnga pa'i dmag dpon brgyud 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du phebs 'byor thub par bkris bde legs zhu rgyu'i rlung 'phrin khag mang po btang 'byor rnams phul/ rlung 'phrin gyi brjod chig phal che ba'i nang /tu la'i bla mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bod mi dmangs kyi don du sku ngal spangs te rgya gar sa thog zhabs sor 'khod par bkris bde legs zhu rgyu dang / rgya mi dmar po'i ring lugs kyis gtsos pa'i 'dzam gling dmar po'i ring lugs rnams la ngo rgol mthar phyin byed kyi yod/ bod rang dbang rang btsan yong ba'i mdzad bzang la rgyab skyor zhu gi yod ces gsal/de'i sang nyin 7gong sa mchog dang bka' blon zur shan sne gsum/ spyi mkhan pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ kho bo/ gdan 'thus gnyis bcas dang / rgya gar gzhung gi sku tshab sku zhabs har man dar sing dang ldi li phyi 'brel las khungs nas ched btang sku zhabs me non lhan du tshogs 'du gnang ba'i sar bar lam rgya dmar gyis de sngon btsan shed thog bzhag pa'i gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ma gnas pa'i btsan dbang rim byas dang / nye dus lha sar 7gong sa mchog rgya mi'i dmag sgar du gdan zhus kyis rkyen pas bod rgya'i mthun lam 'thor zhig phyin pa/ de la rgya mis drag gnon gyis bod mi stong phrag mang po dmar gsod btang ba dang / 7gong sa mchog bzhugs yul rtse pho brang dang /nor bu gling ga lha sa gtsug lag khang gnyis/ lha sa nye 'khor ser 'bras gnyis kyis dgon pas gtsos pa'i ri khrod khag bcas la me sgrogs grangs las 'das pa brgyab yod 332

pa'i skor gyi gnas tshul zhib phra gsungs te gnas tshul rnams rgya gar gzhung la 'phral du snyan seng yong ba'i bka' mol gnang / de'i dgong dro 'bum sde la'i spyi khyab har man dar sing gis 7gong sa mchog gis dbus chibs zhabs yongs rdzogs la dga' bsu'i gsol ston phul/ der nyin lnga bzhugs zhag gis sku ngal gso ba gnang ring rgya gar las byed gang yod dang / yul mi stong phrag brgal bar mjal kha bstsal/ 'bum la'i khul du bud med lag shes yar rgyas las khang dang / mnyam las tshong khang / slob grwa/ bzo grwa/sman khang / gzhung gi yig tshang khag bcas par gzigs skor gdan zhus ltar chibs bsgyur bskyangs/de bzhin bod zla 3 tshes ra phyi che 4 ches 15 nyin bod gzhung gi lo ltar de nyin mgon po gtso bor gyur pa'i srung ma rnams la mchod gtor phul ba'i chos phyogs kyi dus chen brgyad gtor dang bsnun nas gzhung 'bas rnams kyis dgun chas phud de dbyar chas gyon pa'i sngar srol mdzad sgo dus skabs 'khel gshis rtags rten slad gzim chung du mgon po'i gsung bskang mchod gtor 'bul bshams thog sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po dang / mchod g.yog rnam gnyis nas zhal 'don gsung zhabs zhus/ gsol mchod grub bstun 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod 'phral bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis gzhung gnas kyi mjal dar phul/ de mur sku zhabs me non dang / 'bum la'i spyi khyab bcas mdzad sgo'i bzhugs gral du 'khod de mjal dar phul ba dang phyag dbang zhus/ gsol ja bzhes 'bras rim bzhin phebs rjes mdzad sgo grol/ 'bum sde lar nyin lnga bzhugs zhag gnang rjes bod rla 3ches 9 nyin snga dro chibs thon gnang khar yul mi gtso 'thus rnams kyis snyan seng zhu sa don bzhin sa gnas der dran rten gyi chub shing mtshan byang can zhig 'dzugs gnang 333

mdzad/ 'bum sde lar nyin shas bzhugs ring har man dar sing gi lcam nas 7gong sa mchog gi ljags smin gsol tshogs tshang ma dang dod chen pos bzos te phul/de nas phebs rtso 'jib 'khor nang gdan 'dren zhus te/ phebs lam grog rong gzar po dang / chu khabrag thug g.yang gzar chen po yod sar phebs lam bzos yod pa der dal bu'i ngang nas gdan 'dren zhus kyang da dung phebs ṭo yam yom byed pa dang /thal 'tshub chen po langs te rjes su yong mkhan 'jib 'khor de bgrod lam gsal por mthong ma thub pas bar thag ring tsam bzhag nas bskyod dgos byung ste chu tshod bzhi ring me le 18 tsam las phebs ma thub/de nas rgya thang dang ri rgyud sa mtshams pu ṭi ras si zhes pa'i sar rgya gar gyi dmag sgar chags pa'i nye 'gram mgron khang du zhabs sor 'khod skabs sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog de gar phebs bsur 'dug pa 7gong sa mchog dang rgyal yum chen mo sku mched rnams bcas mjal 'phrad kyis dgyes mnyes shin tu chen po byung / de'i sang nyin de nas me le drug tsam gyi sar yod pa'i mgron khang du phebs te sku ngal khyug tsam gso ba gnang ring de khul phyi rgyal khag nas gsar 'god pa mang po phebs sgug zhus 'dug pa de rnams la mjal 'phrad gnang / de rnams kyi bar lam bod du dus 'gyur zing 'khrugs ji byung bka' 'dre zhus par re zhig gi dgongs 'char gsung gleng gnang rgyu'i dus su bab min zhes gsungs/de nas te tsi pur grong khyer bar phebs ṭo legs par gdan zhus kyis te tse pur gyi mgron khang du gdan drangs/ mgron khang der zhabs sor 'khod skabs gong gi gsar 'god pa de rnams sngon 'byor phebs sgug zhu bzhin 'dug de sngon bka' sgug du phebs bzhugs gnang ba'i srid zur bde mkhar ba dang / bka' tshab g.yu thog bkris don grub/334

'bras ljongs rgyal po'i mgron gnyer/ 'bras spyi las drung bcas 'tshams zhu mjal dar dang zhabs bcar zhus/ der yod gsar 'god pa rnams kyis re 'dun zhus pa ltar/ mi re re bzhin la 7gong sa mchog gis bka' 'dre zhus lan bstsal ma dgos par spyi yongs thog gsal bsgrags shig gnang ba'i nang / rtsa ba bod rgya'i gnas stangs dang /bar lam rgya mir mthun lam gnang stangs/ nye dus lha sar zing rkyen langs stangs sogs zhib 'khod yod pas 7gong sa mchog gi gsung bshad phyogs bsgrigs khongs su gsal/335

le tshan gsum bcu pa/7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mcho ga gis dbu 'khrid bskyangs pa'i bod mi btsan byol gzhung gsar gtod kyi lam lugs/ra༅༅/ /7gong sa mchog mon yul sa gnas su phebs skabs pe cing gi rlung 'phrin nas/ log spyod pa tshos ṭī la'i bla ma btsan khrid byas pa red ces gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis khyab bsgrags byas yod pa ma zad/ de rjes 7gong sa mchog nas te tse pur la gsar 'god pa rnams la gsal bsgrags gnang ba de yang phyi rgyal btsan dbang rgyal khab dang / rgyal spyi'i rgya skyed ring lugs pa rgya gar gzhung tshos rdzun gtam bzos pa red ces bshad pa de bzhin pe cing du yod pa'i paṇa chen rin po che dang / nga phod/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtsho gsum nas gong gsal te tse pur gsal bsgrags gnang ba de tā la'i bla ma'i gsung pa ma red/ ces pe cing gyi rlung 'phrin thog nas bshad bcug pa bcas de dag ni rgya gar gzhung nas 7gong sa mchog la dga' bsu zhus pa der rgya dmar gyis khong khro chen pos 'khon lan bslogs pa zhig yin par mngon/de'i dgong dro rgya gar gzhung gis ched mngags gzengs bstod kyis gra sgrig zhus pa'i ri lir gdan zhus kyis de'i sang nyin snga dro nub lhang ga la'i sa khul shi li gu rir zhabs sor 'khod skabs bka' rdor 'bras gsum du gnas pa'i bod me smos ci/'brug pa dang / 'bras ljongs / ta mang / shar pa/ rgya gar ba bcas mi grangs khro337

gnyis lhag tsam ri li'i babs tshugs su phebs bsu zhal mjal du bcar te lha sde rnams nas rol mo dung rgya'i snyan seng dang / mi sde rnams nas bod kyi rgyal dar dang /me tog mjal dar sogs 'bul bzhin dga' 'bod kyi skad sgra dbyar rnga ldir ba lta bu'i dbus su shi li gu ri'i ri li'i babs tshugs su chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam sku ngal gso ba gnang / ri li babs tshugs kyi phyi'i sdengs cha mthon po'i steng du chibs bsgyur gyis der 'dzoms pa'i mi rigs mi 'dra ba stong phrag mang por dgyes mnyes chen pos zhal mjal bstsal/rgya gar gzhung gi 'bras ljongs su bca' bzhugs chab srid spyi khyab a pa pan dang / rgya gar nub lhang ga la'i mnga' sde'i drung che/ 'bras ljongs rgyal po dang rgyal sras/bka' sbug khul du bca' bzhugs 'brug rgyal btsun mo'i yum ra ṇi chos nyid dbang mo bcas phebs bsur bcar 'dug pa de rnams la gzim chung mjal kha rim bzhin bstsal nas chu tshod 11 thog de nas mu mthud ri li thog phebs thon gyis rim bzhin phebs lam 'khel ba'i grong khyer che khag wa ra ṇa si dang / lag na'o/ ḍi ra dun bcas kyi ri li 'bab tshugs su zhabs sor 'khod skabs rgya gar mi dmangs khri phrag mang pos dga' bsu dang / gus 'dud zhus pa'i thog tu la'i bla ma sku che brtan pa dang / 'phags bod mi rigs kyi mdza' brtse ji srid bar du brtan par shog rgya mis bod du btsan gnon gyi bya spyod 'phral du mtshams 'jog byed dgos zhes skad 'bod 'brug skad ltar bsgrags/rla 4 ches na nyin rgya gar nub byang ri rgyud dbyar dus tsha g.yol bya yul snyan grags can gyi ma su rir bzhugs yul 'brir la ha'o se zhes pa rgya gar nang snyan grags can gyi 'byor ldan khyim bdag 'bir la zhes pa de'i khang khungs shig tu rgya gar gzhung gis phebs sgrig zhus pa ltar der zhabs sor 'khod/ rgya gar gzhung gis 7gong sa 338

mchog la bod rgyal khab kyi dbu khrid kyi thob thang sne len gzab rgyas zhus pa dang / sne shan dang sku srung mi sna ched 'dzugs zhus/ de nas nyin bzhi'i ring sku ngal gso ba gnang rjes ches 5 nyin rgya gar srid blon niha ru mchog kyang 7gong sa mchog gi mjal 'phrad du ched phebs kyis mchod yon rnam gnyis slar yang mjal 'phrad thog 7gong sa mchog gis bar lam bod du rkyen ngan ji byung skor dang / slad kyi mdzad phyogs thad gsung gleng rgyun ring gnang / srid blon niha ru nas kyang bod kyi rkyen ngan la thugs pham chen po'i thog thugs gso'i bka' slob 'bul gnang mdzad/de nas mi ring bar de sngon rgya gar bka' rdor khul sogs la sngon phebs srid tshab zur pa bde mkhar ba dang / bka' tshab g.yu thog bde don tshogs pa'i dbu 'dzin gcen mkhan rtsis gsum bcas dang / gzhung zhabs gzhan rnams bcas ma su ri bzhugs sgar du bskong tshogs kyis gzhis byes lhan 'dzoms gnang ste ma 'ongs rang cag bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan pa chab srid slar gso'i skor dang / yang dgos bod chol kha gsum du gnas pa'i bod mi yongs kyi rang dbang brtson len gyi bsgrub bya'i slad gros sdur tshogs 'du nyin bsnun gnang ba'i don snying / bod btsan byol gzhung gi sgrigagazhi gsar du bkod bsgrigs gnang ste bka' shag lhan tshogs 'og chos don dang / nang srid/ phyi srid/ shes rig dpal 'byor 'du 'dod bcas lhan khang khag lnga dang / las khungs kyi rim pa de las dma' ba bde srung dang / ldi lir bca' bzhugs don gcod las khungs gnyis bcas bkod sgrig gis bka' blon rnams nas gong gsal lhan khang che khag gi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyur gtan 'bebs dang / ngo las cha bgos gnang nas chos don bka' blon shan kha ba 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal dang / phyag rogs mkhan drung tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang / nang srid bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge 339

legs dang / phyag rogs mkhan mgron pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ phyi srid bka' blon sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / phyag sbrel sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la skabs der phyi srid bka' blon gyi mtshan gnas bstsal/ shes rig bka' blon dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / phyag rogs mkhan drung ngag dbang don grub/ dpal 'byor 'du 'a god bka' blon g.yu thog bkris don grub/ phyag sbrel spyi mkhan dga' brang blo bzang rig 'dzin/ phyag rogs dza sag spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel/ bde srung 'gan 'dzin kho bo sku srung mda' dpon stag lha phun tshogs bkris/ phyi srid bka' blon gyi phyag rogs dang ldi li don gcod gcig lcogs rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / phyag rogs phreng ring rim bzhi rig 'dzin rnam rgyal bcas khungs so sor bskobazhag gnang / skabs der dus skabs dang bsnun te bod kyi cha lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i sngar srol bzang po'i phyu chen de gzhung 'bangs tshang mas gyon chas bya rgyu gtan la phab/gong 'khod ltar/ 7gong sa chen po ston 'khor lha sa nas chibs thon grub rjes rgya dmag gis bod mi rnams la gdug rtsub kyi bya spyod ngan rgu tshang ba lag len bstar te gsod bzung grangs med byas pa'i 'jigs snang ma bzod par ser skya mi dmangs mang po rgya gar dang / 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs/ bal yul / la dwags/ 'bar ma/ shar tur ki si than bcas khyim mchis rgyal khab khag gi sa mtshams brgyud nas mnga' sde khag gi sa mtshams su btsan byol ba khri phrag mang po chu yan khyab pa ltar lhags parabarten 7gong sa mchog nas thugs rje bkrin bla med kyis rgya gar nang khul du bkag 'gog med pa de bgrod thub pa'i thog 'phral yun gyi 'tsho thabs phra tshugs yong ba'i rgya gar gzhung dmangs gnyis nas gang ci'i rogs bskyor yong thabs zhu skul gnang bar rgya gar 340

gzhung nas zhal bzhes gnang /bod mi mang che ba yong sa rgya gar shar a sam mnga' sde'i sa mtshams nas yong ste mi sa ma rir gsog sgar btsugs pa dang / de bzhin bod 'brug sa mtshams brgyud nas mang po 'byor te rgya 'brug sa mtshams sbag sar gsog sgar yang btsugs nas btsan byol bod mi rnams kyi mdun bsu sne len du bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / dza sag kun gling 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ kho bo bcas ched brdzong gnang ste rgya gar gzhung la bod mi btsan byol rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i dka' ngal sel thabs dang /lhag par ris med dge 'dun pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas dang / 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen sogs kyi bka' mol rim zhus ltar rgya 'brug sa mtshams sbag sar gdan sa gsum dang / sa rnying bka' gsum ris su ma chad pa'i 'dus sde thos bsam nor bu'i gling zhes pa'i chos sgar gsar 'dzugs gnang /skabs der rgya gar gzhung gis bod rgya'i sa mtshams khag tu 'byor ba'i bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la 'phral sel gyi dka' ngal sel thabs su gsog sgar khag tu 'byor ba'i bod mi btsan byol tshor zas gos skyob gso dang / lta rtogs 'go 'dzin dang /sman pa sogs gra sgrig gnang zhing / rgya gar dbus gros tshogs 'og ma'i 'thus mi a tsaru kir pa la nis dbu khrid kyis rgya gar dbus skyob gso tshogs pa gsar 'dzugs kyis rgya gar gzhung 'bangs dang / phyi rgyal khag gi rogs ram tsho khag bcas nas bod mi btsan byol ba rnams la rogs ram skyob gso 'byor rigs tshogs pa de brgyud nas bod mi rnams la skyob gso bgo sprod gya nom pa gnang / rgya 'brug sa mtshams su sbag sa'i gsog sgar la bod mi ser skya rim 'byor tshor sne len du 7gong sa mchog nas mgron che pha lha sa gnas su ched brdzong gnang ste 344

'tshams 'dre gnang / gsog sgar khag tu 'byor ba'i ris med ser mo ba rnams sbag sar gsog sgar du zla bsgril btang ba dang / mi dmangs khongs nas 'tsho ba rang gso thub rigs rnams rang gi 'dod mos ltar bka' rdor 'bras gsum sa khul la bskyed 'thus dang / de byings rnams la las ka thob ched rgya gar nub byang ri rgyud khag la lam bzo byed par btang / de bzhin bod gzhung dmag sgar lnga'i dmag grangs 500 lhag tsam rnams dang / bstan srung dang dmag gang tsam bcas 'bras ljongs khul lam bzor btang zhing / na gzhon khongs nas lag shes la do snang yod rigs khag gcig rang mos ltar rgya gar khul gyi bzo gra khag tu slob sbyong du btang / bstan srung dang blangs dmag khongs kyi na gzhon khag cig mi sa ma ri gsog sgar nye 'gram du 'phral sel bod yig dang / dbyin yig gi slob grwa btsugs te slob sbyong byed du bcugakho bo cag ma su ri bzhugs sgar nas ldi li brgyud a sam mi sa ma ri gsog sgar du ched bskyod kyis de khul bod nas btsan byol du gsar 'byor rang re'i ser skya spyan zu rnams la 'tshams 'dre byas te dus yun de tsam ma 'gor bar ma su ri bzhugs sgar du phyir log byed rtsis yin yang sa gnas der 'byor skabs bod mi rnams 'os babs kyi sa khul khag la bgos gtong bya rgyu dang / phyin chad kyi mdun lam bkod sgrig bya rgyu'i skor rgya gar gzhung phyogs la bka' mol zhu dgos mang dag byung bar brten de khul zu gsum lhag tsam ring ser skya mi dmangs dang mnyam du bsdad de gsog sgar de'i lta rtog gi 'gan 'khur rang bzhin gyis len dgos byung /thog mar lam bzor btang ba'i bod mi tsho khag 'ga' shas la dmigs bsal 'go 'dzin med kyang / rjes su rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / sa gnas gzhung gis bod mi'i sdod sgar du tu la'i bla ma'i dpon rigs med na ma 'grigs pa mkhyen te lam bzo khag 342

dang / gsog skar khag chos sgar bcas dang / rjes su gzhis chags khag sogs la bod gzhung nas 'go 'dzin rim bzhin bsko bzhag gnang rgyur khas len dang / rgyab bskyor gnang byung / gong 'khod ltar/ 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du zhabs sor 'khod rjes bod mi btsan byol ba mang po rim bzhin rjes 'byor byung ba'i ngag lam nas gzhis lus bod mi rnams nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i sdug bsngal dang dngangs skrag gi gnas stangs je sdug je zhan du gyur yod pa'i gnas tshul gsan thos byung nas/ 7gong sa mchog nas lngags rtsom gnang ba'i slob dpon thugs rje can gyi thugs dam gnad bskul gdungs dbyangs gsol 'debs nang / phongs shing don med bkol spyod gdung bas mnar/ snyad sdang srog la 'jigs pa'i dngangs skrag gis/ gshin rje'i grong khyer lta bur gyur pa yi/ chosaldan gangs can pa rnams ci yis nongs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mngon sum du byung 'dugaskabs der rgya mis bod kyi log spyod pa nyung shas kyis drag po'i zing 'khrug bslangs te mtha' ma bcings 'grol dmag gis zing 'khrug zhod 'jags btang lugs dang / de sngon bod kyi chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bka' bkod rgyud 'dzin mnga' bdag gi srid dbang sger 'dzin de rtsa med du btang lugs/ zhing bran dang bran g.yog gi lam lugs de yang rtsa med bzos te rgya che'i zhing bran dang / bran g.yog rnams la sngar byung ma myong ba'i rang dbang dang / dmangs gtso'i khe dbang thob lugs dang / de sngon bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / sku drag dang mtho rim dgon khag bcas mnga' bdag chen po gsum gyis zhing bran rnams la rang snang gang shar gyis bshu gzhog dang / sdug sbyong gtong ba/ rta lcag gzhu ba sogs khrims gcod ngan pa ji snyed btang yod lugs kyi rdzun gtam yang yang 'dzam gling nang du khyab spel byas pa dang / de bzhin btsan rgyal ring lugs pa 343
