dang / rgya skyed ring lugs pa chos bod kyi log spyod pa nyung shas bed spyod byas te zing 'khrug bslangs nas mun nag gi srid dbang slar gso'i re stong bcangs te ṭī la'i bla ma btsan khrid byas pa red ces rlung 'phrin nas 'ud sgrog yang yang byas par brten 1959lo'i rla 5 ches 30 nyin 7gong sa mchog nas ma su rir gsar 'god lhan tshogs sar 'dzam gling yar thon rgyal khab kyi gzhung dang / mi dmangs rnams nas bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul ji byung la rtogs zhib yong ba dang / rgya mi'i phyogs nas bod mi tshor btsan dbang mnar gcod sdug sbyong gi bya spyod mtshams 'jog dgos pa/ bden pa med pa'i bya ba de nus shugs ji ltar che yang / mthar thug gi rgyal kha de bden pa rang la 'thob rgyu yin/ nga tsho bod mi tshos rgya mi dang zhi grigs yong thabs kyi re 'dun mu mthud bya rgyu yin/ nga tsho zhi bder 'dod pa yod stabs 'dzam gling rgyal khab tshang mas zhi bde'i bya ba dang drang bden gyi bya ba la bsam mthun rgyab bskyor gnang rogs zhu rgyu yin lugs sogs 'khod pa'i gsung 'phrin zhig khyab bsgrags dang 'brel gsar 'god khag nas bod kyi snga phyi'i gnas lugs skor dre ba mang dag zhus pa tshang mar bka' lan zhib gsal gnang / 'on kyang rgya phyogs nas 7gong sa mchog gi gsar 'god pa rnams la gsung gleng 'bod skul ji ltar gnang ba de ngos len ma byas pa'i khar/ bod nang drag rnub kyi bya spyod mu mthud lag len bstar bar brten thugs kyis ma bzod par rgyal spyi'i mnyam sbrel rgyal chogs su bod don skor snyan zhu 'bul gnang mdzad rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang dgos byung /phyi zu 'a chis 1 nyin ma su ri nas ldi lir chibs thon gnang skabs ḍi ra dun ri li 'bab tshugs nas rgya gar gzhung gis dmigs bsal gra sgrig gnang ba'i ri li thog gdan zhus kyis de'i sang nyin spyi zu 9 ches 3 nyin snga dro ldi lir phebs 'byor 344

skabs ri li babs tshugs su rgya gar dbus gzhung gi phyi srid blon chen gzhon pa lcam sku meg nan dang / dpon rigs 'ga' shas phebs bsur bcar thog dga' bsu'i me tog phreng ba phul ba dang / ldi lir rgya gar mi dmangs bod don tshogs pa dang / tshogs pa gzhan khag rnams kyi tshogs mi de bzhin mang tshogs stong phrag mang po bcas phebs bsur bcar te lag tu dbyin hin bod bcas yig rigs gsum gyi 'bod chig sbyar yig mang po khyer nas tu la'i bla ma skya che brtan pa dang / rgyal bar gyur cig gung khran ring lugs pham par gyur cig ces pa'i skad 'bod byas/7gong sa mchog ri li'i gzim sgo'i phyir phebs thon skabs phebs bsur bcar mkhan mang tshogs rnams kyis mjal ma thag dga' spro brjod kyi mi lang ba'i thog nas me tog bstor ba dang / thal mo'i rdeb sgra yun ring bsgrags te dga' bsu gus 'dud bla na med pa zhus/ de nas phebs ṭo thog de sngon chos tshogs su phebs skabs kyi bzhugs yul ha'e dhar bta mgron khang la gra sgrig gnang 'dug pa ltar zhabs sor 'khod/sku ngal cud zad gso ba gnang rjes rgya gar gyi mes po ma ha ta ma ghan lha'i sku phung zhugs 'bul zhu sa ra ji sgar me tog 'bul bar phebs te thugs smon gnang /zu 9 ches 3 nas tshes 14 bar nyin bcu gsum ldi lir bzhugs rgyun ring rgya gar gyi srid 'dzin bgres gzhon rnam gnyis dang / srid blon niha ru/ de min gnad yod khag bcas la mjal 'phrad gnang /de bzhin rgya gar du bca' bzhugs sing ga la dang / a ri/ phe li pen/ ma la'i shi ya/ lho krita nam/ nyi hong / tha'i lan/ e jab/ dbyin ji/ pa ki si than sogasargyal khab khag gi sku tshab ngo ma 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul du ched bcar gyis bar lam bod la rkyen ngan ji byung skor rang rang so so'i rgyal khab dang mi dmangs kyi tshab zhus 345

nas blo pham dang / 'tshams 'dre yod ces dang / tu la'i bla ma sku bde po'i thog nas rgya gar du phebs thub par bkris bde legs yod ces sogs zhus/de bzhin ldi li grong khyer spyi khyab nas gsol ja'i ja ston gyi dga' bsu'i tshogs 'dur gdan 'dren zhus te tshogs 'du'i thog ldi li'i gnad yod mi sna 300 lhag tsam mgron 'bod kyis 7gong sa mchog la dga' bsu zhus pa dang / grong khyer spyi khyab nas 7gong sa mchog la me tog phul ba dang / dga' bsu'i gsung bshad gnang / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog nas bod kyi gnad don skor gsung lan mdor bsdus bstsal/ ldi ler bod don tshogs pa dang / rgya gar/ 'dzam gling zhi bde'i tshogs pa so so nas kyang 7gong sa mchog gdan zhus kyis dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams/ ldi lir bzhugs rgyun ring nyin ltar snga dro nas dgong dro'i bar tshogs pa khag gi dga' bsu'i tshogs 'dur phebs pa dang / rgya gar gnad yod dpon rigs dang /tshogs pa khag gi gnad yod mi sna mjal 'phrad/ ldi li khul dad ldan mi dmangs khag nas yang yang mjal kha zhu bar bcar te de rnams la 'dod blo khengs pa'i mjal kha baX/khub/be+e 'a tshos 9 nyin 'dzam gling mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs kyi drung che ṭaka ha ma shog (238 83107715 smo)()/7) la 7gong sa mchog gi mtshan thog nas bod kyi bde sdug snyan zhu tar thog nas 'bul gnang mdzad pa rgyal tshogs kyi yig char gsal/phyi ches 14 nyin dgong dro ldi li nas ma su rir chibs thon ma gnang gong rang re'i 'dzam gling mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs la snyan zhu 'bul mkhan sku'i gcen po phyi srid bka' blon rgya lo don grub mchog dang / phyag rogs su ldi li don gcod rtsis dpon zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan/ las tshan sa 'du rin chen don grub bcas la bsko bzhag 346

gis byed sgo rnams bka' mngags dang / bka' yig bcas bstsal/ldi li don gcod rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa a rir phebs bskyed ring re zhig don gcod las tshab tu mkhan chung chang khyim thub bstan tsho dpal dang / rim bzhi tsha rong sras bdud 'dul rnam rgyal gnyis la bsko bzhag bstsal/de bzhin bod mi btsan byol ba'i gsog sgar khag nang yod pa'i na gzhon skad yig dang / bzo las byi slob sbyong du 'os rigs dbye 'byed 'go 'doms shes rig bka' blon dza sag kun gling dang / las bya rtse drung thub bstan nyin byed dang / byams pa dbang 'dus bcas sa gnas khag tu bsko brdzong gnang ste ldi li nas bzhugs sgar ma su rir phyir phebs mdzad/de sngon 7gong sa mchog rgya gar chos tshogs su phebs skabs thugs ngo mkhyen pa'i rgya gar rgyal yongs su snyan grags can gyi mi sna 'ja'i parakasha na ra yan (/31 231 bya'i sku'i 257ba) gyis dbu khrid gnang ste ab ro e shi yan ko mi ṭi (4170—4318ba 00771(40ba116༷ / zhes pa'i tshogs 'du ldi li gsar par phyi lo 1950 lo'i zu 4 ches 8 nas tshos 11 bar nyin bzhi'i ring tshogs pa'i sar rgya gar dgus gzhung tshogs 'du gong 'og gi 'thus mi dang / mi sna grags can mang po phebs yod pa dang / de bzhin phyi rgyal nas shri lang ka dang / lho lī ti nam/ zhin rdu ni shi ya/ nyi hong /'bar ma/ ma la'i ya/ bal yul/ kong ko/ phe li phen/ tur ki si than/ li ba non/sge ne ya/ e 'jeb/ 'jor ḍan/ tong kong / tha'i wan bcas rgyal khab bcu bdun tsam gyi 'thus mi dang / chab srid pa/ gsar 'god pa/ rtsom sgrig pa/ chos pa/ spyi tshogs nang bi mi sna grags can khag bcas phebs te tshogs 'du de'i thog ab phi ri ka dang e shi ya'i yul khag gi dka' ngal skor dang / lhag par bar lam rgya dmar gung khran tang gis 347

bod la btsan 'dzul byas pa'i thog bod nang mi ser spel yul gyi srid byus ngan pa lag len bstar ba dang / bod mi rnams la btsan gnon gyis mnar gcod btang ste bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung / goms gshis bcas rtsa gtor byas dang byed bzhin pa bcas bod khyon yongs su gegs bar dang sdug bsngal mang po byung skor gleng mol gyis tshogs mi rnams nas bod mi rnams la sngar yod kyi khe dbang dang / rang thag rang gcod longs su spyod thabs skor mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs la rgyab bskyor yong ba'i zhu skul byas pa dang / bod don skor 'dzam gling yongs su khyab spel bya rgyu/ rgya mis bod du'agro ba mi'i thob thang las 'gal ba'i mnar gcod btang bar ngo rgol dang / skyon 'dzugs byas shing / 'gro ba mi'i thob thang rdog rol gtong ba'i bya ba'i rigs mtshams 'jog byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul byas pa dang / e shi ya dang ab phe ri ka gling phran gnyis kyi rgyal khab khag gi mi rigs phan tshun gyi 'brel ba'i thog nas bod don la gdung sems mnyam skyed bya rgyu/ ldi li gsar par ab ro e shi ya'i las khungs shig gsar 'dzugs bya rgyu'i skor tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis gros chod bzhag pa/tshogs 'du de grol rjes rgyal khab 'ga' shas nas phebs pa'i 'thus mis 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs sgar ma su rir mjal khar bcar te bar lam du rkyen ngan byung ba'i skor bka' 'dre zhus par bka' lan gnang / khong chos bod mi rnams ṣādaka' ngal 'phrad pa der blo pham dang gdung sems mnyam skyed zhu gi yod pa ma zad/slad bod mi rnams kyi drang bden gyi rang thag rang gcod kyi thob thang brtson len gyi las 'gul dang / sdug bsngal myangs dang myong bzhin pa'i bod mi rnams kyi skor 'thus mi rang rang so so'i gzhung dang / mi dmangs rnams nas gsal po shes rtogs thub pa'i gsal bsgrags dang / rgyab bskyor yong thabs 'bad brtson zhus chog pa bcas zhus pa red/348

de'i rjes tsam la/ rgya gar gyi snyan grags can gyi khrims dpon por shu tam gyis dbu khrid pa'i rgyal spyi'i khrims don mkhas pa tsho khag cig gis bod rgya gnyis kyi rtsod gleng dang / lhag par rgya mis bod du btsan gnon byas pa'i bya spyod sogs kyi skor la brtag dpyad ched du bod mi btsan byol ba'i gsog sgar khag la bskyod de bod mi mang po ngo 'phrad ji brtsad byas don/ rgya dmar gyis khams dang / a mdo sa khul la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur zhes ming btags te don du rgyu dngos tshang ma 'phrog pa dang / bod mi drag zhan rnams la nyes ming re re btags te btson 'jug dang / ngal rtsol btsan bskul byed pa sogs sdug bsngal myangs dang myong bzhin yod lugs/ bod mi rigs rtsa brlag gtong ched pho mo'i skye sgo bkag pa dang / mi sna grags can dang bla ma sogs la rdung rdeg mnar gcod sna mang gis 'thab 'dzing btang mthar dmar gsod btang ba'i skabs der de'i nang mi pha ma spun mched dang / bza' zu bu phrug bcas btsan bkug blta ru 'jug gi yod pa dang / de bzhin mi dmangs rnams la btsan shed dang / ngan skul byas te dgon pa mang po'i sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa rtsa gtor dang mer bsregs gtong du bcug pa/ khams khul gyi snyan grags yod pa'i li thang dgon pa dang / 'ba' chos sde dgon pa/ cha 'phreng dgon pa bcas la gnam gru'i thog nas 'bar mdel grangs med 'phangs te rtsa gtor btang ba/ sa khul de gnyis kyi mi dmangs rnams kyis dngos su myangs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / bod mi'i chos dang rig gzhung goms gshis bcas rtsa gtor btang ba dang gtong bzhin pa'i gnas tshul shin tu mang po khong chos shes rtogs byung ba dang / de bzhin bod kyi sngar rabs dang deng rabs kyi lo rgyus/ lhag par du bod dang phyi rgyal rgyal khab khag dbar bzhag pa'i chings yig dang gros chod bcas la nan tan gyis zhib 'jug gnang nas khrims don mkhas pa de rnams ma su rir ched phebs kyis 349

7gong sa mchog dang / bka' blon rnam pa/ de min gnad yod dpon rigs bcas mjal 'phrad gnang ste gang ci'i skor dri ba dri lan bcas zhib nan gnang ba'i gnas tshul rnams khong tsho'i las khungs dbus ma 'ji ni war snyan seng zhus/ 'ji ni wa'i rgyal spyi'i khrims dpon tshogs pas gong gi gan da don rnams la dpyad zhib byas pa'i mtha' 'doms su 1959 lo bod kyi gnad don dang / khrims lugs zhes pa'i deb cig bton pa'i nang / rgya mis bod nang mi rigs rtsa med kyi khrims 'gal byas pa dang / bod de don dngos thog rang dbang rang btsan yin pa ma zad/ khrims mthun gyi rang dbang rang btsan yang red ces thag gcod byas yod/rgya gar gzhung gi 7gong sa mchog dang / sku 'khor rnams rgya gar sa thog tu btsan byol du bzhugs chog pa'i bka' 'khrol dang / dga' bsu zhus te rgya gar gzhung gi sku mgron lta gu'i brtsi bkur gyis bzhugs sgar ma su rir go sgrig zhus pa ltar der lo gcig tsam bzhugs shing / de rjes rgya gar gzhung nas ma su ri'i sa gnas de dbyar dus tsha g.yol sa khul yin pas de khul spro 'cham du phyi mi gang byung yong sa zhig yin stabs sku phya srung 'doms thog dka' ngal 'phrad kyi 'dug pas pan 'jab mnga' khul kung ra sa gnas rda ram sa la zhes pa sngar dbyin ji sdod yul sa babs yag po zhig yod pa der spo shugs gnang legs dgongs 'char gnang ste 1950 phyi rla 4 ches 30nyin ma su ri nas phebs thon gyis zu 5 ches 1 nyin rda sar phebs 'byor gnang skabs sa khul de pan 'jab mnga' sde'i khongs yin 'dug pa de'i rjes tsam la hi ma cal par desha'i mnga' khongs su bcugabazhugs skar gnas spos ma gnang gong sa babs la zhib 'jug ched shes rig bka' blon dza sag kun gling dang / rgya gar gzhung gi sne shan lhan du sa gnas su ched 350

phebs gzigs bskor gyis thugs babs byung nas ma su rir phyir 'khor skabs 7gong sa mchog la stan seng gnang gsal du ma su ri'i 'o ma las rda ram sa la'i chu zhim pa 'dug ces zhu gnang mdzad/ma su ri nas rda ram sa lar spo bzhugs gnang rgyu thugs gtan 'khel nye'i mtshams ma su ri bzhugs sgar gyi nye 'khor he pi we lis zhes pa'i sa khul de'i g.yas g.yon du yod pa'i khang pa gnyis tsam khang gla glas te bod mi'i gsog sgar khag nas na gzhon 50 tsam 'dems sgrug gis dbyin ji'i skad yig dang / bod yig sum rtags slob sbyong bcas bya rgyu'i sngon 'gro'i slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs kyis slob gra'i 'dzin skyong dza sag phreng ring 'jigs med sum rtsen dbang por bsko bzhag bka' mngags bstsal/7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po ston 'khor ma su ri nas rda ram sa lar spo bzhugs gnang skabs ma su rir gtan sdod rgya gar gyi yul mi rnams nas tu la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs ma gnang bar 'di ga rang du bzhugs gdan 'jags rogs zhes re 'dun zhus kyang / gang ci'i gnas babs kyis ma 'grigs par bzhugs sgar spo bzhugs gnang dgos byung /rda ram sa la de kung ra'i rdzong khongs su gnas yod cing / rda ram sa la'i rgyab tu rdo la dhar gangs ri mthon po de gnas yod stabs dbyar dus char zhod ha cang chen po yod pa de rgya gar rgyal yongs su char zhod babs tshad ang gnyis pa yin zer/ de'i mdun lho ngos kyi kung ra'i ri klung gi yul ljongs ni rgya gar rgyal yongs su skad grags ldan pa'i mjes sdug g.yu yi gzhong pa dang mtshungs shing / dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi gnas yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nang tshan gnas chen dza lan rda ra yang gang ra 'di nyid yin pa mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis brtsams gnang mdzad pa'i gnas yig tu 351

gsal/ mtshan mo lung gshongs der rgyang lta byed skabs glog zhun rnam par bkra bas nam mkha'i skar tshogs sa la 'phos pa lta bur snang/thog mar rda ram sa lar 'byor nye'i rgyang ring nas rdo la dhar gangs ri de mthong ba tsam gyis gangs ri de'i rgyab tu rang cag bod mi rnams kyi brtse ba'i pha yul kha ba can gyi zhing khams de gnas yod snyam pa yid la lhang lhang 'char bzhin sems thag nye ba'i tshor snang zhig yong gi 'dug7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul pho brang de rda ram sa la steng mig lo ghan ji nas yar gyen du gom bgrod chu chod skar ma bco lnga tsam 'gor sa'i rtse la gnas pa de de sngon dbyin ji'i dus rabs su dbyin ji ba zhig gis bskrun pa'i khang chen zhig red/ de rjes rgya gar ba 'byor ldan zhig nas bdag 'dzin byas yod pa de'i ming la surag asha ram zhes 'bod/ khang chen der lo mang bdag sprod de tsam ma byung ba'i stabs kyis nyams gog tu gyur 'dug par brten skabs der rgya gar gzhung gis 7gong sa mchog gi bzhugs yul thugs gtan 'khel mtshams brel tshab kyi thog nas nyams gso gnang 'dugabazhugs sgar pho brang de'i nang du 7gong sa mchog dang / rgyal yum chen mos dbus yab gzhis sku 'khor rnams dang / gsol gzim mchod gsum/ sku sger yig tshang / gsol thab/ sku sger drung che/ rgya gar gzhung nas btsugs pa'i gsung sgyur gyi las shag sne shan gyi yig tshang / rgyab ngos su sku srung ba 'ga' shas sdod shag bcas go sgrig zhus 'dug de'i rgyab kyi ri rtse'i g.yas g.yon du khang chen gnyis yod par yongs 'dzin bgres gzhon rnam gnyis dang / gsung zhabs rnam gra 'ga' shas kyi bzhugs yul go sgrig zhus 'dug bka' blon shan sne gnyis dang / spyi mkhan dga' brang / mgron che pha lha 352

chibs zhabs gzhan dag rnams kyi bzhugs yul leg lo lhan ji 'i 'gram mo ṭi ma hol zhes pa'i khang rnying chen po zhig tu khang mig rer mi gsum nas bzhi tsam gyi bzhugs sa go sgrig zhus 'dug pa ha cang gu dog po 'dug de min khang mig che ba gnyis kyi nang du bod gzhung gi nang srid dang chos don las khungs tshogs sa dang / khang mig 'bring tsam zhig la 'du 'god las khungs dang / rtsis zhib las khungs gnyis tshogs sa yin/ khang pa de tsho nyin mo las khungs tshogs sa dang / mtshan mo las byed 'ga' shas las khungs tshogs sa'i nang nyal dgos kyi yod/shes rig las khungs dang / bde srung las khungs tshogs sa med gshes de nas me le gcig lhag gi sar las byed 'ga' shas kyi bzhugs khang zhig yod pa der shes rig las khungs tshogs shing / bde srung las khungs de mig lo lhan ji'i khang stong gi dkyil du yod pa'i de sngon kha che'i lha khang gyang gog chung ngu zhig gi nang du 'phral sel nyams gso byas nas tshugs/ skabs der chibs zhabs lhan du bcar mkhan gzhung zhabs che chung rnams kyi mthun rkyen ha cang zhan po yin pa ste/ bka' blon sogs mtho rim las byed rnams la zu re gsol phogs hin sgor 75 dang / de 'og rnams la che re hin sgor 53 dang a na brgyad re yod/ 'on kyang de rnams kyis phogs dang bzhugs yul sogs gnas stangs ha cang zhan po yod na yang sdug skad rgyag mkhan gcig kyang med pa'i thog rgyal bstan chab srid kyi rtsa don slar gso kho na'i sems shugs me lce 'bar ba lta bu'i ngang nas dka' ngal khyad du bsad de hur brtson chen pos las don bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dngos yod de dag la da cha rang gzhan tshang mas longs su spyod bzhin pa yin/7gong sa mchog rda ram sa lar chibs bsgyur gnang ma thag bar lam bod mi 353

btsan byol ba mang po rgya gar byang rgyud ri rgyud sa gnas khag tu lam las su btang ba rnam sa kyi dka' ngal sel thabs su de dag gi bu phrug rnams rda sa bzhugs sgar gyi g.yas g.yon du 'phral sel bu bcol khang zhig gsar btsugs kyis de'i lta rtog tu dbu 'dzin sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma dang / las rogs rtse drung thub bstan nyin byed la bsko bzhag bstsal/rda ram sa la'i nye 'khor gyi ku lu khul gyi bod mi lam las khag tu kho bo dang /rtse drung shan kha ba dge legs dar rgyas gnyis ched brdzong gis phru gu pho mo 35 'khrid yod pa dang / de'i rjes tsam la rtse drung byams pa dbang 'dus kyis sem la khul nas lam las khag gi phru gu 30 lhag tsam 'khrid yong ste phru gu 70 lhag tsam ko niyem ha'u se/ zhes deng sang shes rig bod kyi blos gar tshogs pa'i gnas sa der bdag nyar gso skyong gi bu gso khang gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ de rnams kyi nyin re'i lto gos dang /nyal chas sogs rgya gar gzhung dang / rgya gar dbus skyob gso tshogs pas mthun rkyen rogs ram gnang ba dang / 'dzam gling ye shu'i tshogs pa khag bcas kyi rogs skyor gnang ba'i bkren la brten nas rim bzhin rgya bal 'bras 'brug la dwags bcas su 'byor ba'i bod mi btsan byol rim 'byor gyi phru gu nyin re bzhin rda sa bzhugs sgar du phul 'byor byung ste grangs 'bor rim 'phar gyis sdod sa'i dka' ngal 'phrad de deng sang rda sa bu khyim gyi chags yul de'i khang rnying rnams nyos nas rim bzhin khang pa gsar rgyag gis yar rgyas btang ste/ phru gu de rnams gso skyong gnang /de bzhin bod mi btsan byol gzhung gi las byed grangs 'bor rim 'phar gyis las byed kyi bzhugs yul dang / las khungs tshugs yul thad dka' ngal 'phrad stabs rda sa steng shod gnyis kyi dbar la a mar na tha zhes pa'i sa khang spras gzigs kyis gangs 354

can skyed gshongs zhes pa'i ming sgyur gnang nas las khungs ma lag bcas dang / las byed gang 'tshams gyi bzhugs yul spo bzhugs gnang ba nas bzung da phan lo re bzhin yar rgyas yong bzhin pa red/7gong sa chen po mchog gis yang dag pa'i dgongs gzhi bla na med par brten nas rgya gar srid blon niha ru mchog dang bka' gros kyis bod mi btsan byol ba'i bu phrug rnams ma 'ongs rang cag bod mi rnams kyi dmigs yul bsgrub bya'i dpung khag gcig gso skyong ched du deng rabs kyi shes yon med du mi rung ba zhig yin pas de'i slad du rgya gar dbus shes rig las khungs kyi 'og rgya bod gnyis lhan tshogs kyi shes rig tshogs pa gsar 'dzugs kyis de 'og sa gnas ma su ri dang / ḍal la to si/ sem la/ rdor gling /bka' sbug mon ṭi a bu/ pa ca ma ri sogs gtan 'jags slob grwa dang / bod mi gnas sdod gzhis chags khag la nyin mo'i slob grwa bcas gsar 'dzugs kyis slob grwa khag gi 'dzin skyong lta rtog gi 'gan dbang bod mir bsko gzhag gnang ba dang / slob sbyong gi sgrig lam dang / dge rgan/ mthun rkyen bcas rgya gar gzhung nas rogs ram gnang /de bzhin de sngon 7gong sa mchog chos tshogs su phebs skabs thugs ngo mkhyen pa'i grogs po po lan mi rigs yin pa phe ṭi man zhes pa des 'char gzhi bkod don bzhin ma su ri dang / rda ram sa la khag gnyis kyi bu phrug khyim sde snga rjes gsar 'dzugs gnang ste/ rgya gar nang gi sger gyi tshogs pa khag dang/ phyi rgyal khag gi rogs ram tshogs pa sogs nas mthun rkyen rogs ram gnang ba'i dwa phrug gtso gyur nyam thag bu phrug gso skyong dang / slob sbyong sprod rgyu'i las don yar ngo'i zla bzhin 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod pa red/da bar gong gsal slob grwa khag dang bu khyim gnyis nas bu dang bu mo khri 'ga' 355

shas deng rabs kyi slob sbyong go skabs bzang po thob yod pa ma zad/ de'i khrod nas slob sbyong hur brtson phul byung gi rigs rgya gar mtho rim slob grwa khag dang / phyi rgyal khag gi mtho rim slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i go skabs dang mthun rkyen yang bstsal bzhin yod stabs da cha btsan byol bod gzhung gi las byed brgya cha dgu bcu lhag tsam gong gsal slob grwa khag dang bu khyim gnyis nas gso skyong gnang ba sha stag red/rgya bal 'brug 'bras bcas su 'byor bsdad bod mi rnams kyi 'phral sel dka' ngal sel thabs su 'ga' shas lam las dang / la las rang kha rang gso'i rtsag rtsig gi ngal rtsol nang du 'tsho gnas byed kyi yod kyang / de tsam gyis rang cag bod mi rnams kyis phugs kyi rtsa don bsgrub thabs kyi dka' ngal sel thabs med par dgongs te bod mi'i rtsa don gyi dmigs yul 'grub thabs de lo rgyus ring po'i mang gzhi zhig 'dings dgos par brten ji srid rang btsan ma thob bar de srid du rang cag bod mi rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang / rig gzhung skad yig nyams pa sor 'chud/mi nyams gong 'phel gtong thabs kyi ched du bod mi khe gtsang 'dus sdod kyi gzhis chags byed dgos pa dang / de yang sa cha rgya khyon gang 'tshams ma byung mthu med stabs 7gong sa mchog nas rgya gar srid blon 2ha rur zhu bskul bskyangs don bzhin srid blon mchog nas kyang rgya gar mnga' sde khag la sa cha rogs ram 'bod skul phyag bris gnang bar thog mar ma'i sor mnga' sde nas zhal bzhes gnang son byung bas nang srid bka' blon pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang / gzhis chags sa yul rgyus babs yod pa sku zhabs mo re si phe ṭi man lhan du rgya gar lho phyogs ma'i sor mnga' sde'i khul 'be la kob be zhes pa nags tshal skugs po yod pa'i sa cha der gzigs bskor gnang /dang thog de khul bod mi stong phrag tsam la sa zhing gnang nas lugs zung bsam 356

grub gling zhes pa'i ming btags/ de nas rim bzhin mon lho ṭi 'dod rgu gling dang / ton zur rab rgyas gling / ko li sgar don ldan gling / o ri sa phun tshogs gling / man pati phan bde gling / 'ban rda ra nor rgyas gling / a sam khul du ti dzu dar rgyas gling / me'o chos 'phel gling / 'bum sde la khul du bstan 'dzin sgang / sgang tog kun phan gling / rdo gling dang la dwags bsod nams gling bcas rim bzhin gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ de bzhin 'brug yul dang / bal yul sogs su yang rim bzhin bod mi gzhis chags gang la gang 'tshams gsar 'dzugs mdzad/de bzhin gong gsal gzhis chags khag gi nang ris med chos lugs kyi dgon sde khag kyang ji snyed cig phyag btabs te 7rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa nyams pa gsor chud nas ji srid bar mi nyams gong 'phel 'a byung thabs kyi rmang gzhi sra brtan 'dzugs par mdzad/ phyogs mtshungs bod mi'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lag shes rum thag gi las gra de bod mi gnas sdod sa khul phal mo cher btsugs te de dag gi thon zog rgya gar dang / phyi rgyal khag mang por phyir 'tshong byed pa dper na/ bal yul khul sdod bod mi btsan byol ba rnams kyi rum thag bzo grwa khag nas btags pa'i rum gdan rnams phyi'i rgyal khab tu btsongs pa'i yong 'babs de bal yul rgyal khab kyi lo re'i dngos zog phyir 'tshong gi yong 'bab kyi brgya cha 85 tsam lon gyi yod ces zer/ bod mi rnams kyi brtse ba'i pha yul nas rang dbang med par kha bral te yul gzhan du gyar te dka' ngal sna mang phrad na'ang gtso bo 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob lam ston dang / yang sgos nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi byin mthu la brten nas bod mi rnams blo brtan bag phebs thog ngal ba khyad bsad 'bad brtson che skyed byas te yul mi las lhag pa'i 'tsho ba gang legs skyel bzhin yod/357

1959 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du zhabs sor 'khod pa'i lo de'i dgun dus gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du gnas gzigs chibs bsgyur bskyangs pa'i skabs der rgya bal 'brug 'bras bcas su phebs 'byor rang cag chol kha gsum gyi gnad yod ser skya mi sna khag dang / rgya gar du snga rjes su phebs 'byor gzhung zhabs gnad yod bcas lhan 'dzoms kyi ma gros bsam mthun gyi thog nas slad bod gzhung bstan srid rang dbang rang btsan slar gso'i bsgrub bya'i skor gros gleng dang / lhag par bod mi rnams kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbu khrid 7gong sa skyabs mgon mchog sku che zhabs pad bskal brgyar bstan pa'i gsol ba 'debs rgyu dang / mgon po gang gi dbu khrid 'og chol gsum gzhis byes mi dmangs rnams mthun sgril dam zab lcags kyi gong bu lta bu'i sgo nas rang rang so so'i 'byon nus la dpag pa'i sri zhu zhabs 'degs hur brtson zhu rgyu'i mna' gan dang 'brel ba'i dam bca' phul/ 7gong sa mchog cigi thugs dgongs su sngar phan rang cag bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs de 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag dang mi 'dra ba logs su gnas yod kyang / de dag mu mthud gnas thabs med pa ma zad/ gnas 'dod kyang med cing / sngon dus bod mi'i spyi tshogs nang ser skya pho mo mchog dman gyi dbye ba rim can yod pa sogs kyis chos srid gang gi thad la'ang mdun skyed de tsam ma thub pa'i 'gog rkyen sna mang phrad par brten slad bod mi rnams kyi chab srid kyi go rtogs yar thon rgyal khab khag gi dpal yon srol bzang dang mthun pa byung na chos dang / chab srid/ dpal 'byor bcas sgo gang sa nas spyi snyoms kyis bod rang btsan slar gso'i mdun lam thog shar bskyod thub thabs kyi dgongs bzhes rlabs chen mdzad nas dmangs gtso'i khrims srol dang mthun pa'i chos srid zung du sbrel ba'i rtsa khrims zin bris shig phyogs sgrig mdzad rgyur gtan 'bebs gnang ba dang / de don gzhir bzhag gis btsan byol bod mi'i 358

khrod du rigs rus dang / lung tshan / 'byor rgud/ pho mo bcas kyi dbye ba med par rang gi shes yon dang / lhag bsam 'byon thang la gzhigs pas spyi 'thus mang mos grangs 'bor gyis 'dems bsko bya dgos pa dang / de bzhin btsan byol bod gzhung gi sri zhu'i las don mtha' dag gi nang du yang rigs rus dang / pho mo dbye ba med par 'dzul zhugs chog pa sogs kyi go skabs ches bzang po bstsal ba ltar rim bzhin dmangs gtso'i rgyal khab gzhan dang mtshungs pa'i dmangs gtso rang dbang gi spyi snyoms phyag len bstar te skabs babs kyi las don gang sar de sngon rang dbang rang btsan du gnas pa'i dus skabs las kyang tshags tshud 'gran rla bral ba byung yod/ phyi lo 1950 lor rla 9 ches 3 nyen rda ram sa la bzhugs sgar du de sngon bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs gnad yod rnams dang bod mi'i sdod sgar khag gi chol kha gsum gyi mi dmangs rnams nas 'dems bsko byas pa'i spyi 'thus dang / ser skya mi sna grags can bcas lhan 'dzoms kyis lo de'i snga lo ma su rir btsan byol bod gzhung gsar 'dzugs kyi sgrig gzhi phyag len cha tshang ma grub pa'i mjug skyong bskyar sgrig gnang ste sngar yod las khungs ma lag drug yod pa'i thog kha snon las byed bdag gnyer khang dang /rtsis zhib las khungs gnyis/ bde srung las khungs dang 'dra bar gsar 'dzugs gnang / bod chol kha gsum gyi khongs nas spyi 'thus gsum re dang / sa skya/ bka' rgyud/rnying ma/ dge lugs spyi 'thus re bcas kyi lo dus gsum ring las 'khur gnang rgyur bsko gzhag bstsal/skabs der rang gzhan tshang mas dmangs gtso'i lam srol lag len bstar rgyur nyams myong de tsam med stabs gnas skabs ring spyi 'thus rnams logs su zur tshogs ma dgos par/ gzhung srid 'dzin skyong gi las don la brtag zhib dang / nyams 359

myong gsog ched spyi 'thus rnams da yod las khungs ma lag khag dang bcas pa'i nang du dgu 'dzin las regs kyi gnas rim thog gzhung zhabs mnyam du phyar ba gru 'dregs kyis sri zhu bsgrubs/skabs der bod mi btsan byol ba rnams kyi bu phrug gso skyong dang / slob sbyong gi dka' ngal sel slad sku'i gcen po stag 'cher rin po che mchog gis thugs ngo mkhyen pa'i sud si mi rigs yin pa'i tog ṭar a shi man gyis thabs shes ngo sprod kyi rogs ram byas te rda sa bu bcol khang gi khongs nas snga rjes su bu dang bu mo 30 cam sud si pe se kra lo tse byis pa'i khyim sde (20bya(210251 6611skus0ba 3 711/280)zhes pa'i rogs ram tshogs pa'i 'og tu gso skyong dang slob sbyong gi go skabs thob ste pha tshab dang ma tshab chos dge bcas bsko brdzong gnang /de'i rjes tsam la tog ṭar a she man gyis slar yang snga rjes su bu dang bu mo drug cu skor sud dza lan ḍir 'byor ldan khyim tshang khag gi bu tshab lta bur lo dus ma slebs par slob sbyong dang gso skyong bdag gnyer bya rgyur blangs te rang gi bu phrug nang bzhin thob thang sprod rgyu'i gan rgya bzhagade nas gong bzhin zhing lan dang / pha ran si/ 'jar man bcas kyi byis pa'i khyim sde'i tshogs pa khag gis bu bu mo tsho khag re dang / pha tshab ma tshab bcas gong bzhin blangarngan/skabs der bod mir sha tsha yod pa'i phyi rgyal gyi mi rigs 'ga' shas kyis bod phrug mang po phyi rgyal du gtong ba de ma 'ongs par de rnams nub phyogs kyi shes yon dang /lta spyod ji snyed slob sbyong thob pa las/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos dang rig gzhung /goms gshis bcas rtsa brlag tu 'gro rgyur brten bod kyi spyi tshogs thog phan thogs dka' 360

ba'i nyen kha yod stabs slad phyin de rigs rtsa ba nas gtong rgyu med ces lhag bsam zol med lta bu'i bsam tshul brjod mkhan byung yang / 7gong sa mchog nas ma 'ongs bod kyi rtsa don la dgongs bzhes gzigs rgyang ring po'i thog nas bod phrug gang mang phyi rgyal du gtong gnang mdzad / de rnams kyis da cha bod kyi rtsa don las 'gul thog la phan nus chen po thon bzhin yod/7gong sa mchog rgya gar du phebs nas lo ngo gnyis tsam song ba'i ring rgya dmar gyis bod ljongs yongs su pha shi si'i drag po'i bkag 'doms 'og de sngon bod gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs rnams dang / chos lugs khag gi bla ma/ dge bshes/ dge 'dun pa/ tshong rigs/ bod gzhung gi drag po'i 'go dmag rnams dang / grong gseb khag gi gtso drag dang / rgan po sogs phran bu'i go don rtogs pa'i shes yon can yod tshad btsan shed kyis 'dzin bzung btson bcug thog mi'i nus shugs las brgal ba'i ngal rtsol btsan bskul gyi sdug sbyong btang ba dang / khrims med lugs med kyis khyi gsod pa ltar gyi dmar gsod ji snyed btang zhing / bod mi mang tshogs byings rnams kyang ya nga ba'i bkres skom gyis mnar ba'i sdug bsngal myangs dang myong bzhin pa'i gnas tshul rnams bod nas bal yul dang / rgya gar/ 'brug 'bras sa mtshams sogs brgyud bros byol du yong mkhan gnas tshul dngos myong rnams kyis sa nas thos/bod mi btsan byol ba mang che ba'i yong yul bod kyi nub phyogs stod khul rdzong khag nas bal yul dang / la dwags brgyud yong ba dang / lhag par du bod kyi nub brgyud sa khul de ri mtho chu gtsang gangs ri dang brag ris bskor ba'i rang byung gi sa mtshams dbye ba lta bur gnas yod par brten rgya dmar gyi bkag 'gog gi nus pa ma thon pa'i dbang gis bros byol mang po byed thub pa byung /361

bod dbus gtsang gi sa mtshams khag la rgya dmar gyi dmag don bkag 'doms dam po byas yod stabs mtha' mtshams su gnas pa'i bod mi bros byol thub pa las/ dbus gtsang nang khul sa gnas khag nas bros byol bya rgyu shin tu khag po byung /'on kyang mi'i nus pa de gnam las rgyal zhes zer ba ltar bod nang rgya mi'i btson khang tshun chad nas dka' nyen grangs med la ma 'dzems par bros thar ba yang khag cig byung yod pa red/de rnams kyis lo ngo gnyis ring dngos su myangs pa'i gnas tshul dang / rgya che'i bod mi rnams kyis myang bzhin pa'i ya nga ba'i gnas tshul de tsho thos pa tsam gyis rang dbang med par mig chu shor dgos pa zhe cig red/rgya dmar dbang 'dzin pas rtag tu drel bsgrags byas don bod rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la da bar bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa nyung shas kyis gtum drag gis dbang sgyur byas pa dang gdug rtsub che bas bshu gzhog btang yod pa red/ bar lam bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa ches nyung shas shig gis zing 'khrug bslangs pa der ma'o kru'u zhi dang / krung go gung khran tang gi yang dag pa'i dbu khrid 'og bod kyi zing 'khrug de zhod 'jags btang ste krung go gung khran tang gis bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur lag len bstar nas mi dmangs rnams la phan bde bskrun yod/bod kyi mun nag gi 'gro lam de rtsa gtor gyis 'od zer ldan pa'i 'gro lam thog bskyod kyi yod/ zing 'khrug zhod 'jags dang / dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur lag len bstar nas de sngon chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bka' bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran bdag pa'i srid dbang sger 'dzin rtsa gtor btang ste bka' bkod rgyud 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs med pa bzos stabs rgya che'i zhing bran dang / bran g.yog rnams la sngar byung ma myong ba'i rang 362

dbang dang dmangs gtso'i khe dbang thob rgyu byung ba red ces zer ba dang / zing 'khrug nang du ma zhugs pa'i mtho rim mi sna la blu nyo'i srid byus lag len bstar yod pa red ces zer nas rgya dmar gyi dbang 'dzin pas bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul rnams la phyin ci bslogs te nyin nas zla ba dang / rla ba nas lo bskud de rgyun chad med par bod mi rnams mgo bskor slob gso brgyab pa ma zad/ rgyang bsgrags rlung 'phrin thog nas kyang rgyun ma ra bshad yod pa red/lhag par du bod mi rnams snga dro nam ma langs gong nas dgong dro sa ma rub bar ngal rtsol btsan skul byas pa dang / mtshan mo nam phyed bar srid don slob sbyong yin zhes bskong tshogs thog gong gsal gnas tshul rnams chab srid slob sbyong yin zhes shod kyi yod pa red/da dung bod mi mi re ngo re'i sa nas lo brgyad tshun da bar gyi lo rgyus len pa dang / lta spyod 'gyur ldog ji byung gi bsam tshul zhu ba yang yang len pa/ rgya dmar gyis bod mi yongs la ya nga snying rje med pa'i sdug sbyong de lta bu btang ba ma zad/ zing 'khrug nang du rtsa ba nas ma zhugs pa'i chos kyi dge sbyor nyams len kho nar gzhol mkhan na rgas mtho rim mi sna dang / bla ma dge bshes/ 'byor ldan bcas la yang ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis nag 'gel gnod 'chi btang ba las g.yol thabs med par 'dzin bzung btson 'jug dang / ngal rtsol ra bar btang ba/ 'ga' shas bod kyi shar byang sa mtha' mi med lung stong dang / rgya nag nub byang sa khul ci'u chon dang lan kru'u khul sogs la rgyang 'bud lta bur btang ste zhing las dang / lcags lam bzo bskrun gyi ngal rtsol bskul ba dang / za 'thung ming tsam las ma ster bar mi mang po ched mngags ltogs shi rgyag bcug pa red/ 363

bod kyi rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la dang thog rgya dmar gyi g.yo ngan bslu bred kyis dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur gyi 'od zer ldan pa'i lam chen du rang dbang sprad lugs rdzun gtam rtag tu brjod kyang / don dngos bod rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams la ko ba rlon pa'i zhwa mo g.yogs pa ltar srid byus je dam du btang nas rang dbang dang bral ba'i byi'u rlung tsi'i nang blugs pa ltar byung yod pa red/dbus gtsang sa khul la byung ba'i gnas tshul de rigs mdo stod smad gnyis su de'i sngon tsam nas byung yod cing / ma'o tse tung gi rjes 'brangs g.yon phyogs pa chos dang thog mdo stod smad sa khul gyi mi dmangs rnams la mgo skor bslu bred dang / de nas mtho dman dbar gral rim gyi 'gal ba bzo ched dkrugs shing brgyab nas drag po'i 'thab 'dzings byas pa dang / btson 'jug do dam gyi ngal rtsol sdug sbyong btang ba'i thogaya nga snying rje med par dmar gsod btang / rgya mi'i rgyugs khyi byed mkhan bod mi 'ga' shas kyang skabs shig ring thed spyod byas zin rjes dmar gsod btang ba'i gnas tshul byung 'dugaklog pa po rnams la dpe mtshon zhig zhu rgyur/ dus skabs der mdo smad mtsho lho'i khul hor re tsho pa'i dpon stong dpon dbang rgyal dang / mtsho lho rang skyong khul gyi chab srid gros tshogs kyi 'thus mi phur pa gnyis kyis gung khran tang gi rjes su 'brangs nas rogs byas te sa khul der zing 'khrug pa rnams zhod 'jags btang nas de la byas rjes gzengs bstod sprad yod kyang / rjes su bred spyod zin rjes kho gnyis 'dzin bzung gis dmar gsod btang 'dugamatsho lho rang skyong khul gyi rdzong khag 30 yi gral rim 'bring khag dang /mtho rim gyi bod mi las byed pa 143 yod pa'i nang mtha' ma zing 'khrug zhod 364

'jags rjes las byed pa de rnams kyi nang mi 119 tsam 'dzin bzung byas nas dmar gsod btang 'dugade bzhin bod dbus khul du yang zing 'khrug nang ma zhugs pa'i rgyal gces yar thon zer ba'i mnga' bdag dang / mnga' tshab rnams la yang zing 'khrug rjes skabs shig blu nyo'i srid byus kyi go skabs sprad nas mi dmangs la mgo skor gtong byed kyi lag cichar spyad zin rjes rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su de rnams la yang nyes ming sna tshogs bkal nas drag po'i 'thab 'dzing gi sdug sbyong ji snyed btang 'dug pa ma zad/lhag par rgyal gces yar thon gyi mi sna zhes rgya dmar gyis ming btags pa'i ka shod don grub dang / phun khang zur pa grong smad blo bzang dbang ldan/ bon zur phun dbang sogs kyang 'thab 'dzings kyi 'jigs skrag ma bzod par rang shi rgyag dgos byung ba sogs re re bzhin brjod kyi mi langs kyang 'dir dpang rtags mtshon byed don dngos re zung zhig bgrangs so/365

le tshan so gcig pa/phyi lo 1953 lor rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis bod hin sa mtshams la drag dpung gdong thug gi rgyu rkyen/dang〉༅/ /phyi lo 1949 lo rgya dmar gyis rgya nag dbang bsgyur byas nas bzung rgyal spyi'i mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs nang du tshud thabs kyis rgya gar gzhung la ngo bstod lta bu byas par brten rgya gar gyis rogs bskyor byas pa dang / lhag par rgya dmar gyis bod la dbang bsgyur bya rgyur bar chad mi yong ched de sngon dbyin ji dang / bod gnyis kyi meg ma hon sa thig skor la kha mi grags pa lta bu'i ngos len gyi rnam 'gyur bstan yod par brten rgya gar gzhung gis bod la rogs bskyor yong thabs skor rgya gar gzhung la skad 'bod ji ltar byas kyang rgya gar gzhung gis kha ya ma gnang ba'i rkyen gyis rgya dmar gyis rang snang gang dran gyi bya spyod lag len bstar ba red/de'i sngon rgya dmar gyis rgya nag la dbang 'gyur ma byung ba'i sngon tsam la rgya gar shar phyogs sa khul gyi rgyal srung dmag spyi dbyin ci pha ran se ṭa kur (banga'abazhu15 150607/gyis rgya nag gis bod dbang bsgyur byed 'char la nga tshos gdong len gra sgrig byed dgos kyi red ces bsam tshul zhig bton yod pa red/de rjes a mi ri gas ko ri yar dmag 'khrug rgyag skabs a ri'i srid 'dzin kru ru man gyis rgya gar gzhung gis bod sa khul de srung skyob byas na a ri nas skyel 'dren 367

'don sprod kyi rogs ram byed kyi yin zhes bsam tshul bton yod kyang rgya gar gzhung gi ma nyan pa red/ gal srid skabs der rgya gar gzhung gis dmag grangs khri gcig tsam bod du btang yod na rgya nag gzhung gis rgya gar gzhung dang dmag gi gdong thug mi yong ba'i g.yol thabs byed kyi red/ gang yin zhe na/ skabs der rgya nag gis ko ri ya dang dmag 'thab byed bzhin yin par brten rgya gar dang dmag sa ang gnyis pa zhig rgyag gi ma red/'on kyang a ris bsam tshul bton pa de la ni'u ldi lis de sngon yang ha se sban ḍi yis bod du rgyang skyod gyi dmag brgyab pa ltar lag len bstar na rjes 'bras gang yang yong rgyu med par ha cang nyen kha chen po yong rgyur 'jigs te a ri'i srid 'dzin kru ru man gyi bsam tshul la ngos len ma byas pa red ces/ sha ha (4 2 5636) yis brtsams pa'i rgya gar gyi srung skyob dang phyi 'brel srid byus/ (/bkye120 70(0btu'u 'ibasku 107018ba 20/1/14)zhes pa'i deb nang du gsal /de mtshungs 1950 lo'i rla 11 nang rgya gar gyi srid blon gzhon pa nang srid blon chen gcig lcogs sar dar pa skyel (53621 7311866 6621 2260/) mchog gis srid blon niha ru la bod don skor gnas bris ring po zhig phul ba'i nang du rgya gar gzhung gi pe cing du bca' sdod sku tshab pa ni kur rgya mi'i mgo g.yogs 'og tu tshud pa red ces mngon chung thog nas skyon 'dzugs byas yod pa dang / rgya nag ni kha dan tshig la mi gnas pa dang / ma rung khog bcug gi gab yib kyi dgra bo zhig red ces dang / khong gis tha tshig tu/ rgya nag gi dmag bod du btsan 'dzul byas nas de sngon rgya gar dang / bod kyi dbar gyi sa mtshams dang tshong don gros chod bcas rtsa med du 'gro rgyu nyag cig red/ gros chod de rnams nga tshos dus rabs phyed ring bya ba bsgrubs pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa zhig red ces dang / yang khong gis mngon chung gi thog nas srid blon niha ru la/ nga rgyal thog blo thag mi 368

chod pa de sngar bzhin 'dzin gyi yod pa red/ rgya gar gyis rgya nag la ya lan bya thabs mthar phyin gyi srid byus gsar par tshad gzhi zhig bzo dgos thog rgya gar gyi dpung dmag rtsod rnyog langs pa'i sar srung skyob tu bzhag dgos kyi 'dug ces gnas yig btang yod pa red/ 'on kyang srid blon nen rus/ rang gi bsam don rgyun 'khyongs kho na byas te rgya nag dang da mus bzhin mdza' mthun gyi srid byus lag len bstar te rgya nag gzhung gsarapa de mnyam sbrel rgyal tshogs nang du tshud thabs kyi drol bsgrags thabs shes 'bad brtson byas pa dang / 1954 lo'i rla 4 ches 39 nyin rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis pe cing du ming rtags bkod pa'i gros chod chings yig gi nang du/ rgya gar gyi lha sar bca' sdod sku tshab las khungs dang / rgyal rtse/ gro mo/ stod sgar thog bcas khag gsum gyi tshong don las khungs dang / sgrag tar gyi sgrig chas/ rgyal rtse nas sgang thog bar zhag tshugs sdod khang bcas rgya mir rtsis sprod byas/ rgya gar ba bod du sngar bzhin gnas bskor bskyod 'thus skor gsal ba las sa mtshams kyi skor la gros mol gang yang ma byung ba red/lo de'i rla snye nang rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis gros mthun zhes pa de'i nang rgyagar gzhung gis krung go'i gzhung nas bod la bdag dbang yod ces 'khod yod/de sngon dbyin ji rgyal khab kyis bod de rang btsan rgyal khab cig la ngos 'dzin thog 'brel ba byas yod pa des rgya gar rang btsan byung nas dang thog sngar mus bzhin srid byus de 'dzin yod kyang / lo de'i rla 7 nang rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis bod kyi gros chod ces pa de bzhag pa'i nang du de sngon gyi srid byus 'dzin pa de mjug 'grol byas pa red/gleng brjod nang du krung go'i bod sa gnas zhes 'khod 'dug gros chod de'i 369

nang zhi mthun mnyam gnas kyi bslab pa lnga'am/ pan ca shel zhes pa de gzhi bzung nas gros chod cig bzhag pa red/dang po/ phan tshun bdag dbang dang mnga' khongs cha tshang la brtsi 'jogaganyis pa/ phan tshun btsan gnon mi byed pa/gsum pa/ nang srid la the byus mi byed pa/ bzhi pa/ 'dra mnyam gnyis phan/lnga pa/ zhi bde mnyam gnas bcas red/zhi mthun mnyam las kyi bslabs pa lnga 'am/ pan ca shel zhes pa'i 'byung khungs der mi chos 'grel bshad mi 'dra ba rgyag gi yod pa ni la las/ srid blon rteta ru en rdu ni shi yar phebs skabs/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chig don snyan po de rnyed pa red/ tshig don de'i yong khungs ni snga rabs rgya gar gyi kun spyod srol rgyun gyi tha snyad cig red/skabs de nas srid blon niha ru yis rgya gar phyi 'brel srid byus kyi spyod lam drang bden yin pa'i thog la bed spyod kyis drel bsgrags byas te/ e shi ya/'i gling chen nang gi rgyal khab chen po rgya gar dang rgya nag gnyis kyi zhi bde mnyam gnas kyi bslab pa'am/ pan ca shil gyi srid byus gzhir bzung nas mdza' mthun lag sgrel gyis rgyal spyi'i mdun lam thog bskyod rgyu'i lag len bstar gyi yod pa red/yang mi la las zhi bde mnyam gnas zhes pa'i tshig don de 1949 lo ma'o tse tung gi gtam bshad cig tu don tshan dang po dang bzhi pa'i tshig don de bshad yod pa red ces zer/ gang ltar gnas tshul de'i 'og lo rabs lnga bcu pa'i dkyil du rgya gar dang rgya nag rgyal khab gnyis bu spun hin dh+wa ci ni sba ye sba ye zhes pa'i 'bod tshig de dar 370

khyab byung ba red/1955 lo rgya nag srid blon kra'u en le rgya gar du 'tshams 'drir yong skabs khong gis rgya gar gyi srid blon deha ru la mig ma ton sa thig de'i don gnad skor gleng lhag byung ba nas bzung de rjes lo shas ring rgyal khab de gnyis kyi srid blon gyi ming thog nas sa mtshams skor la rtsod gleng gi yig 'brel la na grangs mang po byung yod/rgya gar gzhung gi leg ma hon sa thig de rgya dkar nag rgyal khab phan tshun gnyis kyi sa mtshams rtsod rnyog gang yang bsdad yod pa ma red ces gsungs yod pa dang / rgya nag gi meg ma ton sa thig ni de sngon dbyin ji dang / bod gnyis nas bzhag pa'i gros chod kyi mjug 'bras shig red/ de dag rgya nag gis ngos len byas med ces bshad yod kyang / kra'u en les/ leg ma ton gi sa thig de don dngos zhig chags yod stabs khog nas khas len byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan yod pa red/ gal srid rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis sa thig ngos len byas na/ bod kyi bdag dbang la ngos len dang / brtsi 'jog byed dgos pa red/phyi lo 1959 lo 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog rgya gar du btsan byol phebs te lo de'i rla 9 pa'i nang ldi lir rgya gar gyi 'dzam gling zhi bde tshogs pa'i tshogs 'du'i thog gal srid rgya gar gzhung gis bod rang btsan gyi thob thang la ngos len ma garang na sem la'i chings yig de nus pa med pa chags pa dang / de bzhin mig ma hon sa thig de yang rang bzhin gyis nus pa med pa chags kyi yod pa red ces gsungs yod/phyi lo 1959 lo'i rla 8 ches 35 nyin rgya dkar nag gnyis mig ma ton sa thig thog phan tshun drag po'i gdong thug byung ste rgya gar gyi dmag cig bsad pa dang /gcig la smas skyon byung 'dug/ gnas tshul dza drag de 'phel rgyas byung ba'i thog rgya gar 371

gyi chab srid tshogs pa khag dang / las rigs khag gi mi sna/ mi dmangs bcas kyis bar lam rgya dmar gyis bod la btsan gnod kyi bya spyod ngan pa lag len bstar ba der ngo rgol shugs che byas pa ma zad/ bod mi rnams dang lhag par du 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog la gdung sems mnyam skyed zhus 'brel gus bkur chen po zhu gi 'dug de bzhin rgya gar gzhung gi da bar rgya nag la bstun mkhas kyis rgya yan skyag lang du btang ba dang / rgya gar nyam chung nus med la brtsis te bod la btsan dbang byed du bcug pa red ces rgya gar gyi gsar shog khag dang / mi sna snyan grags can gyis gzhung la kha rdung dang skyon 'dzugs byas pa red/ skabs der srid blon niha ru yis rgya nag gi bya spyod kyis rkyen pas g.yo 'gul chen po thub te rnam 'gyur ston stangs kyi 'gyur ba de byung ba red/don tshan gcig ni/ phyi lo 1959 lo'i zla 8 ches 35 nyin med ma hon sa thig brgal bskyod dmag 'khrug byung ba de dang / de rjes rla 'a chis 8 nyin kra'u en le yis/ srid blon naha ru la leg ma ton sa thig skor la gnas bres shig btang 'byor nang du leg ma ton sa thig de lo rgyus thog krung go'i gzhung gis khas len byas med par brten de'i lho rgyud thad drangs kyi la gsham bar mnga' khul de krung go'i sa khul yin/ sa khul de'i rgya khyon me le gru bzhi ma 3875 tsam yod/ krung go'i gzhung gis btsan gnon gyi 'og rgyal khab kyi bdag dbang dang / mnga' khul phyir tshong gi khas len ga 'dra ze byed kyi red ces 'khod 'dugasrid blon naha ru yis de sngon kra'u en le yis meg ma hon sa thig de khog nas khas len byas pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan yod pa rnams kha dan tshig la ma gnas par yongs su brtsi med du btang ba red/dang thog rgya gar srid blon deha ru yis krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab 372

gsar gtod byung ba de mi rigs ring lugs kyi rgyal khab kyi srid dbang thob pa dang / e sha ya/'i chab srid thog slar gso thub pa'i rtags mtshan zhig yin pa las gung khran ring lugs kyi rgyal kha thob par ngos 'dzin byas yod pa ma red/khong gi dgongs par/ rgya nag gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dpal yon de ma khe si ring lugs kyi lung tshig dang gung khran tang gi sgrig gzhi de rim bzhin 'jig pa dang 'dres sbyor gyi lam lugs gzhan zhig chags rgyu dang / de bzhin krung go dang hin rdu rgyal khab gnyis kyi lam lugs mi mthun yang 'dzam gling mtha' yas pa'i nang gi chab srid kyi 'gran rtsod thog la kha gtad cig chags na yang rgyal khab gnyis kyi mthun lam thog skyon gnod chen po yong gi ma red dgongs pa red/ khong gis rgya nag dang 'brel ba ma byung sngon nas ma 'ongs par rgya nag dang rgya gar gnyis rgyal spyi'i thog la phan nus chen po chags rgyu'i yid ches yod cing / rgyal khab de gnyis spyan nye ltar 'dra mnyam mdza' brtse mtshon pa'i mdun lam thog 'dzam gling rgyal spyi'i nang rgyal khab de gnyis mna' 'brel dam po 'brel 'dres gcig tu gyur thub pa'i dgongs tshul re 'dun rgyun ring gnang yod pa red/phyi lo 1949 lo'i lo mjug tu/ ma'o tse tung gis rgya nag la gung khran ring lugs kyi krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab de btsugs ma thag ru su rgyal khab kyi rjes tsam la rgya gar gzhung gis ngos len byas pa'i rgyal khab gnyis pa'i gras shig red/ de nas bzung rgya gar gyis rgya nag gzhung gsar pa'i thog la srid byus lag len bstar stangs de rgya gar rgyal khab nang gi chab srid pa dang / gsar 'god pa/ las rigs khag gi mi sna khag cig gis srid blon naha rus rgya nag gzhung gsar pa rgya yan gtong thabs kyi srid byus bskyangs pa de skyag lang ngan shor kyis bod la btsan 'dzul de byung ba dang / gnas tshul de dag byung skabs rgya gar gzhung gis rgol gtam drag po ma bsgrags pa'i thog kha rog 373

bsdad nas rgya mi bod du yongs su btsan 'dzul byed bcug pa red/ khag gcig gis/ rgya gar byang phyogs kyi sa mtshams su rgya nag pa chags pa de ring min rgya gar gyi mnga' khul du rgya bskyed ring lugs kyi 'jigs skul bya rgyu de g.yol thabs med pa zhig chags kyi red ces skyon brjod byas yod pa red/ da cha sngon gyi skyon 'dzugs de rigs rnams ma 'ongs lung bstan lta buradangos su ra 'phrod byung ba red/rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi meg ma hon sa thig du gdong thug byung nas rla gnyis kyi rjes la dwags dang / bod kyi sa mtshams kun dga' la zhes pa'i thog phan tshun gnyis gdong thug kyang byung ba red/la bod sa mtshams der 1843 lo'i rla 10 ches 9 nang bod sing gnyis dmag 'khrug mtshams 'jog gis phan tshun gnyis btsan 'dzul mi byed pa'i chings yig bzhag pa de'i nang sa mtshams dbye 'byed byas pa de da bar gnas yod pa ltar rgya gar gzhung gis thog mtha' bar gsum du chings yig der brtsi 'jog byed bzhin yod kyang pe cing gis chings yig de 'jog skabs rgya nag gzhung gi sku tshab zhugs med pa ma zad/ chings yig de'i nang du sa mtshams gnad yod dngos gsal thag gcod byung mi 'dug ces shod kyi yod par brten rgyal khab gnyis kyi sa mtshams slar yang dbye 'byed dgos lugs bshad pa red/rgya gar dang rgya nag phan tshun gnyis rtsod gleng byung ba'i skabs der rgya phyogs nas 1955 lo rla 3 ches nang shar tur ki si than yar ken sa gnas ag sa cin brgyud (47521 khu'i/ba) stod sgar thog bar 'gro lam ring tshad me le 750 tsam che 19 ring gsar bskrun byas yod/ de'i ming la shin bod lam chen zer/ lam chen de'i nang rgya gar gyis sa cha me le brgya lhag tsam tshud yod ces zer/ 'on kyang 'gro lam de 374

bzos ma tshar sngon du rgya gar gyis ma shes pa red/1955 lo kra'u en le rgya gar du yong skabs sa mtshams skor bsam tshul ston pa nas bzung 1959 lo'i rla 8 pa'i nang rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi sa mtshams su drag po'i gdong thug ma byung bar phan tshun gnyis kyi shar nub sa mtsha mas gnyis kyi rtsod gleng rno ngar ldan pa'i yig 'grul dang gsar shog thog dpyad gtam ji snyed spel yod pa red/ meg ma hon sa thig dang la bod sa mtshams su rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis drag po'i gdong thug byung rkyen de sngon bu spun lta bur 'bod pa'i 'du shes de dgra bor gyur te rgya gar rgyal yongs gang sa gang du rgya nag la ngo rgol gyi rba rlabs de khyab pa red/phyi lo 1953 lo rla 1 ches 31 nyen rgya dkar nag gnyis kyis hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud lho byang gnyis nas 'dzam gling yongs su g.yo 'gul thebs pa'i dmag 'khrug glo bur du byung ste rgya mi'i dmag mi meg ma hon sa thig gi lho ngos su 'dzul nas smyug ma gshags pa ltar mon rta dbang nas thad drangs kyis rgya gar a sam khul gyi te tse pur gyi nye 'gram ca khu (05755)bar slebs nas zu 11 ches 30 nyin dgong dro pe cing nas me mda' rgyag mtshams 'jog pa'i gsal bsgrags byas/ de nas nyin dgu'i rjes rgya mi'i dmag rnams rim bzhin meg ma ton sa thig gi byang phyogs su phyir 'then byas/ 'ga' shas kyis ru su yis shugs gnon brgyab nas rgya mi'i dmag phyir 'then rgyag dgos byung ba red zer/ gang ltar rgya dkar nag gnyis meg ma hon sa thig gi lho ngos phyogs kyi nags tshal gyis khengs pa'i ri klung du dmag 'khrug nyin shas 'thab mthar phan tshun gnyis ka she mas mang po byung yang / rgya mi'i phyogs la shi mas ji byung su zhig gis shes tshor byung med/ de bzhin rgya gar gyis rgya mi'i 375

dmag gcig kyang 'dzin bzung byed ma thub/ rgya gar gyi dmag 1300 tsam shi ba dang /rgya mis 'dzin bzung byas pa 3900 lhag tsam byung 'dug dmag 'khrug de'i nang phan tshun gnyis kyis dmag grangs gcig mtshungs yin na'ang / rgya gar gyis dgra bor mthong chung byas pa'i nyer len gyis dmag 'thab nang pham nyes chen po byung ba las dmag mkho'i sgrig chas de rgya dmag las zhan pa med zer/1959 lo bod mi rnams rgya gar du bros byol skabs rgya gar gyi drag zhan tshang mas gal srid rgya mi dang / rgya gar gnyis dmag 'khrug thug na rgya gar gyi dmag mi gnig gis rgya mi'i dmag mi bcu tsam kha gtad gcog thub kyi red ces 'ud sgrog byas yod pa de ni rang gzhan gnyis kyi gnas tshul gsal po ma rtogs pa'i rkyen gyis yin/ dmag 'khrug ma byung ba'i sngon tsam la rgya dmag gis 'bras ljongs bcings 'grol gtong gi red ces dang/ rgya dmag gis gro mo'i chu rgyud thad drangs nas shar pa ke si than dang lag sgrel gyis a sam dang / blang ga la sa khul gnyis gcod gtub byed kyi red ces dkrog gtam de khyab ste bka' rdor dang / 'bras ljongs/ 'brug bcas su gnas sdod bod mi rnams dkrog gtam de'i dngangs skrag gis rgya gar nang khul dang / bod mi gnas sdod bya yul khag gzhan du gnas spo byas yod pa red/dmag 'khrug de ma byung sngon rgya gar gzhung gis bod mi rnams bod rang btsan gyi las 'gul bya rgyu bkag 'doms gang thub byas yod par brten bka' rdor khul du btsan byol du gnas pa'i chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'go khrid dza sag a 'brug mgon po bkris kyis gtsos pa'i mi sna 'ga' shas bka' rdor khul du bzhugs ma bcug par ldi li khul du gnas spo gnang dgos byung /dmag 'khrug byung rjes rgya gar gzhung gis pe cing la bsnun mkhas byas pa'i 376

srid byus de ston mjug chu yi rba rlabs lta bur mar chag nas yid thang chad thog bod don skor phran bu'i rnam 'gyur drag tu song nas gong gsal 'go khrid de rnams rang sar phyir log byed du bcug ste srid don gyi las 'gul sngar mus bzhin byed du bcug pa red/1953 lo'i don rkyen des rgya gar gzhung la slob gso chen po thob ste rang gis sa mtshams srung skyob sra brtan ma byung thabs med yin pa shes nas byang phyogs kyi sa mtshams shar ti pu ciri bo nas / nub la dwags kyi sa mtshams bar srung skyob thog nus shugs 'don rgyur gtan 'khel te bod mi btsan byol ba na gzhon rnams la drag po'i slob sbyong sprad nas gong gsal sa mtshams khag tu bed spyod bya ched bsdu len bya rgyu gtan 'khel byung / gong gsal gnas tshul skor rgya gar 'brel yod nas sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog la bka' bsdur byung ste/ 19༄3 lo'i nang sku gcen rgyal don mchog gis kho bo dang / chu bzhi sgang drug gi 'go pa gnyis mnyam du 'bras ljongs khul du lam las la yod pa'i bod dmag rnams dang bstan srung dang blangs dmag drag po'i slob sbyong bya yul du 'phral du gtong thabs dgos lugs bka' phebs ltar bskyed de sa gnas su yod pa rnams kyi nang nas rgas 'khogs re zung phud/ gzhon pa rnams sa gnas su gtong thabs byas/ de bzhin sa gnas gzhan du yod pa'i lam las rnams kyang rang rang gi 'dod blo ltar drag po'i slob sbyong du rim bzhin gtong thabs byas nas grangs 'bor khri gcig lhag tsam zin yod/ de rnams la zu shas ring drag po'i slob sbyong sprad rjes rgya gar byang phyogs bod rgya'i sa mtshams khag tu so lta byed pa ra bzhag dmag sgar de'i ming la (590018/ stu10ba/101 60100) dmigs bsal sa mtshams kyi dpung sde zer/ dmag gi ang rtags 33 yin/ dmag sgar de'i bka' bkod spyi khyab khang dang slob sbyong dge rgan / mthun rkyen/ sgrig 'dzugs kyi 'go 'doms 377

bcas rgya gar gzhung nas thugs 'gan bzhes kyi yod cing de rnams la lta rtogs bya chedarang phyogs nas chab srid slob ston 'go byed bsko gzhag gi ched brdzong gnang /phyi lo 1959 lo bod mi btsan byol rnams rgya bal 'brug gsum bcas su 'byor rjes sku'i gcen po rgyal don mchog dang / dza sag a 'brug mgon po bkris rnam gnyis kyi bkod sgrig 'og gong gsal sa gnas sdod sgar khag tu gnas pa'i bstan srung dang blangs dmag gi khongs nas khag gcig bal yul rgyud glo smon thang du gsang bskyod kyis 'jab dmag gi dmag sgar gsar 'dzugs gnang /phyi lo 1954 sku gcen chi ring sgrol mas lo shas ring bod phrug rnams la gzigs skyong gnang ba'i sku ngal chen po byung rkyen glo skran gyi snun gzhi bzhes te rla shas ring ka la ka tar sman bcos su phebs kyang dwangs skyes ma byung bar 7gong sa mchog gi bka' drin nyag cig la brten nas zhing lan du sman bcos su gdan zhus kyis gshags bcos gnang ba bcas zhabs rim dang sman bcos sogs gang thub byas rung / gang gis kyang zlog ma btub cing kho bo'i bsod nams kyi yol sgor ma 'chun par 'jig rten phye ma'i snga lam du gshegs pas bsam brjod las 'das pa'i gdung ba drag pos mnasaskabs der 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas sku'i gcen mo de nyid kyi mdzad rjes mdor bsdus dang / dam pa de nyid sa lam rim bgrod kyis bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du 'thob pa'i thugs smon mtshams sbyor gyis ljags rtsom bkrin che ba 'di ltar/brtse ldan gcen mo tshe ring sgrol ma de nyid/ 1930 lo bod chen po'i nang tshan mdo smad a mdo sku 'bum gyi nye skor stag 'tshor khyim tshang du btsas/ grong gseb zhing pa phal pa'i bru mo dkyus 'gre'i lugs bzhin nang khyim gyi nyin re'i las kur g.yengs pas 378

shes yon sbyangs brtson byas pa med/ nged tā la'i bla ma'i yang sri da du ngos 'dzin byas te nang mi yongs rdzogs bod dbus phyogs su yong ba'i skabs/ gcen mo dang / yul srol ltar chung grogs su mnyam yod phun tshogs bkris lha sa chos ldan zhing du 'byor/ lha sar sdod ring bod yig dang / rgya skad sngar nas phran shes thog/ rgya yig khya khyor tsam sbyang brtson byas yod pa dang / yul gshes mig ltos goms pa lta bu'i chos dad mi chung tsam 'jags/ gcen mor bu gcig dang / bu mo gnyis byung ste gcig 'das grongs song / de sngon rgya gar dang / rgya nag nang sog khul lta skor 'gro myong ba dang / 1953 lo 'gor pe cing gi bkod byus 'og rgya nag nas/ mo se kho brgyud o si ḍi ri ya/ khri nar zhi bde'i gzhon nu 'i tshogs 'du zhig la phyin/ lha sar rgyal gces bud med mthun grogs tshogs pa'i 'thus mi dang 'go 'dzin gras kyi ming 'khur blangs/ 1959 lo bod du rkyen ngan byung skabs nged cag mnyam du rgya gar du 'byor rjes btsan byol bod mi ches mang rgya gar du rim 'byor gyis bu phrug la yul dus 'phrod bsten gso skyong ji bzhin ma thub pas bod phrug 'bor che rkyen 'das dka' ngal tshabs che byung bar brten 'di ga pan jab rda ram sa lar 'phral sel bu gso khang zhig btsugs pa'i 'gan 'khur gcen mo de nyid nas blangs te/ 1951 nas 1954 lo tshe mthar ma slebs bar bu phrug 1050 tsam la byams skyong bdag gces lta rtogs lhag bsam rnam dag gis rang nyid shes nus gang yang med kyang ngal 'khur dang len byas song ba de ni khong rang gi mi che'i nang byas rjes che shos rjes su yi rangs bya 'os pa zhig yin/ gcen mor snga dus shig nas khong skran dang / rtsa dkar lta bu'i nad gzhi zhig yod mus 1954 zu nga nang 'phar ldang la ka tar sman bcos rla ba lnga tsam byas kyang phan thogs ma byung stabs sman pa'i ngag don ltar zhing lan du sman bcos byed slad bskyod/ sman bcos dang / rim 'gro ji ltar byas kyang / 'dus 379

byas mi rtag pa'i gshis lugs bzlog ma btub par/ 1954 lo'i zu 11 ches na1snga dro eng lan sman khang du che 'dus byas lugs thos par/ mchog gsum thugs rje bskul rgyu tsam las thabs dben/ rla grogs phun chogs bkris nas 'khur blangs kyi 'khos bsnun rnam dkar dge mjug rgya cher bsgrubs/ eng lan nas 'khyer 'byor de nyid kyi rus thal la nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsung rab nas ji skad gsungs pa ltar gyi rus chog gnad smin dang 'brel sa tshar dpar 'debs kyis sgrom bu 'di nang sgrig 'jug thog de nyid kyis ma shi gson pa'i ring nyam thag bu phrug mang por byams skyong byas pas mtshon bdag gzhan rnam dkar gyi phung po rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthu la brten nas de nyid ngan song ngan 'gro'i skye gnas su mi lhung bar dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten bzang thob/ mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes kyi rjes su bzung ste/ sa lam rim bgrod bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur du thob pa'i bsngo smon mtshams sbyor ci nus bgyis/ /brtse ba'i 'dzum dang mdza' ba'i 'bel gtam gyis/ /'grogs pa'i tshul ni dngas gsum rmi lam bzhin/ /da lta dran yul tsam las mngon sum du/ /mthong thos bral 'di snying la nad du che/ /'di snang sgyu ma'i 'ja' ris mkha' la dwangs/ /las snang 'khrul pa'i 'jigs gzugs mun ltar 'thibs/ /gar 'gro'i gdengs med bya spu rlung 'khyer 'dra/ /mgon med 'o 'dod lhang gis 'bod che skyo/ /srid gsum mi rtag ston ku'i sprin 'dra zhes/ /drang srong chen pos gsungs bzhin mngon sum du/ /mthong yang rtag 'dzin gdon gyis snying myos pas/ /long yod sos dal sdod 'di a tsa ma/ /sdug cing yid 'ong dang bral mi sdug 'phrad/ /na rga 'chi sogs gdung ba mi bzad pa/ /bye ba bsam yas da dung myong 'gyur tshul/ /bsam nas rang don 'khor rtsa gcod la 'bungs/shakyu'i dge sbyong bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/ phyi lo 1955 phyi 7 ches 34 bod 380

shing sprul zu 5 tshes 35 nyin bris pa dge'o//de lta bu 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa skad cig nyid du 'gyur ba'i chos can du mthong nas da ni 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi gnas 'di las sgrol ba'i thar pa'i lam sne zin pa zhig nges par cis kyang bya dgos snyam yang / dus chod rim bzhin song ba dang bsnun nas 'di nang gi bya gzhag la sngar bzhin mgo 'khor te de sngon dam bca' brtan po bkod pa de yang rim bzhin lhod g.yeng lta bur gyur/ dam pa de nyid eng lan du sman bcos gnang ba'i ring bu bstan 'dzin ngag dbang dang/ bu mo mkha' 'gro che ring gnyis zhing lan du slob sbyong byed pa'i skabs yin stabs sku 'tsho bzhugs ring khong gnyis kyis nyin mtshan dus drug ring zhabs 'degs gang legs zhus pa des skyes ma'i dren lan cung bsabs thub par snyam/dam pa de nyid la sbyang stobs kyi yon tan de tsam med kyang rang bzhin skyes stobs kyi blo gros che ba dang / thugs rig rno ba/ 'jon thang che ba/ gzhung bsam drang pa/ g.yo sdi med pa/ kha ri kha thug cig yin pa'i rkyen gyis rnam kun gyi grogs po nye ltos re zung la phog thug byung rkyen lha khog 'dre zhugs lta bus dam pa de nyid la ma nyes kha g.yogs kyi skur 'debs zhu mkhan yang byung yod pa dper na/ phyi rgyal ba bud med gcig gis rda sa bu gso khang du rla shas ring bsdad rjes mo la dwa phrug gcig sprod rogs zhes zhus par dam pa de nyid kyis dwa phrug mi sger la sprad lngu slad bu phrug des rang gi 'tsho ba'i thog gi dka' ngal sel thub kyang / 'tshar long byung rjes bod mi rigs kyi rig gzhung dang /goms gshis/ lhag par bod rigs kyi la rgya ma shes par bod mi'i khongs nas kha bral ba lta bu'i nyen kha yod par dgongs nas gong rim la phyi rgyal mi rigs sger khag su la yang bu tshab tu rtsa sprod gnang rgyu mi 'dug ces dgongs 'char snyan seng zhus te phyag len 38ga
